Keep the loops closed - Track every ask that lands on Kasey, from a DM, a call, an email or a Slack thread, and make sure it has an owner and a due date. Chase it so she doesn't have to. - Bump your own open items before anyone asks you about them. If something's stuck, tell us what you've already tried. - Notice what nobody's watching. Expired cards, a Zoom seat shortage before a live call, a reply Kasey owes someone from three weeks ago. - When Kasey can't be reached and something can't wait, make the call yourself, then tell her what you chose and why. Support the team - Scheduling and logistics for team calls, member 1:1s and events. - Vendor and tool admin as the Operations Manager assigns it: subscriptions, seats, renewals. - Onboarding paperwork for new hires and contractors. HOW WE'LL KNOW YOU'RE GREAT This is written from what our last EA actually did that got her promoted: - You answer the question before Kasey asks it. If there's a problem, your message has the options in it. - You write a brief she can read in ninety seconds and act on without a follow-up question. - You're the one who notices. "How long should each call run?" before building the schedule, not after. - You tell us what's on your radar so Kasey knows it's handled without having to think about it. - You lead with numbers when you report, and you bring a solution with every question. YOU'RE PROBABLY RIGHT FOR THIS IF - You've been an EA, chief of staff or operations coordinator for a founder or small leadership team, and you can show a brief, a recap or a system you built. - You write clear English fast. Slack-speed, not essay-speed. And you can say it out loud just as clearly, including on the phone with US businesses. - You're organized to a degree other people comment on. - You're confident making a judgment call on your own, and telling us about it after. - You can work 9 to 5 ET and be fully present in those hours. This is a live business. - You're comfortable with Slack, Google Calendar, Gmail, Notion, Zoom, Calendly and Loom, and you pick up new tools quickly. - You already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) in your daily work. We run on Claude and will train you on our setup. - You want this to be your one job, and you want to grow into more. Our last EA became Operations Manager in under eight months. THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF - You wait to be told. We need someone who sees the gap and moves. - You'd rather send a question than a recommendation. - You can't commit to ET hours. E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote POSITION OVERVIEW MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business. This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance. The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces. We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance • Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces. • Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items. 2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance • Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems. • Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates. • Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records. 3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support • Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates. • Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority. • Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure. • Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases. 4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring • Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications. • Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving. • Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring. • Record shipment references and organize supporting documents. • Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies. 5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support • Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems. • Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information. • Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information. 6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance • Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases. • Update records using verified emails, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications. • Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data. • Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation. • Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions. 7. Email, Communication & Task Management • Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications. • Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation. • Track outstanding requests and pending responses. • Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate. 8. Document & File Organization • Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards. • Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents. • Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions. 9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support • Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks. • Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities. • Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs. 10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement • Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation. • Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early. • Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation. • Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency. QUALIFICATIONS Required • Exper

jobs.title: Funnelish Funnel Builder + Advertorial Copywriter for E-Commerce Product Testing (Ongoing, High Volume)
jobs.description: Funnelish Funnel Builder + Advertorial Copywriter for E-Commerce Product Testing (Ongoing, High Volume) About the role I run an e-commerce brand that tests new products every weekday. Each product gets its own standalone funnel: an advertorial article, a sales/landing page, checkout, and simple upsells. Each funnel lives on its own subdomain with its own pixel. I need one reliable person to write the articles and build the funnels in Funnelish so every product is ready to go live the same day the ads are ready. Volume Up to 3 new product funnels per weekday (about 15 a week, or 60 a month) Monday through Friday only New products every day across a wide mix of niches and price points What you'll do Write the advertorial/pre-sell article for each product (roughly 800–1,500 words). Think news-style, listicle ("5 reasons why…"), or story-driven discovery pieces that warm up cold Facebook traffic before the sales page Write and build the product landing page: headline, hook, problem/solution, benefits, social proof sections, FAQ, guarantee, and strong CTAs Set up the Funnelish checkout with an order bump and 1–2 one-click upsells per funnel Build everything in Funnelish (templates provided), mobile-first, since nearly all traffic is on phones Brand each funnel as its own one-off brand (name, colors, basic look) with no tie-in to a main store Hook up the per-funnel tracking pixel and test the full flow from ad click to article to landing page to checkout to upsell before handoff Build from reusable templates so funnels get faster and more consistent over time When an ad's angle is winning, adjust the article and page to match it What I'll provide Product name, supplier link, images and specs Target customer and the main angle/selling point The 3 ad angles being tested, so the article matches the ads Subdomain, pixel, and Funnelish access for each funnel Feedback on conversion rates and drop-off so we can improve what works Must-haves A portfolio of direct-response funnels, landing pages, or advertorials you've written and/or built. Please send live links or screenshots Strong direct-response copywriting: you know the difference between a pre-sell article and a sales page, and why both matter Experience building in Funnelish is strongly preferred. Experience with similar builders (ClickFunnels, GemPages, Replo, Shopify page builders) is OK if you can pick up Funnelish quickly Mobile-first design sense: clean, fast, and easy to read on a phone Speed and consistency. You can deliver 3 complete funnels per weekday Attention to detail: broken links, wrong prices, or a missing pixel kill a test Nice-to-haves Experience with Funnelish's built-in checkout, order bumps, and one-click upsells Experience with Facebook/Meta ad traffic and how cold traffic converts Understanding of conversion metrics: CTR to the page, add-to-cart, checkout rate, upsell take rate Basic image editing (Canva/Photoshop) for page graphics and product images Comfort with AI writing tools, provided you edit everything so it reads human and persuasive Turnaround Full funnel (article, landing page, checkout, upsells) live and tested within 24 hours of receiving the product brief Pay $20 per finished funnel (article, landing page, checkout, and upsells, live and tested) At full volume that's up to 15 funnels a week ($300/week), or about 60 a month ($1,200/month) Paid test first: 1 complete funnel at the same $20 rate before we start ongoing work Bonuses for funnels that become winners To apply Send 2–3 links or screenshots of funnels, landing pages, or advertorials you've built or written Tell me whether you've built in Funnelish before, which other page builders you've used, and your typical turnaround Answer this: "Write a headline and opening paragraph for an advertorial selling a portable rechargeable mini blender." Start your message with the word "FUNNEL" so I know you read the whole post

jobs.title: Fast, Scroll-Stopping Video Ad Creator for E-Commerce Product Testing (Ongoing, High Volume)
jobs.description: Hiring: Fast, Scroll-Stopping Video Ad Creator for E-Commerce Product Testing (Ongoing, High Volume) About the role I run an e-commerce brand that tests new products every weekday. Each product gets its own funnel and its own set of video ads on Facebook/Instagram. I'm looking for one reliable creator to make all of my ad videos. The goal isn't pretty brand films. It's ads that stop the scroll, explain the product in seconds, and get people to click and buy. Volume * Up to 3 new products per weekday, with 3 video ads per product (about 9 ads a day, 45 a week) * Monday through Friday only * New products every day across a wide mix of niches and price points What you'll do * Make 3 distinct short-form video ads per product (15–45 seconds, 9:16 vertical, plus 1:1 or 4:5 when needed) * Give each ad a different angle, such as problem/solution, demo/unboxing style, UGC/testimonial style, or a "you need this because…" hook * Write or adapt the hooks, on-screen text, and captions * Source and edit footage: supplier clips, stock, AI-generated visuals and AI voiceover, AI UGC, Any other types * Add trending-style captions, music, sound effects, and fast pacing * Deliver named, organized files (product / angle / version) in a shared folder * Turn around new ads quickly when a product almost hits and gets a retest What I'll provide * Product name, product page or supplier link, and any images or video I have * A short brief with the target customer and the main selling point * Feedback on which ads are winning so you can lean into what works Must-haves * A portfolio of direct-response e-commerce or dropshipping ads (TikTok/Meta style). Please send links, not just a resume * You understand hooks: the first 2 seconds d ---------- everything * Speed and consistency. You can deliver 9 ads per weekday without quality dropping off * Comfort with CapCut, Premiere, or similar, plus AI video, image, and voice tools (Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, etc.) * Clear communication and on-time delivery Nice-to-haves * You can shoot your own UGC-style footage with products * Experience with Meta Ads Manager and an understanding of CTR, hook rate, and ROAS * Experience with problem/solution or "gadget" style products Turnaround * Ads are due within 24 hours of receiving the product brief Pay * $60 per product set of 3, I will be needing about 45 total ads per week so once i find the right hire we will get you on a weekly salary of about $900-$1000 * Paid test first: 1 product (3 ads) before we start ongoing work * Bonuses for ads that become winners To apply 1. Send 3–5 links to ads you've made that you think performed well, and tell me why 2. Tell me what tools you use and your typical turnaround 3. Answer this: "What would your 3 hooks be for a portable rechargeable mini blender?" 4. Start your message with the word "HOOK" so I know you read the whole post

jobs.description: 𝗲𝗕𝗮𝘆 & 𝗪𝗮𝗹𝗺𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝗔𝗰𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗻𝘁 𝗦𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁 𝗩𝗔 – 𝗟𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁, 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗽𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗹𝘆 𝗪𝗛𝗢 𝗪𝗘 𝗔𝗥𝗘 We are a US-based beauty company (14 years in business) selling on Amazon, eBay and Walmart, with customers in the USA, Europe, UK, Japan, Singapore and more. We need a full-time VA who can run our eBay and Walmart stores day to day without needing close supervision. 𝗦𝗖𝗛𝗘𝗗𝗨𝗟𝗘 & 𝗣𝗔𝗬 • 𝗙𝘂𝗹𝗹 𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲, 40-50 hrs/week, Mon–Fri, 8:45 AM – 5:15 PM Pacific Time, with occasional weekend coverage when needed = 12:45 AM – 9:15 AM Philippine Time (Nov–Mar) / 11:45 PM – 8:15 AM PH Time (Mar–Nov) • $3.50 – $5.50/hr depending on experience, with a raise review after a 3-month probation • Paid US public holidays, paid every two weeks, hours tracked with Hubstaff 𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗬𝗢𝗨'𝗟𝗟 𝗗𝗢 • Create and improve eBay and Walmart listings: titles, bullets, descriptions, item specifics, images, variations • Upload items in bulk (Walmart Seller Center templates, eBay bulk tools) and fix errors and unpublished items • Keep pricing (Informed.co), inventory and promotions accurate • Handle orders, cancellations, returns and refunds, and record them in our system • Answer buyer messages within 24 hours and handle eBay cases and Walmart disputes • Watch account health (eBay seller level, Walmart on-time delivery, cancellation and return rates) and fix problems early • Review how products are selling and suggest improvements to content, pricing, reviews and promotions • Find bundle and upsell ideas and new products to list • Amazon Seller Central experience is a plus 𝗠𝗨𝗦𝗧 𝗛𝗔𝗩𝗘 • 1+ year of hands-on eBay and/or Walmart experience, including creating listings yourself • Careful with details, patient, and proactive: you spot problems and fix them without being told • Reliable PC, stable internet, and a backup for power and internet • Good written English 𝗛𝗢𝗪 𝗧𝗢 𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗟𝗬 – 𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗗 𝗖𝗔𝗥𝗘𝗙𝗨𝗟𝗟𝗬 • Put the word "BEAUTY" in your subject line so we know you read the whole post. • Copy each question number and answer EVERY question in full. 𝗤𝗨𝗘𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦 𝗲𝗕𝗮𝘆 & 𝗪𝗮𝗹𝗺𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 1) Your eBay/Walmart experience. jobs.title: Real Estate Accountant
jobs.description: Real Estate Accountant Beacons Group LLC Part-Time · Remote · Compensation: DOE About Beacons Beacons is a family-owned real estate investment company based in Rancho Santa Fe, California. We own and operate a growing portfolio of long-term rental properties, renovation and resale projects, and a short-term rental, held across multiple LLCs. We are an active buyer — including acquisitions funded through 1031 exchanges — and we run our financial operations with the discipline of a much larger firm: property-level books, a fixed month-end close calendar, and weekly reporting by property. The Role The Real Estate Accountant owns the day-to-day accounting for the portfolio. You will keep clean, property-level books, run the month-end close on schedule, and produce the weekly and monthly reporting ownership relies on to make acquisition, financing, and renovation decisions. This is a hands-on, part-time, fully remote role in a small, fast-moving family office — accuracy and follow-through matter more here than hierarchy. Key Responsibilities • Maintain complete, accurate books for each property and LLC, with every transaction coded to the correct property, category, and cost center • Run the month-end close on a fixed calendar — statements and cutoff, reconciliations, journal entries and variance review, reporting package, sign-off, and period lock — completed by day 7 • Produce weekly profit & loss and cash flow reporting by property and consolidated in Reach, plus a consolidated monthly balance sheet • Reconcile all bank, credit card, and loan accounts monthly; research and clear exceptions promptly • Manage rental accounting: rent rolls, tenant ledgers, and security deposit accounting • Account for a variety of debt — conventional mortgages, interest-only private loans, a HELOC, and construction/bridge financing — including principal, interest, and escrow breakouts from lender statements • Record balance sheet entries for real estate investment activity: acquisitions, dispositions, loan fundings and payoffs, escrow and earnest money deposits, 1031 exchange balances, and capital contributions and distributions • Track renovation and construction costs by property (job costing), including budget vs. actual and contractor payment history • Support acquisitions and dispositions: review closing statements, post settlement entries, coordinate with escrow, and track 1031 exchange funds and deadlines • Book tax entries in a separate, dedicated location so property-level operating results stay clean • Prepare annual tax workpapers (Schedule E), depreciation schedules, and supporting documentation for the outside CPA • Track insurance, property tax, HOA, and utility obligations by property so nothing lapses • Work in Digits for accounting and Reach for reporting; keep supporting documentation attached to transactions and maintain an organized digital file system (Google Drive) • Use and help improve AI-driven automation in the accounting workflow — automated transaction categorization, reconciliations, and reporting — reviewing automated work for accuracy before it is final • Flag discrepancies, duplicates, and unusual items for review rather than booking around them Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience • 3–5+ years of accounting experience, including at least 2 years in real estate or property management accounting • Multi-entity, multi-property accounting experience required • Expert-level reconciliation skills and strong Excel / Google Sheets ability • Working knowledge of loan amortization, escrow accounting, and closing statements • Familiarity with 1031 exchanges a strong plus • Experience with Digits and Reach reporting strongly preferred • AI automation experience required — direct, hands-on experience applying AI and automation tools to accounting processes (categorization, reconciliation, reporting, or workflow automation) • A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership — you spot what needs doing, figure things out on your own, and follow through to done • Exceptional attention to detail, comfort with deadlines, and the judgment to ask before guessing • CPA or CPA-track a plus, but not required Use 3 credits And title response “experienced real estate accountant”

THE ROLE IN ONE PARAGRAPH You'll work under our Finance Manager, who owns the books and signs off every close. The job has two halves. The first is hands-on bookkeeping: you'll take over daily entries and reconciliations from an outsourced provider, and today most of that work is manual and high-volume. The second is shrinking that manual work: you'll build AI agents, automations and simple systems that take over the repetitive parts, so the books get faster and more accurate every month. You need to be good at both. WHAT YOU'LL DO Daily - Record every transaction in QuickBooks Online for each entity, including sales, payouts, processor fees, refunds and adjustments that don't sync automatically. - Categorize every transaction against the chart of accounts (ad spend, COGS, shipping and fulfillment, SaaS, contractors) and by brand, and suggest changes to the chart for the Finance Manager to approve. - Check the daily fulfillment partner bills against the orders shipped, and flag any billing errors before they are paid. - Handle payables and receivables: enter vendor bills, prepare payment runs for the Finance Manager to approve, and track refunds, processor reserves and receipts. Weekly - Send the Finance Manager a cash position for each entity, to feed the cash forecast. - Track chargebacks and disputes from open to closed, and book losses and reserve releases. Monthly - Prepare the month-end close for every entity on a fixed calendar (accruals, prepaids, deferrals and adjusting entries), ready for the Finance Manager to review and sign off. - Reconcile all bank, credit card, loan and balance sheet accounts. - Reconcile Shopify sales, refunds, discounts, chargebacks and fees against payouts from Shopify Payments, PayPal, Stripe and other processors. - Reconcile Amazon Seller Central settlement reports (fees, refunds, reserves, FBA charges) to deposits. - Book ad spend from Meta, Google and other ad platform invoices and match it to card charges. - Book subscription and membership revenue correctly, including deferred revenue for annual plans. - Record and reconcile intercompany transactions and balances between entities, keeping consolidated books accurate and audit-ready. - Book inventory, landed costs and COGS. - Record payroll and contractor payments. - Reconcile sales tax collected and payable against the filings managed in Numeral. - Reconcile our management spreadsheets to QuickBooks, and help move them into one source of truth. - Review software subscriptions and flag any that are unused or duplicated. - Draft a P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statement for each entity, plus consolidated views and a contribution margin view for each brand, for the Finance Manager to review. Yearly and ongoing - Prepare schedules and supporting documents for year-end: the US tax package and 1099s with our CPA, and the Hong Kong audit and profits tax filings with our auditors and company secretary. - Write down every recurring process, so the books are always audit-ready and easy to hand over. - When an error keeps coming back, raise it with the Finance Manager and suggest a fix to the process. Building automation - Find the most repetitive, error-prone tasks in the books and automate them first, such as transaction categorization, payout matching, fulfillment bill checks, receipt collection and intercompany entries. - Build and maintain AI agents and automations for finance, for example an agent that matches Shopify and processor payouts to bank deposits, or one that flags unusual transactions before the close. - Connect our tools (QuickBooks Online, Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, PayPal, Numeral, Google Sheets) through their APIs or automation platforms. - Document how each automation works, what it touches and how to switch it off, so someone else can run it. - Track how many hours each automation saves and its error rate, and report both to the Finance Manager every month. What You'll Do ● Deliver solutions across operations, finance, marketing and member experience, from approved plan to tested, production-ready release ● Determine the technical approach where no API or standard integration exists, and present options with trade-offs before building ● Use AI coding agents (mainly Claude Code) to build custom apps, internal tools, integrations and features from scratch, front end and back end ● Build automations from the ground up, in n8n where it's the right tool and custom code where it isn't ● Develop and maintain our internal dashboard and the systems behind it ● Move existing scripts and data jobs off local machines into reliable, hosted, monitored setups ● Build AI agents and AI assistants that work with our own data and systems, such as answering questions from internal documents or handling repetitive tasks end to end ● Identify technical risks, gaps in requirements and more effective implementation options, before and during delivery ● Manage each build end to end: estimate, build, test, deploy, monitor, and report progress and outcomes to your lead ● Follow a clear release process: propose, build on a development branch, review with your lead, test, then release. You direct them, review every change, test it, and can debug and fix it yourself when the agent gets stuck. ● Experience building AI agents and RAG systems: you've built at least one agent that uses tools or takes actions, and at least one system that answers from a company's own documents or data (retrieval-augmented generation) ● Comfortable across the stack: front end, back end, databases and APIs ● Strong execution against specifications: delivers to plan with precision, and clarifies ambiguity early instead of making assumptions ● End-to-end technical ownership: estimates, builds, tests, documents, deploys, monitors and resolves issues after release ● Clear, proactive communication: gives realistic estimates, reports progress, and escalates blockers early ● Versatile problem-solver: comfortable jumping between very different problems, and learns new tools, APIs and systems fast ● Thrives in the unknown: comfortable with messy data, missing documentation, no API and no ready-made solution ● Experience with n8n or similar automation tools (self-hosted n8n is a plus) ● Documents work clearly ● Good English, self-driven, and works independently ● Improvement mindset (a plus): notices inefficiencies and automation opportunities while building, and brings them to your lead with a short recommendation Tools Experience Must Have: ● Claude Code ● JavaScrip

jobs.description: We run a local direct-mail co-op postcard campaign that puts trusted local businesses directly into 5,000 mailboxes in different communities. Each business gets an exclusive spot for their industry on a large, high-gloss mailer, no competitors allowed on the same card. We are looking for a sharp, confident cold caller to reach local business owners during U.S. daytime hours, pitch open category spots, handle objections smoothly, and simply warm up leads and grab their emails for me to close the rest from there. SCHEDULE AND PAY: Hours: Part-time, 10-15 hours a week during U.S. Time business hours Pay: $9 an hour base + $20 per lead that ends up buying. WHAT YOU WILL DO: Call local business owners and decision-makers (home services, restaurants, fitness, auto, local retail, etc.) from a provided local lead list. Deliver a natural, conversational opener explaining the upcoming neighborhood mailer and letting them know their industry category is still open. Handle common small-business objections calmly and persuasively (like "I don't do print ads," "Send me an email," "How much does it cost?" or "We're already busy") without sounding pushy or scripted. Grab emails of interested prospects that are warmed up for me to close the deal. Log call outcomes, notes, and follow-ups accurately in our sheet/CRM. REQUIREMENTS AND SETUP: Clear, natural, friendly English with American conversational pacing and tone, you must sound like someone a local U.S. business owner would actually enjoy talking to. Must not have heavy foreign accents, must sound local. Proven outbound cold calling or telesales experience (experience calling U.S. small business owners is a huge plus). Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet room, and a quality noise-canceling headset/mic. Does not let rejection bother you, quick thinking, coachability, and comfort using a dialer and basic spreadsheet/CRM.

jobs.title: KDP Book Production Specialist: Formatting, AI Tools & Quality Control
jobs.description: We are a British publishing company looking for a careful, reliable person to research, create and produce AI-assisted books for Amazon KDP. You will take books from research to upload-ready files: researching topics, writing and editing with AI tools, proofreading, formatting, quality control, images, covers and A+ Content. This is a hands-on production role. It needs someone who reads instructions closely, keeps track of their own tasks and fixes mistakes without being reminded. TO SHOW YOU HAVE READ THIS POST, START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "KDP READY". Responsibilities - Research book topics, competitors and keywords - Write and edit books using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini), following our prompts and SOPs - Manually proofread the full text of each book, up to 30,000 words at times, checking grammar, facts, repeated or missing content and consistency - Format interiors for paperback, hardcover and eBook (Atticus, Word, Canva) - Check margins, gutters, bleed, trim size and page count against KDP requirements - Create interior images and covers with AI tools and Canva - Build A+ Content and prepare KDP uploads and metadata - Keep a task list, acknowledge every request and post daily status updates - Spot problems before publication and suggest fixes Requirements - Excellent written English and clear spoken English (we use video calls) - Very strong attention to detail, with the patience to proofread long texts carefully - Hands-on formatting experience with Atticus, Word or similar tools - Comfortable with AI tools, including AI image generation - Reads instructions carefully, asks when unsure, and does not repeat the same mistake - Works independently, takes constructive feedback well and takes ownership of errors - Hours: 9am to 5pm UK time, Monday to Friday (currently 5pm to 1am Philippines time), camera on for calls - Reliable internet and power backup KDP experience is an advantage but not essential. Strong formatting and attention to detail matter most. Shortlisted candidates complete a short, paid skills test before any offer. HOW TO APPLY: Answer every question below in your OWN words. Short, specific answers are better than polished ones. Applications that look copied from ChatGPT or other AI tools will be rejected. Questions 1. Start with "KDP READY". Where are you located, and are you currently working for another employer or client? 2. Rate yourself from 1 (beginner) to 5 (expert) and say how many years or books you have used each tool for. Write "never used" if that applies. - Microsoft Word - Canva - Atticus - Affinity Publisher or Adobe InDesign - Kindle Create or Draft2Digital - Grammarly or other proofreading tools - Any other formatting or design tools 3. Which AI tools do you use right now? For each one, tell us your current plan (free or paid, for example "ChatGPT Plus $20 a month" or "Gemini free") and what you use it for. 4. Have you written or helped write a book or long document with AI, chapter by chapter? Describe your process and how you checked the facts. 5. AI images: which tools have you used, and how do you keep characters and style consistent across a whole book? Share links to examples. 6. Tell us about a real mistake you made at work. What happened, and what did you change afterwards? 7. Your manager says on Tuesday, "Adjust the margins, it's not urgent." On Friday they ask you to check your task list for anything missing. What do you do, and why? 8. List the five checks you would run before publishing a 30,000-word book, in order, and say why the first one is most important. Please provide - Resume/CV: open link (no access request needed) - Portfolio: open link to formatted interiors, covers, Canva work or AI images - A 60 to 90 second video or voice message (Google Drive, Loom or similar link): introduce yourself and describe one book you worked on Only applications that answer all questions and include accessible links and the video or voice message will be considered. This is a long-term role for someone who wants to build a career in publishing.

jobs.title: Short-Form Video Editor for social media
jobs.description: We run an Instagram page built around Mel, a dog groomer character who specializes in doodles. Mel isn't a real person — she's fully AI-generated. Every video is made in Veo 3. The page is growing and the bottleneck is production. We need someone who can sit down, generate, and deliver finished Reels without us hand-holding every prompt. What you'll do: Generate 6–10 finished Reels per week (20–40 seconds each) in Veo 3 Keep Mel consistent — same face, same hair, same salon, same voice, every single video. This is the hardest part of the job and the main thing we're hiring for. Build scenes around a simple brief we give you: a dog, a grooming problem, a transformation, a product moment Iterate on prompts until the shot is right. Most usable clips take several generations — that's expected, not a failure. Assemble clips into a finished vertical Reel: pacing, cuts, captions, sound Fix the AI tells before delivery — warped hands, morphing dogs, text glitches, uncanny motion. If it looks like AI slop, it doesn't ship. Deliver in 9:16, ready to post, on a set weekly schedule Track what works — pull IG insights and our affiliate numbers into a simple weekly sheet so we know which hooks and formats to make more of What you're NOT doing: no posting (we publish), no writing captions or affiliate links, no customer messages. Produce and report — that's the role. Tools — we provide everything: You'll get logins for our Veo 3 access, editing software, and voice tools. You don't need to pay for anything. You do need a computer and internet that can handle generating and downloading video all day. What we're looking for: Hands-on Veo 3 experience. Not "I've used AI tools" — actual Veo 3 or Flow output you can show us. A real method for character consistency across generations. If you know why this is hard, you're the person we want. If you don't, this role will frustrate both of us. Strong prompt writing — you can describe a camera angle, a lighting setup, and a dog's coat texture in a way the model actually follows Video editing in CapCut, Premiere, or Resolve — enough to cut, caption, and sound-design a Reel Taste. You can tell the difference between a video that looks real and one that looks like AI. Most people can't. Patient and systematic. This job is 80% iteration. Someone who gets discouraged by bad generations will hate it. Comfortable with basic spreadsheets for the weekly performance report A few hours of overlap with US Eastern Time Good written English Bonus: you know dogs, or you're willing to learn what a badly groomed doodle actually looks like The setup: 20 hours per week, part-time, long-term ₱28,000 – ₱40,000/month depending on experience, paid twice monthly via Wise Paid trial project before we commit long-term (details below) Clear briefs, weekly check-in, no micromanaging How to apply: Send us: Links to AI-generated video you personally made — Veo 3, Flow, Kling, Runway, Sora, whatever. Vertical short-form preferred. Tell us which model and what your prompt approach was. Your answer to this: How do you keep the same character looking identical across 10 different AI-generated videos? Two or three sentences. We're testing whether you've actually done this. Roughly how many generations it takes you to get one usable 8-second clip, honestly. Your available hours in Philippine time. Start your message with the word "DOODLE" so we know you read the post. No video samples, no review. We're hiring one person for the long haul, so put a little effort in — we will too. SKILL REQUIREMENTS (tag these on the listing) Video Editing · AI Video Generation · Prompt Engineering · Content Creation · Instagram · CapCut · Adobe Premiere Pro · Social Media Marketing · Attention to Detail

jobs.title: Healthcare Technical Support
jobs.description: • Pay: USD 950 a month base, plus performance incentives. Our top performers take home about USD 1,100 to 1,200 a month. • Shift: Monday to Friday, US Eastern daytime in staggered shifts between 8 AM and 8 PM, with some weekend shifts and on-call turns (a night shift in Manila) • Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off • Where: fully remote A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE An 81-year-old patient calls ten minutes before his video visit. His tablet screen is dark and he is not sure it is charged. You stay calm, find out what he sees, get the tablet charging and on Wi-Fi, and get him into the visit before his nurse gives up waiting. THE JOB Our patients are mostly older adults at home in the US with heart failure or COPD. They see their care team by video on a tablet we send them, and their pulse oximeter and blood pressure monitor send readings to us. When something stops working, you are the person who fixes it, often by walking a patient who is not comfortable with technology through it one step at a time. You take about 50 calls a day from patients and clinicians: a tablet that will not join a visit, a device that stopped sending readings, a clinician who needs help in Athenahealth. You own each problem until it is solved, and you write clear reports for our engineers when something needs a fix on their side. ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines. WHAT YOU NEED • 2 or more years in technical or customer support where you solved technology problems for customers • Tech savviness: you pick up new devices and tools quickly (Android tablets, Zoom, Google Workspace) • A friendly, patient way of helping older adults in the US, in clear English • Reliable high-speed internet and availability for this shift for the long term Experience with Samsung Knox or another device-management tool, remote monitoring devices, Athenahealth, or an issue tracker such as GitLab is a plus. jobs.title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer (Star Wars) - Thumbnails for Lore and Explainer Videos
jobs.description: We're hiring a thumbnail designer for a new YouTube channel of Star Wars lore videos: narrated explainers, rankings and "every type of…" breakdowns, 15–30 minutes long, about the characters, ships, armies and history of the galaxy. For each video you'll receive the title and a short summary, and you'll hand back a finished thumbnail in two versions. We're looking for someone to work with us on an ongoing basis. A thumbnail has one job: make the right viewer click. This audience knows the universe in detail, so the details have to be right. A clone in the wrong legion's markings, or a lightsaber with the wrong hilt, loses them before they click. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Read the title and summary and pick the one picture worth the click: a character, a ship, a creature or a line-up. - Build it from scratch. Create or source the art, cut it out clean, and light it so it stands off a dark background. - Fix what AI image tools get wrong: helmets, hands, hilts, symbols and armour markings. - Add 1–4 words that tease the video instead of repeating the title. - Deliver 2 versions of each thumbnail so we can test them against each other with YouTube's Test & Compare. - Check every thumbnail at phone size before you send it. - Save the layered source file (PSD or similar) next to each export in our shared Google Drive. THE STYLE - One subject fills a third to half of the frame, sharp and saturated, on black or deep space. - The colour comes from the subject: a lightsaber's glow on a face, a red rim light on a Sith, engine light on a hull. - The words are heavy capitals in white with one word in yellow or red, such as "NEVER REPAIRED", "HE KNEW." or "WHO BUILT IT?". - At most one arrow, from the words to the thing they're about. - For "every type" and ranking videos: three vertical panels, each with one character over its own colour and a one- or two-word label under it. - For long documentaries: a film poster look, with one painted scene and a title. - No emojis, borders, logos or clutter. Every thumbnail must show something the video really covers, and follow YouTube's thumbnail policies. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - A portfolio of YouTube thumbnails you designed yourself, ideally for Star Wars, film, gaming, anime or other lore channels. - Strong Photoshop skills (or similar): cut-outs, lighting, glow, colour grading and type. - Experience with AI image tools, and the eye to finish their output by hand so it looks film-accurate. - A good knowledge of Star Wars: the films, The Clone Wars and the main games and books. You can tell a Phase I clone helmet from a Phase II. - An eye for what gets clicks. You study what's working in a niche and can explain why a thumbnail works. - Good written English, so the words on a thumbnail are short and correct. - Reliable deadlines and clear communication. - Bonus: experience with YouTube's Test & Compare. Workload: To start, 4–5 videos a week, each with 2 thumbnail versions. This will grow. Turnaround: Within 24 hours of receiving the title and summary. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the word "blueberry" and include: 1. Your email address 2. Your portfolio link (Behance, Google Drive or similar, set so anyone with the link can view) 3. Links to 3–5 YouTube videos that use thumbnails you designed (link the videos, not image files), the channel each one is for, and what you did on each 4. The YouTube channels you've designed thumbnails for, when, and how many thumbnails a week you made for each (or "none yet") 5. How you made one of the thumbnails you linked: where each picture in it came from, the tools you used and how long it took 6. Your current workload: how many thumbnails you design in a typical week, for how many clients, and how many more a week you could take on for us 7. A sample thumbnail (1280 x 720) for this imaginary video, "Why the Empire Stopped Using Clone Troopers", made for this application and shared as a Google Drive link anyone can view 8. The software you use, including any AI image tools 9. Your expected rate (per thumbnail or per month) 10. How quickly you usually deliver a thumbnail after receiving a brief, and the hours you work (Philippine time) 11. Your ---------- username Applications that skip the code word or any of items 1–11 won't be reviewed.

jobs.title: Experienced social media Clipping  Manager

Escalate issues to platform support when needed. - Set up creator-specific tracking and preserve referral information through landing pages, applications, bookings, and customer records. - Match customer bonuses to verified payments and refunds under the agreed rules. - Maintain a budget and performance dashboard covering delivery, traffic, qualified applications, attended calls, customers, collections, refunds, and acquisition cost. - Recommend improvements based on actual results. We need someone who can run the daily operation independently, keep records organized, and bring problems to us with evidence and a proposed solution. **Required experience** - Personally managed at least two paid clipping campaigns, including submission reviews and creator payment checks. - Hands-on experience with Content Rewards beyond submitting your own clips. - Experience reviewing suspicious traffic and documenting fraud investigations. - Ability to distinguish genuine low-converting traffic from evidence of manipulated engagement. - Experience maintaining campaign budgets, tracking links, spreadsheets, or CRM reports. - Strong written English, reliable communication, and consistent follow-through. **Strong advantages** - Previous work with trading educators, traders, financial creators, or online mentorship businesses. - Experience connecting short-form content to YouTube training, applications, sales calls, and verified purchases. - Experience measuring paid membership acquisition and renewals. - Ability to write practical procedures and train clippers to follow them. **How to apply** Start your application with **CLIPPING OPERATOR** and answer these questions: 1. **Describe two clipping campaigns you personally managed.** Include the niche, approximate budget, platforms, number of active clippers, your responsibilities, and results you can substantiate. 2. **Show your Content Rewards experience.** Share a short Loom walkthrough or screenshots demonstrating your campaign-management work. Use material you have permission to share and redact confidential information. 3. **Describe a specific fraud investigation.** What raised your concern, what evidence did you check, what action did you take, and what happened? Distinguish confirmed findings from suspicions. 4. **Explain your screening process.** How would you vet a clipper and review a suspicious submission before recommending payment? 5. **Explain your tracking experience.** How have you tracked clips through to leads or sales? What tools did you use, and how did you handle missing attribution? 6. **Describe any trading-industry experience.** Who did you work with, and what was your exact role? 7. **Provide your expected part-time rate, weekly availability, availability for Pacific Time check-ins, and earliest start date.** Applications must include specific answers and evidence of relevant experience. Shortlisted applicants will be interviewed and complete a paid trial assignment. We are looking for an experienced operator who can build a reliable clipping operation and help us judge success through real business results.

jobs.title: JerseyBird Long Form Documentary Editor
jobs.description: JerseyBird is one of the most followed teamwear brands in the world. We design custom kits for clubs and schools, and we make JerseyBird on Tour, a documentary series on YouTube: 50 states, 50 stops, 50 stories. In each episode we travel to a team we made kits for and tell the story of the program, the people and the town. Here is episode one: ---------- That episode is where we started, not where we are going. We love the animations in it and we want more of that. The pacing and polish are what we believe can be improved, and the next episodes have to be a clear level above it. We are hiring one long-form documentary editor to own these episodes from raw footage to the final upload-ready file. This is not a role for a short-form editor. We need two things in one person: 1. A real filmmaker. You understand story, pacing, tension and emotion, and you have the hard skills to finish a film: edit, color, sound. 2. AI forward. The animations in episode one were built with an AI-assisted After Effects workflow. You already use AI tools in your motion graphics and editing, and you keep finding new ones. AI makes your work faster and better. It does not replace your taste. THE WORK - One episode a month, 30 to 60 minutes each, plus other JerseyBird documentaries as the show grows. - You receive organized footage, a full script with clip IDs and timestamps, transcripts of every clip, recorded voiceover and reference material. - You deliver the finished episode. That means all of it: - Story edit: pacing, structure, tension, emotion. The script is the backbone, and you make it work on screen. - Motion graphics and animation: title cards, name lower thirds, location tags, animated travel maps, player cards and squad screens, on-screen breakdowns with circles and arrows. - Captions in one consistent style from start to finish. - Color correction and grade. - Sound design, music edit and final mix. - Every graphic is built new for each episode. Nothing is lifted from an old video. PAY - $30 USD per finished minute of the approved final episode. A 40 minute episode pays $1,200. - Two rounds of revisions are included in the rate. - Paid per episode on approval. - A retention bonus on top of the rate when an episode beats our audience retention target on YouTube. REQUIREMENTS - At least 2 long-form documentaries (15 minutes or longer) that you edited yourself. - Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. This is required. You deliver the final file and the full project with organized media. - Strong motion graphics and animation skills, with AI tools as part of how you work. You build the graphics yourself. - Color and audio finishing skills. - A computer and internet connection that can handle large 4K projects. - Clear written English. You read a detailed script and follow it, and you speak up when something on the page does not work on screen. - You hit deadlines and you check your own work. No black frames, no missing lower thirds, no unfinished endings in a cut you send us. - Sports documentary experience is a plus. A love of soccer is a bigger one. HOW TO APPLY Put the words "Fifty stops" in the subject line so we know you read this. Then send: 1. Links to 2 or 3 long-form documentaries (15 minutes or longer) you edited. 2. For each one, exactly what you did yourself: edit, graphics, color, sound. If someone else did part of it, say so. 3. Watch episode one and tell us two things you would change to take it up a level. 4. The AI tools you use today and one example of work you made with them (a link or a short clip). 5. Your usual turnaround for a 30 minute documentary. The strongest applicants get a paid test: a 2 to 3 minute sequence cut from our real footage, with graphics. The hire is made from that test. Applications without long-form samples will not be read.

jobs.title: Credentialing and Billing Specialist
jobs.description: Position Summary: The Credentialing and Billing Specialist manages provider credentialing and payer enrollment and supports accurate, timely billing for ASun Star’s behavioral health and related services in New Jersey and Pennsylvania. The specialist tracks each provider’s enrollment status by payer, program, and service location, then applies that information to billing so claims are submitted under the correct provider and location. This role works closely with clinical leadership, intake, scheduling, and finance to resolve credentialing, authorization, and claims issues that can delay reimbursement. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Credentialing and Payer Enrollment Prepare, submit, and track initial credentialing, recredentialing, enrollment, and revalidation applications for individual providers and ASun Star entities, as applicable. Maintain current provider records, including licenses, NPIs, taxonomy codes, malpractice insurance, and CAQH profiles and attestations where required. Coordinate payer roster updates, group affiliations, practice location additions, and provider departures across New Jersey and Pennsylvania. Confirm and document payer approvals and effective dates by provider, program, and location. Communicate enrollment status and billing start dates to leadership, intake, and scheduling. Track renewal deadlines, follow up on outstanding applications, and escalate delays that may affect service scheduling or reimbursement. Billing and Claims Follow-Up Verify insurance eligibility, benefits, and authorization requirements. Monitor authorization dates and remaining units where applicable, and flag gaps to the appropriate team. Review claims against service records and payer requirements. Check dates of service, procedure codes, modifiers, units, place of service, and rendering and billing provider information before submission. Submit claims and monitor clearinghouse and payer responses for rejected, denied, or unpaid claims. Investigate discrepancies, coordinate corrections with the responsible staff, and submit corrected claims, reconsiderations, or appeals within payer deadlines. Review remittance advice and coordinate with finance to reconcile payments, adjustments, and outstanding balances. Maintain a follow-up list for aging claims and report recurring issues, including credentialing mismatches, authorization gaps, and documentation delays. Compliance and Reporting: Maintain organized, audit-ready credentialing and billing records and protect confidential provider and client information in accordance with HIPAA and ASun Star policies. Provide regular updates on pending enrollments, upcoming renewals, claim denials, aging balances, and issues that require leadership action. Identify recurring problems and recommend workflow improvements to reduce preventable denials and payment delays. Qualifications: Required High school diploma or equivalent. At least two years of experience in healthcare credentialing, provider enrollment, or medical billing, with hands-on experience in both credentialing and claims follow-up. Working knowledge of insurance eligibility, prior authorizations, claims submission, remittance advice, and denial resolution. Familiarity with CAQH, payer portals, electronic health record or practice management systems, clearinghouses, and Excel. Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines, maintain accurate records, and communicate clearly with payers and internal teams. Preferred: Experience billing for outpatient mental health, substance use disorder treatment, applied behavior analysis (ABA), or other behavioral health services. Experience with New Jersey and Pennsylvania Medicaid, managed care organizations, or commercial insurance plans. Experience enrolling individual providers and group practices across multiple locations. A relevant credential such as Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) or Certified Professional Biller (CPB).

What This Role Actually Is You are the engine that keeps content moving every day — from the planning stage all the way through to publishing. You will build the content plans, write the hooks and captions, track what is trending, and then bring all of that to life across platforms on schedule. You bring enough of your own judgment to catch what is working, flag what is not, and suggest adjustments in real time. We are not looking for someone who only follows instructions with no instincts of their own. We want someone with a genuine feel for short vertical video who can plan strategically, execute at a high level, and speak up when something is not landing. What We Are Looking For 1. You can plan content that actually drives results You build monthly content plans that include filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Every piece aligns with our content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals so each video moves people toward a clear next step. 2. You have a real feel for short vertical video You understand pacing, hooks, text overlay timing, and what makes a piece of content stop the scroll. You track current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turn them into content ideas that fit our brand — not just follow trends blindly. 3. You can execute at volume, reliably You manage content calendars, schedule and publish across multiple platforms, and keep everything organized without things falling through the cracks — especially during launch periods when volume increases. You keep a clean, organized tracker so the team always knows what is approved, filmed, and scheduled. 4. You write hooks that stop the scroll and captions that sound human You write on-screen text hooks that make people stop scrolling. Your captions feel like a real conversation, not a sales pitch. You have a natural sense of voice and can write in a style that sounds like the person posting — not like generic marketing copy. 5. You are proactive, not just responsive You flag what is underperforming, suggest small tweaks, and bring ideas to the table — without needing to own the entire strategic direction. You know the difference between "I have a suggestion" and "I am going to change the plan." 6. You are highly organized and communicative You meet deadlines without being chased, you do not go quiet when things get busy, and you are comfortable working inside an established system with clear processes. You submit plans on a set schedule and revise them quickly based on feedback. 7. You are comfortable working under direction from the brand owner This role reports into content direction set by Keenya. You should want that structure, not resent it. You take direction well and give thoughtful input without needing to own every decision. jobs.description: About Us We are a Los Angeles property management company with roughly 170 residential properties and about thirty owners. This is not data entry with a close attached — we want someone who can tell us why a number moved, not just that it did. What You'll Do General accounting and bookkeeping ● Record daily transactions and maintain an accurate general ledger in AppFolio. ● Prepare and post journal entries, accruals and adjustments. ● Clean up miscategorized or historical transactions to restore reliable books. Reconciliations and month-end close ● Reconcile bank, loan and corporate credit card accounts monthly. ● Run the month-end close checklist and deliver closing entries on schedule. ● Prepare P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reports for management review. ● Perform P&L variance analysis and explain significant movements in plain English. Payroll and billing ● Process payroll and reconcile payroll liabilities. ● Manage billing cycles, including job-based and project billing. Insurance accounting ● Record insurance policies as prepaid assets and maintain amortization schedules. ● Track policy renewals and reconcile insurance-related accounts. Systems and data ● Support AppFolio migrations (for example, Desktop to Online) and validate converted financial data. ● Keep data consistent across AppFolio and other applications. Process improvement and controls ● Write and update SOPs for recurring accounting tasks. ● Recommend and apply internal controls that reduce errors and fraud risk. ● Improve finance workflows to shorten close time and reduce manual work. Throughout ● Raise what does not reconcile. A number that will not tie out gets escalated with what you found — never adjusted to fit. Qualifications ● Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Accounting, Finance or a related field. ● Then EITHER: 5+ years of accounting or bookkeeping experience, including 2+ years supporting U.S.-based companies — ● OR: Philippine CPA licensure (PRC-registered, CPALE passer). We will consider a recent passer with strong fundamentals in place of the experience requirement, and train you on our systems. ● Hands-on experience running month-end close and preparing financial statements — or, for a recent CPA passer, the technical grounding to learn it quickly. ● Strong Excel skills. ● Strong attention to detail, with a record of accurate reconciliations and clean books. ● Clear written and spoken English for working with U.S. owners, vendors and project managers. ● Ability to work independently, meet close deadlines and manage several clients or entities at once. ● A real system for closing on time. You work from a checklist and a calendar, not memory, and you can say exactly what is still open at any point in the close. You will be asked to show it. ● Discretion with sensitive financial information. ● Reliable computer, stable internet (≥100 Mbps) with a backup connection, and a backup-power plan. Preferred Qualifications ● Hands-on AppFolio experience — or AppFolio certification or formal AppFolio training. We will train the right candidate on our systems. ● Construction accounting: job costing, progress billing, retainage and WIP reporting. ● Real estate accounting: property-level books, rent rolls and owner reporting. ● Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, U.S. payroll basics and accrual accounting. ● Familiarity with QuickBase, CheckCentral, Buildertrend or Bluebeam. Job Location: Remote Reports to: Financial Controller Start Date: Immediately About Priority Haulage Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence. Job Summary Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows. Role Overview The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month. This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls. Availability & Working Hours This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving). Core Daily Hours 5:30 AM – 7:30 AM PHT (10:30 AM – 12:30 PM NZDT) These hours are required each business day for core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Mondays), and communication with the New Zealand team. Candidates should have some flexibility outside these hours to address urgent or time-sensitive matters, ensuring outstanding tasks are resolved before the following business day. Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle Additional hours are required during the monthly close process. This includes: • Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and • Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end. During this period, responsibilities include: • Reconciliations • Working papers • Management accounts preparation • Review updates • Close-related coordination This workload is expected to average approximately ~15 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity. Flexible Support & Process Improvement Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support: • Finance process improvements • Reporting and documentation enhancements • Workflow optimisation • Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities. Job Responsibilities Reporting & Compliance • Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. • Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. • Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements. Bookkeeping & Financial Operations • Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero. • Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts. • Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time. Payroll Administration • Review approved driver timesheets. • Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings. • Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards. Client Management • Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations. • Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries. • Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator. jobs.description: **IMPORTANT: DO NOT APPLY UNTIL YOU HAVE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POSTING AND REVIEWED THE “HOW TO APPLY” SECTION. FAILURE TO FOLLOW ALL REQUIRED INSTRUCTIONS WILL RESULT IN AUTOMATIC DISQUALIFICATION. NO EXCEPTIONS.** # NOW HIRING – FULL-TIME VIRTUAL ASSISTANT ## Surplus Funds Research Specialist **Asset Recovery Agents of America LLC** - Location: Remote – Philippines - Position: Long-term independent contractor - Available positions: One (1) - Application deadline: December 15, 2026 - Anticipated start date: January 2027 - Starting pay: $1.61 USD per hour, plus performance bonuses - Weekly hours: 40 - Payday: Every Friday - Training provided ## THREE-STAGE HIRING PROCESS Each stage will contain separate instructions and requirements. Your attention to detail, reading comprehension and ability to follow instructions will be evaluated throughout the entire hiring process. **Stage 1 – Application and Initial Interview:** Management will review applications and interview qualifying applicants before selecting candidates for Stage 2. **Stage 2 – Practical Testing:** Selected candidates will receive detailed instructions, a small practical test and an instructional video demonstrating how to research surplus funds cases. **Stage 3 – Final Interview:** The highest-performing candidates will participate in a final interview. One individual will be selected. We anticipate a January 2027 start date, provided we identify the right individual. ## COMPENSATION AND WORK SCHEDULE - $1.61 USD per hour. - $64.40 USD per week. - $257.60 USD per four-week period. - 40 paid hours per week. - Paid every Friday. - Daily paid 30-minute lunch break taken at your discretion. **Colorado, United States:** Monday–Friday, 6:00 PM–2:00 AM. **Philippines:** Tuesday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM during U.S. standard time and 8:00 AM–4:00 PM during U.S. daylight saving time. ## ABOUT OUR COMPANY Asset Recovery Agents of America LLC is a small, growing U.S.-based company that helps eligible individuals recover surplus funds resulting from foreclosure auctions. We are building a strong team that can help our company become financially successful. Our starting compensation is entry-level, but as our company becomes profitable, we intend to consider permanent pay increases. Our company operates nearly 24 hours a day across multiple shifts: - **Night shift:** The researcher identifies fresh surplus funds leads and prepares a verified CSV file. - **Early morning:** Management reviews the research, performs skip tracing and uploads eligible leads into our CRM. - **Day shift:** Our cold calling team begins contacting potential clients at the start of the next business day. Research is the foundation of our company. Poor-quality leads result in wasted expenses, fewer contracts and lost revenue, potentially threatening our ability to remain open. Accurate leads create opportunities for successful contracts, paid recoveries, company growth and additional compensation for our team. **Our goal is to grow together and succeed together.** ## JOB RESPONSIBILITIES You will spend most of your shift conducting extensive online research using ChatGPT, public records and auction websites. Your responsibilities include: - Thoroughly researching foreclosure auctions that occurred that day across our 40 approved U.S. states and assigned counties. - Researching mortgage foreclosures, tax deed auctions and sheriff sales. - Continuously entering research prompts and reviewing ChatGPT responses. - Identifying potential surplus funds cases of $10,000 or more. - Verifying auction results, property information and previous legal ownership. - Distinguishing estimated surplus from officially verified balances. - Removing duplicate and inaccurate records. - Documenting unavailable records and incomplete research. - Verifying AI-generated information against reliable sources. - Preparing and emailing an accurate, skip-tracing-ready CSV file before the end of every shift. Additional research programs may include PropertyRadar and PropStream. Training will be provided. Management will typically perform skip tracing and CRM uploads. **This is a research position. No cold calling is required.** ## PERFORMANCE BONUSES ### BONUS #1 – $25 PER ATTORNEY-APPROVED CASE Receive $25 USD for every qualifying case originating from your research that results in a signed recovery agreement and receives full attorney approval. **Paid:** The following Friday payday after attorney approval. You do not have to wait for the case to pay out. | Approved cases | Your bonus | |---|---:| | 1 | $25 | | 5 | $125 | | 10 | $250 | | 20 | $500 | | 50 | $1,250 | | 100 | $2,500 | ### BONUS #2 – 5% OF COMPANY NET PROFIT Receive 5% of the company's actual net profit from each qualifying case originating from your research that successfully pays out. **Paid:** The first Friday payday after the company's payment has cleared its bank account and net profit has been determined. | Company net profit | Your 5% bonus | |-

jobs.description: We are a growing North American e-commerce children's brand creating culturally representative toys and gifts. We're looking for an experienced Creative Strategist to become the creative brain behind our paid and organic content, with a strong focus on Meta advertising. We already have a marketing team, graphic designers, video editors and a media buying agency. We need someone who can proactively identify what creative we should produce, why it will resonate with customers and how it will drive sales. This is a creative strategy role, not a media buying or social media management position. ## RESPONSIBILITIES - Research customer psychology, buying motivations, objections, competitors and creative trends. - Develop compelling selling angles, creative concepts, hooks, scripts and storyboards. - Analyze paid and organic creative performance to identify what's working, what's not and why. - Develop structured creative testing and iteration strategies for Meta ads. - Proactively identify creative gaps and opportunities before performance declines. - Create actionable briefs for designers, video editors, UGC creators and ambassadors. - Provide creative direction and constructive feedback to our production team. - Develop organic and founder-led storytelling concepts that build brand awareness and drive purchase intent. - Identify opportunities to repurpose existing footage, photography and winning content. - Develop creative strategies around product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns and different audiences. - Provide weekly creative insights and actionable recommendations on what to continue, change, stop and test next. ## WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proven creative strategy experience with DTC e-commerce brands. - Strong understanding of Meta advertising and performance creative. - Excellent storytelling, copywriting, hook development and scriptwriting skills. - Strong customer research and consumer psychology skills. - Ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into creative decisions. - Experience developing structured creative testing strategies. - Ability to guide designers, video editors and content creators. - Excellent written English and communication skills. - Proactive, resourceful and able to work independently. ## BONUS EXPERIENCE - Children's products, parenting, lifestyle or gifting brands. - Founder-led content and UGC strategy. - Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ads Manager, Shopify, Klaviyo or GA4. - Video editing or graphic design. - North American consumer markets. ## WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT We don't want someone who simply follows trends, generates generic ideas or tells us to "make more creatives." We want someone who can explain why a creative works, identify what needs to improve and develop specific, thoughtful concepts that our team can execute. We're a bootstrapped, mission-driven business that values authentic storytelling, creative efficiency, profitability and measurable results. This is a part-time, remote position with the potential for a long-term relationship and growth. ## TO APPLY Please complete our application form: ---------- Include examples of creative strategies, scripts, briefs or campaigns you personally developed, along with performance results where available. Applications without a completed form will not be reviewed.

jobs.title: IT MSP Level 1/2 Technician
jobs.description: JOB OVERVIEW We are hiring a full-time, experienced technical support professional to support our U.S.-based customers across managed IT, cloud services, business communications, VoIP, and emerging AI technologies. This is not an entry-level help desk position. We are specifically looking for an experienced technician who already has a strong foundation in computers, Windows, Microsoft 365, networking, troubleshooting, and customer support. Experience with business telecommunications, VoIP, SIP, cloud PBX systems, or related communications technologies is especially valuable. We are offering compensation at the experienced/expert level because we want someone who knows how to troubleshoot problems, think independently, communicate professionally with customers, and take ownership of issues through resolution. Our company has nearly 30 years of experience in managed IT and cloud services. MSP support remains an important part of our business, but the next generation of the company is increasingly focused on Cloudspire Voice and Cloudspire AI. The person joining our technical team will work across both sides of the business. ### Must Have (intermediate to advanced) - Microsoft 365 administration: users, licenses, mailboxes, shared mailboxes, MFA, and Exchange Online basics - Networking: IP addressing and subnets, DNS, DHCP, routing basics, VPNs, and firewalls - Diagnosing connectivity and call quality issues such as packet loss, latency, and jitter, and knowing how to test for them - At least 2 years in a hands-on Level 1/Level 2 support role, ideally at an MSP ### Primary Responsibilities - Provide Level 1 and Level 2 help desk and technical support - Troubleshoot Windows desktops, applications, connectivity, printers, email, and general end-user issues - Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 environments - Use our RMM platform (NinjaOne) for endpoint monitoring, management, remote access, patching, and support - Work with our endpoint security platform (SentinelOne), including reviewing alerts and assisting with threat mitigation - Prior NinjaOne or SentinelOne experience is a plus but not required; we will train you - Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routers, firewalls, Wi-Fi, and general connectivity - Work extensively within our ticketing system while following documented procedures, priorities, escalation requirements, and service standards - Document troubleshooting, changes, customer communications, and resolutions thoroughly and accurately ### VoIP & Cloud Communications Telecommunications is an increasingly important part of this position. You will support our Cloudspire Voice platform and work with business-class VoIP systems, including: - VoIP and SIP troubleshooting - Cloud PBX administration - Phone provisioning and configuration - Extensions, users, hunt groups, auto attendants, call queues, and call routing - Troubleshooting call quality, registration, connectivity, and signaling issues - Number provisioning and related telecom support - Supporting physical phones, softphones, and mobile applications - Working directly with customers to diagnose and resolve communications problems Strong prior VoIP, SIP, PBX, UCaaS, or telecommunications experience will be highly valued. ### AI & Emerging Technology Cloudspire AI is one of the fastest-growing areas of our business. Prior AI experience is **not required**, but it is a significant advantage. The technician will have an opportunity to learn and work with: - AI voice agents - AI-powered customer service and communications - Agent prompting and configuration - Call flows and automation - API integrations - Troubleshooting AI conversations and behaviors - Connecting AI agents with business systems and communications platforms We are looking for someone who is interested in learning these technologies rather than someone who wants to remain exclusively in traditional desktop support. ### Customer Service & Communication Customer satisfaction is extremely important to us. You will communicate directly with U.S.-based customers by telephone, email, tickets, and remote support sessions throughout the workday. You must be professional, patient, courteous, and confident speaking with customers. *** Excellent spoken and written English is required. *** Attention to detail is also critical. Tickets must be documented correctly, instructions must be followed carefully, configurations must be verified, and customer requests must be completed accurately. ### Additional Skills That Can Create Opportunity We are a small technology company, so people who bring skills beyond their primary role can have opportunities to contribute in other areas. Experience or interest in any of the following would be considered a significant bonus: - Technology sales or pre-sales - Conducting product demonstrations - Customer relationship management - Business development - Lead generation - Digital marketing - Social media or LinkedIn outreach
