jobs.title: Shopify Developer (Frontend) - Liquid, JavaScript, HTML & CSS
jobs.description: We're a growing ecommerce SaaS company looking for an experienced Shopify developer to support ongoing custom development across a portfolio of Shopify stores. You'll work directly with our team and clients to develop custom Shopify components, implement CRO improvements, customise themes and roll out functionality across multiple stores. This is NOT a Shopify store-building, virtual assistant, product listing or page-builder role. You must be comfortable writing code from scratch, working with unfamiliar codebases and debugging frontend issues. We're looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship rather than a one-off project. Responsibilities - Develop custom Shopify Liquid sections, snippets, blocks and components from scratch. - Build reusable, configurable components using Shopify's JSON schema and theme settings. - Develop custom frontend functionality using vanilla JavaScript. - Implement responsive CRO components, including product gallery badges, promotional banners, bundle displays, countdown timers and product page elements. - Integrate custom components with our proprietary JavaScript-based Shopify software. - Port existing functionality between different Shopify themes while maintaining compatibility. - Work with multiple theme drafts and manage changes without introducing regressions. - Debug JavaScript errors, CSS conflicts, rendering issues and theme-specific compatibility problems. - Communicate directly with clients, provide development estimates and track time against individual tasks. Essential Technical Requirements - Shopify Liquid - Strong understanding of Liquid objects, filters, tags, loops and conditional logic. - Experience developing custom sections, snippets and blocks from scratch. - Understanding of section schemas, presets, dynamic sources and global theme settings. - Experience working with settings_schema.json, settings_data.json, JSON templates and theme.liquid. - Understanding of Shopify metafields, product objects, variants and collection objects. - Ability to work with both Online Store 2.0 and legacy Shopify themes. JavaScript - DOM manipulation and event handling. - Asynchronous programming, promises, async/await and Fetch API. - Experience with dynamically rendered content and event delegation. - Understanding of browser storage, cookies and JavaScript execution lifecycles. - Ability to debug race conditions, asynchronous rendering issues and duplicate event listeners. - Experience with browser developer tools, network requests and performance debugging. HTML & CSS - Semantic HTML and accessible frontend development. - Responsive layouts using Flexbox, CSS Grid and media queries. - Strong understanding of CSS specificity, inheritance, positioning and stacking contexts. - Ability to implement components from screenshots or design references without relying on page builders. - Ability to identify and resolve styling conflicts across different themes. Development Practices - Ability to read, understand and modify existing code written by other developers. - Write clean, maintainable and reusable code. - Understand the performance implications of frontend changes. - Experience with Git, version control and Shopify CLI is highly desirable. - Ability to independently investigate technical issues rather than relying on step-by-step instructions. Working Arrangement - Ongoing freelance development work. - Hourly compensation with time-tracking software. - Flexible working hours based on incoming requests. - Direct communication with our team and clients through Slack. - Training on our proprietary software and integration architecture. - Opportunity for increased hours as the business grows. Nice to have: - Experience with Shopify Section Rendering API How to Apply: Please submit your CV along with samples of your previous development work, portfolio or GitHub profile. 1) Do you have at least 2 years of hands-on Shopify Liquid development experience? 2) Can you develop custom Shopify sections, snippets and blocks from scratch? 3) Are you proficient in vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), HTML and CSS? 4) Do you have experience working with Shopify theme schemas and JSON templates? 5) Do you have experience with the Shopify Section Rendering API and AJAX Cart API? 6) Can you develop custom Shopify functionality without relying on third-party apps or page builders? 7) Do you have experience with Git? 8) How many hours per week are you available? 9) Are you comfortable working on an ad hoc, hourly basis, where workload varies depending on the development requests we receive?

We’re looking for someone who wants this to be their primary long term role and can reliably cover each shift. Hours may change seasonally within the studio’s 8 am to 9 pm Pacific window. This is not an entry-level VA role. Think of it as close to a chief of staff for a busy owner. You will manage their priorities, keep operations moving, and use tools and AI to work smarter, not just harder. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR You are a strong fit if: - You notice what needs to be done and do it before anyone asks - You genuinely care about helping a founder succeed, not just finishing a task list - You think clearly and communicate in clear, professional written and spoken English - You are comfortable learning new tools quickly and figuring things out on your own - You already use AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar) in your daily work and can explain how - You have worked directly with a CEO, founder or business owner before WHAT YOU MIGHT DO DAY TO DAY - Manage the owner's inbox, calendar and priorities - Follow up on tasks, projects and people so nothing falls through the cracks - Create and improve SOPs, systems and workflows - Prepare summaries, reports, research and documents - Coordinate with team members, vendors and customers - Use automation and AI tools to save the owner time - Spot problems early and suggest solutions REQUIREMENTS - At least 5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant or similar role - Experience supporting a business owner, founder or executive directly - Strong written and spoken English - Comfortable with tools such as Google Workspace, project management apps (for example ClickUp, Asana, Notion or ---------- ) and AI tools - Reliable internet connection, a backup power or internet plan, and a quiet workspace - Available for 10 to 20 hours per week, with some overlap with US Mountain time business hours WHAT WE OFFER - Part-time, 10 to 20 hours per week - $6 to $10 per hour, based on experience - Long-term work with a business owner who values your skills - Work that uses your full ability, not just repetitive tasks - A chance to grow into a trusted, senior role HOW TO APPLY Please read carefully. We review every application, and following instructions is part of the selection. 1. Link to your resume. 2. In your message, answer this question: What is one way you would save a busy business owner at least one hour every week, and which tool would you use? 3. Tell us which AI tools you use in your work and give one example of how you used one. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a short online assessment (about 30 minutes). AI use is allowed and encouraged during the assessment. We want to see how you think and how you work.

jobs.title: SaaS Client Success & Onboarding Manager (Shopify)
jobs.description: ⚠️ PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING: To respect everyone’s time, please only apply if you meet these non-negotiable requirements: You have at least 2 years of direct work experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or Retention Manager in a SaaS, e-commerce, CMS, or web-based tech company. (General customer service, BPO voice/chat support, or virtual assistant experience alone will not be considered.) About Us We are a fast-growing, lean SaaS startup building a conversion optimization and personalization platform for Shopify brands. Our AI-powered visual editor helps online stores customize their pages, tailor shopping experiences for specific audiences, and grow revenue through continuous A/B testing and smart product upsells. About the Role We're looking for a driven, detail-oriented SaaS Client Success & Onboarding Manager to join our core team. You'll take full ownership of onboarding our new merchants, managing a portfolio of ambitious e-commerce brands, and helping them get real, measurable results from our software. Because we're a lean team, you'll work directly with our founders, marketers, and internal product team. We move fast and value people who take initiative, own their work, and follow through. What You'll Be Doing - Merchant Onboarding: Guide new customers from initial kickoff through full setup so they launch smoothly and see value right away. - Portfolio Management: Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with 40+ Shopify brands from day one through renewal. - Success Planning: Turn each merchant's business goals into a clear, actionable roadmap. - Hands-On Campaign Setup: Occasionally jump in to help merchants set up and launch A/B tests and personalized storefront experiences so they get the most out of our platform. - Reporting & Retention: Review account performance data to spot growth opportunities, catch churn risks early, and share clear, easy-to-understand updates. - Proactive Support & Product Feedback: Keep an eye on platform usage, reach out when engagement dips, answer questions quickly, and pass merchant feedback directly to our product team. What We're Looking For - At least 2 years of experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or Retention Manager in a SaaS, e-commerce, CMS, or web-based tech company. (MUST) - Experience with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms is a strong plus. - Familiarity with Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), A/B testing, UX, basic front-end concepts, or Google Analytics is a major advantage. - Comfortable reading basic performance data, explaining insights in plain terms, and juggling 40+ active accounts without dropping the ball. - Fluent, clear, and confident spoken and written English for client calls and written check-ins. - A quiet workspace, a reliable 100+ Mbps internet connection, and the flexibility to work morning, mid, or night shifts to support our global merchants. What You Get - A strong, above-market base salary that reflects your skills and experience. - A permanent, 100% work-from-home role with no commute and no office mandates. - Direct access to our founders and core team—no middlemen or unnecessary layers. - Clear opportunities to grow and move into higher-level roles as our company expands. - Full access to our AI-powered tools and workflows so you can stay ahead and work smarter. How to Apply Please send your application directly here on OnlineJobs.ph. To make sure you've read the full post, use "CLIENT SUCCESS" as your subject line (or start your message with it). In your message, please include: 1. A brief overview of your experience in SaaS, client/customer success, or Shopify/e-commerce. 2. A link to your updated resume/CV. Applications without the keyword will not be reviewed. Looking forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Part-Time Recruiter
jobs.description: Position: Part-Time Recruiter (Full-Cycle, Multi-Channel) Hours: 20 hours per week (4 hours/day, Monday–Friday) Schedule: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM Sydney time, with some flexibility for interviews across Australian and PH time zones Location: Remote Engagement: Independent contractor, 3-month trial period; hours may increase based on hiring volume and performance Reports to Head of Operations Time tracking: Time-tracking software required during working hours About Us We are a growing Australian group in the independent optical and eye-health space. Our businesses span lens supply, a professional network for independent optometrists, practice software, owned optometry practices, and several ventures outside optometry. About the Role We are hiring across marketing, development, finance, operations, and clinical education at the same time, and we need one person to own the pipeline. You will run full-cycle recruitment for multiple open roles at once, from intake to signed offer. You will source well beyond one job board, actively headhunting on LinkedIn and across local and international platforms. Item Detail Position Part-Time Recruiter (Full-Cycle, Multi-Channel) Hours 20 hours per week (4 hours/day, Monday–Friday) Schedule 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM Sydney time, with some flexibility for interviews across Australian and PH time zones Location Remote Engagement: Independent contractor, 3-month trial period; hours may increase based on hiring volume and performance Reports to Head of Operations Time tracking: Time-tracking software required during working hours Job Description You will work closely with the Head of Operations and our hiring managers, who will lean on you to deliver shortlists, not just applicants. Key Responsibilities Intake & planning: Hold intake calls with hiring managers to agree on must-haves, hours, budget, timeline, and interview stages for each role Job ads: Write and adapt job descriptions and ads for each channel; follow our confidentiality guidelines on what is shown publicly Sourcing & headhunting: Post roles and actively search candidate databases, LinkedIn, and talent pools; reach out directly to passive candidates Screening: Review CVs and portfolios, run first-round screening calls, and send hiring managers a scored shortlist with notes Assessments: Coordinate skills tests and work samples (e.g. design, writing, coding, finance tasks) and track results Interview coordination: Schedule interviews across Australian and PH time zones, prepare interview packs, and collect feedback within 24 hours Candidate experience: Keep every candidate informed at each stage, including timely, professional rejections Offers & handover: Run reference checks, prepare offer details for approval, and hand new hires over for onboarding (forms, NDAs, contracts) Tracking & reporting: Keep the recruitment tracker current in our project management tool; send a weekly update on pipeline status, time-to-hire and channel spend Roles You'll Recruit For You will handle a mix of remote and Australia-based roles, from entry-level VAs to senior leadership. Sourcing Channels: You will choose the right channel for each role and report on which ones deliver hires, not just applicants. Area: What you'll do: Talent pool: Build and maintain a pool of pre-screened candidates for recurring roles (VAs, designers, developers) so we can backfill quickly. Function Example roles Typical seniority Marketing & creative: Marketing VAs, social media and Canva designers, video editors, graphic designers, WordPress/web support, SEO specialists Junior to mid: Software development Developers (front-end, back-end, C#/.NET, integrations), QA and customer support, project managers Mid to senior: Finance, Bookkeepers, accountants, finance leadership Mid to senior: Operations & admin: Sales and marketing coordinators, operations assistants Junior to mid: Clinical & education (Australia), Clinical education specialists and optometry-related roles Mid to senior: Affiliated businesses Technical and operational roles for partner companies within our network Varies You will also recommend when to boost, extend, or pause a paid post based on applicant quality and cost. What Success Looks Like These targets will be reviewed at the end of the 3-month trial. Channel Best for OnlineJobs.ph Remote VAs, designers, editors, developers LinkedIn (job posts and direct outreach) Developers, project managers, finance and clinical roles; headhunting passive candidates SEEK Australia-based roles JobStreet, Indeed, Kalibrr: Philippines-based professional and technical roles Facebook groups and niche communities Creative, VA and freelance talent Referrals and talent pool: Fast backfills and trusted candidates Measure Target First shortlist delivered within 5 business days of intake Shortlist quality: At least half of shortlisted candidates progress to a hiring-manager interview Time to hire: 30 days or less for junior/mid roles; 45 days or less for senior roles Candidate

jobs.title: Part-Time Financial Reporting Analyst / Management Accountant
jobs.description: **Job Type:** Part-time, long-term independent contractor **Location:** Remote – Philippines **Working Hours:** Approximately 15 hours per week **Monthly Compensation:** PHP 25,000–30,000, depending on qualifications and experience **Industry:** Manufacturing and Construction **Reporting To:** Chief Financial Officer (CFO) ## About Us We are an established and growing Australian group of companies specialising in aluminium manufacturing, fabrication and powder coating, with operations across Australia. As part of our business expansion, we are looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented and trustworthy Financial Reporting Analyst to support our management team with financial reporting, business performance analysis and financial planning. This position is primarily focused on management accounting and financial analysis rather than day-to-day bookkeeping. ## Key Responsibilities ### Weekly Financial Reporting - Prepare weekly revenue and expenditure reports. - Analyse accounts receivable and accounts payable. - Monitor labour costs and operating expenses. - Identify unusual transactions and significant expense movements. - Prepare weekly financial summaries for management. ### Monthly Financial Reporting - Prepare profit and loss reports across multiple business entities. - Conduct financial performance and profitability analysis. - Prepare budget versus actual reports and variance analysis. - Analyse gross profit margins and operating expenses. - Prepare labour cost and operational efficiency reports. - Compare financial performance across different business locations. - Assist with balance sheet reviews and cash flow analysis. - Maintain financial dashboards and management KPIs. - Provide written commentary explaining significant financial movements, potential risks and areas for improvement. ### Quarterly Financial Reporting - Prepare quarterly financial performance reviews. - Conduct year-on-year financial comparisons. - Assist with financial forecasting and budgeting. - Identify cost-saving opportunities and operational inefficiencies. - Provide actionable financial recommendations to management. ### Process Improvement - Develop and maintain standardised financial reporting templates. - Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting processes. - Verify financial data for accuracy and consistency. - Liaise with the internal accounting team when discrepancies are identified. - Maintain clear documentation of reporting procedures. ## Qualifications and Requirements - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline. - Minimum of three years of relevant experience in financial reporting, management accounting or financial analysis. - Strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles. - Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS and financial modelling. - Experience with Xero accounting software. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Excellent written English and professional communication skills. - Ability to work independently and meet reporting deadlines. - Exceptional attention to detail, integrity and confidentiality. ## Preferred Qualifications - jobs.title: RN with ICU, Critical Care, Emergency Training
jobs.description: Do not apply if you are not experienced, check for our other RN positions. # Remote Registered Nurse (RN) – Preoperative Assessment & Postoperative Clinical Triage **Engagement Type:** Independent Contractor **Work Location:** Remote **Clinical Setting:** Ambulatory Surgery Centers (ASCs) **Clinical Liaison:** Director of Clinical Operations / Director of Nursing **POSITION SUMMARY** We are seeking a highly experienced Registered Nurse as an independent contractor with a strong clinical background in Intensive Care (ICU), Critical Care, Emergency Department (ED), Trauma, or high-acuity Post-Anesthesia Care (PACU) to provide remote preoperative telephone assessments and postoperative clinical follow-up services for patients undergoing surgical procedures in ambulatory surgery centers. The qualified candidate must possess advanced clinical assessment skills, exceptional critical thinking abilities, strong pharmacological knowledge, emergency response training, and the ability to recognize potential medical and surgical complications without physically examining the patient. This is not an administrative, scheduling, or routine patient reminder position. This engagement requires an experienced clinical nurse capable of exercising independent nursing judgment, identifying surgical risk factors, recognizing acute patient deterioration, and initiating appropriate clinical escalation. **SCOPE OF CONTRACTED SERVICES** **1. Preoperative Clinical Assessment** - Conduct comprehensive preoperative telephone assessments. - Obtain and review medical and surgical histories. - Perform medication reconciliation and review allergies. - Identify medical comorbidities and potential anesthesia-related risks. - Evaluate patients against established ASC patient selection and admission criteria. - Identify medications requiring perioperative management, including anticoagulants, antiplatelets, GLP-1 medications, insulin, and opioids. - Communicate medication instructions according to approved protocols and provider orders. - Review laboratory results, diagnostic studies, EKGs, history and physical examinations, and medical clearances. - Identify abnormal, missing, or incomplete clinical documentation. - Assess cardiovascular, pulmonary, neurological, renal, hepatic, and endocrine risk factors. - Identify obstructive sleep apnea, obesity, airway concerns, bleeding disorders, previous anesthesia complications, recent infections, hospitalizations, and functional limitations. - Recognize conditions requiring additional medical evaluation or consideration of a higher-acuity surgical setting. - Escalate clinical concerns to the anesthesiologist, surgeon, or designated clinical personnel. - Track outstanding clinical requirements and verify appropriate resolution before surgery. **2. Preoperative Patient Education** - Provide individualized preoperative instructions. - Reinforce fasting requirements and medication instructions. - Educate patients regarding surgical preparation and anticipated recovery. - Confirm transportation arrangements and responsible adult supervision following discharge. - Identify postoperative home support and potential discharge barriers. - Utilize teach-back techniques to confirm patient understanding. - Address patient questions and concerns within the RN scope of practice. - Document patient education and identified barriers to compliance. **3. Postoperative Clinical Assessment and Follow-Up** - Conduct postoperative telephone assessments within established facility timeframes. - Evaluate patient recovery following anesthesia and surgical intervention. - Perform focused clinical assessments based on the surgical procedure and patient-specific risk factors. - Assess pain severity and effectiveness of prescribed pain management. - Assess mental status, respiratory symptoms, cardiovascular symptoms, and medication tolerance. - Assess patient-reported surgical site condition, bleeding, drainage, swelling, and signs of infection. - Evaluate nausea, vomiting, hydration, nutritional intake, urinary retention, and bowel function. - Assess patient-reported mobility, functional status, and neurovascular symptoms. - Identify potential postoperative complications requiring immediate or timely medical intervention. - Reinforce discharge instructions and postoperative precautions. - Coordinate additional follow-up with the surgeon or appropriate healthcare provider. - Document unsuccessful contact attempts and initiate follow-up according to facility policy. **4. Clinical Triage and Emergency Recognition** - Demonstrate advanced clinical judgment when assessing patients remotely. - Recognize signs and symptoms of myocardial infarction, acute coronary syndrome, pulmonary embolism, deep vein thrombosis, stroke, respiratory compromise, and opioid-related adverse events. - Recognize postoperative hemorrhage, sepsis, anaphylaxis, hypoglycemia, hyperglycemia, acute neurovascular compromise, compartment syndrome, and acute change

Most bookings come from follow-up - Send confirmations and reminders so leads show up to their calls - Re-book no-shows and cancellations quickly - Keep the CRM clean and organized: every lead tagged, every conversation logged, every next step clear - Report your numbers daily (conversations, appointments booked, show rate) - Give feedback to the team on what leads are saying so we can improve our messaging WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - New leads get a response within minutes during your shift - No lead falls through the cracks. Everyone gets followed up with - Your calendar is full of qualified calls - Your booked calls actually show up - You hit your daily and weekly booking targets without being chased WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR - You genuinely love DMing, having conversations, and booking appointments. This should feel like your thing - Excellent written English. You sound like a real person, not a script or a bot - Very organized. You track everything and always know where every lead stands - Self-managed. You don't need to be checked on, reminded, or micromanaged. You see what needs to be done and do it - Fast and responsive. You don't let messages sit - Reliable, with a stable internet connection and a quiet place to work - Hungry to earn. You like that commission rewards your effort - Looking for a long-term home, not something temporary THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF - You need someone telling you what to do every hour - You're slow to respond or let conversations go cold - You're disorganized or forget to follow up - You're looking for an easy, low-effort job PAY AND GROWTH - Starting: $350/month base salary + 5% commission on every deal that closes from your booked calls - 90-day evaluation: if you perform, your base goes up to about $650/month + 5% commission - Commission is uncapped. The more you book and the more that close, the more you earn - Long-term growth opportunities as the company scales WHAT WE GIVE YOU - Proven resources, assets, and scripts/frameworks so you're not starting from scratch - Full training on our offer, our process, and how we talk to leads - A clear system to follow and a team that wants you to win - You bring the work ethic. jobs.description: ABOUT US We're a fast-growing vacation rental management company in the North Georgia mountains (USA). We're a lean, entrepreneurial team that runs on modern systems, automation and AI, and we expect every person on the team to own their seat. We're not looking for someone to just "do the books." We want an accountant who builds, improves, and helps us make better decisions with the numbers. THE ROLE You'll own accounting for three related US companies: a property management company (with an owner trust account), a real estate company that owns short-term rentals, and a holding company. You'll close the books, reconcile trust funds, prepare owner statements, and turn reports into insights the founders use to run the business. WHAT YOU'LL DO Books and close - Classify and reconcile all transactions in QuickBooks Online at least 3x per week; books always match the bank - Deliver weekly financial reports every Friday and full monthly packages by the 5th, including month-end journal entries (depreciation, prepaid amortization, accruals) - Track results by property using classes, so every home has its own P&L Trust and owner accounting - Manage the owner trust account: monthly reconciliation, owner balances, amounts due to/from owners, and fees moved from trust to operating - Prepare monthly owner statements and payouts in our property management system (Hospitable), tied out to QuickBooks - Book owner pass-through costs (supplies, repairs, trash) correctly as reimbursables, not income - Prepare monthly lodging/hotel-motel tax figures for county filings Insights and decisions - Don't just send reports. Tell us what changed, why, and what we should do about it - Flag margin issues, unusual spend, cash timing, and properties underperforming - Build and maintain cash flow projections Build and improve - Find at least one way each week to make our financial reporting faster, cleaner, or more useful - Use AI tools (we use Claude daily) and automation to cut manual work: rules, imports, reconciliations, recurring entries - Own and maintain accounting SOPs so the function scales as we add homes - Research the right treatment when something new comes up, document it, and bring us the answer, not just the question WHO YOU ARE - Accountable. You hit deadlines without being chased. If something will slip, you say so early with a plan. - A critical thinker. You ask "why does this number look like that?" before we do. - An owner. You take initiative, propose projects, and finish them. - A builder who loves to learn. You enjoy fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments where systems are still being built and you get to shape them. - Comfortable with feedback. You clear review comments quickly and don't make the same mistake twice. REQUIREMENTS - CPA (Philippines) or BS Accountancy required; CPA strongly preferred - 3+ years of accounting experience with US clients - Hands-on trust accounting experience (property management, escrow, or client funds) - Vacation rental / short-term rental or property management accounting experience - US real estate accounting experience (rental properties, depreciation, capital improvements, multiple entities) - Strong QuickBooks Online and Excel / Google Sheets skills - Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your accounting work, or a strong desire to - Excellent written English - Reliable internet, backup power, and at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern business hours Nice to have: Hospitable, Guesty, OwnerRez or another vacation rental PMS; month-end close for multiple entities; owner statement experience; Asana. WHAT WE OFFER - Stable full-time role with a growing US company - Flexible schedule (with set weekly deadlines and US-hours overlap) - 2 weeks paid time off plus Philippine national holidays - Raises and bonuses as the company grows and you take on more - A real path to Controller as we scale HOW TO APPLY Apply with your resume and a short cover note that includes: 1. Your trust accounting experience: what type of trust account, how many owners/clients, and how you reconciled it. 2. Your vacation rental or property management experience: which companies and which software. 3. A short answer to this: A guest pays $1,500 for a stay. That includes a $350 cleaning fee the management company keeps (the cleaner costs $290). During the month, the manager also buys $80 of supplies for the owner on the company card. The management fee is 20% of nightly revenue. How would you record this, and what does the owner get paid? 4. One example of a process you improved or automated in a past role, and the result. Start your subject line with "Trust Ledger" so we know you read the full listing. Applications without the answer to #3 won't be reviewed.

jobs.title: Part-Time Talent Sourcer: LinkedIn Outreach
jobs.description: We're a performance creative agency, and we're always looking for great senior video editors. You'll be the one who finds them. You'll search LinkedIn and editor communities for experienced ad editors in Latin America and Europe, start real conversations, and get the best ones to apply. Every editor you bring in who starts our paid trial or gets hired earns you a commission on top of your base. You'll do your outreach by hand from your own LinkedIn account, with Eyeball Factory listed as your employer. No bots or automation tools. WHO WE ARE Eyeball Factory makes direct response video ads (VSLs, UGC ads, AI UGC and animated explainers) for 40+ brands, including IM8 Health, HelloNancy and Peachies. The founders built and sold a 7-figure e-commerce brand and grew a media company to 95,000 newsletter subscribers. We were founded in 2020, we're headquartered in the UAE, and the whole team is remote. WHO YOU'LL BE FINDING Senior video editors who make direct response ads: the scroll-stopping Facebook and ---------- ads, UGC-style videos and video sales letters that brands run to sell their products. We want editors with: - 3+ years editing paid social ads, with ads that actually ran - Experience with AI ad tools: AI avatars, AI voice, AI b-roll - Bonus: they write their own scripts It's a $4,000/month role plus commission, with coaching from our founder, so it's an easy role to pitch. YOUR 4 HOURS - Hour 1, research: find 15-20 editors who match, on LinkedIn and in editor communities, and check their work - Hour 2, outreach: send connection requests and short, personal first messages - Hour 3, follow-up: reply to editors, move interested ones to email, and send them our application details - Hour 4, admin: log every touch in the outreach sheet, and book qualified editors into a first call That works out to about 10 connection requests and 15 messages a day. WHAT YOU'LL EARN - Base: $400 USD a month for 20 hours a week (about $4.60 an hour) - +$50 for each editor you sourced who starts our paid 2-week trial - +$300 for each editor you sourced who's hired and stays with us for 30 days Example of a strong month: 2 trial starts and 1 hire = $400 + $100 + $300 = $800 (about $9.20 an hour). You're paid monthly in USD via Wise or PayPal. Commission is paid with the next monthly payment after the milestone. You get credit for any editor you logged first, with the date and profile link, before they applied. YOUR TARGETS - 50 LinkedIn connection requests a week - 75 messages and emails a week, follow-ups included - 5 qualified applicants a week (applied with their Loom and portfolio, and passed screening) - 2 first calls booked a week - 1 trial start a month WHAT WE GIVE YOU - A clear profile of who to find, with examples of portfolios that pass and portfolios that don't - LinkedIn search strings and message templates to start from - An onboarding call, then a weekly check-in on your numbers - Room to grow: hit your targets and you're first in line for more hours as our sourcing team grows YOU'RE A FIT IF - You're based in the Philippines and available 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, during hours that overlap with our working day in Dubai - You have 1+ year in recruiting, sourcing, headhunting, lead generation or appointment setting, ideally for overseas clients - You have an established LinkedIn account under your real name (1+ year old, 300+ connections), and you're happy to use it for outreach with Eyeball Factory as your employer - You write short, natural English messages that people actually reply to - You log everything in Google Sheets without being reminded - You have reliable internet, with a backup for power and internet Bonus: you've recruited video editors or other creatives, you know LinkedIn Boolean search or Sales Navigator, or you know editor communities on ---------- , Skool or Reddit. THIS ISN'T FOR YOU IF - You send the same copy-pasted message to everyone. We want fewer, better messages. - You'd rather not use your own LinkedIn account - You need a fixed script for every situation HOW TO APPLY Apply through our application form here: ---------- The form asks for your LinkedIn profile link, your CV (optional) and your answers to these 5 questions: (1) How old your LinkedIn account is, and how many connections it has. (2) The last role where you sourced or messaged people, and your weekly numbers. (3) How would you find senior video editors in Latin America or Europe who make direct response ads? Give us your search terms, and how you'd tell a strong editor from an average one. (4) A message you've sent that got good replies, and why it worked. (5) Which 4 hours a day (Manila time) you can work, and when you can start. Start your cover letter in the form with the word "Eyeball" so we know you read this far. Applications without it won't be reviewed. We only review applications sent through the form. If the link doesn't show for you, apply here on OnlineJobs.ph and we'll send it to you. HOW HIRING WORKS

jobs.title: E-commerce Website Coordinator (WooCommerce)
jobs.description: You'll manage the products on our WordPress website. That means adding and updating product pages, keeping prices and details correct, and checking that the website and sofa configurator work properly. This is not a developer or SEO specialist role. It's for someone meticulous who enjoys getting product details exactly right. You'll start with product updates, page checks and configurator testing. As you prove dependable, you'll take ownership of catalog audits, the configurator and the full website backlog. The role owns the accurate implementation and maintenance of product information across: • Adorn Croft's WordPress website • All pages, including the high-traffic product pages and collection pages • The sofa configurators • Fabric and material options • Pricing, measurements, descriptions, lead times, and related manual website updates This is a detail-intensive website execution and product-data role. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ CORE PURPOSE Ensure that every Adorn Croft product and customization option is published accurately, completely, consistently and on time, and that customers can use the website and configurator without encountering misleading information or broken functionality. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ SCOPE 1. PRODUCT CREATION AND MAINTENANCE • Create and update product pages. • Enter titles, descriptions, pricing, dimensions, materials, care instructions, lead times, shipping notes and customization options. • Write basic SEO-friendly product titles, descriptions and meta descriptions using approved brand guidelines. • Assign products to the correct categories and collections. • Maintain SKUs, tags, attributes, related products and product status. • Remove placeholders and outdated information. • Apply approved formatting consistently. • Verify that products, prices and product sizes match the company's master records. • Test the pages for polished UX/UI on both mobile and desktop versions. • Monitor Adorn Croft's website and configurator twice a week for broken functionality and report issues to the IT/marketing team. 2. CONFIGURATOR ADMINISTRATION • Upload and organize fabrics, modules, wood bases and other options. • Connect each option to the correct module and product, and correct any mismatches. • Verify prices and price adjustments. • Test the centimetre/inch toggle, layers, filters, undo/redo, saved sessions, email links and add-to-cart flow. • Report technical bugs clearly to the developer. • You will maintain and test the configurator; coding and technical repairs remain with the developer. 3. WEBSITE MAINTENANCE • Update menus, banners, text, links, buttons, promotional messages, policies, FAQs and collection pages. • Check mobile and desktop presentation after every change. • Identify broken links, missing images, formatting problems and outdated content. • Maintain forms, downloadable files, embedded videos and basic page components. • Conduct routine checks after WordPress or plugin updates. 4. PRODUCT-DATA QUALITY CONTROL • Compare live pages against the approved product-information sheet. • Audit pricing, measurements, materials, options and lead times. • Maintain a change log showing what was changed, by whom, when and why. • Conduct regular catalog audits. • Correct inconsistencies across product pages, configurator entries, invoices and internal price lists. 5. DOCUMENTATION AND REPORTING • Maintain upload templates and standard operating procedures. • Keep a weekly record of published products, completed updates, detected errors and outstanding issues. • Maintain the website request backlog. • Document repeat problems and recommend process improvements. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ACCOUNTABILITY Own these five outcomes: 1. Product information is accurate and complete. 2. Approved website updates are published on time. 3. Configurator options and pricing work correctly. 4. The website is routinely checked for customer-facing problems. 5. Website changes and product data are documented and traceable. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ REQUIREMENTS MUST HAVE • WordPress product administration: hands-on experience creating and updating products, variations, attributes and categories (WooCommerce preferred). • Exceptional attention to detail: meticulous with prices, dimensions, materials and options, and you check your work against source records before publishing. • Testing and QA: you routinely check changes on mobile and desktop and test functionality before release. • Basic product copywriting: you can write clear product titles and descriptions (basic SEO knowledge is a plus). • Spreadsheets: comfortable using Google Sheets or Excel to compare and maintain product data. • Organization and documentation: experience keeping SOPs, templates, logs or a task backlog (ClickUp or similar). • Good written English NICE TO HAVE • Experience with product configurators • Furniture or home décor e-commerce experience ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ SCORECARD ACCURACY • 0 crit

AI replies must continue to be reviewed by our team before sending. • Integrations Connect GHL with relevant tools, including Slack, spreadsheets and student-access systems where needed. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR • Demonstrated experience building and troubleshooting GoHighLevel automations. • Strong understanding of pipelines, triggers, conditions, custom fields, tags, tasks and notifications. • Experience connecting systems through automation tools, APIs or webhooks. • Ability to work from a detailed written brief, identify gaps and recommend practical improvements. • Clear written communication and regular progress updates. • Careful testing, attention to detail and understandable handover documentation. ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE WE VALUE • GoHighLevel Conversation AI. • Recurring invoicing, payment reminders and billing integrations. • Instagram and Facebook messaging workflows. • Slack, Google Sheets, Xero or Skool integrations. • Systems involving separate parent, student and billing contacts. Please include your availability, time zone and expected rate. We can discuss an hourly arrangement or a project quote after you have reviewed the detailed scope. HOW TO APPLY Please include: 1. A brief overview of your relevant GoHighLevel experience. 2. One or two examples of workflows or systems you personally built, explaining what they did and which parts you were responsible for. Screenshots or a short Loom video are welcome—please hide any client information. 3. Your experience with Conversation AI, invoicing/payment workflows and external integrations. 4. A short explanation of how you would approach reviewing an existing GHL account before making changes. 5. Your expected hourly rate and currency, weekly availability and earliest start date. We’ll share the detailed task list with shortlisted applicants so you can assess the scope, timing and any additional costs before we agree on the work.

jobs.description: I'm looking for a talented and reliable short-form video editor who understands TikTok, viral video formats, viewer retention, and product-based content. jobs.title: Amazon.ca Online Arbitrage Sourcing VA — Paid Per Lead, 3 Lead Types (Keepa + SellerAmp Experience Required)
jobs.description: About us 3SBF Trading Inc. is a Canadian Amazon FBA seller (Amazon.ca only), newly launched and building our catalogue carefully — account health first, profit second, growth third. We source for ourselves every day, so we know honestly: full-standard leads are rare. We would rather pay fairly for a few real leads than receive a flood of weak ones. The job Find online arbitrage products from Canadian online retailers for resale on Amazon.ca. You will research, verify each product in Keepa and SellerAmp (we provide both accounts), and submit leads in our Google Sheet format. Flexible hours, output-based — part-time to start, more work for performers. Pay — three lead types (paid weekly via Wise, after our internal review) - Type 1 — Full lead: US$8. Meets ALL hard rules below AND at least CAD $5.00 profit per unit AND at least 25% ROI in SellerAmp at the current source price. - Type 2 — Test-lane lead: US$3. Meets ALL hard rules below, but profit lands between CAD −$1 and +$3 per unit at the current source price. We are in a proof phase and buy small test quantities of these. - Type 3 — Ungating candidate: no payment on submission. Profitable on paper (Type 1 economics) at a real source but RESTRICTED for our account in SellerAmp. Submit these separately, clearly labelled. If we pursue the brand, get ungated, and place an order based on your lead, you receive a US$5 bonus. Quality over quantity, always. Leads that fail the hard rules are not paid, whichever type they were submitted as. Hard rules — EVERY lead, EVERY type: - Sold on Amazon.ca; new and sealed; FBA offers on the listing. - Eligibility (Types 1 and 2): SellerAmp must show our account can sell it ("You can sell this product"). - Price sanity: the current Buy Box must be in line with the 3–6 month average on Keepa — no price spikes. - Demand: at least 10 bought in the past month; sales rank in roughly the top 1–3% of its category. - Competition: at least 3 FBA sellers; Buy Box shared fairly (no single seller taking 80%+); Amazon itself must NOT be a seller on the listing; the brand must NOT be selling its own listing. - Product type: real third-party retail brands only. No private label, no generic/unbranded products, no IP-risk products. - Source: a legitimate Canadian retailer, first-party only — the retailer itself, never a marketplace seller inside Walmart or another platform, and never eBay, Temu, AliExpress, or Alibaba. The price must be live at submission; include any sale price, promo code, or cashback you found. - Rating 3.5 stars or higher (4.0+ preferred). Buy Box roughly CAD $10–$100. - Flag anything hazmat / dangerous goods in your submission notes. Zero tolerance: leads copied from shared lead lists, lead groups, or other sellers' lists end the engagement immediately. Every lead must be sourced by you, independently. You will NOT be given: Seller Central access (not needed for this role), purchasing duties, or final buy decisions — we review and d ---------- every purchase. Requirements Proven online arbitrage sourcing experience (Amazon.ca experience strongly preferred) Confident Keepa chart reading: price and sales-rank history, Buy Box share, offer counts Confident SellerAmp use: profitability, eligibility, IP flags Google Sheets; reliable internet; good written English How to apply Start your application with the words "Maple Sourcer" so we know you read this post. Then: How long have you done Amazon OA sourcing, and for which marketplaces? Your Keepa skill (1–10) and SellerAmp skill (1–10)? Submit 3 sample leads for Amazon.ca, sourced within the last 7 days. At least one should be a Type 1 if you can find one — if not, send your best Type 2 leads and say so honestly; we respect that more than inflated numbers. For each lead: which type it is, ASIN, Amazon.ca link, source retailer + link, source price, Buy Box price, SellerAmp profit and ROI, and a Keepa link.

Assist with trust administration, probate, and guardianship proceedings. - Prepare court forms, pleadings, correspondence, notices, and supporting documents. - Assist with trust funding, property transfers, and beneficiary documentation. - Coordinate document execution, notarization, and witnessing. - Communicate with financial institutions, trustees, beneficiaries, and other relevant parties as directed by counsel. **Client Communication and Case Management** - Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for clients. - Respond promptly and professionally to client emails and telephone calls. - Obtain outstanding documents and information from clients. - Provide clients with appropriate case status updates. - Maintain organized and accurate electronic client files. - Proactively follow up on outstanding assignments and pending matters. - Manage client onboarding, engagement agreements, and intake procedures. **Billing and Invoicing** - Manage billing through MyCase, Clio, or comparable legal practice management software. - Prepare, review, and distribute client invoices subject to attorney approval. - Maintain accurate attorney and paralegal time entries. - Monitor outstanding balances and retainer replenishment requirements. - Follow up with clients regarding outstanding invoices and payments. - Maintain accurate records of client payments and expenses. - Prepare weekly billing and accounts receivable reports. - Identify unbilled time and expenses. **Court Scheduling and Calendar Management** - Coordinate and schedule court hearings, depositions, mediations, and conferences. - Communicate with judicial assistants, court personnel, opposing counsel, and other parties. - Calendar court deadlines, filing requirements, and important case dates. - Assist with electronic court filings and service of documents. - Monitor court dockets and notify attorneys of relevant developments. - Schedule client consultations, attorney meetings, and Zoom conferences. - Prepare and distribute calendar invitations, Zoom links, and meeting reminders. - Confirm appointments and ensure necessary documents are available before meetings. **Administrative and Operational Support** - Maintain attorney calendars and daily task lists. - Track assignments, deadlines, and work completion. - Prepare daily status reports identifying completed tasks, pending assignments, and matters requiring attorney attention. - Organize electronic documents and maintain consistent file-naming procedures. - Assist with general litigation and transactional matters as needed. - Maintain strict confidentiality of client information and attorney-client privileged communications. ### Qualifications - Minimum of two years of experience as a paralegal or legal assistant preferred. - Experience in estate planning, trusts, probate, or guardianship strongly preferred. - Experience with MyCase, Clio, or comparable legal practice management software. - Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Adobe Acrobat, and Zoom. - Familiarity with electronic court filing systems and court scheduling procedures. - Strong written and verbal English communication skills. - Excellent organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills. - Ability to work independently, prioritize assignments, and meet deadlines. - Strong attention to detail and accuracy. - Professional telephone and email etiquette. - Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately. ### Performance Expectations The successful candidate must demonstrate initiative, accountability, responsiveness, and the ability to independently manage administrative responsibilities. The position requires proactive follow-up rather than waiting for repeated instructions from attorneys. Performance will be evaluated based on: - Accuracy and timeliness of completed assignments. - Client responsiveness and professionalism. - Billing and invoicing accuracy. - Consistent follow-up on outstanding payments and documents. - Compliance with court deadlines and calendaring requirements. - Organization and maintenance of client files. - Productivity and completion of assigned daily tasks. ### How to Apply Interest

We support U.S.-based high school students through a team-based model, where each student is guided by a Head Counselor, Essay Editor, and Subject Tutors. As a Math Tutor, you'll help students strengthen their math foundations and build confidence in their coursework, working alongside the student's Head Counselor and fellow tutors in our "AI-Enhanced but Human-Centered" model. We are especially looking for tutors who can cover **weekend and evening** sessions in Pacific Time. What You'll Do: - Subject-Specific Tutoring: Tutor high school math, from foundational courses through advanced coursework, depending on the student's needs. Meet each student where they are, whether they are highly accelerated or need more remedial support. - Student-Centered Instruction: Use a Socratic teaching style — guide students to the answer through questions instead of lecturing at them. Figure out *why* a student is stuck (missing prerequisite, misread problem, or procedural error) before re-teaching, and explain concepts in simple, relatable language. - Interactive Teaching: Run interactive sessions using screen-share / present mode, live annotation, practice problems, past exam papers, and resources like Khan Academy. Keep students actively participating so they don't disengage. - Team Collaboration: Work closely with the student's Head Counselor so your tutoring supports the student's bigger academic and college-admissions plan — not just the next test. - Prompt, Prepared Communication: Reply to messages from students, parents, and the Telos team within 24 business hours. Prepare before every session, take clear session notes, track student progress, and raise any concerns early. Who You Are: - Weekend & Evening Availability (Top Priority): Available for tutoring sessions on weekends and evenings in Pacific Time (PST/PDT). Weekend availability is the ideal. - Strong Math Background: Strong command of high school-level math, with a degree or coursework in Mathematics, Engineering, a STEM field, or a closely related area. - Tutoring Experience (Preferred, not required): Prior tutoring experience, ideally one-on-one with high school students, is nice to have. Relatability and patience matter more than years of experience. - Warm & Approachable: You come across as the kind of person a teenager actually wants to keep working with — patient, encouraging, and never intimidating. - Cross-Cultural Communication: Communicate clearly and warmly with U.S. students and parents in fluent, natural-sounding English, and stay professional across time zones. - Tech-Savvy: Comfortable working in a fully remote, AI-enhanced environment, including using tools like Claude, Gemini, or NotebookLM to help prepare lessons. Schedule & Work Environment: - Fully Remote: This role is 100% remote, open to candidates in the U.S. and internationally. - Tech Setup & Workspace Requirements: Clear camera quality is essential since we highly value professionalism during client-facing meetings. A crisp microphone and a relatively quiet, well-lit workspace ensure our AI tools (like Gemini) can capture accurate meeting transcripts for our notes and timesheets. - Flexible Hours: Work hours are flexible within reason, provided all deliverables are completed on time and client communication remains timely and professional. Sessions are booked based on the student's specific requests. - Availability: Must be available on weekends and evenings in Pacific Time. Weekday after-school hours (typically 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM Pacific Time) are also high-demand. International candidates should confirm they can reliably work these hours in their local time. What We Offer: - Pay: $5/hour - Resources: Telos will provide the necessary software subscriptions and tools required for the role. jobs.title: Top Video Editors for Top YouTube Creators
jobs.description: Hey Editors! It’s Time to Level Up. Ready to Take Your Editing Career Further? We are looking for an expert-level YouTube Video Editor who can create premium, retention-focused long-form content for top creators and brands. This role is best suited for editors who understand high-quality YouTube storytelling in the style of channels such as Vox, Johnny Harris, Cleo Abram, and other documentary/explainer-style creators. We are not looking for basic editors, short-form-only editors, or editors who simply add cuts and captions. We are looking for someone with strong creative judgment, technical skill, and the ability to turn raw footage and direction into a polished, engaging, and thoughtful YouTube video. The ideal editor understands pacing, story structure, audience retention, visual clarity, motion graphics, sound design, and how every editing choice affects the viewer’s experience. Responsibilities Edit high-quality long-form YouTube videos for creators, brands, and educational content. Build strong hooks that make viewers want to keep watching. Shape raw footage into a clear and engaging story. Use B-roll, archival footage, graphics, music, sound design, and visual references intentionally. Create clean motion graphics, maps, text animations, callouts, and visual explanations when needed. Improve pacing, flow, clarity, and retention throughout the video. Follow creative direction while also bringing your own strong editorial judgment. Apply feedback quickly and professionally. Work with creative leads, producers, and post-production teams to meet high creative standards. Deliver polished edits on time in a fast-moving YouTube-first environment. Qualifications Strong experience editing long-form YouTube videos. Expert-level skill in Adobe Premiere Pro. Expert-level skill in Adobe After Effects and motion graphics. Good understanding of Photoshop or other Adobe Creative Suite tools. Strong storytelling and pacing instincts. Ability to create documentary, explainer, talking-head, educational, or creator-style edits. Strong use of B-roll, archival footage, visual references, graphics, sound design, and music. Understanding of audience retention, viewer engagement, and YouTube performance. Experience editing high-performing or high-quality content for creators, agencies, brands, or media companies. Ability to work with feedback, revisions, and tight deadlines. Strong attention to detail and clean technical execution. Reliable computer/workstation setup and strong internet connection. This Role Is Not For Entry-level editors. Editors with only short-form reel experience. Editors with only wedding, corporate, event, or basic social media editing experience. Editors who are not comfortable with long-form YouTube content. Editors who only follow instructions but do not bring creative judgment. Editors who cannot work with feedback or tight deadlines. Editors who do not have strong Premiere Pro and After Effects skills. Benefits Work from anywhere! We’re a 100% remote team. A quarterly wellness reimbursement 20 days of paid time off annually. 12 additional holidays per year. Unlimited sick and bereavement leave. Working for a company that is values-oriented and committed to positive social impact. Unlimited reimbursement on book purchases for self-education. Gifts/cash bonuses on birthdays, work anniversaries, and other work-related achievements. Working directly with some of the largest brands on the planet. This could include moving up to Lead Short-Form or Long-Form Editor, Director of the Editing Department, Post-Production Supervisor, or even Creative Director or beyond! Preferred Qualifications - Previous experience supporting U.S.-based residential solar sales teams. - Understanding of the residential solar project lifecycle. - Familiarity with solar contracts, financing documentation, and customer onboarding requirements. - Experience coordinating across multiple operational departments. - Previous experience supporting geographically distributed teams in a remote environment. Schedule & Work Arrangement - Full-time, fully remote offshore position. - Monday–Friday. - Must be available to work designated U.S. business hours. What SpartanX Provides - Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications. - Ongoing training and professional development. - Opportunities for career growth and advancement. - Collaborative, team-focused work environment. - Opportunity to directly impact operational efficiency, sales performance, and customer satisfaction. jobs.title: Business Development Preconstruction Estimator
jobs.description: Position summary Department: Business Development Preconstruction and Estimating. Proposed direct manager: Daniel Abreu, under BD leadership. Functional technical coordination: designated Estimating/Design reviewer. Proposed location: remote Philippines or another approved location. Proposed schedule: Monday through Friday, 4:00 p.m. to 12:30 a.m. Eastern Time, including a 30-minute meal break, subject to HR confirmation and an explicit daylight-saving arrangement. Purpose: convert qualified BD opportunities into complete, traceable and commercially reviewable estimates. Prepare technical scope, measured takeoffs, supplier-cost comparisons, RFIs, estimate worksheets and coordinated proposal packages. Protect the relationship between the quoted scope and the package received by Operations. Core responsibilities: - Review assigned plans, specifications, schedules, revisions and addenda; identify trade boundaries, existing-to-remain items, alternates and unresolved selections. - Prepare calibrated and traceable takeoffs by room, piece, model, floor and phase using approved tools; record scale, revision and source. - Coordinate cabinet layout and BOM dependencies with the designated designer; flag catalog and dimensional limitations. - Build estimate worksheets from valid cost sources and approved labor/pricing rules; separate cost, quantity, markup, freight, tax and assumptions. - Prepare one consolidated RFI list with impact, recommendation, decision owner and response date; escalate blockers before commitments are missed. - Maintain ClickUp ownership, effort, ETA, status, next action and source links; preserve document and quote revisions. - Prepare proposal scopes, inclusions, exclusions and alternates; complete self-check and participate in independent technical review. - Assemble the approved handoff to Order Entry and Operations; support clarification and root-cause learning without releasing production. - Maintain approved assemblies, templates and historical benchmark cases during reserved development time. Required capabilities: Demonstrated construction estimating or takeoff experience, preferably two or more years with comparable project complexity. Strong written English, arithmetic and spreadsheet skills. Evidence of accurate plan reading, scope interpretation, revision control and cost-source discipline. Practical proficiency in at least one approved takeoff tool; ability to explain measurements and assumptions. Stable working environment and schedule availability. Candidates must state their actual trade proficiency. Countertop, flooring and cabinet knowledge are assessed separately. The initial job assignment is limited to demonstrated and certified scope; a generic administrative background alone is insufficient. Preferred capabilities Commercial/multifamily projects, builder matrices, MeasureSquare, Bluebeam or comparable takeoff tools, cabinet BOM coordination, BuildingConnected/Autodesk, ClickUp, Google Workspace, supplier-cost comparison and overseas sourcing. AI experience is useful when paired with source verification and technical judgment.

jobs.title: MSP Automation Developer
jobs.description: COMPANY Parachute Technology is a Managed IT Service Provider. We have a friendly and supportive work environment, with a hands-on leadership. Primary headquarters is in San Ramon, CA. We are doubling down on automation to improve client experience, reduce ticket volume, and increase technician throughput. You will design, build, and maintain automations across our PSA, RMM, and cloud platforms to streamline workflows, accelerate ticket resolution, and keep client environments compliant and well-configured at scale. Job Description Automation and scripting Build and maintain reusable automations in Immybot, PowerShell/Python for Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure/Intune, and common MSP tooling. Create event-driven workflows using APIs, webhooks, and iPaaS/RPA (e.g., Microsoft Power Automate, Zapier, Logic Apps). Implement self-healing tasks in RMM for alert remediation, patching, software deployment, and configuration drift correction. Workflow Optimization Map current service workflows (incident, request, change, onboarding/offboarding) and eliminate waste via automation. Reduce technician touch time by building triage, enrichment, and classification automations in the PSA. Automate asset lifecycle tasks: discovery, tagging, baseline config, policy enforcement, and documentation updates. Platform Engineering and Reliability Own configuration hygiene across tenants (baseline policies, hardening, Intune device compliance, Conditional Access). Create CI/CD pipelines for scripts and policy-as-code with version control, peer review, and rollback. Add observability: logging, metrics, alerting, and dashboards for automation success/fail and ROI. Data and Integrations Integrate PSA, RMM, documentation, and billing systems to ensure single source of truth (SSOT). Build data pipelines to surface insights (e.g., ticket drivers, SLA risk, noisy alerts) and prioritize automation backlog. Governance, Security, and Documentation Follow change control, ITIL processes, and least-privilege access. Document runbooks, code, and deployment patterns; enable technicians to safely run automations. Impact and Success Metrics Ticket reduction: decrease repeat/noise tickets and auto-resolve a targeted percentage of alerts/incidents. Speed: reduce time-to-first-response and time-to-resolution for top incident categories. Technician productivity: increase tickets closed per FTE; reduce after-hours escalations. Configuration hygiene: increase baseline compliance (M365/Azure/Intune/RMM) and reduce drift. Reliability: maintain automation success rate and rollback within defined SLOs. Requirements Required Qualifications 3+ years in an MSP or similar multi-tenant environment. Strong scripting in PowerShell; working knowledge of Python. Hands-on with at least one PSA (ConnectWise Manage, Autotask) and one RMM (NinjaOne, N-central, Kaseya, Datto RMM, Intune for device mgmt). Microsoft 365/Azure AD/Entra/Intune administration and policy automation experience. API experience: REST, JSON, OAuth; building integrations between PSA, RMM, documentation, and monitoring. Version control (Git), code review, and basic CI/CD for scripts. Understanding of ITIL incident/request/change practices and change risk management. Strong documentation habits and ability to translate business requirements into technical automation. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, or other RPA/iPaaS. Infrastructure-as-code or policy-as-code exposure (e.g., Intune templates, Graph API automation). Monitoring/observability tools (e.g., Sentinel, Log Analytics, Splunk, Datadog). Security automation: Conditional Access, Defender for Endpoint policies, vulnerability remediation workflows. Certifications: CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft MS-102/SC-200/MD-102, ITIL Foundation, relevant RMM/PSA certs. Example Projects you might own: Auto-triage: classify, enrich, and route tickets based on content, device signals, and client priority. Self-healing: auto-restart services/processes, clear disk space, fix DNS/NTP, remediate common Windows events. Patch orchestration: approval policies with maintenance windows and success verification. Onboarding/offboarding: user, mailbox, license, group, device, and access automation with proof of completion. Drift control: reconcile device and software inventories, enforce baseline configs, and update documentation automatically. SLA risk alerts: proactive signals when SLA breaches are likely based on backlog and priority. How You’ll Work Collaborate with Service Desk, NOC, and Engineering to identify top automation candidates and quantify ROI. Run discovery, design, pilot, and production rollout with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics. Maintain a transparent automation backlog with business value scoring and regular stakeholder updates. Tools you may use here PSA: ConnectWise Manage RMM/endpoint: ConnectWise Microsoft 365/Azure: Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Defender, Conditi

As the leading provider, our clinical outcomes are second to none. You will join a winning team that is committed to evidence-based treatment and long-term results. We strive to change the lives of individuals and their families suffering from unrelenting anxiety, disturbing and terrifying thoughts, uncontrollable worry, exhausting behaviors and rituals, and avoidance that keeps them from living their lives. Adheres to all company policies and procedures Other duties as assigned Qualifications Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in healthcare medical billing, patient accounts receivable, or healthcare payment posting. Knowledge Base: Strong understanding of medical billing terminology, EOB interpretation, coordination of benefits (COB), and healthcare accounting practices. Attributes: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and auditing skills; ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Project Timeline & Performance KPIs Should this contract extend, performance will be evaluated against the following milestones to measure efficiency, speed, and accuracy: 30-Day KPIs (Onboarding & Accuracy Baseline) Complete standard system training and demonstrate proficiency in navigating the practice management ledger. Establish a steady daily review cadence, auditing a minimum of 35-40 unallocated transactions per day. Maintain a posting and reconciliation accuracy rate of 99% or higher on all audited accounts. 60-Day KPIs (Volume Acceleration & Error Reduction) Increase daily workflow throughput to audit and resolve a minimum of 45–50 unallocated transactions per day. Achieve a posting accuracy rate of 99% or higher with minimal supervision or need for posting reversals. The role will mainly involve contacting potential and existing clients, making outbound calls using contact lists provided by the company, following up on enquiries and handling administrative tasks such as preparing and sending quotations and invoices. The successful candidate should have good communication skills, confidence when speaking with clients and the ability to manage tasks efficiently. **Key Responsibilities** - Make outbound calls to potential and existing clients using contact lists provided by the company. - Introduce our services and communicate with prospective customers. - Follow up with clients regarding enquiries, quotations and outstanding responses. - Prepare and send quotations to customers. - Create and send invoices to clients. - Respond to customer enquiries through phone, email and other communication channels. - Maintain accurate customer information and update CRM records. - Coordinate with the internal team regarding customer requests and scheduled services. - Assist with general administrative and operational tasks. - Maintain professional relationships with customers and ensure timely communication. **Requirements** - Good spoken and written English communication skills. - Confident and comfortable making outbound calls. - Good customer service and interpersonal skills. - Basic computer skills and familiarity with email and spreadsheets. - Good organisational and time-management skills. - Attention to detail when preparing quotations and invoices. - Ability to handle multiple tasks and work independently. - Reliable, proactive and willing to learn. **Preferred Skills** - Previous experience in customer service, sales support or virtual assistance. - Experience with CRM systems. - Familiarity with preparing quotations and invoices. - Experience handling outbound calls and customer follow-ups. **Working Arrangement** - Remote position. - Full-time preferred. - Must be comfortable making regular outbound calls and communicating with clients during agreed working hours. **Salary & Performance-Based Incentives** - Basic Salary: PHP 20,000 per month. - Project Commission: 20% commission on the profit generated from eligible projects secured through your sales and client acquisition efforts. - Subscription Bonus: 10% of the subscription amount for clients whose ongoing accounts and services you manage. In addition to the basic monthly salary, you will have opportunities to earn additional income through project commissions and ongoing client management bonuses. These incentives will be based on performance and eligible business results. **Application Instructions** Please begin your application message with the word "CLEANSTART" so we know you have read the full job description. Please also include a link to your updated CV/Resume if it is not already available on your OnlineJobs.ph profile. We look forward to learning more about you!

jobs.title: Remote Sales Manager – Residential/Commercial Solar & Roofing ($8M+ Installed/Yr)
jobs.description: 🏢 **JOB OVERVIEW** In an industry full of startups that disappear overnight, Smart Roofs Solar has been thriving for 15 years and is currently installing approximately $8 Million per year. We don't just sell panels; we operate across three high-ticket divisions: Residential Solar, Commercial Solar, and Residential Roofing. We are launching a brand-new Remote Sales Manager role to work directly alongside our CEO, operations team, and US and Philippines (PH) sales teams to lead, scale, and optimize our revenue engine. Because you will be helping us scale an already-proven $8M/year operation, your monthly bonus is tied directly to total sales volume across all three divisions. If you know how to coach reps through residential kitchen-table objections, navigate commercial solar decision-makers, and keep sales and operations tightly aligned from contract to install, this role was built for you. --- 🎯 **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** * Partner with the CEO, Operations & Sales: Work directly with executive leadership, operations, and our US and PH sales teams to build out this new remote leadership seat and ensure seamless alignment from initial pitch to final installation. * Drive Multi-Company Revenue: Lead the charge across all three divisions—B2C (Residential Solar & Residential Roofing) and B2B (Commercial Solar)—ensuring reps know how to bundle and cross-sell roofing + solar deals to maximize volume. * Coach & Elevate Talent: Run high-energy daily huddles, call reviews, and 1-on-1 coaching sessions to sharpen setter and closer performance from initial pitch to final contract. * Own the Numbers & Handoffs: Track and optimize core KPIs—dial-to-contact rates, appointment sit rates, pitch-to-close ratios, and pull-through rates (partnering closely with operations to move signed contracts cleanly to installation). * Refine the Playbook: Audit our CRM pipelines, eliminate bottlenecks between setters, closers, and project operations, and continuously upgrade scripts and rebuttals for both residential homeowners and commercial property owners. * Build a Winning Culture: Foster a high-accountability, zero-excuse, results-driven remote sales floor where top performers are recognized and underperformers are coached up or out. --- ✅ **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (MUST-HAVES):** * 5+ Years of Sales Management Experience: A verifiable track record of building, scaling, and managing remote B2C and B2B sales teams. * Direct Industry Expertise: Hands-on experience in Residential Solar, Commercial Solar, and/or Residential Roofing is required. You must already understand the terminology, financing/PPA structures, roofing scopes, and buyer psychology of these markets. * Cross-Department & Cross-Border Leadership: Proven ability to lead, motivate, and bridge the gap between PH-based appointment setters/inside sales reps, US-based closers, and internal operations teams. * Data-Driven Operator: Strong command of CRM pipeline management, conversion metrics, and structured performance turnarounds. * Remote Self-Starter: Highly organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable stepping into a newly created role where you can help shape the structure while aligning with US business hours. --- 💰 **COMPENSATION & PERKS:** * Base Pay: $10.00/hour (Full-Time, 40 hrs/week) * Monthly Sales Volume Bonus: Paid monthly based on total sales volume across all three companies/divisions. As this is a newly created remote role, exact tier structures will be finalized with the right candidate, with On-Target Earnings (OTE) of $10.00/hr base + $800 to $2,700/month in sales bonuses. * Work Setup: 100% Work-From-Home * Stability & Scale: Step into a leadership seat at a 15-year-old established organization already installing ~$8M annually, where your strategies will directly grow the bottom line—and your paycheck. # ================================================== 📩 **HOW TO APPLY** To be considered for an immediate interview with our CEO, first identify your **Priority Tier** based on your hands-on industry background: * **TIER 1:** Commercial Solar + Residential Solar + Roofing Sales Managment Experience * **TIER 2:** Residential Solar OR Commercial Solar Sales Managment Experience (with or without Roofing) * **TIER 3:** Roofing Sales Managment Experience Only Next, you **MUST** use the exact subject line format below when submitting your application on OnlineJobs.ph: **Subject Line:** [Your Tier] – SOLAR ROOF LEADER – [Largest Team Size Managed] – [Your Specific Verticals] *(Example: TIER 1 – SOLAR ROOF LEADER – 25 Reps – Comm Solar, Resi Solar & Roofing)* *(Example: TIER 2 – SOLAR ROOF LEADER – 15 Reps – Resi Solar)* In the body of your message, include 2–3 sentences sharing the biggest monthly or annual revenue volume a team achieved under your leadership.
