jobs.title: Job Listing — All-Round E-Commerce Virtual Assistant
jobs.description: About us We're a fast-scaling UK e-commerce brand, doing around £600,000/month and pushing hard past it. Direct-to-consumer on Shopify, driven primarily by paid social. We're preparing a US launch and building the team and systems to scale aggressively into Q4 and beyond. The founder runs lean and moves fast. Decisions are made quickly, standards are high, and everything is built with intent — nothing exists in this business "just because". You'd be working directly with the founder, inside the engine room of a brand in genuine growth mode. The role This is an all-round executive VA role. You are the founder's right hand online - the person who takes every piece of operational & admin work off his plate so he can stay focused on growth. This is not a narrow, ticket-based VA job. The brief is deliberately broad: if it can be done from a laptop and it needs doing, it's yours. Some days that's spreadsheets and data entry; other days it's chasing suppliers, organising files, managing inboxes, pulling research, or setting up a tool from scratch. You will be logged into core business systems and trusted with sensitive access. That trust is the foundation of this role - we vet hard for it, and we reward it with real responsibility and long-term stability. What you'll be doing A non-exhaustive flavour of the work: • Operations admin - keeping our project management system asana updated and organised; building and maintaining SOPs; tracking tasks across the team; chasing loose ends so nothing slips. • Inbox & comms support - triaging email and messages, drafting replies, coordinating with team members, agencies, and suppliers on the founder's behalf. • E-commerce admin - Shopify back-office tasks: orders, products, apps, basic store housekeeping; supporting fulfilment and supply chain follow-ups. • Data & reporting - pulling numbers from our tools, maintaining trackers and spreadsheets, preparing simple reports so decisions can be made fast. • Creative & marketing support - organising creative assets, uploading and labelling content, supporting creator outreach admin, prepping briefs and files for editors. • General admin work - file organisation, account setups, scheduling, documentation, and the hundred small things that keep a fast-moving business tight. • Onboarding & Offboarding team members according to SOP • Operating my calendar • Ongoing candidate search for job roles The mix will shift as the business scales. What won't change: you own the details so the founder doesn't have to. Who you are • Genuinely sharp. You pick things up fast, connect dots without being walked through them, and can be given an outcome rather than a checklist. If something's ambiguous, you make a sensible call or ask one good question — not ten. • Trustworthy to the core. You'll hold logins to real business systems. Discretion, honesty, and reliability are non-negotiable. References will be checked. • You get the vision. You understand you're joining a brand that intends to scale hard, and you work like it — urgency, ownership, no "that's not my job". • Obsessively organised. Nothing you own gets dropped. You keep systems tidier than you found them. • A strong communicator in English. Clear, concise written updates. You lead with the answer — TLDR first, detail after. • AI & Digitally native. You can learn any tool quickly. Experience with Shopify, Asana, Slack, or e-commerce generally is a big plus, not a requirement. • Proactive. You spot what needs doing before being asked. When told how we like something done once, you remember it permanently. Tools you'll touch Shopify, Asana, Slack, WhatsApp, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Google Workspace, plus various e-commerce and AI tools as needed. You don't need to know them all on day one — you need to be the kind of person who can open a new tool and be competent in it within a week. The details • Location: Fully remote. Significant working-hours overlap with UK time required. • Hours: Full-time preferred; exceptional part-time candidates considered. • Pay: Competitive for your market, tracked hourly, paid monthly, with growth tied to performance. Top performers get more responsibility and more money — we promote from within as we scale. • Start: As soon as possible. How to apply Send us: 1. A short cover note (max 150 words) on why this role fits you — TLDR style, answer first. NOTE - this job posting is written using AI, your cover note cannot be! Although I am looking for someone who is completely AI native, I do not want to read through hundreds of AI cover letters! 2. Your CV. 3. One example of a time you took something messy and made it organised — 2–3 sentences. 4. Start your application with the word "Calm" so we know you read this properly. Applications that ignore the instructions won't be read. Attention to detail starts here.

jobs.title: Remote MSP Technician / Systems Administrator
jobs.description: Company: Meteor Networks ( ---------- ) Schedule: Full time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Toronto time (Eastern) Pay: In US dollars, based on experience ABOUT US Meteor Networks is a managed service provider (MSP). We look after the IT for our business clients, including their security, cloud, networks, servers and phone systems. We are looking for a technician to join our team and help our clients day to day. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Help clients with everyday IT requests: adding and removing users, resetting passwords, and fixing issues as they come in - Manage client security using the Huntress platform, including endpoint detection and response (EDR) and identity threat detection and response (ITDR) - Manage and lock down Microsoft 365 tenants and email security - Work with Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft Intune and Entra ID - Administer Windows Server and Linux servers - Monitor, configure and troubleshoot client networks - Program and troubleshoot our VoIP phone system, which is built on FusionPBX and hosted in our own data center - Manage backups using Comet Backup with Wasabi storage, and Dropsuite for Microsoft 365 - Help onboard new clients - Work tickets in our ticketing system and keep notes clear and up to date TOOLS WE USE - NinjaOne (RMM) - Our own ticketing system - Huntress (EDR, ITDR) - Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune - Comet Backup, Wasabi, Dropsuite - Ubiquiti and pfSense firewalls - TP-Link switches - TP-Link and UniFi access points - FusionPBX You do not need to know all of these. We will train you on the ones you have not used before. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - We are open to all experience levels, from junior to senior - If you are early in your career, you should have IT schooling or a solid understanding of the basics (networking, Windows, user accounts, security). We can teach you our tools, but we cannot train someone from zero - Hands on experience matters more to us than certifications. Certifications like CompTIA or Microsoft are a plus, but proven experience is enough - Good spoken and written English, since you will talk with clients by phone and video - Able to work on your own, ask questions when stuck, and keep good notes EQUIPMENT AND INTERNET - Your own computer with a webcam - A good headset with a microphone - Internet of at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload. A wired connection is preferred. You will be on voice calls, video calls and remote desktop sessions throughout the day - We understand brownouts happen. If you lose power or internet, those hours are unpaid unless you have your own backup power or internet ON CALL (OPTIONAL) On call work is available if you want it. You are paid for being on call, and paid by the hour for any time you spend working on a call. HOW TO APPLY Send us a short video, 2 to 3 minutes long, in English. Please record it with the same webcam and headset you would use for work, because we want to see and hear your setup. In the video, please: 1. Introduce yourself 2. Tell us about your IT experience, especially anything that matches what we do (Microsoft 365, Active Directory, networking, servers, security, VoIP) 3. Tell us why you think you are a good fit for this role 4. Tell us why you want to work with Meteor Networks 5. Confirm that you can work full time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Toronto time, and tell us if you are interested in on call work 6. Talk us through how you would handle the two scenarios below, as if you were explaining it to us on the phone SCENARIO 1: A new employee starts on Monday. Walk us through setting up their Microsoft 365 account, including the licence, email and MFA, and adding them to the right groups so they can get to the shared files. Then tell us what you would check if they still cannot sign in. SCENARIO 2: Huntress flags a Microsoft 365 sign in for one of our users from another country, and the user approved the MFA prompt. You also find a new inbox rule that forwards their email outside the company. Tell us how you would contain it, clean it up, and stop it from happening again. Put "Meteor Tech Ready" in your subject line so we know you read the full post. Applications without a video or the subject line will not be reviewed.

Sometimes they’re planning their first painting project and have questions. Sometimes they just need to know when someone will get back to them. If you notice we’re entering the same information twice, or there’s an easier way to keep track of appointments, speak up. What matters is that the details are accurate and the homeowner is taken care of. Your first 30 days and what comes next I’ll show you how I handle an estimate inquiry. Then you’ll take a call, record what the homeowner needs, and we’ll talk through it together. You’ll get to put that feedback into practice on your next one. You can learn the painting business here. What I’m looking for from the start is someone who listens, asks questions when something is unclear, and takes ownership of their work. You can expect the same openness from me. If I ask you to improve something, I’ll explain what I saw and what a better result looks like. If something goes wrong, I want you to feel comfortable telling me early so we can put things right together. At the end of 30 days, we’ll sit down and talk about how the work is going for both of us. If you’re handling the responsibilities well and we have enough work to support a full-time schedule, we’ll discuss making that transition together. Beyond onboarding, we’ll review your progress every three months. As the company grows and you take on more responsibility, there’s an opportunity to grow into an Office Manager role. Your résumé or a brief work history. Are you currently working for another employer or client? If you’re selected, what’s the earliest date you could start? Please factor in any notice you’d need to give and let me know how much time you’d need. 2. A fresh video for this opening, up to two minutes long. Tell me what interests you about working here and one experience that’s prepared you for the role. Then imagine you’ve answered the phone and Sarah says, “Hi, I’m thinking about painting my living room. Before I schedule an estimate, can you tell me roughly what it’ll cost?” This is Sarah’s first call, and that’s all she’s shared so far. What would you say next? Speak directly to Sarah in your own words, just as you would on the phone. A simple phone recording is great. Just check that your link opens. 3. One short written example. Tell me about a time you kept records organized and made sure someone received a follow-up. How did you keep track? If AI or automation helped, tell me what it handled and what you checked yourself. If you handled it manually, tell me one step you’d simplify. What to expect after you apply We’re looking to hire within the next two to four weeks. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance. They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts. ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution. Primary Objectives Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment Competitive Advantage Regular Work Activities Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails) Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track) General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content) Daily spot checks on priority ASINs Weekly analysis and seasonal updates Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP) Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals) SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets) Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing) Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type) FAQ seeding weekly/as needed Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list) Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches) Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues) Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers) Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination) Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests) Key Skills Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth) Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions) Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation Organized project management across many ASINs Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating) Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops) People Contacts and Interactions PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment) Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes) Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions) Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable * Manage and maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable. * Process vendor invoices, payments, and customer receipts. * Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up on past-due balances. * Maintain accurate vendor and customer records. * Assist with cash flow monitoring and payment scheduling. Commission Reporting * Prepare recurring commission reports and calculations. * Review sales and transaction information for accuracy. * Coordinate commission payments and resolve discrepancies. * Maintain supporting documentation for commission calculations. Payroll * Coordinate and process payroll information. * Review payroll reports for accuracy. * Maintain employee payroll records and assist with payroll-related questions. * Coordinate with the payroll provider and accounting team as needed. Client Support * Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for the client regarding accounting and business management matters. * Respond to client questions and requests in a timely and professional manner. * Coordinate with vendors, employees, and other third parties on behalf of the client. * Identify issues and communicate them to the appropriate accounting or management team. Bookkeeping & Financial Administration * Perform bank and credit card reconciliations. * Maintain accurate and organized accounting records. * Assist with monthly financial reporting and account analysis. * Enter and review transactions in QuickBooks Online. * Assist with budgeting, cash flow tracking, and other financial analysis as needed. General Business Management Support * Handle miscellaneous accounting, business management, and administrative tasks related to the client's business. * Assist with special projects and financial research. * Maintain organized electronic records and supporting documentation. * Coordinate with the tax and accounting teams regarding tax filings, information requests, and year-end matters. * Take on additional responsibilities as needed to support the client's business operations. QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS * Minimum 2 years of experience working with U.S.-based clients or accounts. * 2+ years of bookkeeping, accounting, business management, or related experience. * Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable. * Experience with payroll and commission calculations preferred. * QuickBooks Online experience preferred. * Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills. * Excellent attention to detail and organization. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities. * Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial and payroll information. * Strong client service and communication skills. IDEAL CANDIDATE The ideal candidate is someone who can become familiar with the client's business and serve as a reliable day-to-day financial resource. This person should be proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities. You will also review older transactions, identify discrepancies, and assist with collections when needed. We are looking for someone with hands-on A/R experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while maintaining accurate financial records. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Post customer payments for approximately 3–5 hours per day. - Match incoming payments to the correct services, jobs, and customer accounts. - Review accounts to ensure payments have been entered accurately. - Audit older jobs and transactions to verify that all payments have been received and properly applied. - Identify missing payments, incorrect entries, and account discrepancies. - Maintain accurate and organized accounts receivable records. - Assist with collections and payment follow-ups when time allows. - Perform other administrative and accounting-related duties as needed. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Previous hands-on experience in Accounts Receivable. - Strong understanding of payment posting and account reconciliation. - Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial records. - Ability to review transactions, identify discrepancies, and resolve payment-record issues. - Strong organizational and time-management skills. - Ability to work independently and manage assigned tasks efficiently. - Reliable internet connection, computer, and quiet remote workspace. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience handling payment posting for service-based businesses. - Background in auditing customer accounts and reviewing historical transactions. - Experience with accounting software, billing systems, or payment platforms. - Collections and accounts follow-up experience. PRIORITY SKILLS - Payment Posting - Accounts Receivable Reconciliation - Account Auditing and Review - Financial Record Management - Administrative Support IDEAL CANDIDATE The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, organized, and experienced in handling accounts receivable transactions. You should be comfortable reviewing payment records, matching payments to the correct accounts, and identifying discrepancies without overlooking small details. Accuracy and consistency are essential for this position. APPLICATION QUESTIONS 1. How many years of hands-on Accounts Receivable experience do you have, and what were your main responsibilities? 2. Describe your experience with payment posting, matching payments to jobs or invoices, and reconciling customer accounts. 3. What accounting or payment systems have you used, and are you comfortable auditing older transactions to identify missing or incorrectly applied payments? APPLICATION INSTRUCTION To confirm that you have read the entire job description, please use this subject line when applying: ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE - [YOUR FULL NAME] Applications that do not follow the subject-line instruction may not be prioritized.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Hands-on experience setting up and administering Google Workspace for a business or organization. - Strong knowledge of Google Drive, shared drives, folder structures, and access permissions. - Proficiency in Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, and Google Sheets. - Experience managing user accounts and organizing company information. - Ability to create clear SOPs, process documentation, and workflow instructions. - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. - Ability to work independently, troubleshoot issues, and take ownership of assigned projects. - Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience managing Google Workspace as a company's central operating system. - Knowledge of Google Apps Script or other workflow automation tools. - Experience integrating Google Workspace with third-party applications. - Familiarity with Zapier, Make, or similar automation platforms. - Previous experience supporting U.S.-based businesses. - Experience training employees and implementing new internal systems. jobs.title: Financial Accountant (AU Experience) + Morning Shift
jobs.description: Job Brief We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Financial Accountant to manage end-to-end financial accounting, month-end close, transactional finance, and credit management functions. Operating as a seamless extension of the Australian finance team, this role goes beyond routine processing to drive accountability, maintain strict accuracy, and deliver actionable insights. The successful remote professional will take full ownership of defined workstreams, ensure compliance with Australian financial standards, and actively contribute to continuous process improvement to support business growth. Responsibilities Support the monthly financial close and assist in preparing recurring financial reports to maintain accurate financial visibility. Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations, proactively investigating and resolving reconciling items on a timely basis. Prepare accurate journals, accruals, prepayments, and month-end adjustments backed by appropriate supporting documentation. Review general ledger activity regularly to identify, investigate, and correct unusual, incomplete, or incorrectly coded transactions. Maintain fixed asset records and support depreciation calculations alongside routine asset reconciliations. Support intercompany accounting workflows, perform balance reconciliations, and resolve outstanding intercompany accounts promptly. Assist with year-end audit requirements by preparing comprehensive supporting schedules and audit documentation. Take operational ownership of the aged receivables ledger, executing routine collection activities to support cash flow optimisation. Monitor customer balances, track overdue accounts, and ensure strict adherence to approved commercial payment terms. Issue customer statements, payment reminders, and collection correspondence while conducting proactive follow-up communications. Maintain clear collection notes, agreed action steps, and follow-up schedules to provide a complete and transparent audit trail. Investigate unapplied receipts, short payments, and account discrepancies, coordinating directly with stakeholders for resolution. Prepare regular aged debt, collection, and credit risk reports for Australian management review. Escalate material overdue accounts, disputed balances, payment-plan requests, and credit risk exceptions to Australian leadership. Review supplier invoices and supporting documentation to verify completeness and adherence to internal approval thresholds. Assist with accounts payable reconciliations, payment run preparations, and the investigation of billing discrepancies. Support employee expense reporting and corporate card reconciliations to ensure complete financial compliance. Maintain accurate customer, supplier, and financial records alongside complete supporting documentation across systems. Manage Groupware submissions in strict accordance with established Delegation of Authority requirements. Prepare recurring monthly spend reports, schedules, and ad hoc financial analysis to support strategic decision-making. Support actual-versus-budget analysis and investigate material variances to ensure financial transparency. Proactively identify unusual transactions, financial trends, control issues, or exceptions and bring them to management's attention. Maintain clean, accurate accounting records within Xero and other relevant company finance systems. Operate strictly within established approval processes, financial delegations, and internal governance controls. Assist with documenting finance procedures, calendars, checklists, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Identify and execute opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate recurring finance activities to improve operational efficiency. Requirements Demonstrated hands-on experience in financial accounting, including month-end close procedures and balance sheet reconciliations. Strong capability in accounts receivable and credit management, with confidence in managing overdue accounts and customer collections. Experience supporting an Australian business or strong familiarity with Australian accounting principles and practices. High attention to detail, sound commercial judgement, and the ability to investigate root causes rather than simply processing transactions. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills to liaise confidently with Australian managers and clients. Ability to work independently within established procedures, manage strict monthly deadlines, and proactively escalate material exceptions. Software Proficiency Xero or similar ERP/accounting platforms Microsoft Excel, including advanced data manipulation and reconciliations Groupware systems Education Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy, Finance, or a related business discipline. CPA / CA qualification or progress towards is highly regarded.

You explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit. You make 45 to 60 calls a day. The Kind of Person I'm Looking For: This role is for someone who likes to create, think, organize and solve problems. I'm not looking for someone who waits for instructions and checks tasks off a list. I'm looking for someone who sees an opportunity and says: "I have an idea. What if we tried this?" The work we create together should help generate real clients and real revenue. Your Core Responsibilities This is where you'll spend most of your time: - Creating Instagram and LinkedIn content - Designing Canva graphics and carousels - Writing engaging captions in excellent English - Editing short-form videos and Reels - Scheduling and managing social media posts - Planning and maintaining a monthly content calendar As You Grow As HIDARI and our client base grow, the right person can take on more, depending on their strengths and interests: - Lead magnets, guides and downloadable resources - Mailchimp email campaigns - Website updates (WordPress) - Mini-courses and digital products - Eventbrite and event promotion - Competitor, industry and marketing research - Funnel building and marketing automation - Improving our internal systems and processes You don't need experience in these areas to apply. I'm much more interested in strong core skills, initiative and a willingness to learn. You'll Probably Fit In Well If You Are: - Fluent in written English - Confident with Canva - Familiar with Instagram and LinkedIn - Comfortable editing short-form video (CapCut or similar) - Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve your work - Organized, dependable and detail-oriented - Proactive and able to work independently - Open to feedback and revisions - Willing to research and figure things out when you don't know the answer Bonus: Experience with Meta Business Suite, Mailchimp, WordPress or Eventbrite. What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days - You're self-directed. You manage your own workload and don't wait to be told what to do next. - You bring ideas to the table. You regularly pitch new content ideas, formats or improvements without being asked. - Our content calendar runs ahead. Content is planned and scheduled at least 2 weeks in advance. - We post consistently. Instagram and LinkedIn stay active every week, with no gaps. - Your work is on-brand from the first draft. You learn our brand guidelines and voice, so revisions get lighter over time. - You meet deadlines without reminders. Flexible hours only work when deliverables arrive on time. - You learn from the numbers. You notice which posts perform best and suggest how we can do more of what works. How to Apply To make sure you've read the entire posting, please begin your application with the words "Blue Cat." Applications without it will not be considered. Please send me: - A brief introduction about yourself - Your resume - Your portfolio or examples of your work Links to social media accounts you've helped manage Your weekly availability Creative Exercise I'm more interested in how you think than in something perfectly polished. Please review HIDARI Group and send me: 1. Instagram Carousel Idea: Share one carousel concept. A simple written outline is completely fine. 2. Growth Idea: Give me one marketing idea you think HIDARI should try and briefly explain why you think it would work. Please don't spend hours on this. I'm looking for creativity, initiative and how you approach marketing problems. Our Hiring Process Application. Send your application and creative exercise. Short call. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a 15–20 minute video call. Paid trial. Finalists complete a short, paid trial task based on real HIDARI work. Offer. The best fit receives a contractor offer and onboarding. What It's Like Working With Me I move quickly, I have a lot of ideas, and I enjoy working with people who are comfortable contributing their own. See something we could improve? Tell me. Have an idea? Pitch it. Something isn't working? Help me understand why and figure out a better approach. I want to build a team of talented people who enjoy producing great work together. As HIDARI grows, I want the people who helped build it to have opportunities to grow with it. If that sounds like an environment you'd enjoy, I'd love to hear from you. Start your application with "Blue Cat" and tell me what you can bring to HIDARI.

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative (Remote, Full-Time) — U.S. Pest Control
jobs.description: Customer Service Representative — Remote, Full-Time Prime Pest & Lawn is a growing residential pest control and lawn care company serving homeowners in several U.S. states. We are hiring remote Customer Service Representatives to join our office team as the first voice our customers hear. This is a long-term role with a published career path. We are not looking for someone to answer and transfer. We are looking for people who like talking to customers, can solve the problem on the call, and want to grow with one company. What You Will Do Answer inbound calls — Scheduling, billing questions, service questions, reservices and bookings for all of our branches. Work our email and text inbox — Clear, friendly, accurate replies, worked to empty every shift. Help customers who want to cancel — Understand why, and make a genuine effort to keep them. Keep perfect records — Log every conversation in our customer system the same day. Make outbound calls — Appointment confirmations and follow-up lists when the phones are quiet. What We Require Clear, easily understood spoken and written English At least one year of live phone customer service experience Genuine warmth and patience with homeowners who are frustrated or worried A quiet place to work, a computer, a noise-cancelling headset and wired internet A backup plan for power and internet outages Availability Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Mountain Time (11:00 PM to 8:00 AM Philippine time while the U.S. is on standard time) This must be your only job. We need your best hours, not a second shift. What Will Move You To The Top Of The List FieldRoutes experience — This is the system we run on. Pest control or lawn care experience — You will already understand what customers are calling about. Cancellation saves or retention work — You know how to keep a customer without arguing with them. What We Offer Pay — $6.00 to $8.00 USD per hour, based on experience, paid twice a month and always on time. 13th month pay — Every December, prorated for months worked. Paid training — Structured, hands-on, and live training with our team from your first day. A real career path — Customer Service Representative, then Branch Specialist, then Team Lead, with a higher pay band at each step. A team, not a task list — You will join our meetings, know our branch managers by name, and be treated as part of Prime. How To Apply — Please Read Carefully We do not review written applications on their own. To be considered, you must do both of the following. Put the words "Prime Customer Care" in the subject line of your application. Record yourself answering the four questions below, as a voice recording or a video, and include the link in your application. The Four Questions Introduce yourself and tell us about your experience handling customer phone calls. Where will you work from, and what is your backup if your power or internet goes out? Tell us about a time a customer was upset with you. What did you say, and how did it end? Have you used FieldRoutes or any other customer or scheduling software? What did you do in it? A customer calls to cancel their pest control because they are still seeing bugs. In your own words, how would you respond? Just do your best. We are listening to how you talk to people, not checking whether you know our programs. Applications without a recording or without the subject line will not be reviewed. Thank you for taking the time to apply.

jobs.title: Email Marketing & Content Specialist
jobs.description: Email Marketing & Content Specialist Company: Wise Agent Location: Philippines, remote Type: Full-time, hourly contractor Pay: 8–11 USD per hour, based on experience, writing quality, and demonstrated results Hours: 40 paid hours per week Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Arizona time, including a 30-minute unpaid lunch break. This is 11:00 p.m.–7:30 a.m. the following morning in the Philippines. The Friday shift ends Saturday morning. Performance reviews: At 3, 6, and 12 months, with opportunities for pay increases based on performance. About Wise Agent Wise Agent is an established real estate technology company helping agents, teams, and brokers stay organized, automate follow-up, build relationships, and grow their businesses. Our platform combines CRM, marketing, transaction management, websites, and other tools with 24/7 human support. We have a collaborative team in Arizona and the Philippines and are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term role. About the role You will take ownership of email marketing and written content, including our weekly email, The Hoot, our monthly newsletter, blogs, product announcements, and promotional campaigns. Every piece should help the reader understand a problem, see a practical solution, and take a relevant next step. You will also measure performance, run thoughtful tests, and recommend improvements that help us grow our audience, generate trials, and acquire paying members. You should bring hands-on email marketing experience. We will train you on Wise Agent, our audience, brand voice, tools, and internal processes. What you’ll do Email marketing and newsletters Write, build, test, and schedule The Hoot, monthly newsletters, product announcements, and promotional emails. Develop subject lines, preview text, clear messaging, and effective calls to action. Segment audiences so prospects, trial users, paying members, and partners receive relevant messages. Maintain the email calendar and coordinate deadlines, assets, and approvals. Check recipients, personalization, links, tracking, spelling, and mobile presentation before every send. Testing and improvement Maintain an A/B testing plan for subject lines, preview text, content, calls to action, and sending days or times. Define the hypothesis, success metric, and review period before each test. Test one main variable at a time using comparable audience groups. jobs.title: FULL-TIME CSR / APPOINTMENT SETTER — HOME SERVICE LEADS (GOHIGHLEVEL REQUIRED)
jobs.description: READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING This role requires previous experience calling leads for home service businesses (waterproofing, foundation repair, crawl space, concrete, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, pest control, solar, and similar). This is the minimum requirement, not a preference. If you do not have it, do not apply. Your application will not be reviewed. ABOUT DRYSCALE DryScale runs lead generation for waterproofing, crawl space, foundation repair, and concrete contractors across the United States. We get some of the best results in the space and are one of the fastest-growing agencies on the market. Our ads bring in homeowners with a real problem at the house (water in the basement, a cracking foundation, a sinking driveway) who have asked to be contacted. You are the person who calls them. Because we're growing this fast, we need a high-quality, long-term partner in this CSR role, not a short-term hire. If you're looking for a few months of work, this isn't it. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Dial every new B2C lead that comes in across our client accounts, fast. Speed-to-lead is the job. - Book the homeowner for a free in-home inspection and estimate on the client's calendar in GoHighLevel. - Work the follow-up: no-answers, callbacks, texts, and older leads that never booked. - Confirm upcoming appointments so they actually hold. - Keep GHL clean: correct pipeline stage, notes on every conversation, tags, and call outcomes. - Handle multiple client accounts, each with its own services, service area, and calendar. - Flag out-of-area requests, wrong-service leads, and anything the client's office needs to know. REQUIREMENTS (ALL FIVE ARE REQUIRED) 1. Experience calling for home service businesses. Minimum requirement, see above. 2. Familiar with GoHighLevel (GHL): contacts, conversations, pipelines, and calendars. 3. At least 3 years of experience in previous roles (phone-based customer service, appointment setting, or inside sales). 4. Very fluent in English. You will be on the phone with US homeowners all day: clear, confident, and easy to understand. 5. Able to work a full-time position on US Eastern Time hours. You'll also need reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset. COMPENSATION $1,500–$2,000 USD per month on-target earnings: base pay plus performance pay tied to the appointments you book. HOW TO APPLY: SEND A 1-MINUTE VIDEO There are no interviews at this stage. To apply, record a quick video (about 1 minute) of yourself reading the call script below, then send it to us. Your video must: - Show your face on camera. - Start with your name and the home service industries you've called for, then go straight into the script. - Be recorded with the headset or mic you'd actually use on calls, in the space you'd actually work from. We want to hear what homeowners would hear. - Sound like a real call. Don't just read the words. Say it the way you would to a homeowner on the phone. Read only your own lines. You don't need to act out the homeowner. EXAMPLE SCRIPT: FOUNDATION REPAIR NEW LEAD CALL "Hi, is this Mark? Hey Mark, this is [your name] with Summit Foundation Repair. You filled out a form on our site a few minutes ago about some cracks in your foundation. Did I catch you at an okay time? Great. Just so I understand what's going on: are the cracks inside the basement, on the outside walls, or both? And have you noticed any doors sticking, or windows that don't close like they used to? Okay, that's really helpful. That's exactly what our inspectors want to look at before it gets any worse. What we'll do is send a specialist out to the house for a free inspection. They'll show you what's causing it and give you a written estimate right there, no cost and no obligation. I've got Thursday at 10 AM or Friday at 2 PM open in your area. Which one works better for you? Perfect, you're all set for Thursday at 10. You'll get a text confirmation in the next few minutes. Thanks, Mark. Talk soon." HOW TO SEND IT Reply to this post with all four of the following: 1. A link to your video (Loom, unlisted YouTube, or Google Drive set to "Anyone with the link can view"). 2. Confirmation that you meet the minimum requirements, including which home service businesses you've called for. 3. Confirmation that you can work full-time on US Eastern Time hours. 4. Confirmation that you're familiar with GoHighLevel. If anything is missing, or the video link doesn't open, your application will not be reviewed. Consider this the first test of the job: following instructions exactly is what this role is. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT We'll watch every video and reach out directly to the applicants we think are the best fit. If you don't hear from us, you were not selected this round. We're looking forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Bilingual Spanish/English Legal Intake Specialist & Legal Assistant (US Law Firm)
jobs.description: ABOUT US Gaines & Gaines, APLC is a California law firm that stands up for employees in workplace disputes, including unpaid wages, wrongful termination, discrimination, and retaliation. Our team is available to answer questions, review your work, and help you improve. • A close-knit, supportive team: you'll work alongside other remote VAs who know what it's like to work US hours from the Philippines, and you'll be treated as a real member of the firm • Meaningful work: you'll help workers who have been treated unfairly get the help they need • Room to grow: as you learn, you can take on more responsibility in intake and legal assistant work THE ROLE You'll handle intake calls with Spanish- and English-speaking potential new clients, gather the facts of their situation, write clear summaries in English for our attorney, and support our legal team with client communication and admin work. You'll be fully trained on our process and what to say. REQUIREMENTS • Fluent Spanish AND English, both spoken and written (you will be tested in both) • Strong phone presence: patient, warm, and able to keep callers on topic when they're stressed or confused • Excellent written English, with clear, accurate, concise notes • Experience in intake, a call center, customer service, or virtual assistant work for US clients • Strong attention to detail and the ability to keep client information strictly confidential • Reliable high-speed internet, backup internet/power, a quiet workspace, and a noise-canceling headset • Available during US Pacific Time business hours NICE TO HAVE • Experience at a US law firm, especially in employment, personal injury, or other intake-heavy practices • Experience with Clio, Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel), and OneDrive. We use these every day, so experience is a plus, but not required. We'll train you! • Familiarity with 8x8 (or a similar VoIP phone system) and Calendly • Comfort with Mexican and Central American Spanish dialects and slang SCHEDULE & PAY • Full-time, Monday through Friday • Typical hours: 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time (about 12:30 AM to 9:00 AM Manila time) • Two paid 10-minute breaks and one unpaid 30-minute lunch each day • After you complete training, we're open to a longer unpaid lunch (up to 1 hour) if you prefer • Pay: $5 to $10/hour, depending on experience • Long-term role for the right person HOW TO APPLY To be considered, please: • Use the subject line "Bilingual Interview – [Your Full Name]" • Attach your resume • Include a short voice recording (2 to 3 minutes): introduce yourself in English, then pretend you're answering a call from a Spanish-speaking worker who says they weren't paid for overtime. Greet them and ask your first few questions in Spanish. • Briefly tell us where and how you learned Spanish, and describe any intake or legal experience Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed.

You would be the dedicated developer for the public website and its tools: small fixes, content and data updates, prepared feature changes, and first response when something breaks. Write the end-of-day handoff note you would leave for the founder after a day where you fixed a broken page, found a second problem you could not fix yet, and finished a small feature. jobs.title: OPERATIONS MANAGER (Real Estate Experience is a MUST!)
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Operations Manager to oversee the daily execution of our residential real estate transactions, marketing outreach campaigns, and internal database operations. Acting as the central operational hub for our team, you will bridge the gap between active client escrows and business growth initiatives—ensuring seamless closings, accurate brand assets, and high-performing outreach workflows. Key Responsibilities 1. Transaction & Escrow Management Closing & Title Coordination: Confirm final closing and recording statuses directly with title companies; coordinate payment methods and check-pickup logistics. Inspection & Repair Negotiations: Track and follow up on seller responses to the BINSR (Buyer’s Inspection Notice and Seller’s Response). Vendor & Municipal Compliance: Collect contractor estimates, verify municipal permit statuses (such as patio and structural permits), and liaise with specialty vendors (e.g., roofing contractors) to gather formal assessments. Client Decision Support: Present vendor recommendations and repair estimates to clients and lead agents to secure timely decisions on negotiation next steps. 2. Growth, Marketing & Outreach Operations Campaign Review & Alignment: Manage feedback loops with leadership on growth workbooks, neighborhood market reports, SMS/text drafts, and call priority lists. Technical QA & Testing: Execute end-to-end phone and message delivery testing prior to launching outreach campaigns. Performance & Priority Management: Establish baseline metrics for outreach campaigns and finalize call/text priorities following leadership review. 3. Brand Asset & Database Quality Control Directory & Profile Audits: Regularly review flagged agent/team profiles in internal tracking systems (e.g., B•Real tracker) to identify discrepancies or outdated assets. Asset Replacement Coordination: Manage the end-to-end replacement of outdated profile images and branding materials with creative vendors or team members. System Maintenance: Maintain accurate, real-time status logs across operational trackers as updates and corrections are completed. Qualifications & Skills Experience: 2+ years in real estate operations, transaction coordination, or executive administration (experience with Arizona residential real estate contracts and BINSR workflows strongly preferred). Technical Proficiency: Strong command of spreadsheets/workbooks (Excel/Google Sheets), CRM platforms, SMS/dialer testing tools, and project tracking databases. Communication: Clear, proactive communicator capable of coordinating directly with title officers, contractors, clients, and internal leadership. Execution Style: Self-directed problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, manages competing deadlines without dropping details, and takes full ownership of follow-through. Please include "Leverage Agent - Operations Manager" at the subject line.

jobs.description: About the Role We are looking for a highly efficient Operations Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our growing organization. Remote Team Leadership: Track record of successfully managing and upskilling remote teams or Virtual Assistants, with a sharp eye for workflow efficiency and clear delegation. jobs.title: Senior Social Media & Content Specialist
jobs.description: About Us Narratives by Nazar is a digital marketing agency that empowers small, women-focused businesses to grow through creative and strategic social media management. We’re a growing agency that works with brands in the beauty, wellness, and aesthetic industries. As we expand, we’re looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and tech-savvy Senior Social Media & Content Specialist to help us manage our growing client base and support our daily operations. This is an evolving role that offers opportunities for growth, learning, and increased responsibility. About the Role As a Senior Social Media & Content Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting content creation and social media management across multiple client accounts. We’re looking for someone who is creative, organized, proactive, and must have experienced in using AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to create social media content efficiently. As our agency grows, you must be comfortable eventually managing 10–15 dedicated client accounts and producing approximately 35–60 social media posts per week, including static posts, carousels, and Reels, while maintaining content quality and brand consistency. Key Responsibilities Content Creation Support: - Create engaging social media posts, captions, carousels, and Reels for Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. - Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI-powered platforms to generate content ideas, captions, graphics, and short-form videos. - Edit photos and videos to match each client’s brand aesthetic. - Research trends, hashtags, and competitor content to keep our strategies fresh. - Ensure all content follows each client's brand voice and visual guidelines. Social Media Management: - Schedule and publish content across multiple platforms. - Engage with followers by responding to comments and direct messages. - Monitor daily social media activity and flag any issues. - Manage multiple client accounts and maintain consistent content schedules. jobs.title: U.S. Tax Preparer
jobs.description: About ERPS Group ERPS Group is a fast-growing accounting, tax, and business advisory firm dedicated to helping business owners build stronger, more profitable companies. We provide accounting, tax planning, bookkeeping, payroll, CFO advisory, and business consulting services to clients across multiple industries. Our mission is to deliver exceptional client service while helping entrepreneurs make informed financial decisions and achieve long-term success. We believe in professionalism, accountability, continuous improvement, and teamwork. Every member of our team plays an important role in creating an outstanding client experience. We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced U.S. Tax Preparer & Reviewer to join our growing team. This position requires practical experience preparing U.S. tax returns, reviewing returns for accuracy and completeness before submission, and maintaining a strong understanding of U.S. federal and state tax regulations. The ideal candidate is analytical, proactive, highly responsible, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with our U.S.-based team. Key Responsibilities 1. U.S. Tax Return Preparation Prepare accurate U.S. individual and business tax returns. Work with various tax forms, including but not limited to Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065. Review financial statements, supporting documentation, and client-provided information to ensure accurate tax reporting. Identify potential tax deductions, credits, and tax-saving opportunities within applicable tax regulations. Ensure tax returns are prepared in compliance with current U.S. federal and applicable state tax laws. Identify missing, inconsistent, or questionable information and request clarification when necessary. 2. Tax Return Review & Quality Control Independently review prepared tax returns before submission to identify errors, inconsistencies, omissions, and potential compliance issues. Verify calculations, supporting schedules, income reporting, deductions, credits, and tax liabilities. Ensure all required forms, disclosures, and supporting documentation are included. Identify potential tax risks and escalate complex or unusual tax situations to the appropriate manager or tax professional. Maintain high standards of accuracy and quality while meeting established turnaround times. Ensure all returns pass internal quality-control procedures before being finalized for filing. 3. Tax Research & Compliance Maintain an up-to-date understanding of U.S. federal and state tax regulations. Research tax questions and provide well-supported answers based on reliable IRS guidance and applicable tax authorities. Stay informed about annual tax law changes, filing requirements, and regulatory updates. Assist with resolving tax return discrepancies and responding to internal review comments. Maintain proper documentation of research, calculations, and decisions. 4. Client Documentation & Workflow Management Organize and maintain tax documents, workpapers, and client records. Identify missing documentation and communicate outstanding requirements to the appropriate team members. Maintain accurate records of assigned returns, progress, review status, and deadlines. Work efficiently with the accounting and customer care teams to ensure a smooth tax preparation process. Handle confidential financial and personal information with the highest level of discretion. 5. Team Collaboration & Accountability Collaborate with U.S.-based tax professionals, accountants, and management. Follow established company procedures, workflows, and quality standards. Meet daily and weekly production targets without compromising accuracy. Communicate proactively regarding delays, issues, or potential compliance concerns. Take ownership of assigned returns from preparation through internal review and completion. Required Qualifications & Experience Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience preparing U.S. tax returns. Demonstrated experience with both individual and business tax returns. Strong knowledge of U.S. federal income tax regulations and familiarity with state taxation. Practical experience reviewing tax returns for accuracy, completeness, and compliance before filing. Strong understanding of IRS forms, instructions, and filing requirements. Experience working with U.S. accounting and tax preparation software. Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to understand complex U.S. tax terminology and communicate effectively with U.S.-based professionals. Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills. Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Excellent organizational and time-management skills. Ability to manage multiple tax returns and deadlines simultaneously. Ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet performance expectations. Preferred Qualifications Experience with professional tax preparation software such as ProSeries. Experience working with QuickBooks

jobs.title: Customer Service & Inbound Sales Representative (Full-Time, US Hours) + Admin Support - URGENT
jobs.description: === SALARY === $3.50 USD per hour (about $385 per biweekly pay period for 110 hours), plus INCENTIVES. We are more than happy to increase the base rate to $4.00 USD per hour after 3 months. === JOB DESCRIPTION (paste below) === ABOUT US Bee Man Dan LLC is a Houston, Texas company that does bee removal and hive relocation. We locate hives with thermal imaging; we have served Houston-area families since 2015, and we are 5-star Google-rated. Our operations team works remotely from the Philippines. THE ROLE You are the first voice customers hear and the person who keeps our daily operations moving. You answer inbound calls, turn inquiries into confirmed bookings, and keep the schedule, follow-ups, and admin organized so nothing slips. We need someone who sounds great on the phone, closes with confidence and honesty, and stays on top of the details without being chased. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1. Answer inbound customer calls: understand the problem, quote only from our approved rate card, confirm the address and ZIP code, take the card on file, and book the job. 2. Call back new online inquiries (Facebook and Google leads) within minutes, using our call script, and follow up until the lead books or declines. 3. Set appointments, follow up on quotes that have not booked, and close sales honestly, with no pressure tactics and no promises we cannot keep. 4. Operations admin: check the shared inbox, keep the job schedule and ClickUp tasks up to date, coordinate between customers and our field technicians, follow up on payments, and keep our trackers clean. 5. Log every call and outcome in our call tracker and send an end-of-day report. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - 2 to 3 years of inbound call experience in customer service and sales, ideally in a BPO or call center (required) - Proven record of appointment setting and closing bookings or sales over the phone (required) - Excellent English at an advanced (C2 / near-native) level: a clear, neutral accent and natural, conversational speech (required) - Experience serving US clients and comfortable with US callers and culture (required) - Operations or administrative skills: scheduling, inbox management, trackers, and following up on tasks (required) - Very organized and proactive: you spot what needs doing and do it without being asked (required) - Handles rejection well, coachable, follows a script, and stays honest with customers (required) - Pest control, home services, or lead generation experience (preferred, not required: we will train you on our process) - Comfortable with ClickUp, Google Workspace, and a CRM or Google Sheets (we will train you on our tools) - Quiet workspace, headset, stable internet, and a backup connection and power SCHEDULE Full-time, 11 hours a day, Monday to Friday, on Central Time (Houston) business hours, covering our phone hours of about 8am to 6pm CST. That means evening or overnight hours in the Philippines. No weekend work. Exact shift hours are confirmed at hiring. No time tracking tool. TERMS Independent contractor, paid biweekly via Wise or direct to bank. 3-month probationary period, then the base rate increases to $4.00 USD per hour. Base pay plus incentives. The incentive structure is discussed directly with the selected candidate. HOW TO APPLY (please follow all steps; incomplete applications are not reviewed) 1. Start your message with the word BEE so we know you read this post. 2. Send your resume link. 3. Write 3 to 4 sentences about your experience: industries and accounts handled, years of inbound calls, and one result with a number (bookings, conversion rate, or sales). 4. Send an audio recording of 1 to 2 minutes (voice note or link), recorded for this application. Say your name and the word BEE, then answer: a) Tell us about a call you closed: what the customer wanted, what you said, and how it ended. b) A homeowner says "I'll think about it" after hearing the price. What do you say next to move toward a booking without pressure? 5. Tell us your earliest start date. Applications without an audio recording are not reviewed. Shortlisted applicants complete a short assessment (a call role-play plus a simple admin task such as organizing an inbox or schedule).

jobs.title: Estimating & Sales Operations Assistant
jobs.description: Position Summary Redd Ash Technologies is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Estimating & Sales Operations Assistant to support our Sales Department with sales administration, estimating, quoting, and proposal coordination. This is a sales-focused administrative role requiring prior experience supporting a sales team, managing customer quotes, preparing pricing documentation, or coordinating sales opportunities. The ideal candidate understands the administrative processes behind a successful sales operation and is comfortable working with pricing, vendor quotations, customer requirements, CRM systems, and sales documentation. Responsibilities include preparing and tracking customer estimates and quotes, obtaining vendor pricing, assisting with bid and proposal preparation, maintaining accurate CRM records, and coordinating the administrative activities necessary to move sales opportunities forward. This position is not a general executive or personal assistant role. Candidates should have demonstrated experience in sales administration, sales operations, estimating, quoting, or proposal coordination. Key Responsibilities & Duties 1. Sales Administration & Operations Provide direct administrative and operational support to the Sales Team throughout the sales cycle, from initial customer inquiry through quote submission and order processing. Prepare, format, review, and distribute customer quotations, sales estimates, proposals, and other sales documentation. Generate sales orders, purchase orders, and related documentation as needed. Track outstanding quotes, pending customer responses, follow-ups, and sales opportunities. Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer, contact, opportunity, and activity records within the CRM. Monitor sales pipeline activity and ensure opportunities are updated with current status, notes, next steps, and relevant documentation. Assist the Sales Team with researching customer requirements, product specifications, and potential solutions. Coordinate with internal departments to ensure sales commitments, pricing, and project details are properly documented. Assist with preparing sales reports, pipeline summaries, and other sales performance metrics. 2. Estimating, Quoting & Pricing Prepare detailed cost estimates and customer quotations for equipment, materials, labor, and services. Review customer requests, project specifications, bills of materials (BOMs), and other technical documentation to identify required products and services. Request and obtain pricing, availability, and lead-time information from manufacturers, distributors, and suppliers. Analyze vendor quotations and compare pricing, specifications, and availability to support purchasing and sales decisions. Calculate product costs, labor costs, markups, margins, and customer pricing with a high degree of accuracy. Identify pricing discrepancies, missing information, and potential cost considerations before quotes are submitted. Maintain and update pricing databases, vendor records, and historical cost information. Assist in identifying cost-saving opportunities and alternative products or solutions. Track estimated versus actual costs when applicable. 3. Proposals, Bids & Documentation Assist with preparing and coordinating Requests for Quotes (RFQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and formal bid submissions. Review bid requirements and ensure requested documentation, pricing, and supporting information are compiled accurately. Coordinate with vendors, manufacturers, and internal technical personnel to obtain information required for proposals. Prepare and organize proposal packages, pricing schedules, equipment lists, and supporting documentation. Maintain organized records of submitted quotes, proposals, revisions, and supporting documents. Track proposal deadlines and submission requirements to ensure timely delivery. 4. Vendor & Order Coordination Communicate with vendors and distributors to obtain product pricing, availability, specifications, and estimated delivery dates. Assist with procurement activities, including preparing and issuing purchase orders. Track order confirmations, vendor acknowledgments, and shipment updates. Coordinate with Sales, Project Management, and Accounting to resolve pricing, ordering, and documentation discrepancies. Maintain accurate records of vendor quotations, purchase orders, and related transactions. 5. CRM, Systems & Reporting Maintain accurate customer, vendor, product, and opportunity information within company systems. Ensure sales activities, communications, estimates, and follow-up actions are properly documented. Generate and maintain sales, estimating, and operational reports. Assist with improving sales administrative processes, documentation standards, and workflow efficiency. Maintain organized electronic files and records in accordance with company procedures. Qualifications & Experience Required Experience 2–5 years of experience in sales administration, sales

jobs.title: Video Editor
jobs.description: Hi there! We're Mitch and Hope, a husband-and-wife creative team based in Nashville, Tennessee, USA. We're both video professionals, entrepreneurs and content creators, and we're looking for a long-term video editor to join our small team. ABOUT US We create content for two brands of our own: - Lifestyle and Entertainment: a female-led brand about lifestyle, music, beauty, fashion, travel and life in the Nashville music industry. - Faith and Culture: a male-led Christian media brand exploring faith, culture and personal growth through podcasts, video essays, commentary and experiential storytelling. We also do client work similar to our own: social media videos for businesses and creators, and podcast editing for the people who record in our studio. THE JOB We're looking for a storyteller, not just someone who knows editing software. You'll take raw footage and turn it into videos that are entertaining, meaningful and keep people watching. You'll work directly with both of us. We'll give you footage, direction, references and feedback, and we also want you to bring your own ideas. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON EACH MONTH Our brands: - 4 lifestyle YouTube videos (10 to 20 minutes each) plus about 12 short-form clips - 2 multi-camera podcast episodes (60 to 90 minutes each) - 2 video essays or reaction videos (15 to 20 minutes each) - 1 vlog or documentary-style video (up to about 60 minutes) - Short-form clips cut from all of the above Client work: - Social media videos (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) for businesses and creators - Podcast editing for studio clients YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Edit long-form YouTube videos, podcasts and client projects from raw footage to final export 2. Find the best moments in long videos and turn them into short-form clips with strong hooks and captions 3. Handle color correction, audio cleanup, music, sound effects and basic motion graphics 4. Follow each brand's or client's style and deliver on time 5. Keep footage and project files organized, and send us a short daily report of what you worked on, what's finished, and what's next REQUIRED SKILLS - Fluent written and spoken English, including conversational English, humor and slang - Experience editing long-form YouTube content and short-form social videos - Adobe Premiere Pro - Multi-camera podcast editing - A computer that handles 4K footage and a reliable, fast internet connection WHAT MATTERS TO US - Strong storytelling instincts and attention to detail - Reliable and consistent, with clear communication - Able to work independently and take feedback well - Comfortable working with Christian and faith-based content - Willing to keep client footage confidential NICE TO HAVE - After Effects or advanced motion graphics - Experience with influencers, personal brands or agency clients - ---------- , LOG footage and proxy workflows - Knowledge of music and stock footage licensing SCHEDULE Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Hours are mostly flexible. We'd like about 2 hours each weekday that overlap with our US Central business hours for calls and feedback. We'll agree on a time that works for you, such as early morning or late evening Philippine time. PAY Monthly salary based on experience and portfolio. The editing test is paid. GROWING WITH US We're a small team and we want someone for the long run. As our client work grows, there's room for more creative ownership and raises. HOW TO APPLY Please put "Storytelling First" in your subject line and include: 1. A short introduction about you and your editing experience 2. 3 to 5 videos you personally edited (full-length videos, not just a demo reel) 3. Your role in each video 4. Your favorite YouTube creators and what you like about their editing 5. A screenshot of your computer specs (CPU, GPU, RAM) and your available storage 6. A Speedtest.net screenshot showing your internet download and upload speed 7. Your expected monthly salary in USD 8. Your earliest start date 9. Please use 6 apply points to apply Shortlisted applicants will have a short interview and a paid editing test using footage from our brands and a client project. Have questions about the role? Ask us in your message. We'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Operations Assistant VA
jobs.description: Keep Every Order Moving, From Vendor to Warehouse WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Before a lab can order from Filtrous, the product has to be on our shelves, and that starts with a purchase order placed well in advance. When that order goes out late, a vendor falls behind, or a shipment arrives wrong, our stock runs low and customers wait. As our Operations Assistant VA, you'll own the purchasing and vendor pipeline end-to-end, from the reorder sheet to the warehouse door. You'll make sure purchase orders go out on time, vendors stay on schedule, and shipments don't fall apart. In a business built on speed and reliability, your work keeps products in stock and our customers' labs running. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Turn the Reorder Sheet into Purchase Orders: Work from our reorder sheet to figure out what we need, build purchase orders in our ERP system with the purchasing team, and route them to leadership for approval. • Source Product with Vendors: Find supplier options, request and compare quotes, and work through product specs and minimum order quantities before an order is placed. • Confirm Every Order Detail: Send purchase orders to vendors, get the proforma invoice back, and work out adjustments like carton quantities and price changes. Verify barcodes with our operations team before anything is confirmed, and send vendors the full item package: photos, Certificate of Analysis (CoA), and packing list. • Keep Payments and Production on Track: Send vendor invoices to our finance team for payment, share proof of payment with the vendor, and get a production timeline back. Follow up with every vendor at least weekly, every three days if they go quiet, and escalate if they stop responding. WeChat must be used during business hours for faster turnaround on vendor communication. • Coordinate Shipping, Tariffs, and Customs: Work with our logistics team and freight partners on shipping and tariffs, consolidating across open purchase orders so we never ship a partial container. Handle customs declarations, declared values, and product classifications using information provided or approved by the company. • Keep the Warehouse Ready for Every Delivery: Update our ERP system as soon as a delivery date is set and share it with the warehouse right away, then send reminders a week out, three days out, and the morning of delivery. • Fix Problems and Track Every Order: If a shipment arrives incorrect or damaged, contact the vendor promptly and arrange a timely re-shipment at the vendor's cost. Keep a tracking sheet with each PO number, its exact status, and dates for everything, and other duties as assigned. PROBLEMS YOU WILL SOLVE • Purchase orders go out late: Without one person working the reorder sheet and pushing orders through approval, purchase orders slip and stock runs low before replacements are on the way. • Vendors drift off schedule: When no one follows up on a steady rhythm, suppliers go quiet, production timelines slide, and delays surface only when it is too late to recover. • Order details slip through the cracks: When carton quantities, price changes, barcodes, and product documents are not checked before an order is confirmed, small mistakes turn into wrong labels, wrong quantities, and costly rework. • Shipping costs more than it should: Partial containers, orders that are not consolidated, and incomplete customs paperwork add freight costs, tariff surprises, and delays at the border. • Deliveries catch the warehouse off guard: Without accurate delivery dates and timely reminders, shipments show up unannounced, receiving gets rushed, and damaged or incorrect goods are not sent back to the vendor in time. HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED • Get purchase orders built, approved, and sent to vendors on time, every month • Follow up on every open order at least weekly, with a confirmed production timeline • Ship zero partial containers by consolidating open orders on every shipment • Keep the tracking sheet and ERP current, and give the warehouse notice before every delivery WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE At Filtrous, you won't be a back-office clerk pushing paperwork. You'll own a pipeline that keeps real laboratories stocked with the supplies they rely on every day. You'll work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where your ideas for faster, smoother purchasing actually get implemented. You'll collaborate closely with our purchasing, finance, logistics, and warehouse teams, and your impact on on-time orders and in-stock products will be visible and celebrated. As we grow, so will your career, with opportunities to shape how Filtrous buys and ships from the ground up. WHO YOU ARE • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related field (required) • Experience in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain coordination, working directly with vendors (required) • Proficient with ERP and inventory systems (e.g., Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP) and spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets) • Comfortable with internati

We're a woman-founded brand from Texas, we sell in limited drops, and we move fast, with new sets launching every couple of months. Our motto is "welcome to the table": we're all about bringing women together around the game, so our online presence should feel warm, confident, a little cheeky, and never spammy. You'll work directly with our two co-founders. This is a long-term role with room to grow. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Pinterest (the big one): research keywords, build and organize boards, write keyword-optimized pin titles and descriptions, prepare pins in Canva from our photos and blog posts, schedule them consistently, and track what drives traffic to our site • Instagram (@_thetileedit) and TikTok (@the.tile.edit) engagement: find the right accounts (mahjong players, hosts, design-loving women, home and lifestyle creators) and leave genuine, on-brand comments every day • Send a short weekly report on what you did and what's working • Later, possibly: answer routine customer emails using our guidance WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • Proven Pinterest growth results (required) — show us accounts you've grown, with numbers • Clear, natural, witty written English. Comments must sound like a real person, not a bot • Experience with luxury lifestyle, home, or e-commerce brands is a big plus • Comfortable with Canva, Pinterest Trends, and AI tools • Reliable, organized, and able to make good calls on your own • Your own computer, reliable internet, and backup internet or power • At least a couple of hours of overlap with US Central business hours THIS JOB IS NOT • A general admin role • Follow-for-follow, bots, or automated engagement • A fit for agencies/teams or someone looking for a short side gig HOW TO APPLY 1. Share links to 1–3 Pinterest accounts you've managed and the results (monthly views, outbound clicks, or follower growth). 2.
