Start your application with the words "Welcome to the table" so we know you read the whole post. Applications that skip these steps won't be read.

jobs.title: Solar Project Manager
jobs.description: Job Summary SpartanX is seeking an experienced, highly organized Solar Project Manager to oversee residential solar projects from contract execution through installation, inspection, utility interconnection, and Permission to Operate (PTO). This position is responsible for tracking project milestones, coordinating across multiple departments, identifying delays, and ensuring projects move efficiently toward completion. We're looking for someone with residential solar project management experience who understands the full project lifecycle, communicates effectively, and takes ownership of resolving issues before they become costly delays. What You'll Do Project Management & Coordination - Manage residential solar projects from contract execution through PTO. - Track project milestones, deadlines, and outstanding requirements. - Coordinate with Site Survey, Design, Engineering, Permitting, Installation, Inspections, and Interconnection teams. - Identify project delays and proactively coordinate resolutions. - Monitor project readiness and ensure requirements are completed before advancing to the next stage. - Manage multiple active projects across different U.S. markets. Project Tracking & Issue Resolution - Maintain accurate project records, documentation, and status updates. - Identify missing information, incomplete tasks, and operational bottlenecks. - Follow up with internal departments to ensure timely completion of outstanding items. - Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate leadership. - Monitor aging projects and prioritize actions needed to move them forward. - Support continuous improvement of project management workflows. Communication & Reporting - Provide timely project updates to internal teams and stakeholders. - Coordinate with homeowners when necessary regarding project progress and outstanding requirements. - Communicate scheduling concerns, delays, and changes affecting project timelines. - Maintain accurate CRM and project management records. - Prepare project status reports and identify trends affecting completion timelines. What We're Looking For - Previous residential solar project management experience required. - Strong understanding of the residential solar project lifecycle, from contract through PTO. - Experience coordinating multiple departments and managing high-volume project pipelines. - Knowledge of permitting, inspections, utility interconnection, and installation workflows. - Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills. - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. - Ability to manage competing priorities and meet operational deadlines. - Experience using CRM systems and project management software. - Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment. - Availability during standard U.S. business hours. Preferred Qualifications - Experience managing residential solar projects across multiple U.S. states. - Familiarity with AHJ requirements, utility approvals, and PTO processes. - Experience identifying and resolving stalled or aging projects. Schedule Full-Time | Remote – Offshore Monday–Friday, aligned with standard U.S. business hours, with occasional additional availability based on operational needs. What We Offer - Competitive compensation based on experience. - Fully remote position. - Opportunity to work with a growing U.S. residential solar company. - Collaborative, cross-functional team environment. - Professional growth and advancement opportunities. Why SpartanX? At SpartanX, successful solar projects depend on strong coordination, accountability, and consistent follow-through. Our Project Managers play a critical role in keeping projects moving, resolving obstacles, and ensuring homeowners progress toward system activation. If you understand residential solar operations, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and take ownership of getting projects across the finish line, we'd love to hear from you. Apply here: ---------- Solar Done right.

jobs.title: Customer Support Agent | Fast-Growing D2C E-commerce Brand | Full-Time
jobs.description: This role is for someone who can own customer conversations end to end, protect the reputation of a fast-growing brand, and help build the support systems that make that reputation repeatable as volume climbs. The Role We’re looking for a Customer Support Agent with proven experience inside a 7-, 8- or 9-figure e-commerce brand. You need to understand brand reputation, not just ticket closing. Our existing support lead handles the current queue and will hand over process, tone and tooling. Your job is to take real ownership of your share of the conversations: Answer every ticket in the brand voice, not in generic support language. Resolve the actual problem, not just the message in front of you. Spot the pattern behind repeat tickets and flag it upstream. Turn an unhappy customer into someone who recommends us. Protect response time and resolution quality as volume grows. Improve the process rather than simply following it. The goal isn’t to clear the inbox. The goal is that every single person who contacts us walks away with the best experience we’re capable of giving them. What You’ll Own You’ll own a full share of the daily support queue across email and social channels, alongside the rest of the support team. Your responsibilities will include: Handling customer enquiries across email, social DMs and comments. Order issues: tracking, delays, address changes, damaged or missing items. Refunds, replacements and exchanges, within the brand’s policy and tiers. Pre-purchase questions where the customer needs help d ---------- . Escalations and difficult conversations, handled calmly and without defensiveness. Maintaining accurate notes so any teammate can pick up a thread cold. Reviewing and improving canned responses and macros as the product range changes. Writing and maintaining support SOPs as the team and the ticket volume grow. Flagging recurring issues to the operations and product side with the evidence behind them. Supporting review and reputation workflows so happy customers actually leave feedback. Hitting response time and satisfaction standards consistently, not occasionally. Taking ownership of the customer outcome rather than passing it along. Who We’re Looking For Non-negotiables Proven customer support experience with a successful DTC/e-commerce brand, ideally at 7-, 8- or 9-figure scale. Hands-on experience using CommSlayer. This is a requirement, not a preference. Hands-on experience with Shopify, plus any additional support platform such as Gorgias, Zendesk or Reamaze. Excellent written English. Clear, warm, natural, never robotic. Strong knowledge of standard e-commerce support situations: shipping, fulfilment, returns, chargebacks, disputes. Highly collaborative. You communicate proactively with teammates rather than working in silence. Ability to hold quality at volume, especially on a heavy day. Comfortable writing process documentation, not only using it. Genuinely invested in the long-term vision of the brand you work for. Full-time availability, 40+ hours per week, with reliable internet and a quiet working setup. The mindset We’re looking for someone who is: Genuinely warm toward customers, including the difficult ones. Extremely reliable. Proactive rather than reactive. Comfortable taking ownership of an outcome. Curious about why a customer is unhappy, not merely how to close the ticket. Interested in building a support function, not just working a shift in one. Excited by a fast-moving environment where standards continue to rise. If you need a script for every situation before you can reply to a customer, this isn’t the right role. What Great Looks Like A great support agent on our team doesn’t read a message and ask: “Which macro do I send here?” They ask: “What does this person actually need from us to feel looked after?” If a template covers it, use it. If it doesn’t, write the reply the customer deserves. If the same issue reaches us three times in a week, say so and fix the cause. You should be thinking about: What is this customer really worried about underneath the question? Is my reply solving it, or just acknowledging it? Would I be happy receiving this message? Where is the friction that created this ticket in the first place? Could this have been prevented upstream? Is there anything I can do here beyond the minimum? Does this person now think more of the brand, or less? What should we write down so nobody has to solve this from scratch again? Building The Support System SOP building is a core part of this role, not an optional extra. You should be comfortable documenting and improving process across areas such as: Standard response libraries and tone guidelines Refund, replacement and exchange decision trees Shipping and tracking escalation steps Chargeback and dispute handling Review and reputation workflows Handover notes and shift documentation Reporting on ticket volume, themes and resolution time Onboarding material for the next person who joins the support te

jobs.title: Multimedia Creative Editor (Video, Photo & Motion Graphics)
jobs.description: Loomelic Media is a Las Vegas-based creative agency producing photo, video, and social content for automotive dealerships and other U.S. businesses. We’re hiring a full-time remote Multimedia Creative Editor in the Philippines to turn footage and assets from our team into finished client work. Schedule and pay • Full-time, 40 hours per week, during Philippine daytime hours. We’ll agree on the schedule and any meeting overlap in advance. • $900–$1,200 USD per month for the first 90 days, depending on experience, portfolio, and demonstrated skills, plus a $50 USD monthly internet allowance. Compensation can grow after the first 90 days based on performance and responsibilities. • We care about the people behind the work, and we’re willing to pay well for great talent. We offer quarterly bonuses and 13th-month pay after one year with Loomelic Media. How to apply Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with your résumé or CV, a short introduction in English, your availability, and your expected monthly pay in USD. Include accessible links to a short-form video you edited, a motion graphics sample, and a photo editing or retouching sample. For each, tell us what you did and which tools you used. We’ll invite shortlisted applicants to an interview and a paid editing test using footage we supply.

Paid trial. Coach Wally's Sheet-Pan Salmon & Veggies Serves 4 One pan, three colors, about 35 minutes. Simple to cook and built for the camera. Ingredients • 4 salmon fillets (about 6 oz / 170 g each) • 4 cups broccoli florets • 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes • 3 tablespoons olive oil • 1 large lemon, zested and juiced • 3 garlic cloves, minced • 1 teaspoon dried oregano • 1 teaspoon smoked paprika • 1 teaspoon salt • 0.5 teaspoons black pepper Steps 1. Preheat 10m Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a large sheet pan with parchment paper. 2. Make the lemon-herb mix In a bowl, whisk together 3 tablespoons olive oil, 1 large lemon, zested and juiced, 3 garlic cloves, minced, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon salt and 0.5 teaspoons black pepper. 3. Roast the sweet potatoes 15m Toss 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes with about a third of the lemon-herb mix. Spread on the pan in a single layer and roast. 4. jobs.title: GoHighLevel specialist to build SMS quote follow-up system for Australian roofers
jobs.description: I run an Australian business that follows up quotes for residential roofing companies. I'm looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to build this as a master template (snapshot) that I can copy for each new roofing client. The template needs to include: 1. A quote pipeline with these stages: quote sent, following up, replied, hot lead, inspection booked, won, lost, opted out. 2. A Make or Zapier connection from the roofer's job software into GoHighLevel. ServiceM8 and Jobber first, then Simpro and Fergus. A new quote should create a contact and opportunity. An accepted or declined quote should stop all follow-up. 3. A consent check. Messages only go to contacts who ticked the consent box and whose quote is less than 6 months old. Australia has strict spam laws, so this has to work reliably. 4. SMS and email follow-up from the roofer's own Australian mobile number, which stops as soon as the customer replies. 5. Conversation AI set to suggest mode, so a person approves every reply before it is sent. Questions about price, complaints and insurance should go to the roofer instead. 6. A text to the roofer within 5 minutes when a customer shows interest, with the customer's name, number and quote. 7. An inspection booking calendar with confirmation and reminder texts. 8. Opt-out handling. A STOP reply should set the contact to DND immediately, and every message should include the business name and how to opt out. 9. A Google review request sent to every customer once their job is complete. 10. A dashboard I can use for a monthly report: quotes worked, replies, inspections booked and opt-outs. 11. Written notes and a short Loom explaining how everything works, so someone else could maintain it. Terms: Everything is built in my GoHighLevel account. I'll start with a paid test of 3 to 4 hours ($40 to $60). If that goes well, the template is a fixed-price job with a budget of $350 to $600, paid half when it works in testing and half when the first client is live. After that there is ongoing work at $8 to $15 an hour: setting up each new client takes about 10 to 15 hours, and each live account needs about 6 hours a month. Some overlap with Australian business hours (AEST) is needed. Please answer these questions at the start of your application: 1. What do you need to set up to send SMS from GoHighLevel using an Australian mobile number, and what does the business need to register so its texts don't show as "Unverified"? 2. Send a Loom (under 3 minutes) of a two-way SMS workflow you have built in GoHighLevel where the sequence stops when the contact replies. 3. Have you integrated ServiceM8, Jobber, Simpro or Fergus before? Which one, and with what tool? 4. How would you set up Conversation AI so that no reply is sent without approval? 5. Your hourly rate, your fixed price for this template, and your weekly availability in December. Applications without a Loom will not be considered.

Our maximum acquisition budget is AUD $500 per business. What We're Looking For Small photography agencies, independent studios, or established photography brands specialising in: - Female university students and young adults (18+). - Lifestyle, fashion, portrait and social media photography. - Youth-oriented photography and creative content. - Established portfolios featuring young adult female models. We are particularly interested in smaller businesses, independent photographers with established brands, or inactive agencies whose owners may consider selling. What the Acquisition Should Include Ideally, the purchase will include: - Complete ownership of the business name and brand. - Website, domain and social media accounts, where transferable. - Existing photography portfolio. - Copyright ownership or transferable commercial rights to existing photographs, including appropriate model releases. - Existing client and model networks, subject to applicable consent and privacy requirements. - Other relevant business and digital assets. Important – Ongoing Collaboration We are not looking to replace the existing owner or photographer. Our intention is to acquire the business while offering its current owner or photographer a separate, ongoing paid contract to continue providing photography services. This could be an attractive opportunity for small agencies or independent photographers who wish to continue their creative work without managing the business themselves. Freelancer Deliverables Identify 10 genuine acquisition opportunities and provide a spreadsheet containing: 1. Business or agency name and location. 2. Website and social media profiles. 3. Photography specialisation and portfolio examples. 4. Owner's name and publicly available contact details. 5. Asking price or confirmed interest in discussing a sale. 6. Assets potentially included in the acquisition. 7. Availability of transferable photo copyrights and commercial usage rights. 8. Owner's potential interest in continuing under a photography services contract. Preferred Locations Metro Manila is our first priority, although suitable opportunities elsewhere in the Philippines may be considered. Who Should Apply We welcome freelancers with experience in online research, business sourcing, photography, social media research or local business outreach. Please briefly explain your research approach and how you would identify 10 suitable opportunities. This is a research and sourcing assignment. No purchases, binding offers or negotiations should be made without our prior approval. We value genuine opportunities, accurate information and confidentiality.

jobs.title: Government Contract Billing & Payroll Compliance Specialist P/T US PST Hours
jobs.description: Government Contract Billing & Payroll Compliance Specialist Very Part Time (less than 5 hours a month; can lead to more hours with more types of work...( Company: Redwood Resources Schedule: Very part-time, as needed Location: Remote — US Pacific Time availability required (responsive during US PST Time AND have worked US PST currently or within last 90 days. Position overview Redwood Resources, a public-sector consulting firm, seeks an experienced government contract billing and payroll specialist to support our accounting and project financial management functions. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience invoicing US government agencies or government contractors and understands contractual billing requirements, direct labor costs, overhead rates, fee structures and employee utilization. We are seeking someone who can work independently, interpret contract requirements, identify discrepancies and produce accurate, audit-ready documentation with minimal supervision. Essential responsibilities Prepare monthly government and prime contractor invoices. Calculate and verify base compensation rates, overhead, fees and fully burdened billing rates. Reconcile employee timesheets, payroll records and project labor charges. Support twice-monthly payroll processing and reconciliation. Prepare employee billable utilization reports. Track project budgets, expenditures, remaining contract balances and billing limitations. Reconcile subcontractor invoices and other direct costs. Maintain invoicing deadlines and payment tracking. Prepare certified payroll and subcontractor utilization reports when contractually required. Maintain complete supporting documentation for audits. Identify and proactively communicate discrepancies before invoices or payroll are finalized. Required qualifications Minimum three years of hands-on US government contract billing experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise; five or more years preferred. Demonstrated understanding of direct and indirect costs, overhead rates and contractual fee calculations. Strong Excel skills, including lookup functions, SUMIFS, pivot tables, reconciliations and formula-based reporting. Experience interpreting written contract and invoicing requirements. Exceptional accuracy, responsiveness and attention to detail. Ability to attend scheduled working sessions during US Pacific Time, including payroll and invoicing deadlines. Ability to maintain strict confidentiality of payroll and financial information. Preferred qualifications Experience with architecture, engineering, transportation, infrastructure or public-sector consulting firms. Experience with QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Time. Familiarity with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) cost principles. Certified payroll and prevailing wage reporting experience. DBE/SBE utilization reporting experience. Experience supporting government financial audits. Application instructions Please provide: Your résumé and years of government contract invoicing experience. Examples of government agencies or contractors you have supported. The types of contracts and billing structures you have worked with. Your experience with overhead, fees and utilization reporting. Your availability during US Pacific Time. Your hourly compensation expectations. A redacted sample of a relevant invoice or financial report, if available. Candidates must successfully complete a technical interview and live Excel assessment.

jobs.title: IT Helpdesk Support
jobs.description: Due to a consistent increase in our workload we are looking to employ a new individual in the role of a Systems Administrator. You need to have a reliable internet connection aswell as a reliable computer and always be contactable via Microsoft Teams or by phone. You will need to have a curious mind to be able to diagnose and resolve unique, nonrecurring problems associated with application software and operating systems; determine the source of problems and classify their level, priority and nature. Configure, deploy, maintain, troubleshoot and support computer workstations, laptops, printers, mobile devices, phones and other computer and telecommunications equipment. Install and support PC, laptop, tablet and mobile hardware and software (certifications from CompTIA, Microsoft or HDI are a plus). Create alternative methods of completing tasks, correcting user errors and system inconsistencies to improve the desktop team function. Participate in hardware and software reviews and recommend purchases. Maintain inventory of installed software, manage software licensing and create policies and procedures for upgrades. Work with hardware and software vendors to verify timely product delivery and ensure that new equipment is installed and ready to operate on schedule. Analyze and make recommendations for hardware and software standardization. Ensure desktop computers interconnect seamlessly with diverse systems including associated validation systems, file servers, email servers, computer conferencing systems, application servers and administrative systems. Document procedures, standards, best practices configurations, settings, installation sequences and back-out instructions. Personal requirements: Must have strong work ethic. Must be a trustworthy individual. Must be a team player and ability to move from one problem to the next. Organised and have an attention to detail. Track all work in our CRM RepairShopr. Excellent phone manner. Comprehensive English. Excellent communication Additionally, experience with the following technologies would be highly regarded: Windows 11,10 Server ---------- (Linux is a plus). Microsoft Office 365 Networks to trouble shoot internet related issues Know how to Trouble shoot problems and not get lost. Otherwise escalate to your supervisor. Know how to use remote support technologies such as VPN’s, Wachguard, RDP, Teamviewer A minimum of 2 years experience supporting the technologies listed would be expected. This is an excellent opportunity with an exciting and growing company. The role promises to be demanding, however if you are the right person it could be just the challenge you're looking for. If this sounds interesting we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Lead Generation & Enrollment Specialist | Remote Dance Studio Sales
jobs.description: Lead Generation & Enrollment Specialist | Remote Dance Studio Sales If you’ve ever spotted a way to bring in customers and thought, “I’d love to be the one who runs with that,” you’ll have that opportunity here. Your job is to figure out where our next students will come from and make the first move. You might get a local organization to introduce the studio to its families, start a conversation with a parent who’s looking for classes, or discover a referral source we’ve overlooked. The owner knows the studio and its students. You bring the outreach experience to turn that knowledge into a steady flow of interested families. WHAT YOU’LL OWN - Generate new leads. This is your main responsibility. Choose promising outreach channels, build referral relationships, and start conversations. Track which efforts bring interested families to the studio so you know where to invest your time. - Turn interest into enrollment. About 98% of our students are kids, so most of your conversations will be with parents. We offer adult classes too. Respond promptly to inquiries during your shifts, learn what each person is looking for, and recommend a class they’ll feel confident signing up for. - Own the follow up. Use calls, texts, and emails to keep conversations moving. Keep the CRM current and give the owner a brief daily update on new leads, bookings, enrollments, and next steps. - Support the studio with a weekly email to leads, occasional social media content, and light VA tasks. Sales and outreach come first. WHAT YOU’LL BRING Previous sales experience is required, including experience finding your own prospects. We’ll introduce you to our classes and the families we serve. From there, you’ll d ---------- who to reach, what to say, and what to change when an approach gets few replies. Strong phone skills matter here. You can put a parent at ease, ask a thoughtful question, listen to the answer, and confidently invite them to enroll. You’ll need C1 level or higher spoken and written English. We value someone we can count on. When you tell a parent you’ll call on Thursday, you make the call. When an outreach idea shows promise, you take the next step without waiting for a reminder. Previous VA experience is preferred. CRM familiarity and an interest in dance are both welcome. PAID TRIAL, BASE PAY, AND BONUSES The role begins with a 2 week paid trial at 20 hours per week. You’ll receive $125 USD total for 40 hours. We’ll agree on your trial shifts in advance. During the trial, we’ll assess your initiative, lead generation, sales ability, and reliability. We’ll look at the prospects you find independently, the conversations your outreach starts, which ones progress toward bookings or paid enrollments, and how consistently you follow through. At the end of the trial, we’ll review the results together. If we both d ---------- to continue, you’ll move to 34 hours per week with a base salary of $450 USD per month, paid every 2 weeks through Wise. You can earn performance bonuses on top of your base pay when your outreach consistently brings in multiple new paying students per month. REGULAR SCHEDULE All times are US Pacific Time. Monday through Friday: 10 am to 2 pm and 4 pm to 6 pm, with a break from 2 pm to 4 pm. Saturday and Sunday: 10 am to noon each day. That’s 34 hours across 7 days. Both weekend shifts are required. We’re looking for someone who wants this to be their primary long term role and can reliably cover each shift. Hours may change seasonally within the studio’s 8 am to 9 pm Pacific window. We’ll discuss and agree on any changes in advance. HOW TO APPLY Include “Silver Slippers” in your subject line or message title. Send your resume, confirm you can work the full regular schedule, and answer this question in a few sentences: Tell us about one sales opportunity you created from scratch. How did you find it, what did you personally do to move it forward, and what was the outcome?

jobs.title: Client Outreach Caller - US Medicaid Home Care (Part-Time, Long-Term) - $5/hr + Bonuses
jobs.description: Optimal Care LLC is a growing home care agency in North Dakota, USA. We help people on Medicaid get personal care services so they can stay safely in their own homes. Clients can choose a family member or friend as their paid caregiver, or we find one for them. We are a small team building for the long term. We are looking for a friendly, confident caller who wants to grow with us. The longer you stay, the more your pay, benefits and responsibilities grow. PAY - $5/hour base pay, about 20 hours per week - PLUS a $50 BONUS for every 10 qualified referrals you bring in - no limit on how many bonuses you can earn - Pay and benefits increase the longer you stay with us - Paid twice a month (15th and 30th) WHAT YOU WILL DO - Call families and possible clients in North Dakota who have (or may qualify for) Medicaid - Call referral partners: hospital discharge planners and social workers, clinics, senior centers, county social service offices - Ask simple pre-screen questions (Medicaid status, county, care needs) and fill out our form - Follow up on callbacks and log every call in our Google Sheet - Send qualified leads to our manager, who takes it from there Full call guide, scripts, pre-screen form and training provided. SCHEDULE Monday to Friday, 4 hours per day: 9 AM - 1 PM US Central Time (11 PM - 3 AM Philippine time). Same hours every day. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - US Medicaid experience STRONGLY PREFERRED - applicants with Medicaid, patient intake, or US healthcare call experience will be interviewed first - Clear, friendly, professional spoken English - Cold calling, telesales, appointment setting or call center experience - Organized and reliable with follow-ups - Stable internet, quiet workspace and a headset - Looking for a long-term job, not a short gig NICE TO HAVE - Home care, personal care, home health or HCBS waiver experience - Experience calling hospitals, social workers or case managers - Experience with OpenPhone/Quo, RingCentral or Google Sheets HOW TO APPLY (3 STEPS) 1. Start your message with "Optimal Care Outreach" 2. Tell us about your US Medicaid / healthcare experience (if any) and your cold calling experience: what kind of calls, how many per day, and how long 3. Attach a short voice recording (30-60 seconds) introducing yourself Shortlisted applicants will have a short video interview and a practice call.

jobs.title: Communications Manager (Media & PR) | Hybrid
jobs.description: Kindly attach the link to your CV. The Role This position will lead the Group's media relations, executive thought leadership, LinkedIn presence and corporate communications. You will turn business developments, market trends, workforce insights and the impact of AI into compelling stories and commentary for business audiences, primarily in Australia, with growing reach across the US, UK and Asia. You will also manage an external PR agency in Australia. Lead generation and digital marketing are handled separately. Key Responsibilities Executive Thought Leadership Ghostwrite LinkedIn posts, articles, opinion pieces and speeches for senior leadership. Prepare executives for media interviews, panels and keynote presentations. Media Relations Build relationships with business and trade journalists across Australia, the Philippines and Asia. Pitch stories, secure media coverage and manage press releases and announcements. Brief and manage the Australian PR agency. LinkedIn and Brand Communications Manage the Group's LinkedIn content strategy and publishing calendar. Develop content around business developments, workplace culture, client stories and industry insights. Maintain consistent messaging and encourage employee and leadership participation. Speaking and Events Secure speaking engagements, panel discussions and podcast opportunities. Identify award opportunities and prepare submissions. Content and Reporting Turn internal business data and industry trends into publishable insights and case studies. Track media coverage, LinkedIn growth and speaking engagements. Provide monthly performance reports to senior leadership. What Success Looks Like Within 6 Months: Consistent executive LinkedIn content and measurable audience growth. Established relationships with key Australian and Philippine media contacts. Regular earned media coverage and executive bylined articles. Active LinkedIn presence with growing engagement. A pipeline of speaking and podcast opportunities. An effective, results-driven PR agency relationship. Within 12 Months: The Group and its leadership are recognised as credible voices on offshore teams, global talent and the future of work. About You Must Have 6+ years of experience in communications, PR or journalism, including media relations. Proven success securing earned media coverage, supported by published links. Experience ghostwriting for senior executives, with references. Demonstrable results in media coverage, executive visibility or speaking engagements. Excellent written English and the ability to engage Australian and international business audiences. Strong judgement, independence and the ability to work directly with senior executives. Nice to Have Experience working with Australian or international media. Background in IT-BPM, HR, recruitment, B2B services or technology. Experience securing speaking engagements and preparing award submissions. Journalism experience. Work Schedule: Day Shift Work Location: Pasig City

jobs.title: Executive Assistant-Right Hand-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company
jobs.description: Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal. What You Get If You Win Here - High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos - Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company. - Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics. - Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before. - Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves! If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace. Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs. We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who: Can’t drive tasks to completion independently Mark tasks complete with no proof Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru Need hand-holding I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. What You’ll Actually Do You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs: Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin) Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days) We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want. Real Growth Example One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly. Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises) This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment. What Winning Looks Like By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operat

jobs.title: Tarot Reader
jobs.description: OTST Corp. is an Al-driven internet technology company based in the overseas market, upholding the mission of "Comforting the soul with technology". The company has developed several mobile apps and web products in emotional consulting, online companionship, and spiritual healing realms. Having provided relevant consultation and companionship services to over a million overseas users, the products have garnered tens of thousands of positive reviews. Soulight / Pocket Insight / Healer are online psychic reading and spiritual consulting platforms that we develop and operate for serving users worldwide. Users can connect with advisors in multiple ways, including: - Live Chat (real-time text) - Live Audio / Live Video (real-time voice/video) - Non-real-time reading orders (e.g., reading delivered within 24 hours, in text/audio/video formats) We are looking for experienced and professional psychic advisors who communicate clearly, value user experience, and respect service boundaries and aim to build long-term partnerships and provide stable, high-quality, and compassionate guidance to users globally. OTST Corp. is looking for experienced Tarot readers, Reiki healers, Astrologers, and those with experience in other types of divination. Our platform offers full-time and part-time positions to qualified candidates. Responsibilities: 1. Deliver Online readings consultations You will provide services based on your expertise, including (but not limited to): • Tarot, Numerology, Astrology/Birth Chart, Reiki/Energy Reading, Intuitive Reading, Mediumship • Common topics: relationships/reconciliation/marriage, career and financial direction, life choices, and personal growth 2. Complete Orders on time (Real-time / Non real time) • Fulfill user orders through the platform and deliver within the required timeframe • Provide structured, easy-to-understand readings to improve user clarity and satisfaction • Maintain service availability (status/online settings) to reduce missed orders and timeouts 3. Support After-Service Follow-up & User Experience • Participate in post-service communication when needed (experience follow-ups, necessary clarifications, follow-up suggestions, etc.) • Work with Customer Support/Advisor Operation Team to handle disputes (misunderstandings, expectation gaps, delivery-structure issues, etc.) • Maintain appropriate client relationships to support repeat orders and positive word-of- mouth 4. Contribute to Content & Community (Optional / Plus) • Support platform content initiatives such as guided meditations, themed articles, short-form content, monthly energy themes, etc. Platform Support & Benefits: 1. A Complete Advisor Order & Management System • Efficient delivery workflow and order management tools • Ability to track and manage earnings, orders, user interactions, service settings, availability/schedule status, and other key information • Support for multiple service formats: text/audio/video/non-real-time orders, etc. 2. Stable Traffic & High-Quality User Demand • A paying user base primarily from North America • Pricing and settlements in USD with clear earnings structure • More exposure and campaign resources for top-performing advisors 3. Flexible Collaboration • Freedom to set pricing and manage service availability based on your schedule and expertise • Long-term partnership potential, or start part-time as a trial 4. Operations & Customer Support Assistance • Onboarding guidance: profile setup, service configuration, order flow, FAQs, and policy guidelines Customer Support assistance for service disputes to reduce pressure on advisors • Operations support to improve user experience and retention (follow-up strategy, content direction, etc.) Requirements: •Willing to work on a commission basis • Strong English proficiency with the ability to communicate fluently and express ideas clearly (multilingual ability is a plus) • Clear logic and coherent communication, strong sense of responsibility, and consistent service delivery • Strong service mindset and empathy, willing to follow platform compliance and privacy policies • Stable internet connection and devices (mobile phone and/or computer) • Strong expertise in high-demand topics, with a good understanding of how to build repeat clients

jobs.title: Senior ComfyUI & RunPod AI Video Specialist - Hyperrealistic AI Characters
jobs.description: # Hiring: Senior ComfyUI & RunPod AI Video Specialist — Hyperrealistic AI Characters **Job Type:** Freelance / Part-Time (Potential Long-Term Opportunity) **Project Overview** We are building an automated AI video production studio that generates highly realistic, vertical talking-head videos featuring consistent virtual personalities. Our existing system runs on RunPod and uses ComfyUI, InfiniteTalk, Python, ElevenLabs, and FFmpeg. We are looking for an experienced specialist who can significantly improve the photorealism, motion quality, and consistency of our AI-generated characters. **The system is already built and operational. We are not looking for someone to rebuild it from scratch.** ### Your Responsibilities - Create exceptionally realistic AI-generated human characters. - Improve skin texture, facial details, eyes, hair, and natural imperfections. - Develop and optimize ComfyUI workflows on RunPod. - Improve talking-head animation, lip-sync, and natural facial expressions. - Reduce artificial-looking movements and visual distortions. - Maintain consistent character identity across multiple generations. - Optimize image-to-video settings for high-quality vertical videos. - Create reusable avatar and environment presets. - Troubleshoot artifacts and workflow performance issues. ### Required Experience - Advanced experience with ComfyUI. - Experience running AI-generation workflows on RunPod. - Strong knowledge of AI image and video generation. - Experience with realistic talking-head avatars and lip-sync. - Familiarity with InfiniteTalk or comparable video-generation systems. - Experience with reference-image consistency and character preservation. - Ability to work with existing Python workflows. ### Ideal Candidate You have produced AI-generated people who look convincingly real, not just beautiful AI portraits. You understand the difference between producing an impressive still image and maintaining a believable human appearance throughout a full talking video. ### Paid Trial Project We will begin with a paid technical test. You will receive access to a limited copy of our existing workflow and be asked to: 1. Create one original, hyperrealistic character suitable for talking-head video. 2. Build an approved starting image with a believable environment. 3. Generate a short talking-head video using our existing system. 4. Demonstrate realistic facial movement, skin texture, and stable character identity. 5. Document your workflow and the settings required to reproduce the result. ### Application Requirements Please send: - Your three best examples of realistic AI human videos. - Screenshots of ComfyUI workflows you've personally developed. - Details of your RunPod experience. - The AI models and techniques you currently use. - Your hourly or fixed-project rate. - A brief explanation of how you'd improve realism in a ComfyUI/InfiniteTalk pipeline. **Important:** Applications without examples of actual AI-generated talking videos will not be prioritized. We are looking for someone who can deliver measurable improvements and potentially collaborate long-term as we scale production.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description: ABOUT US Vicky Rahmic Weddings & Events is an Australian luxury wedding, event and travel company servicing clients throughout Australia and internationally. We are growing our team and seeking an experienced, proactive Executive Assistant to work directly alongside our Founder and Creative Director. This position is starting with 12 hours per week Tuesday to Friday has the potential to grow to 30–40 hours per week and progress into an Operations Manager and team leadership role. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Manage the Founder's inbox, calendar and appointments. - Prepare daily briefings and weekly business reports. - Manage tasks, deadlines and business priorities. - Monitor enquiries and follow up with clients and suppliers. - Assist with client onboarding and event administration. - Maintain accurate records and digital filing systems. - Create and maintain SOPs. - Support business growth and operational improvements. - Anticipate the Founder's needs without constant direction. REQUIREMENTS - Minimum three years of Executive Assistant or corporate operations experience. - Events experience preferred - Previous experience supporting a CEO, Founder or Managing Director. - Excellent written and spoken English. - Exceptional attention to detail. - Strong organisational and time management skills. - Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative and take ownership. - Experience with Google Workspace and project management software. - Reliable internet and computer equipment. - Verifiable professional references. Our systems include Google Workspace, Trello, TTO, Clockify. Training will be provided on industry-specific software. Significant experience with Google Workspace and Trello a must. WORKING ARRANGEMENTS Our office operates Tuesday to Friday and is closed on Mondays. Working hours will be during Perth business hours 9am - 12noon All additional hours must be approved in advance. Performance and working hours will be reviewed after three months, with opportunities for increased hours and career progression based on performance and business growth. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our company, not simply complete assigned tasks. HOW TO APPLY Please use the following subject line: Ordinary Isn't in Our Vocabulary | EA | Your Full Name Your application must include: 1. Your updated CV. 2. A brief introduction outlining your executive support experience. 3. Your expected hourly rate in AUD. 4. Your current employment and other client commitments. 5. Your availability to increase your hours in the future. 6. Two professional references. APPLICATION TASK You begin your three-hour shift and discover the following: - The Founder has an important meeting in two hours that is missing from her calendar. - A new client enquiry has been unanswered since yesterday. - A supplier invoice is due today. - Five administrative tasks remain outstanding. - The Founder is unavailable for the next hour. In no more than 150 words, explain how you would prioritise these tasks and what actions you would take independently. Finally, end your application by confirming which day of the week our office is closed. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered. We are looking for ONE senior operations person to run the day-to-day back office of the business, working directly with the owner. You will own the details so nothing falls through the cracks. This is a long-term role. HOURS 40 hrs/week, remote. You must overlap at least 4 hours with US Central time (9 AM - 5 PM CT). PAY $4-5/hour depending on experience, PLUS a quarterly performance bonus. WHAT YOU WILL DO Orders and suppliers - Track purchase orders from PO to delivery: invoices, payments, shipments, and delivery to our prep center - Reconcile supplier invoices against units received and shipped to Amazon; chase missing units, credits and refunds - Keep the order sheet, prep sheet and supplier records accurate and up to date Amazon account and inventory - Set up new SKUs and costs in Sellerboard and repricing tools (Seller Snap or similar) - Monitor inventory and restock needs; plan and track FBA shipments and removal orders - Find and file Amazon reimbursement claims (lost/damaged inventory, fee errors) - Watch account health: listing issues, suppressed/stranded inventory, policy notices; prepare responses for the owner's approval Admin and coordination - Coordinate with the prep center on Slack: check-ins, shipments, removals and returns - Keep weekly reports: sales and profit, open orders, credits owed, reimbursements - Follow up on every open item until it is resolved MUST HAVE - 3+ years of US Amazon Seller Central back-office experience for FBA sellers (wholesale preferred) - Hands-on experience with FBA shipments, removal orders, reimbursement cases and account health - Sellerboard (or similar profit tool) and strong Google Sheets skills - Very organized and detail-oriented, with clear written updates - Strong written and spoken English; reliable internet and a backup power source NICE TO HAVE - Seller Snap or other repricer experience - Bookkeeping basics (QuickBooks) - Experience working with prep centers and US wholesale suppliers HOW TO APPLY Include ALL of the following in your application: 1. Years of US Amazon Seller Central operations experience, and the types of sellers you supported (wholesale, OA, private label) 2. The reimbursement and account-health cases you handled in the past 12 months, with one example and the result 3. How you track purchase orders and reconcile supplier invoices (tools and process) 4. Tools you use daily, with years for each 5. A 3-5 minute Loom video showing how you would check a seller's FBA inventory for lost or damaged units that can be reimbursed 6. Your expected hourly rate and your available hours in US Central time 7. Write the word "RECONCILE" at the top of your application Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid 2-hour test.

jobs.title: HR & Finance Administrative Assistant
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant with strong numerical and administrative skills to support the day-to-day HR, finance, and operational functions of a U.S.-based organization. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys working with spreadsheets, managing records, coordinating administrative processes, and ensuring that information is accurate, organized, and up to date. Shift: Philippine afternoon to evening shift with required overlap during U.S. Eastern Time working hours. Exact working hours will be discussed during the interview. Job Duties and Responsibilities 1. Human Resources Administration - Maintain accurate and up-to-date personnel records and HR documentation. - Monitor employee leave balances, staff information, and policy acknowledgments. - Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding, including required documentation, benefits enrollment, and system access. - Coordinate interview schedules and provide administrative support throughout the recruitment process. 2. Financial Administrative Support - Organize and maintain financial documents, invoices, and contract records. - Monitor vendor agreements, payment deadlines, and contract renewals. - Assist with budget tracking, expense processing, and reimbursements. - Compile and organize financial information for internal reporting, audits, and regulatory filings. - Maintain financial tracking spreadsheets and assist in preparing reports, summaries, and charts. 3. Operations & Administrative Coordination - Provide administrative support to leadership and internal departments. - Maintain operational plans and project trackers using ClickUp. - Monitor deadlines, action items, and departmental deliverables. - Coordinate with relevant team members to ensure accurate and timely reporting. - Maintain organized records while ensuring the confidentiality of sensitive information. Qualifications - Previous experience in administrative support, preferably involving HR, finance, or business operations. - Strong numerical skills and confidence in working with financial data and spreadsheets. - Proficiency in Google Workspace and spreadsheet applications. - Familiarity with ClickUp or similar project management tools. - Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. - Strong written and verbal English communication skills. - Ability to handle confidential employee and financial information with discretion. - Proactive, dependable, and capable of working independently. - Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines consistently. If you believe you're a strong fit for this position, please respond with the following: 1. A link to your resume in PDF format. Your resume should include your contact details, a recent professional photo, and a summary of your work experience, emphasizing tasks relevant to this role. 2. A screenshot of your PC specifications and internet speed, 3. Your WhatsApp number for easy communication. To ensure you've read this post carefully, please include the word "ADMIN SUPPORT" in the subject line of your application. We look forward to reviewing your application!

jobs.title: Senior Amazon FBA Wholesale Sourcing Specialist - Multi-Category Supplier Development (Full-Time, Long-Term)
jobs.description: ABOUT US We are an established US-based Amazon FBA wholesale seller. We are looking for ONE senior sourcing person to bring in new suppliers across categories and turn their price lists into profitable orders, working directly with the owner. This is a long-term role. HOURS 40 hrs/week, remote. You must overlap at least 4 hours with US Central time (9 AM - 5 PM CT). PAY $4-5/hour depending on experience, PLUS a quarterly profit bonus: 5% of net profit on the products you source that hit our ROI target. WHAT YOU WILL DO Supplier development (main focus) - Find and open new wholesale suppliers in any category that works on Amazon: Health & Household, Home & Kitchen, Grocery, Pet, Baby, Sports, Tools, Beauty and more - Target authorized distributors, brands (brand-direct) and manufacturers, in the US and internationally - Qualify every supplier before we apply: legitimacy, brand authorization, pricing, MOQs, payment and shipping terms, landed cost for international suppliers - Run outreach (email, phone, applications) and follow up until the account is approved - Keep a supplier pipeline sheet updated: status, contact, terms and next step Sourcing - Analyze supplier price lists and catalogs (hundreds to thousands of lines) and recommend Buy / Buy smaller / Skip with quantities - Apply our sourcing criteria: net ROI after returns, profit per unit, seller count, Amazon Buy Box share, price stability, sales velocity - Plan replenishment for products we already sell - Check every order before the PO goes out: exact ASIN match, pack size, Transparency, IP history, gating, hazmat and restricted-product claims MUST HAVE - 3+ years of US Amazon FBA WHOLESALE experience (not only online arbitrage) - A proven record of opening wholesale accounts across several categories (brand-direct and distributors) - Expert at Keepa: graphs, Buy Box history, seller counts, stock levels - Strong Google Sheets skills (XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, pivot tables, cleaning messy price lists) - Clear understanding of FBA fees, ROI vs margin, case packs and multi-packs - Strong written and spoken English; reliable internet and a backup power source NICE TO HAVE - Existing distributor or brand relationships you can bring - Importing experience: international freight, customs/duties, US labeling rules - Ungating experience; Sellerboard, Seller Snap, SellerAmp, SmartScout or similar tools HOW TO APPLY Include ALL of the following in your application: 1. Years of US Amazon WHOLESALE experience, and the categories and suppliers/brands you sourced from (names are enough) 2. How many wholesale accounts (US or international) you opened in the past 12 months, in which categories, and how you find and vet new suppliers 3. Tools you use daily, with years for each 4. One example of a wholesale buy you recommended: category, ROI, units, and how it sold 5. A 3-5 minute Loom video walking through the Keepa graph of any product, explaining whether you would buy it wholesale and why 6. Your expected hourly rate and your available hours in US Central time 7. Write the word "SUPPLIERS" at the top of your application Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid 2-hour test on a real price list.

jobs.title: Industrial Designer – 3D CAD & Packaging Design
jobs.description: # WE'RE HIRING: INDUSTRIAL DESIGNER (3D PACKAGING DESIGN & PRODUCT VISUALISATION) **Company:** Snapsil Systems **Position:** Industrial Designer **Employment Type:** Part-Time **Working Hours:** 25 hours per week **Monthly Compensation:** AUD 1,000 **Location:** Remote / Work From Home ## ABOUT SNAPSIL Snapsil Systems is an innovative packaging technology company developing snap-open packaging solutions for different industries and applications. We're looking for a creative and technically capable Industrial Designer who can transform ideas, sketches, and concepts into functional 3D packaging designs, realistic product renders, and engaging animations. If you enjoy combining engineering, creativity, and product design, we'd love to hear from you! ## YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES As our Industrial Designer, you will: - Develop and refine 3D CAD models for packaging products, including geometry, dimensions, lids, and opening mechanisms. - Translate sketches, product samples, and design briefs into accurate 3D models. - Prepare technical drawings and dimensioned files for prototyping and manufacturing. - Collaborate with our technical team to refine designs based on materials, tooling, and manufacturing requirements. - Create photorealistic product renders, branded packaging mockups, and multi-angle product visualisations. - Produce product animations demonstrating how packaging opens, dispenses, and functions. - Support the development of packaging concepts for different industries and applications. - Occasionally assist with marketing visuals and product presentation materials. ## REQUIREMENTS We are looking for someone with: - Proven experience in industrial design, product design, or packaging design. - Strong proficiency in 3D modelling and CAD software. - Experience with **SOLIDWORKS or AutoCAD** (preferred). - Experience creating realistic product renders using KeyShot, Blender, or equivalent software. - Ability to create product animations and demonstrate product functionality. - Understanding of packaging materials, dimensions, tolerances, prototyping, and design for manufacturing. - Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow technical specifications. - Ability to work independently and meet deadlines. - Good communication skills and willingness to collaborate with an international team. **An advantage if you have:** - Thermoforming or packaging tooling experience. - Experience with plastic packaging design. - Knowledge of secondary packaging. - Experience creating marketing materials, product one-pagers, sell sheets, and pitch decks. - Basic graphic design skills. ## WHAT WE OFFER - AUD 1,000 per month. - Part-time engagement: 25 hours per week. - Fully remote working arrangement. - Opportunity to work on innovative packaging technology. - Exposure to international clients and product development projects. - Opportunity to contribute to products across multiple industries. ## HOW TO APPLY Please submit the following: 1. Your updated CV or resume. 2. Your portfolio showcasing 3D packaging designs and product development work. 3. At least one example of a technical drawing. 4. Examples of photorealistic product renders. 5. At least one product animation demonstrating functionality. 6. A list of the design software you are proficient in. **IMPORTANT:** Please include a brief explanation of your role and contribution to each portfolio project. We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate both creative design skills and technical understanding of how products are manufactured. We look forward to seeing your work!

jobs.title: Looking for Mechanical engineer

jobs.title: Senior Brand Manager needed to support 10+ Amazon brands for growth, execution, drive performance and operation
jobs.description: About Prodigy Media Prodigy Media is an established e-commerce company with over a decade of experience developing, launching, and scaling private-label brands, primarily on Amazon USA. We manage a diverse portfolio of brands across multiple categories and are looking for an experienced Senior Amazon Brand Manager to take ownership of brand performance, identify growth opportunities, and lead day-to-day execution. We're looking for someone with extensive Amazon marketplace experience who understands how to grow brands, improve profitability, launch products successfully, and coordinate teams to get results. This is a senior-level position for someone who can think strategically, solve problems independently, and take ownership of performance. We're also embracing modern AI tools to help our team work smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Experience with Claude, Codex, or automation tools is highly valued, but strong Amazon brand management experience is our number one priority. Key Responsibilities 1. Amazon Brand Management & Growth You'll be responsible for overseeing and improving the performance of assigned Amazon private-label brands. Manage multiple Amazon brands and product portfolios. Analyze sales, profitability, organic rankings, conversion rates, traffic, and advertising performance. Identify opportunities to increase revenue, improve margins, and grow market share. Develop and execute strategies to improve underperforming products. Oversee listing optimization, SEO, A+ Content, Brand Stores, and conversion improvements. Conduct competitive analysis and identify market opportunities. Monitor inventory-related issues that affect sales and performance. Develop clear short-term and long-term growth strategies for assigned brands. Our expectation: You don't just maintain Amazon listings. You actively manage and grow the business. 2. Data Analysis, Problem Solving & Execution Strong analytical skills are essential, but identifying problems is only the beginning. We're looking for someone who can: Analyze data to identify declining sales, poor conversion rates, advertising inefficiencies, and other performance issues. Investigate the underlying causes rather than simply reporting numbers. Develop practical solutions supported by research and data. Implement corrective actions and coordinate the necessary resources. Monitor results and continuously improve strategies. Take responsibility for resolving issues from beginning to end. We don't need someone who simply tells us what's wrong. We need someone who knows how to fix it and takes action. 3. Amazon Product Launches You must have direct, hands-on experience launching private-label products on Amazon. Responsibilities include: Conducting product and competitor research. Performing keyword research and analyzing market opportunities. Developing product launch strategies, budgets, and timelines. Coordinating product photography, listing content, A+ Content, and launch assets. Working with PPC specialists on launch campaigns and advertising strategies. Planning compliant product review acquisition strategies. Coordinating inventory readiness and launch schedules. Monitoring launch performance and optimizing strategies to improve rankings, conversions, and sales. You should understand the complete Amazon launch process, from preparation to successful market entry and continued growth. 4. Team Coordination & Project Management You'll work directly with our PPC specialists, graphic designers, and operations team to ensure brand initiatives are completed effectively. Coordinate PPC strategies and campaign priorities with advertising specialists. Work closely with graphic designers to develop listing images, A+ Content, advertising creatives, and product videos. Assign projects, set clear priorities, and establish realistic due dates. Manage multiple ongoing projects and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule. Review creative assets and campaign initiatives to ensure they support brand objectives. Identify bottlenecks and resolve delays before they affect performance. Maintain accountability and clear communication across teams. Use project management systems to organize assignments, responsibilities, and deadlines. You must be comfortable leading execution, making decisions, and ensuring that important work gets completed without constant supervision. 5. External Marketing & Brand Development While Amazon is our main sales channel, we also want to expand our brand presence and customer acquisition efforts beyond Amazon. Experience or familiarity with the following is valuable: Facebook and Instagram advertising. TikTok marketing and short-form video content. Influencer marketing and UGC creators. External traffic strategies that drive customers to Amazon. Affiliate marketing and customer acquisition campaigns. Shopify and direct-to-consumer marketing. We're looking for someone who understands how to use outside marketing channels to build brand aware

Scheduling and Fleet Maintenance Manage and schedule vehicle repairs, maintenance, servicing, inspections, and other fleet-related work. Inventory and Parts Management Monitor inventory of vehicle parts, tools, supplies, and other maintenance-related materials. Coordinate sourcing and purchasing of parts when necessary. Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure commonly used parts are available to avoid unnecessary repair delays. Fleet Monitoring and Record Management Maintain updated records of vehicle condition, repair history, maintenance schedules, and current operational status. Track vehicles that are available for rental, undergoing repairs, awaiting parts, or temporarily out of service. Document repair reports, mechanic assignments, parts used, repair costs, and completion dates. Keep relevant stakeholders updated on vehicle status, repair progress, and expected availability. Maintain organised and accurate fleet maintenance records. Reporting and Operational Improvement Provide updates on outstanding repairs, mechanic assignments, vehicle availability, and inventory requirements. Monitor repair turnaround times and identify recurring delays or operational issues. Identify opportunities to improve mechanic coordination, scheduling, inventory management, and repair processes. Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed. Perform other related tasks and duties that may be assigned by the client later on. About You You're a hands-on, resourceful, and highly organised professional with a strong understanding of vehicle mechanics, repair processes, and fleet maintenance operations. You're capable of assessing reported vehicle issues, identifying likely repairs, coordinating mechanics, and managing multiple repair jobs and schedules. You take ownership of issues from initial report through to resolution and are comfortable working independently in a fast-paced operational environment. Finalize titles following our formatting standards. Complete item specifics and relevant compatibility fields using our supplied information and SOPs. Upload and organize photographs correctly. Enter accurate SKUs, prices, and condition information. Flag missing details, inconsistencies, or uncertain fitment instead of guessing. Track listing progress and complete assigned batches on schedule. Review your work for accuracy before submitting it. Our workflow is designed to be efficient. Once fully trained, our target is approximately 5 minutes per standard listing, while maintaining high accuracy. WORKLOAD & SCHEDULE : Our inventory operates on a monthly sourcing and processing cycle. We currently prepare approximately 120–330 parts per month, depending on sourcing volume. The primary inventory handoff normally happens around the Wednesday following the first Saturday of each month. Most listing work is concentrated in the following days, with deadlines agreed upon based on batch size. This is a part-time, flexible position with variable hours. Some weeks may have little or no work. We expect approximately 10–30 productive listing hours per month at our target pace, with additional hours possible for training, corrections, and business growth. We are seeking someone comfortable with this arrangement who can reliably accommodate our monthly batches. MUST HAVE REQUIREMENTS: At least 1 year of hands-on eBay listing experience. Strong familiarity with eBay Seller Hub and creating listings directly on eBay. Experience listing physical products, preferably used inventory. Excellent attention to detail. Good written English and communication skills. Ability to follow detailed SOPs and instructions. Comfortable working with Google Sheets. Desktop PC required. Reliable internet connection. Ability to meet agreed deadlines and communicate proactively. Preferred: Experience listing used automotive or OEM parts. Knowledge of vehicle compatibility, part numbers, and variations. Multiple monitors for efficient multitasking. Previous experience using Text Blaze or similar productivity tools. Cross-listing experience or software is not required. We sell exclusively through eBay. Training & Onboarding We provide: 5 training videos. 4 detailed PDF SOPs. Live listing demonstrations. Guided practice with feedback. A structured mock-listing assessment. Our onboarding process includes: Watching us complete 5 listings. Completing 10 listings with supervision. Completing 10 listings independently for review. Completing a batch of 100 mock listings on a secondary account, with quality-control checkpoints. All approved training and practice work is paid. We value accuracy, consistency, communication, and the ability to learn from feedback. Compensation Starting pay is $5.25 USD per hour, including approved training and listing work. Performance bonuses may be offered for consistently accurate work, reliability, and strong performance. We are looking for a long-term team member, with the potential for additional responsibilities and hours as our business grows. Answer the following questions: How many years of experience do you have creating listings directly through eBay Seller Hub? What types of products have you listed? Have you previously listed used automotive parts? If yes, tell us about your experience with fitment, part numbers, or vehicle compatibility.
