jobs.title: Customer Service Representative for Digital Products (Fluent English, Weekend Availability Required)
jobs.description: Are YOU an experienced customer service representative who can read the emotion behind a two-line email and respond like a real, warm, thinking human being — not a copy-pasted bot reply? Can you handle a chargeback dispute on a digital product and actually have a shot at winning it, knowing exactly what evidence matters when there's no tracking number or delivery signature to show? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING. We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and digital education space, including a growing catalog of craft and DIY digital products, selling primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our support team and take full ownership of the post-purchase customer experience. We need someone to take responsibility for: Inbox Ownership: Handling our daily support inbox end-to-end — order access issues, missing downloads, billing questions, refund requests, and general product questions — as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand. Retention-First Problem Solving: Before ever processing a refund, identifying and offering the right retention or bonus-bundle offer per our SOP. A refund is always the last resort, not the first move. Chargeback & Dispute Defense: Responding to chargebacks and payment disputes on digital products with the right evidence (delivery confirmation, access logs, communication history, terms accepted at checkout) — you understand this is a different game than physical-product disputes, and you know a genuinely high win-rate claim doesn't exist in this space. Template Adaptation, Not Scripting: We provide a complete SOP with email templates for every common scenario. Your job is to use them as a base and adapt the tone naturally to each customer — never robotic, never obviously AI-generated or copy-pasted. Escalation Judgment: Knowing exactly when a situation (legal threat, unusual request outside our templates, a case that just doesn't smell right) needs to be flagged to us instead of improvised. Daily Reporting: Keeping a simple log of ticket volume and any recurring issues you notice, so we can fix problems at the source. Position Requirements: At least 2 years of specific customer service experience for digital products — not physical/shipping-based ecommerce. You must know the practical difference between a refund and a chargeback, and have direct experience responding to disputes where a tracking number isn't an option. Fluent English, 9/10 or above: natural, native-sounding phrasing — not translated-sounding sentences. As part of the application, you'll be asked to record a short 60-second video or voice response to a question you haven't seen in advance. This isn't optional — written answers alone won't be considered. A real thinking mind, not an AI-generated response: we will read your written answers closely, and generic, overly polished, ChatGPT-flavored replies will be filtered out immediately. We want your judgment, not a prompt's. Comfortable with our tools: Google Drive (sharing, permissions, troubleshooting access errors), PDF delivery, and a shared support inbox/helpdesk. Availability & Commitment: This role requires coverage 7 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday — no exceptions, no "9-to-5, Monday-Friday" mentality. Minimum 3 hours/day, structured as short check-ins spread across your day (morning / afternoon / evening, your own local time zone). Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working, and would you see this growing toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months? Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: correct order numbers, correct links, zero copy-paste mistakes in a customer's name or order details. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team. What We Offer: A complete, ready-to-use Customer Service SOP with templates for every common scenario, plus clear escalation guidelines — you'll never be guessing. A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment. Career Growth: real potential to become the lead/only customer service representative across our full catalog as it expands, with performance-based rate increases and a path toward full-time. Screening Questions (Upwork): Please write a 3-4 sentence sample reply to this customer message: "Hi, I purchased the ebook bundle two days ago but never received the download email. Can you help?" Have you handled disputes/chargebacks on digital products before? If so, roughly what percentage have you been able to win, and what evidence/approach did you use? (Be honest — we're checking for real experience, not a number.) What's your current workload with other clients (hours/week), and do you see yourself moving toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months? Position Requirements: At least 2 years of specific customer service experience for digital products — not physical/shipping-based ecommerce. Availability & Commitment: This role requires coverage 7 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday — no exceptions, no "9-to-5, Monday-Friday" mentality. Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: correct order numbers, correct links, zero copy-paste mistakes in a customer's name or order details. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team. What We Offer: A complete, ready-to-use Customer Service SOP with templates for every common scenario, plus clear escalation guidelines — you'll never be guessing. A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment. Career Growth: real potential to become the lead/only customer service representative across our full catalog as it expands, with performance-based rate increases and a path toward full-time. Screening Questions (Upwork): Please write a 3-4 sentence sample reply to this customer message: "Hi, I purchased the ebook bundle two days ago but never received the download email. Can you help?" (Be honest — we're checking for real experience, not a number.) What's your current workload with other clients (hours/week), and do you see yourself moving toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months? This role requires 7-day-a-week availability, minimum 3 hours/day split into short check-ins across your day — not Mon-Fri only, and not one continuous

We're hiring a killer CS agent who treats our support operation like it's their own business. If you read job posts looking for "tasks" and "responsibilities" to tick off — close this one. If you read them looking for an operation you can take ownership of and grow inside of, keep reading. We run a 6–7 figure multi-brand e-commerce operation spanning 5 stores across the EU and US markets. We move fast, we scale hard, and we're building a backend team that runs like a machine. You'll join a backend team of 7 and work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Supply Chain Manager, Backend Manager, Dispute Manager, and CS team. What this role actually is This is a CS Agent role : high-ownership one. You'll be on the frontline of our support operation across all stores. (Got management experience? Even better : there's real room to grow here if your performance is good for 2 months. But make no mistake: this role is about being an elite agent first.) This is not a "follow the SOP and wait for instructions" role. This is a "I saw a problem three steps before anyone asked, and I fixed it" role. The single most important thing we're looking for Ownership. You don't just clear your queue — you look beyond your own lane, spot problems early (refunds, fulfillment delays, chargebacks, disputes), and get ahead of them. Proactivity and work ethic rank above everything else. Show us that, and you get paid extremely well for it. What you'll own Customer service across all stores, at high volume, without dropping quality Keeping tickets moving fast and flagging backend issues before they blow up Staying tightly synced with supply chain and disputes so nothing falls through the cracks Helping improve the systems that make the whole operation run smoother every week Requirements (read carefully) Minimum 3 years of CS experience in dropshipping — non-negotiable You can handle a minimum of 20 tickets per hour. If you can't, don't apply. Strong hands-on experience with Gorgias You understand high-scale dropshipping — the volume, the margins, the chaos. Strong experience with Claude / AI tools — this is core to how we operate; you need to be genuinely good with it A relentless work ethic and an ownership-first mindset Excellent written English and clear, fast communication What you get Well-paid base — we pay A-players like A-players High KPI-based bonuses on top — your performance directly drives your income A genuine chance to grow inside a scaling 6–7 figure business — the ceiling is high A sharp, fast-moving backend team that takes the work seriously Start date: Immediate. We're ready to move now and we want someone who's ready too. How to apply Don't send a generic application — show us how you take ownership. Start your letter with the word A PLAYER CS. Applications that don't will not be considered. Send a list of 3 stores you've previously worked for that generated at least $50,000+/month in revenue. If you don't have experience at that level, send the last 3 stores you worked for with a brief description of your responsibilities in each.

jobs.title: Full-Time Dashboard Developer - Build Our Multi-Store P&L Command Center
jobs.description: Type: Full-time · Remote Salary: $1,000 USD fixed price + month + performance bonuses for extra scope Start: ASAP the core dashboard must be live before Q4 (October at the absolute latest) The problem we want you to solve We run a multi-brand e-commerce group with 5 Shopify stores across the UK, US & EU , spending daily on Meta, Google and Pinterest Ads. Right now our numbers live in different places: Shopify admin, three ad platforms, supplier COGS sheets, refund reports, spreadsheets. Every decision starts with tab-switching and manual checking. We want one screen. A command center where we open a browser tab and instantly see, per store and blended: revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, ROAS, blended ROAS, profit and profit margin for today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days, or any custom date range. If you have built something like this before, this job is straightforward for you. If you haven't, please don't apply. What you will build (Phase 1) Data connections All 5 Shopify stores connected via API, with a clean architecture so we can add store #6, #7, #8 later without a rebuild Meta Ads, Google Ads and Pinterest Ads connected for live ad spend per store COGS pulled in per store either from Shopify or from our supplier system / cost sheets Metrics Revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, contribution margin ROAS per platform and blended ROAS Net profit and profit % per store and across the group Order count, AOV, refund rate Views A multi-store view: everything visible in one consolidated set of charts A per-store view: drill into any single brand Clear, readable graphs for yesterday / 7 days / 30 days, plus a custom date picker Period-over-period comparison so we can see whether we are growing or bleeding Automation Daily Slack update with yesterday's key numbers per store Weekly Slack update with growth vs. the previous week Must-have requirements A demonstrable track record building a P&L / profit dashboard. Screenshots, a live demo, a Loom walkthrough or a repo — we want proof, not promises. Comfortable working with APIs and API keys (Shopify Admin API, Meta Marketing API, Google Ads API, Pinterest API) Hands-on with Supabase and/or Vercel for building and deploying You work with Claude Code, Claude or Codex as part of your daily workflow — we build fast here Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills — a lot of our cost and supplier data still starts life in a spreadsheet Good written English and reliable daily communication Bonus points (this is how you earn more) Bookkeeping / accounting skills. We also need our finance side organized — invoices, costs and P&L all in one clean place. If you can build that system (or run it yourself), tell us. This alone can raise your offer. You can optimize multiple workflows: sheet automation, accounting flows, backend dashboards. The more of our stack you can own, the more projects we hand you. Experience with e-commerce / dropshipping data specifically Growth path Phase 1 is the P&L command center. After that we want to build: A supply chain dashboard on top of the same system A product listing system This can run as a long-term full-time role or as project-based work — whichever fits you better. We are open to your proposal. How to apply Read this carefully, because we filter hard on it. Start your message with the word READY. Applications that don't will be deleted unread. Then send us: Your track record — links, screenshots, a demo or a Loom of a P&L or analytics dashboard you actually built. Show us the real thing. What you would build for us — the stack you'd use and a rough timeline to get Phase 1 live. How you'd handle COGS — in 3 sentences: how would you get accurate cost-of-goods into the dashboard when it doesn't live cleanly inside Shopify? (This tells us more than a CV does.) Your position on the offer — confirm you're open to $1,000 USD/month, or make us a proposal. If you want to build the extra pieces (accounting system, supply chain, listing tool) tell us what that's worth and we'll talk. We pay for people who make us money. We reply fast to strong applications. Looking forward to seeing what you've built.

The Opportunity You will lead the development and performance of the international brands and retail portfolio, from identifying potential partners and securing commercial rights through launch, distribution, and ongoing growth. Working closely with executive leadership, you will develop the portfolio strategy, build retail and distribution relationships, and make investment recommendations supported by clear commercial analysis. Key responsibilities 1) Portfolio strategy and international brand partnerships Develop the portfolio strategy, identifying priority categories, brands, customer segments, and markets. Identify and engage international brand owners seeking representation or expansion in the Philippines and selected ASEAN markets. Evaluate distribution, licensing, franchise, and other commercial partnership opportunities. Prepare business cases covering market demand, competition, pricing, investment requirements, risks, and expected returns. Lead negotiations on territory, exclusivity, distribution and channel rights, purchase commitments, marketing support, payment terms, and performance obligations. Assess partner credibility, supply reliability, product suitability, and contractual risks with Finance, Legal, and Operations. Build strong relationships with international principals and monitor delivery against agreed commitments. Recommend when to invest, expand, renegotiate, reposition, or exit a brand. 2) Market entry and brand development Develop market-entry plans covering positioning, assortment, pricing, route to market, launch investment, and financial targets. Translate international brand standards into locally relevant commercial execution. Coordinate product readiness, regulatory requirements, supply arrangements, marketing, and channel activation. Establish launch milestones, budgets, ownership, and performance measures. Use customer insights, sales data, and competitor analysis to refine product selection and positioning. Build and maintain relationships with retail groups, distributors, commercial partners, and strategic accounts. Negotiate listings, trading terms, promotions, and channel agreements that support profitable growth. Set channel-specific pricing, assortment, service standards, and performance expectations. Evaluate physical retail opportunities against location economics, investment requirements, payback, and operating capacity. Maintain pricing discipline and manage channel conflict. Improve sales productivity, sell-through, customer retention, and repeat purchasing. Coordinate institutional or government opportunities with the relevant commercial and bidding teams. 4) Financial and commercial management Own the portfolio’s P&L, annual business plan, budgets, and forecasts. Set and deliver targets for revenue, gross margin, contribution, operating profit, and working capital. Assess landed costs, foreign-exchange exposure, trade spending, promotional returns, and channel profitability. Lead demand and inventory planning with Supply Chain, Sales, and Finance. Monitor stock availability, inventory ageing, stock cover, returns, markdowns, and obsolescence. Recommend allocation of capital and resources based on expected returns and execution capacity. Review results against approved business cases and take corrective action where required. Present clear performance reports, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership. 5) Leadership and execution Build and lead the commercial team as the portfolio grows. Establish clear responsibilities, decision rights, targets, and performance expectations. Align Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations around shared priorities. jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description: Location: Philippines Employment type: Full-time, 6 month Contract to Hire as full time Solvera is recruiting on behalf of a US-headquartered client with operations across the United States and ASEAN. Our client provides digital, web, and creative services that help businesses strengthen their brands, reach customers, and grow. Our client is seeking an Executive Assistant to support its CEO and another senior leader, helping them focus their time on the decisions, relationships, and priorities that matter most. The Opportunity Entrepreneurial leaders often have more ideas and opportunities than hours in the day. Meetings compete with decisions, priorities shift, and important actions can lose momentum when nobody owns the follow-through. This role brings clarity to that environment. You will help the CEO and a senior leader make deliberate choices about their time, keep track of commitments, and ensure the right people have what they need to move work forward. You will manage complex calendars and communications, but you will also look ahead: spotting competing priorities, chasing blockers, preparing leaders for decisions, and improving the systems behind the work. We’re looking for someone who can think quickly, exercise sound judgement, and bring order without slowing the business down. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (Not absolute, CEO will work with you to identify which areas you can own): 1) Executive support and calendar management - Manage the CEO’s and senior leader’s calendars, balancing strategic priorities, client commitments, internal meetings, and time for focused work. - Assess meeting requests, clarify their purpose and urgency, and recommend what should be scheduled, delegated, rescheduled, or declined. - Coordinate meetings across time zones, ensuring participants have the relevant information and materials in advance. - Prepare concise daily and weekly schedules that highlight priorities, decisions, deadlines, and potential conflicts. - Anticipate changes and reorganize schedules quickly when business needs shift. - Coordinate travel, itineraries, appointments, and related logistics when required. 2) Priorities, actions, and follow-through - Maintain a clear view of the executives’ priorities, commitments, and deadlines. - Translate meetings and discussions into action items with owners and due dates. - Follow up with stakeholders, identify blockers, and escalate issues that need executive attention. - Help leaders distinguish urgent matters from work that can be delegated, deferred, or handled by others. - Prepare brief status updates so executives can see what is progressing, what is at risk, and where a decision is needed. - Keep track of ideas and new opportunities, helping leaders determine the next step and owner. 3) Executive communications - Monitor and organize executive correspondence as authorized, flagging urgent matters and bringing relevant context to the leaders’ attention. - Draft and, where authorized, send emails and responses on behalf of the CEO and senior leader. - Communicate professionally with clients, partners, and internal teams, adapting to the executive’s voice and the situation. - Follow up on outstanding requests and ensure correspondence is acknowledged and actioned. - Handle sensitive information with discretion and sound judgement. - Know when to respond independently and when to seek direction or escalate. 4) Systems, automation, and continuous improvement - Review recurring administrative work and identify opportunities to simplify or automate it. - Design and maintain practical systems for tracking priorities, meetings, actions, documents, and follow-ups. - Use digital tools and automation to reduce manual work and improve visibility across executive commitments. - Set up or improve templates, reminders, workflows, and dashboards that help the leaders and their teams stay organized. - Explore appropriate AI and productivity tools, applying them thoughtfully while protecting confidential information. - Document processes so they are easy to maintain and improve. 5) Meeting preparation and executive coordination - Prepare agendas, briefing notes, background information, and relevant documents before meetings. - Capture key decisions and actions, and ensure follow-ups reach the right people. - Coordinate with managers and project owners to obtain updates, reports, and materials. - Help prepare presentations, correspondence, and executive summaries. - jobs.title: Sales Executive – Digital, Web & Creative Solutions
jobs.description: Solvera is recruiting on behalf of a US-headquartered client with operations across the United States and ASEAN. We are looking for an experienced Sales Executive to develop new business, build client relationships, and turn customer requirements into well-scoped commercial opportunities. The Opportunity A business may know it needs a stronger online presence, a better website, or a more effective way to reach customers. Your job is to understand what it is trying to achieve, identify the right combination of services, and turn that conversation into a strong commercial opportunity. You will work with creative, marketing, and web development specialists to shape proposals for clients across different industries. You will own your pipeline and lead opportunities from the first conversation through negotiation and close. This role offers direct involvement in growing the client’s business across international markets. It calls for someone who can build trust with decision-makers, spot opportunities beyond the initial brief, and deliver results against sales targets. Key responsibilities 1) New business development - Identify and engage prospective clients through research, referrals, networking, outreach, and other approved channels. - Build a qualified pipeline across businesses and industries suited to the client’s services. - Understand prospects’ business objectives, challenges, budget, decision-making process, and timeline. - Arrange and lead discovery calls, meetings, presentations, and pitches. - Follow up consistently and move opportunities through the sales process. - Deliver agreed sales activity, pipeline, and revenue targets. 2) Solution selling and proposals - Develop a strong understanding of the client’s services, including: - Website design and development. - E-commerce development. - Digital marketing and social media. - Search engine optimization and paid digital advertising. - Graphic design, branding, and corporate identity. - Photography, video production, and content. - Print and other marketing materials. - Identify opportunities to offer individual services or combine them into a broader proposal. - Work with creative, marketing, and technical specialists to confirm scope, deliverables, timelines, and pricing. - Prepare presentations, quotations, proposals, and responses to client enquiries. - Explain recommendations clearly and address client questions or objections. - Negotiate commercial terms within approved limits and secure the necessary internal approvals. - Maintain accurate records of proposals, agreements, and client commitments. 3) Client relationships and account growth - Build professional relationships with clients and understand their changing needs. - Identify opportunities for additional services, project extensions, and ongoing engagements. - Coordinate a clear handover to the relevant delivery teams after a sale. - Stay engaged with clients and help resolve commercial or communication concerns. - Gather client feedback and share relevant insights with internal teams. - Support retention and repeat business through timely follow-up and reliable service. 4) Sales planning and reporting - Maintain accurate prospect, pipeline, and activity records in the designated CRM or sales tracker. - Provide regular updates on opportunities, proposals, forecasts, wins, and losses. - Track progress against individual targets and identify actions needed to close gaps. - Share market insights, competitor activity, and customer feedback with leadership. - Contribute ideas to improve prospecting, proposals, and client acquisition. What we are looking for - At least five years of B2B sales, business development, or account management experience. - Experience selling digital marketing, website development, creative, advertising, branding, or related professional services. - A demonstrable record of developing opportunities and achieving sales targets. - Confidence prospecting, conducting discovery meetings, presenting proposals, and negotiating with clients. - Ability to understand business requirements and coordinate solutions with marketing, creative, or technical specialists. - Very strong written and spoken English. - Good commercial judgement and attention to scope, pricing, and client commitments. - Proficiency in CRM systems, spreadsheets, presentations, and virtual meeting tools. - Ability to manage multiple opportunities and follow through on commitments. Experience that will distinguish candidates - Selling to clients in the United States or other international markets. - Working within a digital agency, creative agency, advertising agency, web development company, or professional services business. - Selling both one-off projects and ongoing service agreements. - Developing new accounts independently through outbound prospecting. - Preparing proposals

jobs.title: Short-Form Video Creator for Meta Andromeda Ads (Reels, Instagram, Facebook) | Music Promotion
jobs.description: ABOUT US We are a music promotion company that helps independent artists get their music heard. We run curated Spotify playlists and a set of Instagram accounts that connect artists with real listeners. Most new artists find us through our paid ads on Instagram and Facebook, so the quality of our video ads directly affects how fast we grow. We are looking for a creative, data-minded video creator who can turn a scroll into a click. THE ROLE You will create video content for several of our music playlists, each with its own genre and audience: - Indie Rock - Hip-Hop - Neoclassical - Soul & R&B - Lo-Fi - [and more] Each playlist needs its own visual style and tone. A Lo-Fi ad should not feel like a Hip-Hop ad. You need to be able to switch styles and still keep the content strong. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Create short vertical videos (9:16) for Reels, Stories and Meta feed ads, aimed at people on Instagram and Facebook to follow our ---------- playlists. - Produce a high volume of genuinely different ad concepts: new hooks, angles, formats, visual styles and messages, not just small edits of the same video - Write scroll-stopping hooks for the first 1 to 3 seconds, plus short on-screen text and captions - Use AI tools (video generation, voiceover, editing, captioning, image generation) to produce content quickly without losing quality - Review ad performance with us (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per click, landing page views) and use the results to plan the next round of creatives - Keep creatives within Meta's ad policies and music licensing rules, so ads don't get rejected or muted - Organize and label all creatives so we can track which concepts win WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU - A portfolio of short-form videos or ads you made yourself. Paid social ads with results are a big plus. - A solid understanding of how Meta Andromeda changed advertising: the creative now does most of the targeting, broad audiences are standard, and the algorithm rewards real creative diversity over many near-identical variations - Hands-on experience with AI content tools (for example CapCut, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Veo, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, or similar). Tell us which ones you use. - Strong editing skills: pacing, captions, transitions, sound design, text animation - Good written English for hooks and on-screen copy aimed at a Western audience of musicians - Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and deliver in batches - Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video editing NICE TO HAVE - Knowledge of the music industry, Spotify, playlists or independent artist culture - Experience with Meta Ads Manager and reading ad performance data - Motion graphics or basic animation skills - Experience with UGC-style or faceless content formats WHAT WE OFFER - Creative freedom to test new ideas, with clear feedback based on real ad data - Performance-based raises as your creatives prove themselves HOW WE START: PAID TRIAL We start with a paid trial on 2 of our playlists: Lo-Fi and Indie Rock. This lets you see how we work and lets us see your work. - Duration: [e.g. 2 weeks] - Deliverables: [e.g. 6 to 8 distinct ad creatives per playlist] - Trial pay: [e.g. PHP X fixed for the full trial] Lo-Fi calls for a calm, aesthetic, atmospheric style. Indie Rock calls for energy, attitude and raw visuals. We want to see that you can do both well. We judge the trial on creative quality and on real ad performance. If it's a good match, you'll take over video content for our other playlists (Hip-Hop, Neoclassical, Soul & R&B and more) and move to a long-term role. HOW TO APPLY Please include: 1. Links to 3 to 5 short-form videos you created (ads preferred) 2. The AI tools you use and what you use each one for 3. In 3 to 5 sentences: how has Meta Andromeda changed the way you would build ad creatives for a new campaign? 4. Your expected monthly rate and available hours 5. A rough idea for one ad that would make an independent Lo-Fi or Indie Rock artist want to submit their song to a playlist Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short paid test task. The best candidate then moves on to the paid trial with our Lo-Fi and Indie Rock playlists.

jobs.title: Senior US Tax Accountant
jobs.description: JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO: Tax Preparation & Compliance *Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065. *Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients. *Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules. *Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness. *Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries. *Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation. *Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment. *Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings. *Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence. *Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval. *Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues. Tax Planning & Strategy *Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year. *Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies. *Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations. *Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications. *Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review. *Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients. *Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning. *Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results. Payroll & Accounting Coordination *Process monthly payroll through our payroll software. *Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness. *Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies. *Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts. *Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records. *Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions. *Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records. Tax Operations & Team Collaboration *Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines. *Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions. *Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems. *Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them. *Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows. *Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation. *Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development. EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED: *Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply. *Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065. *Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage. *Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis. *Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients. *Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements. *Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations. *Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review. *Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions. *Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations. *Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations. *Excellent written and spoken English. *Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines. *Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity. Nice to have: *Philippine Certified Public

jobs.title: BOOKKEEPER / BUSINESS MANAGEMENT STAFF
jobs.description: POSITION OVERVIEW We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Business Management / Bookkeeping Staff member to provide day-to-day accounting and administrative support for one of our key clients. This position will work closely with the client and our accounting team to manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, commission reporting, financial records, and other business management responsibilities. The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable communicating directly with clients, vendors, and employees. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable * Manage and maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable. * Process vendor invoices, payments, and customer receipts. * Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up on past-due balances. * Maintain accurate vendor and customer records. * Assist with cash flow monitoring and payment scheduling. Commission Reporting * Prepare recurring commission reports and calculations. * Review sales and transaction information for accuracy. * Coordinate commission payments and resolve discrepancies. * Maintain supporting documentation for commission calculations. Payroll * Coordinate and process payroll information. * Review payroll reports for accuracy. * Maintain employee payroll records and assist with payroll-related questions. * Coordinate with the payroll provider and accounting team as needed. Client Support * Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for the client regarding accounting and business management matters. * Respond to client questions and requests in a timely and professional manner. * Coordinate with vendors, employees, and other third parties on behalf of the client. * Identify issues and communicate them to the appropriate accounting or management team. Bookkeeping & Financial Administration * Perform bank and credit card reconciliations. * Maintain accurate and organized accounting records. * Assist with monthly financial reporting and account analysis. * Enter and review transactions in QuickBooks Online. * Assist with budgeting, cash flow tracking, and other financial analysis as needed. General Business Management Support * Handle miscellaneous accounting, business management, and administrative tasks related to the client's business. * Assist with special projects and financial research. * Maintain organized electronic records and supporting documentation. * Coordinate with the tax and accounting teams regarding tax filings, information requests, and year-end matters. * Take on additional responsibilities as needed to support the client's business operations. QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS * Minimum 2 years of experience working with U.S.-based clients or accounts. * 2+ years of bookkeeping, accounting, business management, or related experience. * Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable. * Experience with payroll and commission calculations preferred. * QuickBooks Online experience preferred. * Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills. * Excellent attention to detail and organization. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities. * Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial and payroll information. * Strong client service and communication skills. IDEAL CANDIDATE The ideal candidate is someone who can become familiar with the client's business and serve as a reliable day-to-day financial resource. This person should be proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities. WHAT TO EXPECT As a member of our team, you can expect: * A welcoming and inclusive environment where your opinions and ideas are valued. * Opportunities for personal and professional growth through ongoing training and development. * Competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your family. * Flexibility to achieve a work-life balance that suits your needs. * An atmosphere that encourages innovation, creativity, and collaboration. * Regular team-building activities and social events to unwind and build lasting relationships with your colleagues. WORK SCHEDULE **Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (California time)** WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU? * Competitive salary, depending on experience * 24 PTO credits * Remote opportunity — work from the comfort of your home * Long-term opportunity with career growth and advancement OUR BACKGROUND We are a U.S.-based accounting firm committed to providing exceptional service and value to our clients. We believe our success starts with a strong, qualified team and a supportive company culture. We value teamwork, professional growth, and a positive attitude. Our core belief is that attitude is just as important, if not more important, than technical skills, and we strive to create an environment where our team members feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow.

jobs.title: Hiring: Executive Assistant & Founder’s Right Hand
jobs.description: Hi, I'm Dr. Joshi, an American Psychologist living in India, with a very busy life. I'm looking for a highly organized, proactive, tech-savvy Executive Assistant to become my trusted right hand. I have a small business that moves fast, with lots of ideas, projects, and moving parts. I need someone who can help me stay organized, build efficient systems, coordinate with my team, and make sure things actually get done. This is not a traditional admin role. I'm looking for someone who takes ownership, solves problems independently, is empathetic, and and understand my needs, and is very responsive to me. If you can learn new tools quickly, and you enjoy creating order out of chaos, let's talk! What You'll Do 1. Keep Me Organized Turn my WhatsApp messages, voice notes, and ideas into organized tasks and projects. Build and maintain a clear, visual dashboard of everything I'm working on. Track priorities, deadlines, decisions, and follow-ups. Create an efficient system for us to work together so nothing falls through the cracks. 2. Build Systems & SOPs Review existing staff responsibilities and write clear job descriptions for team members. Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), checklists, and documentation. Set up a simple, effective system for assigning tasks, tracking progress, and keeping the team's work flowing. Identify bottlenecks and improve workflows using project management and AI tools. 3. Keep Projects Moving Coordinate with staff, delegate tasks, and follow up on deadlines. Proactively identify delays and help resolve problems. Step in and complete tasks yourself when another team member can't get something done quickly enough. Keep me updated without requiring me to chase information. 4. Execute Tasks Quickly Make updates in Kajabi (pages, courses, offers, and automations). Upload and manage videos in YouTube Studio. Handle Instagram posting, scheduling, and routine updates. Complete administrative and technical tasks across different online platforms. Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to work faster and more efficiently. Who I'm Looking For Exceptionally organized, reliable, and detail-oriented. Highly responsive, proactive, and an excellent communicator. Experienced in supporting a busy founder or entrepreneur. Able to create SOPs, document processes, and build practical systems. Comfortable coordinating team members and managing multiple priorities. Hands-on Kajabi experience is required. Tech-savvy and comfortable with project management tools, Google Workspace, YouTube Studio, Instagram, and AI tools. Independent problem-solver who takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions. Schedule & Communication This is a 25-hour-per-week position at $10 USD/hour. You must be available for dedicated live working sessions with me 1-3 days/week at these times: Monday: 7:30 PM Philippine Time (2–3 hours) Tuesday: 7:30 PM Philippine Time (2–3 hours) Wednesday: 7:30 PM Philippine Time (2–3 hours) The remaining hours will be used for independent work, team coordination, and execution. You must be responsive on WhatsApp and acknowledge messages within one hour during agreed working hours. How to Apply Please send: A brief introduction and your relevant experience. Examples of SOPs, dashboards, or systems you've built. Examples of your hands-on Kajabi experience. Confirmation that you can attend the weekly required evening working sessions. Confirmation that you can respond to my messages within 1 hour during our agreed upon windows of time. To Apply - Answer this question: If you joined a fast-moving business where the founder has lots of ideas, tasks are scattered across WhatsApp, and staff responsibilities aren't clearly documented, what would you do in your first 30 days? Start your application with RIGHT HAND so I know you've read the posting. Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical assessment.

jobs.title: Administrative & Marketing Assistant (Virtual)
jobs.description: Administrative & Marketing Assistant (Virtual) CREW Silicon Valley | ---------- About us: CREW Silicon Valley is the local chapter of CREW Network (Commercial Real Estate Women Network). Founded in 1981, we advance women in commercial real estate through business networking, leadership development, career outreach, and industry research. You will support 3 to 5 volunteer board members of this non-profit, educational organization. Position at a glance Hours: About 20 hours per week, over Monday through Friday. Hours are flexible, with a daily 1-hour overlap window with California (about 7 to 8 am Philippine time, negotiable). US bank holidays are observed. Reports to: CREW SV President. Response time: Reply to requests by the next business day. Pay: USD $8 per hour (or PHP equivalent), paid via Wise every two weeks. Start: On or around December 1, 2026, with a 30-day trial period (check-in after week 1 and a review with the chapter President at Day 30), then quarterly reviews. Success measures: On-time delivery of well written and well-designed newsletters, e-blasts, and posts; accuracy of event, website, and registration details; and regular, clear reporting to the Board. Work style: Remote, computer-based work. Tasks come in writing from a director of the Board, with a due date. Responsibilities 1. Inbox: Respond to or route emails sent to chapter’s email, using templates provided by the Board, follow up on outstanding action items; simplify or automate repetitive tasks. 2. Chapter Marketing & Communications: Under the direction of the Communications Director - Create impactful graphics, using Canva and following the organization’s brand guidelines. Design and publish marketing newsletters and event announcements in Constant Contact. Create and schedule social media posts. Create and update brochures, flyers, and event slide decks. Design and execute based on marketing calendar, track & report results. 3. Chapter events & programs setup: Enter event, fee, and sponsorship details in CREW Network, set up registration, run test registrations, and submit events with marketing materials. Send weekly registration stats to the Program Director. 4. CREW Network liaison: Be the chapter’s contact with CREW Network on administrative, marketing & communications, event registration, and sponsorship tasks. 5. jobs.title: Video Editor & Thumbnail Designer (Long-Form Reaction & Social Commentary) —
jobs.description: Our viewers are primarily U.S.-based heterosexual men aged 18–40 (with strong overlap among Black male audiences and culturally conservative/traditional men). They value straight-talking accountability, reciprocity, traditional family leadership, and practical, rule-based frameworks over feel-good dating platitudes. They tune in for relatable "big brother" mentorship that cuts through noise and delivers clear, actionable takeaways. Role Overview We are looking for a sharp, creative Long-Form YouTube Video Editor & Thumbnail Designer who understands retention pacing, conversational rhythm, and high-CTR packaging. Your mission is to turn raw face-cam reaction recordings into tight, engaging 12-to-25-minute episodes where every cut serves the host's core argument—eliminating filler, reinforcing key points with well-timed memes and sound effects, and delivering scroll-stopping thumbnails. Key Responsibilities Tight Pacing & Filler Removal: Ruthlessly cut all dead air, pauses, false starts, stumbles, "ums," "uhs," and repetitive phrasing so the host sounds crisp, authoritative, and natural without feeling overly chopped or robotic. Story-Driven & Point-Focused Editing: Identify the central thesis and key lessons in every reaction segment. Structure cuts, punch-in zooms, and visual emphasis to spotlight the main points the host is making rather than leaving in tangential rambling. Tasteful Memes & Sound Effects (SFX): Drop in well-timed reaction memes, pop-culture cutaways, and subtle sound effects to punctuate punchlines, expose double standards, and drive home key points—enhancing retention without over-editing or burying the host's message. Thumbnail Design & Packaging: Design high-CTR YouTube thumbnails for each episode (combining expressive host face-cam cutouts, recognizable subject reactions from the clip, and bold 2–4 word curiosity hooks) plus optional A/B test variations. Seamless Reaction Integration & Audio Polish: Balance the source clip (podcasts, debates, courtroom clips) and the host's face-cam commentary smoothly. Normalize dialogue levels, reduce background noise, and maintain consistent vocal clarity across both studio mic audio and external clips. On-Screen Framework Graphics: Add clean, minimalist lower thirds, chapter markers, and on-screen callouts (such as our 5-point vetting scorecards and rule-of-thumb takeaways) that reinforce the host's points. Shorts Timestamp Flagging (Bonus): Flag the top 2–3 high-tension moments per episode for vertical Shorts ---------- We Are Looking For Proven Long-Form YouTube & Thumbnail Experience: Strong portfolio of talking-head, podcast, or reaction commentary edits alongside high-performing YouTube thumbnails (familiarity with creators like Mediocre Tutorials and Reviews, Aba & Preach, Taylor the Fiend, or The Roommates is a major plus). Editorial & Comedic Timing: You listen actively to what the host is saying—you know which sentences carry the weight of the argument and exactly when a 1.5-second meme cut or sound effect makes a point land harder. Cultural & Niche Alignment: Solid grasp of modern dating discourse, internet meme culture, structured debates, and the tone of constructive masculine self-improvement (grounded, direct, never cheap outrage-bait). Technical Proficiency: Fast, reliable workflow in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro, plus Photoshop/Canva/Figma for thumbnails, with strong turnaround discipline (48–72 hours per episode + thumbnail). How to Apply Send the following with your application: 2–3 links to long-form talking-head or reaction videos you have edited (highlight examples showing tight pacing, clean dialogue cleanup, and tasteful meme/SFX placement). 3–5 sample YouTube thumbnails you have designed (ideally in the commentary, podcast, or reaction space). Your per-video rate (covering both the 12–25 minute finished edit from 30–45 minutes of raw footage AND the thumbnail) and typical turnaround time. A 2-sentence note on what makes a reaction video hold viewer retention past the 5-minute mark.

HOURS AND PAY - Rate: $5/hour, paid weekly or bi-weekly by agreement. - Schedule: About 20 hours per week, Monday–Friday, during Memphis (Central Time) business hours. - Monthly total: About $430/month to start. A small bonus may be paid for booked introductory calls that take place. - Term: This is a part-time, long-term role if the first month goes well. It can grow as we open more homes. YOU MUST HAVE - Clear, confident spoken English that U.S. hospital staff can understand easily on the phone — a voice recording is required to apply. - Experience with outbound calling, appointment setting, customer service, or phone-based work. - A quiet workspace, a reliable computer and internet connection, and a headset. - Accuracy with spreadsheets (Google Sheets) and email (Gmail), and the habit of logging work the same day. - A respectful, patient manner with busy professionals. No hard selling, no pressure, and no calls to patients. - Comfort calling hospitals, clinics, and veterans' organizations, and asking for the discharge planning or case management department. NICE TO HAVE - Experience calling U.S. healthcare, social services, property management, or real estate contacts. - Familiarity with Google Workspace and a simple CRM or call-tracking sheet. HOW TO APPLY Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. In your application, answer all three screening questions below and attach or link a voice recording (60–90 seconds) reading the short script in the screening section. Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. SCREENING QUESTIONS 1. Tell us about your outbound calling experience. How many calls a day have you handled, and who were you calling? 2. A discharge planner says, "We can't share patient information." What do you say next? Write your reply in 3–4 sentences. 3. Confirm your setup: your headset and internet, your quiet workspace, and the exact hours you can work in Central Time, Monday–Friday. I'd like to send your team our one-page resource sheet so you have it on file when a patient needs housing. Who is the best person for referrals, and what is the best email for them?" jobs.title: Business Development & Research Assistant
jobs.description: About ZMH Group ZMH Group is developing relationships with organisations involved in social housing, supported living, temporary accommodation and emergency accommodation. The business wants to understand organisations’ accommodation requirements so the Director can assess potential property opportunities and partnerships. Purpose of the role Research relevant providers and councils, identify decision-makers, make professional introductory contact, understand and record accommodation requirements, complete follow-ups, arrange introductory appointments and maintain accurate company records. Key responsibilities Provider research Identify social housing providers, supported living operators and temporary/emergency accommodation organisations. Review each organisation’s website and services before contact. Prioritise organisations whose work aligns with temporary, emergency or supported accommodation. Council research Identify local authorities and relevant housing, temporary accommodation, procurement, commissioning and supplier teams. Find appropriate public contact routes and procurement portals. Outreach Make approved introductory calls and send approved emails. Personalise contact based on research, identify the right person and ask how ZMH Group may be of value. Requirements gathering Record operating areas, expansion areas, property types and bedroom sizes, property condition/standards, HMO licensing requirements and rent/payment settings. Follow-ups and appointments Complete agreed follow-ups, record outcomes and next actions, and arrange introductory meetings for the Director. Google Sheets, Excel Sheets and reporting Maintain provider and council trackers, log outreach, complete a daily work log and submit a short Loom end-of-day summary. Inbox management Monitor the designated inbox, organise correspondence, use approved routine templates and escalate opportunities or sensitive matters. Scope boundaries This role is limited to providers and councils. The VA must NOT research or contact landlords, private property owners or sellers, and must NOT source properties. These activities remain with the Director unless changed by written instruction. The VA must not promise property availability, quote or agree rents, negotiate commercial terms, confirm licensing/compliance, submit tenders, make financial commitments or sign agreements. Refer these matters to the Director. Candidate requirements • Excellent spoken and written English and a confident telephone manner. • Experience in B2B research, lead generation, appointment setting or customer support. • Confident using Google Sheets, Excel, email and online research tools. • Able to research organisations and identify appropriate decision-makers. • Accurate, organised, proactive and comfortable working independently. • Willing to maintain a daily activity log and record short Loom updates. Working pattern and assessment The role is 20 - 25 hours per week, normally five hours per day Monday to Friday. Agree the exact working window with the Director to provide useful overlap with UK business hours. Review performance weekly, with a 30-day assessment and any probation period set out in the written agreement. Recruitment exercise Shortlisted candidates may be asked to research a small sample of relevant UK providers and councils, identify the correct contact route, complete a sample requirements record and record a short Loom walkthrough.

I run Ward Ruddock, a personal injury and property insurance law firm in Miami, Florida. We represent people after car and truck crashes, serious a ---------- , and storms that tear their homes apart, and then we take on the insurance companies for them. We do great work for our clients. The problem is that not enough people know about us yet. I have the knowledge and the stories. I don’t have time to film content every day, and I don’t want a marketing system that waits on me. I’m hiring someone who can produce a high volume of strong content on their own, using the best AI tools available, and who can build the relationships that bring in new clients. You won’t be one of ten assistants in a pool. You’ll work directly with me, and what you do will show up in how fast this firm grows. What you’ll own, in order of priority Content: the voice of the firm. You create content from start to finish, without waiting on me to film. You use AI tools (Bloom, Higgsfield and others), along with design and editing tools, to produce reels, short videos, carousels, graphics and explainers that teach people their rights after an a ---------- or an insurance denial. You write the hooks, scripts and captions. You keep our calendar running at 2 posts a day, 7 days a week, across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok, and you queue each week’s content for my approval in one batch. You also manage our Google Business Profile and make sure every happy client is asked for a review. Partner outreach: building our referral network. You research and build lists of local businesses that see injured people every day (chiropractors, physical therapists, body shops, public adjusters, roofers). You reach out by email, LinkedIn and phone, book intro meetings onto my calendar, prepare a short brief before each one, and follow up afterward. You keep every relationship warm in our CRM. Social lead response: the first reply. When someone messages us after the worst day of their life, you answer quickly and kindly using our scripts, collect their basic info, and get them booked with our intake team. You never give legal advice or talk about case details. We train you on exactly what to say. This takes the least of your time, but when a message comes in, it jumps to the front of the line. What a week here actually looks like On Monday you plan the week’s content around what people in South Florida are searching for and worried about: hurricane claims, trucking crashes, insurance denials. By Wednesday, 14 posts are built, captioned and waiting in my approval queue. In between, you send outreach emails, follow up with a chiropractor who opened your message twice, and book two lunch meetings for me on Thursday. A message comes in from someone hurt in a crash on I-95, and you answer within minutes and get them on the phone with our team. On Friday you send me a short report: what posted, what performed, how many meetings got booked, and how many leads came in. What it’s like to work here We’re client-centered. Our clients come to us hurting and scared. Everything we put out should make them feel they’ve found people who will actually help. We’re easygoing about style and serious about standards. No micromanaging and no politics. Deadlines are deadlines, though, and quality matters. You’ll be heard. If you find a better tool, format or hook, use it and show me the results. I want someone who improves our systems, not just someone who follows them. You’ll grow. As our marketing grows, this role grows into leading it. You’re probably the right person if: You already use AI tools to create images, video and copy, and you can show work that doesn’t look like generic AI You’ve grown a business’s social accounts and can show the numbers You know what makes someone stop scrolling within the first 2 seconds You write natural, conversational English, warm without being stiff You can produce a high volume of content without sacrificing quality You’re comfortable reaching out to US business owners you don’t know You’d rather fix a problem first and tell me afterward than wait to be told You know CapCut, Canva, Premiere or similar. Meta Business Suite, Google Business Profile and CRM experience are all a plus You can work US Eastern hours with reliable internet and a reliable computer This probably isn’t for you if you need someone to hand you raw material and a task list every morning, or if reaching out to strangers and hearing “no” sometimes sounds stressful rather than exciting. jobs.title: Development Finance Analyst
jobs.description: ABOUT US Vecino Group is a US real estate developer of affordable and market rate housing. We take each community from pursuit through construction, stabilization, and permanent loan conversion. THE ROLE This is a full time, long term, remote position. The Development Finance Analyst reports to the Vice President of Finance and supports our finance and development teams on project financing. You will work as an embedded member of our team, inside our systems, on live deals. WHAT YOU WILL DO • Underwrite and screen potential developments against our investment criteria, and flag financial risks with recommended solutions. • Build and maintain financial models: pro formas, development budgets, sources and uses, cash flow, and return analysis, including sensitivities to rents, costs, interest rates, and lease up. • Prepare and submit monthly construction draw requests, and reconcile each draw to the approved budget, prior funding, and supporting documents. • Track budget to actual variances, cost to complete, interest reserves, and projected cash needs, and escalate funding gaps early. • Maintain a schedule of lender and investor deadlines, loan maturities, and required deliverables. • Support financial closings, stabilization, and permanent loan conversion, including review of operating statements, rent rolls, and debt service coverage. • Support tax credit work: equity adjusters, cost certification, and final reconciliation of sources and uses. • Correspond in writing and on calls with US lenders, investors, and consultants. • Prepare presentations and reports for senior leadership. WHAT YOU NEED • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Real Estate, or a related field. CPA is a plus. • 5 or more years of experience in real estate finance, accounting, commercial banking, or private equity. Experience supporting a US company is strongly preferred. • Advanced Excel: financial modeling, lookup functions, pivot tables, error checking, and the ability to trace assumptions through a model built by someone else. • Experience with construction draws, construction lending, or US affordable housing finance (Low Income Housing Tax Credits) is a strong plus. We will train the right person on tax credits. • Excellent written and spoken English. You will communicate directly with lenders and investors. • Strong attention to detail, organized file and version control habits, and high ethical standards with confidential financial information. HOW WE WORK • We run on Microsoft 365. You will work every day in Excel, Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, and Planner, using a company account and our file structures and naming standards. • We use ChatGPT and other AI tools within established internal workflows. You must be comfortable using them, verifying their output, and protecting confidential data. • You will be expected to communicate proactively on Teams, post updates without being asked, and raise problems early. SCHEDULE AND SETUP • Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time. • Reliable computer, primary internet of at least 50 Mbps, a backup connection, and backup power. • A signed confidentiality agreement is required. TO APPLY Use the subject line "Sources and Uses" followed by your name. Applications without it will not be reviewed. Please include: 1. Your resume. 2. A short description of the most complex financial model you have built or maintained, and what decisions it supported. 3. Your experience with construction draws, lender reporting, or US real estate finance. 4. A two minute video introducing yourself in English.

jobs.title: Collections & Accounts Receivable Specialist – 3PL Logistics
jobs.description: ## Role Overview New York Fulfillment is seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Collections & Accounts Receivable Specialist with strong experience in B2B collections, financial management, and customer account administration. *The primary responsibility of this position is to maintain healthy company cash flow by collecting outstanding receivables, enforcing payment terms, monitoring customer credit status, and ensuring payment commitments are fulfilled.* We operate in the third-party logistics (3PL), warehousing, and fulfillment industry. Experience in logistics, distribution, freight, or warehouse operations is highly desirable. The position also involves occasional billing support, financial reporting, customer service, freight invoice review, and purchasing cost analysis as business needs evolve. ## Primary Responsibilities ### 1. Accounts Receivable, Collections & Cash Flow Management - Take ownership of the company's accounts receivable and collections process. - Review aging reports daily and prioritize overdue balances. - Proactively contact customers by phone and email to collect outstanding invoices. - Maintain detailed records of collection communications, payment commitments, and follow-up dates. - *Track every promised payment and verify that funds are actually received by the agreed date.* - Immediately follow up on missed payment commitments and escalate unresolved accounts. - Place customer accounts on credit hold according to company policies when payments are overdue or commitments are broken. - Coordinate with warehouse management to prevent unauthorized order releases or shipments from accounts on hold. - Review customer credit limits, payment terms, and account standing. - Identify high-risk accounts and recommend corrective action. - Resolve payment discrepancies, unapplied payments, short payments, and disputed balances. - Reconcile customer payments and outstanding balances in QuickBooks. - Prepare weekly collection forecasts to help management plan cash availability. - Maintain professional customer communication while consistently enforcing payment policies. ### 2. Financial Monitoring & Reporting - Monitor expected incoming payments and provide management with cash collection forecasts. - Prepare daily or weekly summaries of overdue accounts, promised payments, and collections received. - Identify accounts that could create cash flow shortages. - Track accounts receivable aging and collection performance. - Assist with financial analysis, profitability reviews, and cost monitoring when requested. - Support bank reconciliation and month-end accounting procedures as needed. ## Additional Responsibilities ### 3. Billing & 3PL System Support - Assist with customer invoicing and billing reviews as needed. - Review storage, receiving, fulfillment, shipping, kitting, labeling, and other warehouse service charges. - Identify missing charges, billing errors, and customer rate discrepancies. - Help reconcile billing information between Extensiv and QuickBooks. - Assist with customer billing disputes and invoice corrections. - Support improvements to billing accuracy and automation. ### 4. Customer Service & Account Coordination - Respond to customer questions regarding invoices, payments, account balances, and credit holds. - Assist with customer inquiries related to warehouse services, receiving, fulfillment, inventory, and shipping when needed. - Coordinate with customer service and warehouse staff to resolve account-related issues. - Communicate payment requirements, credit policies, and account status professionally. - Help with customer onboarding and account administration as assigned. ### 5. Freight, Shipping & Vendor Invoice Review - Review freight and transportation invoices for accuracy. - Identify incorrect carrier charges, duplicate invoices, unexpected surcharges, and billing discrepancies. - Communicate with UPS, FedEx, LTL, and FTL carriers when necessary to resolve billing disputes. - Understand common freight documentation, including Bills of Lading (BOL), PRO numbers, and Proof of Delivery (POD). - Compare freight charges against agreed rates and service terms. - Assist with transportation cost analysis as needed. ### 6. Purchasing & Warehouse Supply Cost Control - Monitor pricing and expenses for warehouse supplies, particularly cartons, boxes, packaging materials, labels, pallets, and stretch wrap. - Regularly compare pricing among packaging suppliers and vendors. - Request competitive quotes and identify lower-cost purchasing opportunities. - Review supplier invoices for pricing errors, duplicate charges, and unexpected increases. - Evaluate purchasing costs, delivery charges, minimum order quantities, and vendor terms. - Recommend cost-saving alternatives while maintaining required quality standards. - Assist with vendor negotiations and purchasing decisions when requested. ## Required Qualifications - Strong experience in business-to-business (B2B) accounts receivable

jobs.title: Real Estate - Acquisitions Closer
jobs.description: Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote) ABOUT US Price Real Estate Investments is a U.S.-based real estate investment company purchasing properties directly from homeowners across multiple markets. Our team works remotely to build relationships with sellers, evaluate opportunities, negotiate purchases, and move deals toward closing. We’re hiring an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist who can confidently speak with homeowners, present offers, handle objections, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements. This is a hands-on phone sales position. We’re looking for someone who can negotiate and close, but also stays organized, documents information accurately, follows through, and takes ownership of their work. COMPENSATION $10 USD per hour base pay, paid on the 1st and 15th of each month. Monthly Contract Bonuses: • Bronze: 2 qualified signed contracts = $500 bonus • Silver: 3 qualified signed contracts = $1,500 bonus • Gold: 4 qualified signed contracts = $2,000 bonus • Platinum: 5 qualified signed contracts = $2,500 bonus For each qualified contract above five in the same month, you may earn an additional $500, subject to ownership approval. You receive the bonus for the tier you reach, not the sum of all tiers. Contracts count toward the month in which they are fully signed by the seller and approved by ownership as qualified and realistic. Ownership determines contract qualification and agent credit. Quarterly Consistency Bonus: Earn an additional $2,000 by securing at least three qualified signed contracts in each month of a calendar quarter. This rewards consistent monthly production, not just the total number of contracts across the quarter. Quarterly bonuses are reviewed after the quarter ends and paid on the next regular payroll after ownership approval. SCHEDULE Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Central Time, following U.S. daylight saving changes. This is a fully remote position requiring reliable availability, a quiet workspace, and a dependable computer and internet setup. WHAT YOU’LL DO • Speak directly with homeowners. Build rapport and gather accurate information about property condition, motivation, timeline, occupancy, ownership, and price expectations. • Evaluate opportunities and present offers. Review comparable properties, help evaluate pricing, and present offers approved by our acquisitions department. • Negotiate and close. Handle objections, negotiate within approved amounts and terms, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements using DocuSign. • Stay on top of follow-up. Work new leads, scheduled callbacks, pending offers, and ongoing seller follow-up according to team priorities. • Keep FreedomSoft accurate. Maintain clear notes, correct contact information, current statuses, and specific next steps. Document what sellers actually say rather than making assumptions. • Work closely with our team lead. Participate in coaching and call reviews, apply feedback, and communicate problems early. TRAINING AND ONGOING INTAKE RESPONSIBILITIES Initial training typically takes approximately three to four weeks, depending on progress. It includes reviewing SOPs, shadowing a senior team member, practicing calls, learning our CRM, and receiving feedback. After training, you will handle seller intake and lead processing while management evaluates your readiness to make offers independently. Approval depends on call handling, accuracy, follow-through, consistency, and response to coaching, not simply time in the role. Seller intake and lead processing remain regular responsibilities after you begin making offers. This is not a closer-only position. Your assignments will vary based on lead volume, pending offers, and team priorities. WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED Sales ability: You can listen, uncover the real objection, communicate the value of our offer, and ask for a decision without sounding aggressive or robotic. Ownership and reliability: You complete assigned work, keep commitments, and communicate when you are behind or need help. You do not quietly skip required work to catch up. Attention to detail: You clarify conflicting information, preserve important details, and keep CRM records accurate so the next person can trust your notes. Coachability: You bring your experience while remaining willing to learn our process, follow approved scripts and rebuttals naturally, and apply feedback. Consistent follow-up: You stay professional and persistent through our approved calling, texting, and follow-up process, including when results are slow. REQUIREMENTS • At least two years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations. • Experience personally presenting offers, handling objections, and moving sellers toward signed purchase agreements. Be prepared to explain your own results and what other team members handled. • Strong spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly and naturally with U.S. homeowners. •
