jobs.title: AI Forward QA Engineer
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE We are a focused software development team building and improving internal and customer-facing applications, including web admin tools, digital signage systems, and media-player software. We're rebuilding and expanding our core platform while supporting products already used by customers. We have steady, ongoing work and are looking for someone who can grow into a long-term role with our team. THE ROLE We're looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer who takes ownership of software quality and helps ensure our releases are reliable before they reach customers. This role goes beyond following a checklist. You should understand what is being changed, think critically about what could break, and know when focused regression testing is sufficient versus when broader testing is needed. You'll work closely with developers, designers, and product teammates to identify issues, verify fixes, and improve our testing processes. We also encourage using AI tools to make testing more efficient, provided the results are independently reviewed and validated. This is a contract-to-hire position with a path to full-time employment for the right person. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Review requirements and code changes to plan and execute appropriate testing. - Perform functional, regression, and end-to-end testing across web applications. - Test real user workflows, edge cases, and unexpected behavior beyond the happy path. - Use browser testing, Playwright, and automated CI test suites to identify issues. - Write clear bug reports with reproduction steps, expected versus actual results, and supporting evidence. - Verify fixes and ensure changes don't introduce new problems. - Use AI tools to assist with test planning, troubleshooting, and potential code fixes while validating their output. - Communicate blockers, ask questions, and collaborate closely with the development team. - Help improve test coverage, QA processes, and release reliability. - Participate in short daily stand-ups with some overlap during U.S. working hours. WHAT YOU BRING Required - Experience testing web applications and understanding common user workflows. - Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills. - Ability to create meaningful test cases, identify edge cases, and prioritize regression testing. - Familiarity with browser developer tools and automated testing concepts. - Ability to write clear, reproducible bug reports and follow issues through resolution. - Comfortable using AI tools to support testing and troubleshooting without relying on them blindly. - Good written and spoken English communication skills. - Ability to work independently, manage responsibilities, and communicate proactively. Nice to Have - Experience writing automated tests using Playwright. - Experience with CI pipelines, Git, and pull requests. - Familiarity with AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot. - Experience testing digital signage, media players, or connected-device applications. - Experience improving QA processes within a development team. HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS We care about reliable releases, not simply the number of bugs found or tests completed. - Identify meaningful bugs and regressions before they affect customers. - Apply good judgment when determining the appropriate scope of testing. - Take ownership of issues from discovery through final verification. - Communicate clearly and raise questions or blockers early. - Improve testing efficiency through automation, AI, and better QA practices. WHY JOIN US - Contract-to-hire with a path to a full-time position. - Steady, ongoing work on real products used by customers. - Opportunities to shape QA processes and improve product quality. - Modern development workflows incorporating automation and AI. - Small, collaborative team where your contributions make a direct impact. We're looking for someone practical, curious, communicative, and dependable who enjoys finding problems, understanding why they happen, and helping deliver better software.

jobs.description: Job Overview We are looking for an experienced Social Media & Community Manager who understands that managing social media goes beyond publishing posts. We need someone who can manage social media accounts, develop and execute content plans, engage audiences and build active communities around brands. The ideal candidate understands how to grow a brand's online presence, create meaningful conversations, nurture relationships with followers and turn an audience into an engaged community. You should be comfortable managing different social media platforms, working with content calendars, monitoring performance and identifying opportunities to improve engagement and growth. We are particularly interested in someone with a proven track record of building or growing an online community, not just someone who has experience posting content. Key Responsibilities - Manage and maintain assigned social media accounts across relevant platforms. - Develop and execute social media content calendars and publishing schedules. - Create engaging captions, posts and content ideas that align with the brand's voice and objectives. - Publish and schedule content consistently. - Manage comments, direct messages and audience interactions. - Build, nurture and grow an active online community. - Initiate conversations and develop strategies that encourage meaningful audience participation. - Monitor social media analytics and prepare regular performance reports. - Identify content opportunities and recommend improvements based on performance. - Stay updated on platform changes, social media trends and audience behaviour. - Collaborate with designers, video editors and other team members to execute content strategies. - Ensure consistent brand communication across all platforms. Required Skills and Expertise - Minimum of 2 years of professional social media management experience. - Proven experience managing social media accounts for brands, businesses or individuals. - Demonstrable experience building, growing or managing an online community. - Strong content writing, caption writing and communication skills. - Good understanding of content strategy, audience engagement and social media growth. - Experience with social media management and scheduling tools. - Ability to analyse social media insights and use data to improve performance. - Good understanding of platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube. - Strong organisational and project management skills. An added advantage: Video editing, graphic design and short-form video creation skills. The Kind of Person We Want We want someone who is: - Creative, curious and full of ideas. - Proactive and able to take ownership of assigned accounts. - A natural communicator who enjoys interacting with people. - Community-minded and genuinely interested in building relationships. - Open-minded and receptive to feedback. - Analytical enough to understand what is working and what needs improvement. - A reliable team player who can work independently and meet deadlines. Important: Applicants must provide evidence of social media accounts they have managed and actual results they have achieved. jobs.title: Short-Form Video Asset Manager / Content Research Assistant / B-Roll Creator
jobs.description: I'm looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Short-Form Video Asset Manager / B-Roll Creator to help with my daily content production workflow. This is not a full video editing role. Your main responsibilities will be reviewing reference videos, finding and organizing the visual assets and background music needed for each video, and filming original B-roll footage using your iPhone. We create short-form videos promoting different apps, websites, AI tools, and software products. You will receive reference videos that demonstrate the types of assets, music, and B-roll footage needed. Your job is to gather those materials and recreate the necessary B-roll so our editors have everything they need to assemble the final videos. An iPhone is required for this position. You will use your iPhone's camera to physically film your computer screen while demonstrating websites, apps, and software tools. For example, if a reference video shows ChatGPT generating a response, you may need to open ChatGPT on your computer, recreate a similar demonstration, and film your computer monitor using your iPhone. IMPORTANT: You will NEVER be required to show your face or film yourself. All B-roll will focus on your computer screen, software interfaces, and the actions taking place on the screen. Occasionally, a shot may include your hand pointing at the monitor or interacting with the computer, but your face and body will not appear. You will also not need to speak, record voiceovers, or appear on camera. The footage will be used underneath voiceovers that are handled separately. We are looking for someone who can independently prepare complete asset packages so our editors can focus on editing rather than searching for materials. RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Visual Asset Research, Music, and Collection Carefully review the reference videos provided and identify the visual and audio assets needed. These may include: Video overlays Existing B-roll clips Screenshots Images Logos Graphics Social media clips Website screenshots App interfaces Background music used in reference videos Similar background music matching the reference video's style, tone, and pacing Other visual or audio elements shown in the reference video You will be responsible for finding and downloading the correct or closely matching assets. Background music is an important part of this role. You should attempt to identify the music used in the reference video whenever possible. If the original track cannot be identified or legally used, find a suitable licensed or royalty-free alternative that matches the reference video's overall feel. Only source music and assets that can be used with the necessary permissions or licenses. The goal is to provide our editors with all the visual assets and music they need without having to find these materials themselves. 2. Original B-Roll Filming Using an iPhone In addition to gathering existing assets, you will be responsible for filming original B-roll using your iPhone camera. This does NOT involve filming yourself, showing your face, speaking, or recording yourself on camera. Most B-roll will involve pointing your iPhone camera at your computer monitor while demonstrating websites, software, or AI tools. The purpose is to capture authentic, high-quality footage of computer screens that our editors can use in short-form videos. Examples of B-roll include: Filming your computer monitor while ChatGPT, Claude, or another AI tool is being used. Capturing prompts being typed into AI applications. Filming AI-generated responses appearing on the screen. Capturing website navigation and scrolling. Showing software features, menus, and dashboards. Filming mouse movements and clicks within an application. Demonstrating how a website or software feature works. Recreating computer-screen visuals shown in reference videos. Occasionally including a hand pointing toward something on the monitor, when appropriate. For example, if the reference video shows someone entering a prompt into an AI tool and displaying the results, your task would be to recreate that demonstration on your computer and film the screen using your iPhone. You are filming the computer screen and what's happening on it—not yourself. Important filming requirements An iPhone with a good-quality camera is required. All footage should primarily focus on the computer screen. Your face must not appear in the footage. You will not be required to film yourself or your body. An occasional hand pointing at the screen is acceptable when needed. No talking or voiceover recording is required. No full video editing is required. Film using your iPhone's camera rather than OBS or computer screen-recording software. Footage should be clear, stable, and properly focused. Avoid glare, reflections, flickering, and blurry footage. Make sure text and important information on the computer screen are readable. Record vertically (9:16) unless otherwise instructed. Upload original, high-quality video file

jobs.title: YouTube Video Editor
jobs.description: Job Overview We are looking for a creative and experienced YouTube Video Editor who understands what makes people click, watch and stay engaged with video content. This is not simply a role for someone who knows how to cut and join video clips. We need someone who understands YouTube content, storytelling, audience retention and the importance of creating videos that keep viewers interested from beginning to end. You should be able to take raw footage and transform it into engaging, well-paced and professionally edited YouTube videos that align with the channel's content direction and audience. We want someone who can bring creative ideas to the editing process, work independently and collaborate effectively with the rest of the team. Required Skills and Expertise - Minimum of 2 years of professional YouTube video editing experience. - Proven experience editing and publishing long-form YouTube videos. - Strong knowledge of video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro. - Experience creating YouTube thumbnails using tools such as Photoshop or Canva. - Good understanding of storytelling, pacing and audience retention. - Ability to work with raw footage and independently produce polished videos. - Strong attention to detail, creativity and visual storytelling skills. - Ability to interpret creative briefs and translate them into engaging videos. - Good communication, time management and organisational skills. The Kind of Person We Want We are looking for someone who is: - Creative and willing to bring fresh ideas to the table. - Proactive and capable of working without constant supervision. - Open-minded and receptive to constructive feedback. - A good team player who communicates effectively. - Detail-oriented and committed to delivering quality work. - Reliable, organised and able to meet deadlines. Important: Applicants must have a portfolio demonstrating actual YouTube videos they have edited and thumbnails they have created. Applications without relevant work samples will not be considered. jobs.title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer | $500/month | Long-Term, Multiple Channels
jobs.description: We're hiring an experienced YouTube thumbnail designer for a long-term role across our channels. $500 USD/month base, consistent work, clear references, and room to grow. We own and operate the channels you'll work on. This is an in-house role, not an agency juggling outside clients. We need someone who can make a viewer stop scrolling and want to click. Strong design skills matter, but so does choosing the right image, creating curiosity, and understanding what interests each channel's audience. THE WORK • Create thumbnails across different channels, topics, and visual styles, including gaming, TV, and pop culture. • Turn video titles and briefs into clear, interesting visual concepts. The thumbnail should add to the title rather than simply repeat it. • Match each channel's style while making every thumbnail relevant to its specific video. • Use strong image selection, composition, cutouts, colour, contrast, and readable text where appropriate. Thumbnails need to work at small sizes. • Work with templates we provide and help build reusable templates or repeatable formulas for additional styles. • Keep editable source files organised, meet agreed deadlines, and apply feedback to future work. WORKLOAD AND PAY The base is $500 USD/month. You'll start with a few thumbnails per working day while learning our channels, templates, and feedback. Volume will increase as you become comfortable, with an eventual target of around 10–12 thumbnails per working day. That target relies on established templates and repeatable styles. You won't be expected to invent 10–12 completely new designs from scratch every day. Familiar template-based thumbnails can often take around 10–20 minutes; new styles, harder concepts, and revisions can take longer. We build up based on your readiness and consistent quality, not a fixed deadline to hit full volume. We're happy to show shortlisted applicants the templates and examples before they d ---------- , so you can judge the actual workload yourself. This role requires exclusive thumbnail work for us while you're on the team: no thumbnail clients outside our business, including competing channels. Please apply only if you're comfortable with this arrangement. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR • Proven graphic design experience and a strong portfolio of YouTube thumbnails. • Strong Photoshop skills, or equivalent software that supports professional editing and reusable, editable files. • Ability to adapt across several styles, rather than only producing one type of thumbnail. • An understanding of visual hierarchy, curiosity, audience interest, and how titles and thumbnails work together. Attractive design alone isn't enough. • Good communication, reliable delivery, and the ability to improve from feedback without needing the same corrections repeatedly. • Someone who can suggest a stronger concept when the brief could be improved. Examples of the range of thumbnails involved: ---------- ---------- ---------- WHY JOIN Fixed monthly income, ongoing work across our own channels, and a repeatable process you can get faster at over time. Strong performers may grow into a thumbnail manager role, helping develop styles, review designs, and guide other designers. Further opportunities depend on your ability and what the business needs; promotion isn't guaranteed. HOW TO APPLY Use the subject: Thumbnail Designer – [Your Name] Please include: 1. A link to 5–10 of your strongest YouTube thumbnails. Include different styles if possible and explain your contribution to any team work. 2. Choose one thumbnail from your portfolio and briefly explain who it targets, what makes it interesting, and how it works with the video title. 3. Your design software and experience using or building templates. 4. Your availability, time zone, and earliest start date. 5. Confirmation that you're comfortable with $500/month, the gradual increase towards 10–12 thumbnails per working day, and exclusive thumbnail work for us. If you have performance results for your work, feel free to include them with context. They aren't required. A focused application with relevant examples is more useful than a long generic cover letter.

jobs.title: Game Tester
jobs.description: **About us TB86 Studios is a small indie studio making life and career simulation games for PC. Our first game is a hands-on sim where you build a career, juggle demanding clients and work your way up. We put out a new test build every week, and we're looking for a sharp-eyed tester to help us make every one of them better than the last. **About the role This is a part time, remote role of about 30 to 40 hours a month (roughly 7 to 10 hours a week). Each week you'll get a new build, test it from top to bottom, and report every problem you find. You'll be one of the first people to play the game and a big part of shaping it. **What you'll do • Play each weekly build and test everything: every route, every action, every button, every menu and every click. • Explore every nook and cranny. Look in every direction, up at the sky, down at the ground, behind buildings and into every corner, and check that everything looks and works the way it should. • Try to break the game. Do things in the wrong order, click fast, walk where you're not supposed to, quit in the middle of a task, save and load, and change the settings. • Test in both first person and third person, with keyboard and mouse (and a controller, if you have one). • Report each bug with the game's built-in F8 bug report: what happened, where it happened, and the steps to make it happen again. • Recheck fixed bugs on the next build to make sure they're really gone. • Give honest feedback on what's fun, what's confusing, what's boring and what's hard to find. • Send a short summary at the end of each week. **Who you are • You love simulation games. You've played a lot of them, like The Sims, House Flipper, PowerWash Simulator, Supermarket Simulator, Stardew Valley, Cities: Skylines or Planet Coaster, and you know what makes a sim feel great. • You're an experienced PC gamer. This isn't your first time gaming on a PC. You're comfortable with settings, controls, saves and updates. • You have extreme attention to detail. You're brutal about it. You notice the sign floating in the air, the hair clipping through a hat, the button that doesn't respond and the text that runs off the screen. You don't stop until there are no bugs left to find. • You're patient and thorough. You're happy to replay the same section many times to test every path through it. • You write clearly. Your reports are short, specific and easy to follow. • You're reliable. You put in your hours each week and send your reports on time. • You have a Windows gaming PC that can run modern 3D games, and steady internet to download builds. **Nice to have • Past QA, beta testing or playtesting experience • A controller • An ultrawide or uncommon screen size • Comfortable taking screenshots or short screen recordings **Details • Hours: 30 to 40 hours a month, on your own schedule within each week. A new build comes out every week. • Location: Remote • NDA: You'll sign a non-disclosure agreement before your first build. • Length: Ongoing, through development and into Early Access.

jobs.title: Appointment Setter/ Cold Caller
jobs.description: We sell VerraField, a field sales tool for roofing companies in the United States. Your job is to call roofing company owners from a list we give you and book them into a fifteen-minute video demo with me. You don't run the demo or sell anything. You get the owner on the phone, run our script, and put a time on their calendar. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Call US roofing company owners from our list on the power dialer inside our CRM, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM US Central. The dialer places the next call for you, so you spend less time dialing by hand. - Get past the front desk to the owner. Most calls end at a receptionist or a voicemail. That's normal, and it's the job. - Run our scripts the way they're written. You'll learn every one of them in training. - Book the right person: the owner of a roofing company that has people out selling. A crew that only installs roofs isn't our customer. - Lock the demo in before you hang up: two specific times offered, their cell number, the email the owner actually reads, and the calendar invite accepted. Owners who show are how your appointments close. - Call to confirm the morning of the demo, or the afternoon before if it's an early one. - Log every call in our CRM: who you reached, what happened, when to call back. Then call back when you said you would. - Honor every do-not-call request on the spot and log it. - Make 80 to 120 dials a shift and book at least 10 demos a week. A booking counts when it's the right person and they show up. WHAT WE GIVE YOU - The list. You never find your own leads. - The CRM, the power dialer and the scripts. - Three paid training days. By the end of day three, you're dialing. - We start every shift with a short team call. I listen to your calls, and every day you get something to work on. WHAT YOU NEED - At least one year cold calling US or UK businesses by phone. Appointment setting for a US company is the ideal background. Real estate, solar, insurance, roofing, agency work, all of it counts. - Clear English on the phone that a busy roofing owner follows without effort. If they have to work to understand you, they hang up. I hire from the voice recording, so send a good one. - You can take a "no" fifty times in a row and dial the next one the same way. - Your own computer, a quality wired headset, stable internet, a quiet room, and a backup for when the power or internet goes out. No background noise on calls. - Available Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM US Central Time, every week. PAY - $4 USD/hour base, paid for every hour worked, including training. - $2 bonus for every booking that shows up. - $5 more for every booking that becomes a paying customer. - Part time, 20 hours a week, as an independent contractor. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the word SETTER so we know you read this. Then include: 1. A 60 to 90 second video introduction (a link is fine) introducing yourself and telling us about the last cold calling job you had: who you called, what you were booking, and how many calls a day you made. 2. How long you've cold called US or UK businesses, and for what kind of company. 3. What time 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM US Central is where you live, and that you can work it Monday to Friday. 4. Your internet speed, the headset you use, and your backup for power or internet outages (Required). 5. That the pay works for you: $4 an hour, plus the per-show and per-close bonuses. No recording, no review. If you're shortlisted, you get two video interviews with me. In the second one, we roleplay calls together. After that you get a decision, and if it's a yes, training starts. VerraField is a product of NextVerra LLC, Alabama, USA.

jobs.title: Experienced Cold Calling Appointment Setter (Part Time, US Hours) for a Commercial Cleaning Company
jobs.description: Keeper Facility Care is a commercial cleaning company serving Fairfield County, Connecticut and Westchester County, New York ( ---------- ). We need one experienced part time appointment setter to reach the decision maker at the offices we serve and book short walkthroughs. This is a sales job. We are not looking for beginners. THE JOB You work from a list we give you. Your one goal is a booked 15 minute walkthrough with the decision maker: the office manager, practice manager, administrator, managing partner or owner. Your standard is 150 or more dials every working day, from day one. A dial is one call attempt to one number. The same number twice in one day counts once. Your work: You call the decision maker directly on their business line when we have it, and you call the office main line and get through to them. You follow up by email, and by text to numbers the prospect gave you. You answer inbound calls and return missed calls from offices we have already contacted. You log every call in our CRM and send a confirmation within 10 minutes of each booking. Your rules: You dial by hand, call business lines only, never quote prices, never promise anything free, never claim we do something we do not do, and stop when someone says do not call. Most calls end at the front desk or in voicemail. That is normal. We want someone who stays polite and keeps dialing. HOW WE SELL This is not a job where you read a script. We give you talking points and guardrails, and you have a natural conversation. We want someone who sounds confident and human on the phone, listens, and understands why a clean office matters to a business: its customers, its staff and its reputation. HOURS 20 hours per week, Monday to Thursday, 5 hours a day. Calls run 10 AM to 12 PM and 1 PM to 4 PM US Eastern time. In Philippine time that is currently 11 PM to 1 AM and 2 AM to 5 AM, and it shifts by one hour when US clocks change in March. These are US business hours, so they fall at night in the Philippines. Apply only if you can work these hours every week. Hours can grow for strong performers. PAY $5 to $7 per hour depending on experience, paid weekly in USD by Wise or Payoneer. $10 for every walkthrough that actually happens. $50, $75 or $100 for every office that signs, based on contract size ($1,400 to $2,000 a month, $2,001 to $3,000, $3,001 and up). Paid after we collect the first invoice. Bonuses are extra and not promised. TRIAL The first 80 hours are a paid trial. We track dials, decision maker conversations, walkthroughs booked and walkthroughs held on a weekly scorecard. Then we review your numbers together and d ---------- whether to continue. You sign a contractor agreement with confidentiality and non-compete terms before day one. WE PROVIDE A US phone number and dialer, our CRM, the call list, talking points and objection answers, written playbooks for calling, CRM use and the weekly scorecard, role-play training in week one, and a 15 minute performance review every week. YOU NEED You must have worked in outbound sales for a cleaning company: commercial cleaning, janitorial or facility services. At least 3 years of outbound cold calling appointment setting, and at least part of it for a cleaning company, booking appointments with US businesses. If you have not worked in outbound sales for a cleaning company, do not apply. You have made 100 or more cold calls a day before, and you know how to get past a front desk and reach the decision maker. You stay calm after a lot of no's. A natural, confident phone presence. You sound like a person, not a script. Daily experience using a CRM, and clean call notes. Clear, neutral spoken English that a US office manager understands on the first call, with no heavy accent and no strong regional pronunciation. A computer, a USB headset, a quiet room, and 10 Mbps upload speed. HOW TO APPLY Put this title on the first line of your message: KEEPER, $5 to $7 per hour, [your name]. We do not read messages without it. Then send: 1. A link to a 30 to 45 second voice recording. Do not read a script. Introduce yourself in one sentence. Then imagine you reached the office manager at a dental office and said: "Hi, this is [your name] with Keeper Facility Care. We provide janitorial service to offices near you. Are you the person who d ---------- on cleaning?" The manager says: "We already have a cleaner." Answer in your own words and ask for a 15 minute walkthrough. We listen for clear, neutral English and a natural tone. Make sure the link opens without a login. 2. Your cleaning company experience: the company name, your role, how long you worked there, who you called, calls per day, and your best measurable result, such as appointments booked per week. Then your total years of cold calling appointment setting. 3. The CRMs you have used. 4. Your expected hourly rate in USD. 5. Your upload speed, your headset model, and a yes or no: can you work the hours above every week? Applications that do not follow

jobs.description: About the Role We are a jewelry and accessories brand operating across DTC and Amazon channels, looking for a Planning & Forecast Analyst to own our OTB Planner and turn SKU-level forecasts into confident monthly replenishment buys. Monthly Replenishment Cycle Run the OTB Planner each month and prepare the recommended replenishment buy for DTC and Amazon Review SKU-level forecasts line by line before they become POs; flag and resolve outliers Reconcile the SKU-level buy back to the OTB dollar plan by channel, category, and month 2. Data Analysis Separate DTC and Amazon demand drivers — promotions, traffic, FBA constraints, seasonality, gifting peaks Identify at-risk SKUs early: projected stockouts, overstock, and slow movers Build simple, repeatable views that show the buy, the risks, and what changed since last month 3. Model Logic & Development Model launch and fade curves: how fast new SKUs ramp, when they peak, and when to stop rebuying Design and build logic updates (seasonality weights, safety stock, lead times, new-item and end-of-life rules, channel splits) backed by evidence Back-test every change against recent history, get sign-off, roll it out, and roll it back if it underperforms Version and document every logic change so the team always knows what the model is doing and why 4. Communication & Reporting Present the monthly buy recommendation with a short read on risks and changes Answer “why is the model saying this?” for merchandising, eCommerce, and Amazon partners Lead weekly model reviews covering what sold vs. forecast, which SKUs are being missed, and what logic changes to test next Required Skills & Experience ⚠️ AI Fluency: Works in Claude day-to-day to run, question, and update the planner — this is core to the role, not a nice-to-have ⚠️ Quantitative Skills: Strong math and modeling background — forecasting, statistics, and building and stress-testing model logic Data: Comfortable working with large SKU-level datasets in Excel or Google Sheets Attention to Detail: Catches the outlier SKU before it becomes a bad PO Communication: Explains numbers clearly to merchants, eCommerce, and Amazon partners Adaptability: Comfortable as the model, priorities, and data evolve month to month Business Curiosity: Checks whether a number makes sense for the business, not just whether the math is right Background: Analytics, finance/FP&A, data science, economics, or a similar quantitative field — retail planning experience helpful but not required Nice to Have Retail planning experience (OTB, replenishment, weeks of supply) Amazon Seller/Vendor Central experience (FBA inventory, in-stock, replenishment) DTC / Shopify eCommerce experience Experience forecasting short-lifecycle or high-SKU-count products Jewelry, accessories, or fashion retail background To Apply: Kindly send your resume and introduction video

The successful candidate understands property management accounting, catches discrepancies before they become problems, follows written procedures carefully, and asks clear questions when information is incomplete. Key Responsibilities 1. Maintain accurate tenant, owner, property, vendor, and general ledger records in Buildium. 2. Record and review rent, deposits, management fees, owner contributions, vendor charges, reimbursements, and other property transactions. 3. Process accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoice review, coding, approval tracking, posting, and payment preparation. 4. Complete bank, credit card, trust, operating, and clearing-account reconciliations and promptly investigate discrepancies. 5. Review tenant ledgers, rent rolls, outstanding balances, unapplied funds, security deposits, and recurring charges for accuracy. 6. Prepare and review owner statements, monthly financial reports, supporting schedules, and month-end workpapers. 7. Maintain accurate records in QuickBooks Online and ensure entries agree with approved source documents and supporting systems. 8. Use Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel to reconcile data, track exceptions, analyze variances, and prepare clear management reports. 9. Organize invoices, receipts, statements, approvals, and audit support in accordance with the company filing system. 11. Identify missing documents, unusual balances, duplicate entries, and process gaps; escalate issues with a clear explanation and proposed next step. 12. Follow established procedures, complete assigned work by deadline, and communicate progress or blockers promptly. Required Experience and Qualifications - Property management accounting: Minimum three years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience in residential property management or real estate. - Pacific Standard Time schedule: At least two years in a prior position consistently working Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific Standard Time is required. - Buildium: Minimum two years of regular, hands-on experience. You must be able to navigate accounting workflows confidently and use the platform with limited training. - QuickBooks: Strong working experience with QuickBooks Online, including transaction entry, coding, reconciliations, and financial reporting. - Spreadsheets: Strong Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, filters, sorting, lookups, pivot tables, and reconciliation schedules. - Accounting knowledge: Practical understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger coding, bank reconciliations, tenant ledgers, deposits, owner statements, and month-end close. - Accuracy and judgment: Excellent numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to recognize when information does not reconcile. - Communication: Strong written and spoken English, active listening skills, and the ability to follow instructions and document work clearly. - Work style: Reliable, organized, coachable, willing to learn, and able to manage priorities independently while remaining accountable to the team. - Remote setup: A quiet professional workspace, reliable high-speed internet, a dependable computer, and a practical backup plan for power or internet interruptions. - Confidentiality: Demonstrated discretion when handling banking information, owner statements, tenant records, and other confidential financial information. What We Offer - A stable, full-time, long-term remote position with a consistent schedule. - The opportunity to work with an established Canadian property management company. - Structured training, documented processes, and support from the accounting and operations teams. - Room to take on greater responsibility as your accuracy, reliability, and knowledge of the portfolio grow. - A collaborative, improvement-focused environment that values integrity, accountability, dependability, and initiative. jobs.title: SMALL ENGINE MECHANIC – REMOTE TECHNICAL SUPPORT
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly experienced small engine mechanic based in the Philippines to provide remote technical support to North American customers. This position requires substantial professional repair experience, advanced diagnostic ability, excellent spoken and written English, and strong computer skills. The successful candidate must be able to explain technical issues clearly, exercise sound judgment, and manage multiple customer cases accurately and professionally. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Diagnose complex engine problems remotely through phone calls, chat, photographs, and video. • Guide customers through diagnostic checks, testing, and repairs using clear, straightforward English. • Identify the correct replacement parts using equipment model, type, code, and serial numbers. • Read and interpret service manuals, wiring diagrams, and illustrated parts diagrams. • Diagnose faults involving fuel delivery, ignition, compression, electrical systems, governors, valvetrains, charging systems, and internal engine components. • Maintain accurate records of customer conversations, diagnostic findings, troubleshooting steps, and recommendations. • Communicate patiently and professionally with customers who have varying levels of mechanical knowledge. • Manage multiple customer cases, prioritize outstanding issues, and follow through without compromising accuracy or service quality. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • Five or more years of professional, hands-on experience diagnosing and repairing small engines. • Advanced knowledge of 2-stroke and 4-stroke engines, including their operation, maintenance, and repair. • Excellent spoken English, with clear pronunciation and a professional telephone manner. • Excellent written English, including strong grammar, spelling, and reading comprehension. • Ability to explain technical information and repair instructions clearly and naturally to North American customers. • Strong computer proficiency, including efficient typing, email and chat communication, online research, and navigation between multiple applications. • A reliable computer, quality headset, high-speed internet, a backup internet connection, and a quiet workspace suitable for customer calls. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE • Ten or more years of professional small engine repair experience. • Previous experience as a lead technician, shop foreman, service manager, technical adviser, or instructor. • Experience diagnosing and repairing engines or equipment from Briggs & Stratton, Honda, Kohler, Kawasaki, Stihl, Husqvarna, Yamaha, Generac, Tecumseh, or comparable manufacturers. • Familiarity with equipment commonly used in North America and the terminology customers use to describe it. • Experience using electronic parts catalogs, service databases, ticketing systems, or customer management software. HOW TO APPLY Please submit the following: • Your résumé outlining your professional mechanical experience. • A two-minute, unedited introduction in English, submitted as a video or voice recording. • A brief written summary of your mechanical experience, including the engines, equipment, and types of repairs you have worked on. • A written response to this diagnostic scenario: An engine cranks but will not start. Explain the steps you would take to identify the cause and why. • Details of your internet speed, backup internet connection, and available working hours, including your time zone. SELECTION PROCESS Shortlisted candidates will complete: • A live interview conducted in English. • A written English and customer service assessment. • A practical small engine diagnostic interview. • A computer proficiency and online research assessment. Only applicants who meet all required qualifications will be considered.

Guaranteed minimum: PHP 25,000 for the month while you are building your team. You are paid on what your team brings in, and if that comes to less than PHP 25,000 in a month, we top you up to PHP 25,000. If it comes to more, you simply keep it. The guarantee covers your first 3 months, and applies in any month where you have at least 5 reps working and your team brings in at least 100 approved sign-ups. What you'll bring — 5–8 years of hands-on accounting experience, including owning the month-end close and preparing financial statements. — Advanced QuickBooks experience, including reviewing general ledger activity, managing the chart of accounts, and working across multiple company files. — Strong command of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, and intercompany transactions and eliminations. You can explain why an entry is needed, how it affects each entity, and how you'd confirm it was recorded correctly. — Experience reviewing others' work, catching errors, and giving clear feedback. — Advanced Excel skills, including building reconciliation and accrual schedules. — Clear written and spoken English, sound judgment, and the confidence to raise issues early and explain them to non-accountants. — Availability to work [hours] [time zone], with a dependable home-office setup and reliable internet. Nice to have — Direct experience leading a cash-to-accrual conversion. — Experience supporting U.S. businesses with multiple related entities. — Healthcare, medical practice, or practice management system experience. — A CPA credential or a degree in accounting. How to apply Send your résumé and a short introduction. Tell us which QuickBooks version you've used, which parts of the month-end close you've owned, and how many entities you've managed at once. Give one brief example of an intercompany or accrual entry you prepared or reviewed, and one example of an accounting process you improved. jobs.title: Content Strategist/Social Media Manager
jobs.description: We are hiring a Content Strategist / Social Media Manager to plan, produce, and execute content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok for an established personal brand in the video marketing and monetization space. This is a hybrid role. You will own the content planning process — building monthly plans, writing hooks, scripting videos, and tracking trends — AND you will execute that plan day to day: scheduling, publishing, managing the content calendar, and monitoring performance. Content direction and final approval come from Keenya, but you are the person who turns her vision into a running system that never misses a beat. You will have room to bring your own instincts to formatting, execution, and idea generation. But this is not a role where you are setting the brand's overall strategic direction from scratch. The win here is doing excellent work inside a clear system: planning with precision, executing with speed, and speaking up when something is working or when it is not. About the Brand Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Facebook. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income. We are a systems-driven team that moves fast, especially during launch periods, and we need someone who can keep pace without needing constant hand-holding. What This Role Actually Is You are the engine that keeps content moving every day — from the planning stage all the way through to publishing. You will build the content plans, write the hooks and captions, track what is trending, and then bring all of that to life across platforms on schedule. You bring enough of your own judgment to catch what is working, flag what is not, and suggest adjustments in real time. We are not looking for someone who only follows instructions with no instincts of their own. We want someone with a genuine feel for short vertical video who can plan strategically, execute at a high level, and speak up when something is not landing. What We Are Looking For 1. You can plan content that actually drives results You build monthly content plans that include filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Every piece aligns with our content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals so each video moves people toward a clear next step. 2. You have a real feel for short vertical video You understand pacing, hooks, text overlay timing, and what makes a piece of content stop the scroll. You track current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turn them into content ideas that fit our brand — not just follow trends blindly. 3. You can execute at volume, reliably You manage content calendars, schedule and publish across multiple platforms, and keep everything organized without things falling through the cracks — especially during launch periods when volume increases. You keep a clean, organized tracker so the team always knows what is approved, filmed, and scheduled. 4. You write hooks that stop the scroll and captions that sound human You write on-screen text hooks that make people stop scrolling. Your captions feel like a real conversation, not a sales pitch. You have a natural sense of voice and can write in a style that sounds like the person posting — not like generic marketing copy. 5. You are proactive, not just responsive You flag what is underperforming, suggest small tweaks, and bring ideas to the table — without needing to own the entire strategic direction. You know the difference between "I have a suggestion" and "I am going to change the plan." 6. You are highly organized and communicative You meet deadlines without being chased, you do not go quiet when things get busy, and you are comfortable working inside an established system with clear processes. You submit plans on a set schedule and revise them quickly based on feedback. 7. You are comfortable working under direction from the brand owner This role reports into content direction set by Keenya. You should want that structure, not resent it. You take direction well and give thoughtful input without needing to own every decision. What This Role Involves Planning Building monthly content plans with filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations Tracking current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turning them into on-brand content ideas Aligning every piece with content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals Submitting plans on a set schedule and revising quickly based on feedback Execution Publishing and scheduling content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok Managing and maintaining the content calendar Executing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs as directed, with room for your own polish on formatting

Answer student questions, clarify course concepts, and provide supplemental instruction to reinforce understanding and support certification preparation. - Use screen sharing to demonstrate technical processes, troubleshoot issues, and explain concepts through practical examples. - Deliver short lessons, technical demonstrations, or instructional walkthroughs based on student needs. - Research unfamiliar technical questions when necessary and provide accurate, timely instructional guidance. - Communicate with Student Services regarding instructional concerns or additional student support needs. - Follow the provided Live Mentoring calendar, excluding designated federal holidays and specified days preceding holidays. - Provide occasional additional student support outside scheduled mentoring hours when coordinated in advance, with additional time compensated separately. ## Required Qualifications - Professional experience in IT support, networking, cybersecurity, systems administration, or related fields. - Broad technical knowledge across IT support, networking, cybersecurity, and cloud computing, with the ability to research and effectively address student questions across MedCertify's IT certification programs. - Relevant IT certifications or equivalent demonstrated expertise, such as: - CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Cloud+ - Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) - Microsoft MCSE, MCSA, MCDST, or MCITP - Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to students with varying levels of experience. - Strong troubleshooting skills and experience demonstrating technical processes. - Excellent spoken and written English communication skills. - Proficiency with virtual meeting platforms, screen sharing, and remote instruction. - Reliable availability during scheduled mentoring sessions, including US daylight saving time adjustments. ## Remote Work Requirements - Reliable high-speed internet capable of supporting uninterrupted video conferencing and screen sharing. - Computer with sufficient processing power and memory to demonstrate IT concepts and troubleshooting procedures. - jobs.title: Performance Video Editor — AI-Driven Ads for a K-Beauty DTC Brand
jobs.description: We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly: A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy, Spain and the UK, and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business. We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels — and who can do it with a modern, AI-first workflow: generating avatars, voices, scenes, characters and b-roll with AI, then cutting them into ads that feel real and convert. That's how we move fast, test more, and scale creative volume without sacrificing quality. This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UGC-style ads, AI-generated creative across every new format, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative for e-commerce. --- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING --- You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including: — Facebook and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases — UGC-style ad creatives, both real and AI-generated: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly — AI talking-head and avatar ads: built with HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs and similar — Animated and cartoon-style ads: 3D animated / Pixar-style characters, illustrated and stylized stories built entirely with AI — Cinematic "mini-film" and drama ads: short scenes with AI actors, spoken dialogue and the product in the story — AI music and song-based ads: lyrics, jingles and soundtracks generated with AI and cut to the beat — Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action — Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof — VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure — Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures — Localized creatives for new European markets: AI dubbing, lip-sync and translated captions --- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR --- We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how e-commerce ads work AND how to use AI to create them at scale. You should know how to edit videos that: — Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds — Make the problem feel real and urgent — Show the product clearly and persuasively — Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention — Feel native to Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok — Communicate benefits quickly and clearly — Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof — Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase on our Shopify store You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, AND AI-generated assets, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. --- AI WORKFLOW (NON-NEGOTIABLE) --- This is the core of the role, not a bonus. You should be confident in: — Generating UGC-style AI avatars and talking-head content (HeyGen, Higgsfield, or similar) — Generating AI voiceovers and dubbing in multiple languages and tones, with lip-sync (ElevenLabs, HeyGen or similar) — Generating AI video scenes from text and images: Kling, Veo, Seedance, Runway, Sora, Grok Imagine or similar — Generating consistent AI images, characters and product shots to use as first frames and references (Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux or similar) — Creating animated / cartoon / 3D-style characters that stay consistent from scene to scene — Generating AI b-roll, supplementary visuals, and scene fillers when stock or original footage isn't enough — Generating AI music and sound effects when the ad needs them (Suno, ElevenLabs or similar) — Knowing which tool to use for which job — and combining them efficiently inside a single edit — Optimizing tool credits and subscription costs: every generation has a real cost, and we need someone who gets the best output with the fewest wasted credits — Iterating quickly when an AI generation doesn't land, without burning through resources — Blending AI-generated content with real footage so the final ad feels native and believable, not artificial New AI formats come out every month. We need someone who tries them first, not someone who waits for a tutorial. If you've never touched these tools or you're not comfortable working in an AI-driven pipeline, this role isn't the right fit. --- THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE --- You'll be a strong fit if you: —

jobs.title: Email Support Expert — Shopify DTC brand
jobs.description: We're looking for a customer service specialist who understands one thing clearly: A good reply doesn't just sound polite. It answers the real question, solves the problem before it grows, and turns a frustrated customer into one who orders again. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy, Spain, UK and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means most customers meet us through an ad, arrive with questions, and write to us in their own language. Support is not a cost center for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of trust, retention, and repeat revenue. We're looking for someone who can own that inbox across several languages — and who can do it using a modern, AI-driven workflow that lets us answer fast, absorb volume, and open new markets without the quality dropping. This role is ideal for someone who understands e-commerce support, multilingual communication, courier problems, refunds and disputes, AI-assisted workflows, and the difference between closing a ticket and keeping a customer. --- WHAT YOU'LL BE HANDLING --- You'll be working the inbox of a DTC brand running paid traffic, which means: — "Where is my order": stalled tracking, parcels stuck at a hub, deliveries marked complete but never received — Pre-purchase questions: people who saw the ad and want to know if it works and if we're real — Product and skin questions: ingredients, how to use it, what to expect and when, sensitive skin, pregnancy — Reactions and complaints: rare, serious, handled carefully and escalated properly — Refunds, returns and withdrawal: EU consumer rules, our guarantee, and knowing when to say yes — Disputes and chargebacks: PayPal and card cases, caught early enough to resolve instead of lose — Comments and DMs under our ads: public, and often a cold audience's first impression of us — Win-back conversations: the ones that turn a solved problem into another order --- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR --- We're not looking for someone who writes beautiful, polite emails and nothing else. Anyone can do that now. AI made good prose free, which means good prose is no longer the job. We're looking for someone who works the ticket before writing it. You should: — Read the real carrier events, not the tracking link the customer already saw — Check whether this person wrote before, and what was promised last time — Notice the payment method — PayPal and card have different dispute clocks — Tell a policy abuser apart from someone genuinely upset and about to leave one star — Chase the courier yourself instead of telling the customer to keep waiting — D ---------- within your limits instead of escalating everything and slowing the queue — Close the conversation, so the same person doesn't write three more times You should be able to take a Shopify order, a tracking page that hasn't moved in five days and an angry customer, and turn it into a resolved ticket and a customer who stays. --- LANGUAGES (NON-NEGOTIABLE) --- Our customers write from all over Europe, and every email is answered in the language it arrived in — never in English, and never in something that reads like it came out of a translator. A customer can tell within one sentence. — English at a top level, written and spoken. It's our working language and the one you translate through — You don't need to be native in every market. You do need replies a native reader wouldn't flag as translated — Which means catching what translation tools get wrong: formality in German, politeness register in French, warmth in Italian and Spanish — Any European language you genuinely have is a strong plus, not a requirement — Written level is what counts. You'll be judged on the emails you write, not on a certificate If your English isn't strong enough to move quickly and accurately in both directions, this role isn't the right fit. --- HOW WE USE AI (AND HOW WE DON'T) --- We assume you use AI. Everyone does, and we'd be concerned if you didn't. What matters is how. You should be confident in: — Drafting and translating with it, and holding one consistent tone across every language — Building your own prompts, macros and saved replies, so the same answer isn't rewritten fifty times — Checking every fact first: AI invents shipping dates and policies, and the customer holds us to them — Knowing which tickets it never touches alone: reactions, legal threats, disputes, anyone on their third email — Spotting the answer that is technically correct and still wrong, because it missed the problem underneath — Keeping the result human: a reply that reads as generated costs more trust than a slower one would have If your workflow is pasting the customer's email into ChatGPT and sending back whatever comes out, this role isn't the right fit. --- THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE --- You'll be a strong fit if you: — Have handled real volum

You should: — Read the real carrier events, not the tracking link the customer already saw — Check whether this person wrote before, and what was promised last time — Notice the payment method — PayPal and card have different dispute clocks — Tell a policy abuser apart from someone genuinely upset and about to leave one star — Chase the courier yourself instead of telling the customer to keep waiting — D ---------- within your limits instead of escalating everything and slowing the queue — Close the conversation, so the same person doesn't write three more times You should be able to take a Shopify order, a tracking page that hasn't moved in five days and an angry customer, and turn it into a resolved ticket and a customer who stays. --- LANGUAGES (NON-NEGOTIABLE) --- Our customers write from all over Europe, and every email is answered in the language it arrived in — never in English, and never in something that reads like it came out of a translator. A customer can tell within one sentence. — English at a top level, written and spoken. It's our working language and the one you translate through — You don't need to be native in every market. You do need replies a native reader wouldn't flag as translated — Which means catching what translation tools get wrong: formality in German, politeness register in French, warmth in Italian and Spanish — Any European language you genuinely have is a strong plus, not a requirement — Written level is what counts. You'll be judged on the emails you write, not on a certificate If your English isn't strong enough to move quickly and accurately in both directions, this role isn't the right fit. --- HOW WE USE AI (AND HOW WE DON'T) --- We assume you use AI. Everyone does, and we'd be concerned if you didn't. What matters is how. You should be confident in: — Drafting and translating with it, and holding one consistent tone across every language — Building your own prompts, macros and saved replies, so the same answer isn't rewritten fifty times — Checking every fact first: AI invents shipping dates and policies, and the customer holds us to them — Knowing which tickets it never touches alone: reactions, legal threats, disputes, anyone on their third email — Spotting the answer that is technically correct and still wrong, because it missed the problem underneath — Keeping the result human: a reply that reads as generated costs more trust than a slower one would have If your workflow is pasting the customer's email into ChatGPT and sending back whatever comes out, this role isn't the right fit. --- THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE --- You'll be a strong fit if you: — Have handled real volum

jobs.title: Construction Administrative Assistant – Contracts & Document Coordination
jobs.description: We are a New York-based construction and property services company seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Administrative Coordinator to assist with subcontractor agreements, insurance documentation, and general construction project administration. This position involves preparing documents, coordinating electronic signatures, tracking outstanding paperwork, and proactively following up with subcontractors to ensure all required documentation is received and properly organized. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, communicates clearly, and can independently manage multiple ongoing tasks without requiring constant reminders. Key Responsibilities: - Prepare subcontractor agreements using established Word templates, ensuring accurate project details, subcontractor information, pricing, and other required information. - Convert, compile, and organize Word and PDF documents for distribution and signature. - Send agreements for electronic signature using our e-signature platform, and monitor their completion. - Request, collect, and track subcontractor insurance certificates and related documentation. - Review incoming documents for completeness and accuracy against established requirements. - Maintain accurate Excel spreadsheets and tracking databases showing the status of contracts, insurance documents, and outstanding items. - Proactively follow up with subcontractors and other parties by email and phone to obtain missing paperwork. - Keep internal project managers informed of outstanding documentation, overdue items, and potential issues. - Organize and maintain electronic project files and records. Qualifications: - Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail. - Strong written and spoken English communication skills. - Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PDF editing software. - Experience preparing, formatting, and managing business documents. - Comfortable learning and using electronic signature and document management platforms. - Ability to manage multiple projects, track deadlines, and follow up consistently. - Self-motivated, dependable, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment. Preferred, but not required: - Previous experience supporting a U.S.-based construction company, general contractor, or subcontractor. - Familiarity with subcontractor agreements, certificates of insurance (COIs), and construction documentation. - Experience in contract administration, document control, or project coordination. What We're Looking For The ideal candidate is someone who is meticulous, persistent, and proactive. We need someone who does more than simply update a spreadsheet or send paperwork when asked. You should actively manage the process, identify what is missing, follow up until items are completed, and keep the team informed. Experience in construction is helpful, but strong administrative skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through are more important. How to Apply Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction describing your relevant administrative experience. In your application, please also explain any experience you have managing contracts, collecting documentation, coordinating electronic signatures, or maintaining tracking spreadsheets.

We're looking for an exceptionally talented Senior Graphic Designer who specializes in premium book cover design, professional brand identity development, and high-end visual communication. We're a growing U.S.-based specialty coatings company, and we're looking for a few experienced LinkedIn outreach professionals to join our team! You'll also help manage LinkedIn outreach campaigns, organize leads, respond to interested prospects, and provide simple updates on your progress. We'll provide messaging templates, marketing materials, guidance, and ongoing support to help you succeed. YOUR LINKEDIN PROFILE Since LinkedIn is such an important part of this position, we're looking for someone who already has an established, active LinkedIn account with genuine professional connections. Ideally, we'd love to find someone with 500 or more connections. However, if you're close to that number and have good experience, we'd still be happy to consider you. jobs.description: QuickBooks Online Specialist – Multi-Entity Setup & Training Fixed-term project, 3–6 months Company: Portum Ltd. – vacation rental management, Bahamas & USA Location: Remote Contract: Freelance / independent contractor, 3–6 months Hours: 10–20 hours per week (heavier during initial setup) Rate: Hourly, based on experience About us Portum Ltd. is a vacation rental management company based in Nassau, Bahamas, operating around 30 properties in the Bahamas and Florida. Our operation runs on OwnerRez (property management and bookings), Breezeway (maintenance and housekeeping) and Stripe (payments). We also operate a related US marketing company. We are reorganising our bookkeeping and want a clean, properly structured QuickBooks Online setup built for the long term. You will report directly to the owner and work closely with a team member who will take over the bookkeeping after this project. The project This is a defined project with two equal goals: build the system, and hand it over to someone who can run it. 1. Build the accounting system • Set up QuickBooks Online for each entity (Bahamas operating company and US marketing company) with a chart of accounts suited to vacation rental management: owner funds, guest deposits, management commissions, cleaning fees and owner payouts. • Connect OwnerRez to QuickBooks so bookings, payments, refunds and owner statements flow in correctly. • Integrate Breezeway maintenance and housekeeping costs so they are captured and allocated to the right property and owner. • Connect Stripe so payouts, processing fees and refunds reconcile automatically. • Connect bank and credit card feeds; set up bank rules and a monthly reconciliation routine. • Configure Bahamas VAT tracking and prepare the quarterly VAT returns. • Set up a clean year-end structure for the US entity, ready for our US tax accountant. • Plan and carry out the migration from our existing QuickBooks account to the new setup: d ---------- what history to bring over, transfer opening balances, open items, vendors, customers and owner balances, and verify that the new books tie out to the old ones at the cut-over date. • Keep the old QuickBooks account accessible in read-only form for reference and audit, and close it out cleanly. • Clean up and bring historical records current where needed. 2. Train our team member • Run 2–3 live training sessions per week (approx. 1 hour each) via video call. • Our team member is based in Germany and is new to bookkeeping and QuickBooks – training starts from the fundamentals. • Training happens on our live books: daily entries, reconciliations, owner statements, month-end close and VAT preparation. • Sessions are scheduled in the Philippine afternoon / evening, which is morning in Germany. 3. Document and hand over • Write clear step-by-step procedures (SOPs) for the monthly cycle, quarterly VAT and the key integrations. • By the end of the project, our team member runs the monthly process independently, with you reviewing. What we are looking for • Several years of hands-on QuickBooks Online experience, including full setups from scratch – not just data entry. • Proven experience connecting QuickBooks to third-party systems such as payment processors, property management or booking software (OwnerRez, Guesty, Hostaway or similar). • Experience migrating from an existing QuickBooks file to a new QuickBooks Online company, including opening balances and cut-over reconciliation. • Experience managing books for multiple entities. • Solid understanding of reconciliations, month-end close and trust/owner-fund accounting. • Patience and ability to teach accounting clearly to someone without a finance background. • Fluent written and spoken English; reliable internet and availability for scheduled sessions. • Reliable, detail-oriented and discreet with financial information. Nice to have • Vacation rental or property management bookkeeping experience. • Experience with VAT/GST or sales tax filings. • Experience with Stripe reconciliation or integration tools such as Synder. What success looks like • The old QuickBooks account is fully migrated, with balances tying out at cut-over. • All entities run in a clean, reconciled QuickBooks Online setup. • OwnerRez, Breezeway, Stripe and bank feeds flow into QuickBooks with minimal manual work. • Quarterly Bahamas VAT returns are prepared accurately and on time. • Our team member runs the monthly process independently. • Written procedures are in place for the long-term operation. How to apply Send your CV to ---------- with a short note covering: • A QuickBooks Online setup you built from scratch, and which systems you integrated with it. • A QuickBooks migration you handled, and how you verified the balances. • Any experience with OwnerRez, Breezeway or Stripe. • Your hourly rate and weekly availability. Applications without this note will not be considered.

THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF You wait for instructions, avoid confrontation, accept excuses, or let your own work become a reason to skip a check-in. REQUIREMENTS Reliable internet with a backup Webcam and a quiet workspace Availability during US Central hours Signed confidentiality agreement PAY USD $650–950/month, based on experience. First pay review at month 4, then every 6 months, with increases of 20–30% based on your performance and the business’s growth. The faster we hit our milestones together, the faster your pay grows. Bonus pay for every 3 clients the business signs. Clear growth path into a Chief of Staff role. A 1–2 minute video/audio recording (unscripted, no reading): introduce yourself, then answer this: “The founder has been looking at the same screen for 5 minutes and says he’s ‘thinking.’ What do you say and do?” Your earliest start date. Interview request will be going out later today. Your expected monthly rate. Contact information including whatsapp. Applications missing “READY GO”, any of the answers, or the recording will not be reviewed. jobs.description: # H-1B & PERM Immigration Paralegal (Remote | Contract) ### About the Role **USImmigration.ai** is looking for an experienced **H-1B & PERM Immigration Paralegal** based in the Philippines to support the development, testing, and improvement of our immigration case management platform. We are seeking a highly skilled immigration paralegal with extensive hands-on experience managing H-1B and PERM cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate understands U.S. employment-based immigration processes, documentation requirements, compliance workflows, and case management systems. Provide recommendations for case management workflows, required fields, document checklists, deadline tracking, and case status updates. - Compare platform features with established immigration case management systems and recommend improvements. - Work closely with developers to explain how H-1B and PERM processes should function from a paralegal's perspective. - Document testing findings and provide clear, actionable feedback. - Re-test updated features to ensure issues have been properly resolved. **Team Collaboration** - Participate in regular meetings with the founders, developers, and other team members. - Collaborate with existing testers to maintain consistency across immigration case workflows. - Assist in developing and improving standardized immigration case procedures and documentation requirements. - Strong knowledge of H-1B petitions, LCA preparation and certification, public access files, amendments, extensions, transfers, and RFE responses. - Extensive experience with PERM labor certification, prevailing wage determinations, recruitment procedures, ETA-9089 preparation, and audit documentation. - jobs.title: Hiring a Digital Marketing & Content VA | Island Woodcrafts + OneJoin
jobs.description: Remote | Philippines-based | Some overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours We’re looking for a hands-on marketing VA who can help plan campaigns, create content, and see the work through from idea to publication. You’ll work directly with our team to grow two brands with different customers and goals. - Island Woodcrafts designs and builds custom cabinetry in North Carolina’s Outer Banks. Your focus will be generating qualified showroom and project inquiries from homeowners, builders, and designers. - OneJoin is building a national e-commerce brand for cabinet hardware, cabinetry, and custom components. Your focus will be helping shoppers and trade customers discover our products and turning that interest into site visits, signups, and sales. What you’ll do - Build and manage a content calendar for both brands. Bring campaign ideas to the team and turn approved ideas into published work. - Create social posts, Reels, short videos, email campaigns, and simple graphics. Turn shop footage, installation photos, and product images into content people want to watch, save, and share. - Coordinate with our team to get the footage and product details you need. Give us specific shot lists so we can capture the right material while we’re in the shop, showroom, or on a jobsite. - Write captions, email copy, and website content that fits each brand. Schedule posts and respond to routine comments and messages. - Research competitors and customer questions to find topics, keywords, and campaign opportunities. Help identify builders, designers, and creators we could partner with. - Support OneJoin product launches and Island Woodcrafts project features, showroom promotions, and local campaigns. - Track results and share a short weekly update covering what went live, what drove inquiries or sales, and what you recommend testing next. What we’re looking for - Experience planning and executing digital marketing or creating content for a business. A portfolio with examples of work you personally handled is required. - Strong written English and the ability to write naturally for U.S. homeowners, builders, designers, and online shoppers. - Comfortable with Canva and short-form video editing using CapCut or a similar tool. - Able to work independently, meet publishing deadlines, and use performance data to improve the next campaign. - Experience with Shopify, email marketing, SEO, or Meta Ads is a plus. Experience in e-commerce, home improvement, or interior design is also helpful. How to apply Send your résumé and include the following. 1. Two or three examples of your work.
