In a few sentences, explain who it’s for, what you’d create, and what you’d want the audience to do next. 3. Your weekly availability, hours you can overlap with U.S. Eastern Time, and expected hourly rate.

jobs.title: Virtual Receptionist & Office Assistant | Island Woodcrafts + OneJoin
jobs.description: Must be available during agreed U.S. Eastern business hours Island Woodcrafts and OneJoin are looking for a dependable virtual receptionist and office assistant to help customers, answer incoming calls, and keep day-to-day office tasks organized across both businesses. Island Woodcrafts designs and builds custom cabinetry in the Outer Banks of North Carolina. OneJoin is an e-commerce business focused on cabinet hardware, cabinetry, and custom components. You’ll be a first point of contact for homeowners, builders, designers, and online shoppers. What you’ll do - Answer calls for both businesses, greet callers using the correct company name, and direct them to the right person. - Take accurate messages, capture contact and project details, and make sure each inquiry gets to the right team member. - Monitor shared inboxes, handle routine customer questions, and follow up when someone is waiting for an answer. - Schedule showroom appointments, consultations, and callbacks. - Keep customer records, schedules, and office trackers up to date. - As you learn our products and processes, help prepare routine vendor orders for approval, confirm lead times, and track shipments and backorders. What we’re looking for - Clear, easy-to-understand spoken English and strong written English. You should be comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone, asking follow-up questions, and accurately confirming names, addresses, and order details. - Experience in reception, customer service, or administrative support, including handling live phone calls. - A warm, professional phone manner and the ability to stay calm when a customer is frustrated. - Strong attention to detail and reliable follow-through. If an answer needs to be confirmed, you know how to get it and close the loop with the customer. - A quiet workspace, reliable internet, and a headset with clear audio. - Availability during agreed U.S. Eastern business hours. Depending on the schedule, this may include evening or overnight hours in the Philippines. Experience with Shopify, vendor ordering, or a cabinetry, construction, or home improvement business is a plus. We’ll train you on our products and how each business handles calls, appointments, and orders. How to apply Please send your résumé and include: 1. A short summary of your experience handling customer calls and providing office support. 2. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time and your expected hourly rate. 3. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and showing how you would handle this call: “Hi, I’m following up on my cabinet order. I expected an update yesterday. Can you tell me when it will be ready?”

jobs.description: • Pay: USD 900 a month, fixed. You explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit. THE JOB Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit. You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voicemail, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team. ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines. WHAT YOU NEED • 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare • Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions • Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time • A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages • Availability for this shift for the long term A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or Spanish are a plus. jobs.title: Short-Form Video Asset Manager / B-Roll Creator (iPhone Required)
jobs.salary: $2 USD per completed video asset package
jobs.description: I'm looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Short-Form Video Asset Manager / B-Roll Creator to help with my daily content production workflow. This is not a full video editing role. Your main responsibilities will be reviewing reference videos, finding and organizing the visual assets and background music needed for each video, and filming original B-roll footage using your iPhone. We create short-form videos promoting different apps, websites, AI tools, and software products. You will receive reference videos that demonstrate the types of assets, music, and B-roll footage needed. Your job is to gather those materials and recreate the necessary B-roll so our editors have everything they need to assemble the final videos. An iPhone is required for this position. You will use your iPhone's camera to physically film your computer screen while demonstrating websites, apps, and software tools. For example, if a reference video shows ChatGPT generating a response, you may need to open ChatGPT on your computer, recreate a similar demonstration, and film your computer monitor using your iPhone. IMPORTANT: You will NEVER be required to show your face or film yourself. All B-roll will focus on your computer screen, software interfaces, and the actions taking place on the screen. Occasionally, a shot may include your hand pointing at the monitor or interacting with the computer, but your face and body will not appear. You will also not need to speak, record voiceovers, or appear on camera. The footage will be used underneath voiceovers that are handled separately. We are looking for someone who can independently prepare complete asset packages so our editors can focus on editing rather than searching for materials. RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Visual Asset Research, Music, and Collection Carefully review the reference videos provided and identify the visual and audio assets needed. These may include: Video overlays Existing B-roll clips Screenshots Images Logos Graphics Social media clips Website screenshots App interfaces Background music used in reference videos Similar background music matching the reference video's style, tone, and pacing Other visual or audio elements shown in the reference video You will be responsible for finding and downloading the correct or closely matching assets. Background music is an important part of this role. You should attempt to identify the music used in the reference video whenever possible. If the original track cannot be identified or legally used, find a suitable licensed or royalty-free alternative that matches the reference video's overall feel. Only source music and assets that can be used with the necessary permissions or licenses. The goal is to provide our editors with all the visual assets and music they need without having to find these materials themselves. 2. Original B-Roll Filming Using an iPhone In addition to gathering existing assets, you will be responsible for filming original B-roll using your iPhone camera. This does NOT involve filming yourself, showing your face, speaking, or recording yourself on camera. Most B-roll will involve pointing your iPhone camera at your computer monitor while demonstrating websites, software, or AI tools. The purpose is to capture authentic, high-quality footage of computer screens that our editors can use in short-form videos. Examples of B-roll include: Filming your computer monitor while ChatGPT, Claude, or another AI tool is being used. Capturing prompts being typed into AI applications. Filming AI-generated responses appearing on the screen. Capturing website navigation and scrolling. Showing software features, menus, and dashboards. Filming mouse movements and clicks within an application. Demonstrating how a website or software feature works. Recreating computer-screen visuals shown in reference videos. Occasionally including a hand pointing toward something on the monitor, when appropriate. For example, if the reference video shows someone entering a prompt into an AI tool and displaying the results, your task would be to recreate that demonstration on your computer and film the screen using your iPhone. You are filming the computer screen and what's happening on it—not yourself. Important filming requirements An iPhone with a good-quality camera is required. All footage should primarily focus on the computer screen. Your face must not appear in the footage. You will not be required to film yourself or your body. An occasional hand pointing at the screen is acceptable when needed. No talking or voiceover recording is required. No full video editing is required. Film using your iPhone's camera rather than OBS or computer screen-recording software. Footage should be clear, stable, and properly focused. Avoid glare, reflections, flickering, and blurry footage. Make sure text and important information on the computer screen are readable. Record vertically (9:16) unless otherwise instructed. Upload original, high-quality video file

jobs.title: Part-time Short-Form Trend Scout (IG Reels / TikTok), research only, no editing
jobs.description: Hi! I'm a lifestyle creator based in Paris (~10k on Instagram, plus TikTok and YouTube). My content is Paris life, fashion as the look, beauty, and personal diary-style reels. I'm looking for someone with a real eye for short-form: what makes people stop, keep watching, and follow. What you'll do (about 3–5 hours a week): Every week, send me 5 reel ideas in a shared doc. Each idea includes: - a link to the reference video (trend, format or sound) - the sound to use, if it matters for the idea (and whether it's rising or already peaking) - why it works: the hook, what keeps people watching, and why someone would save, share or follow after it - 2–3 hook options adapted to me (on-screen text) - how I could make it with my life or footage (I'll share a short weekly update) - effort level: low (phone, existing footage) or medium This is research and ideas only: no editing, no posting. Where the ideas should come from: Worldwide trends are welcome, but filtered through my world: an Asian woman living in Paris. That means what's working right now among French/European lifestyle, slow-living, fashion and beauty creators, and global formats that would make sense for someone living my life here. A trend that only works in another country or culture isn't useful to me. This means training your feed. You'll follow the creators I send you (and find more) so your Reels/TikTok feed is full of Paris/European lifestyle content. If your feed doesn't look like my world, the ideas won't either. Please no AI-generated ideas! I've seen many generic "5 trending audios this week" lists with no idea attached and I can tell. I want ideas from someone who actually watched the videos and thought about why they work for me. Getting to know my account: In your first weeks, study my profile: which of my posts did well and which didn't, and why. I'll share notes on what works for me (for example, series and personal stories turn viewers into followers; useful Paris guides get saves and reach). Also study creators similar to me, to see what works for them that I'm not doing yet. Your ideas should get more tailored to me every week. I'll give quick feedback on every idea so you can learn what works for me. Who I'm trying to reach: women roughly 22–35, English-speaking (US, UK, Asia, and internationals living in Europe), who love Paris, style, beauty and real life, and who'd save a reel or send it to a friend. Ideas that go viral with the wrong crowd (shock bait, thirst traps, rage bait) aren't useful to me, even if they get big numbers. You're a fit if you: - scroll Reels/TikTok daily and spot formats before they peak - understand the difference between a video that gets views and a video that gets followers - can explain in 2–3 sentences why a video went viral and why people watched to the end - genuinely like lifestyle, slow living, fashion or beauty content (bonus if you already follow European creators) - write natural, casual English Pay: $30/week (~₱1,900) for 5 ideas a week, paid monthly. Starts with a short paid test ($10), then a 1-month trial. Pay is reviewed after 3 months. Bonus: for any of your ideas I post, based on new followers from that post within 10 days (Instagram or TikTok): $3 for 50+, $10 for 200+, $40 for 1,000+. Max $50 in bonuses per month. The follower levels are reviewed every 3 months as the account grows. Bonuses count for ideas I adapt or post later too, and are paid with the next weekly payment along with a screenshot of the results. To apply: start your message with "PARIS SCOUT" and send: 1. A screenshot of your current Reels Explore or TikTok For You page (no need to change it, I just want to see what you watch) 2. Links to 2 reels from the last 7 days that would work for a lifestyle/fashion creator in Paris, and for each one: why it gets watched to the end, and why someone would follow after it (2–3 sentences) 3. Your hours per week and time zone

jobs.title: Multifamily Underwriting & Financial Modeling Tutor
jobs.description: I'm a commercial real estate professional specializing in multifamily investment sales. I'm seeking a part-time private tutor to teach me multifamily underwriting and financial modeling the way it's taught in a university-level real estate development program — structured, rigorous, and built around a proper textbook curriculum. This is a teaching engagement, not a one-off training session. I want someone who can guide me from fundamentals through a complete, self-built multifamily underwriting and waterfall model, with assessments along the way to prove I've actually learned the material. At a glance: • Role: Private tutor / instructor • Schedule: Twice per week (two 60–90 minute remote sessions) • Format: Fully remote via Zoom/Teams with screen sharing and Excel work-alongs • Rate: $5.5/hour USD (paid via Wise) • Start date: Immediate, upon successful interview What You'll Be Teaching: A structured curriculum of your own proposal, modeled on a university real estate development / real estate finance program, working out of a recognized textbook (e.g., Peter Linneman's Real Estate Finance and Investments or comparable). You will propose the syllabus and textbook in your application. Core topic areas: 1. Foundations — time value of money, NPV/IRR/MIRR, cap rates, NOI, basis points, leverage concepts 2. Multifamily underwriting — rent rolls, market rents, vacancy and loss to lease, operating expenses and expense ratios, capital expenditures, debt terms (amortization, DSCR, loan sizing), investor pro forma conventions 3. Financial modeling in Excel — building a complete multifamily acquisition model from scratch, with sensitivity tables, scenario analysis, and clean formatting standards 4. Waterfalls and syndication math — preferred returns, return of capital, catch-up tranches, promote/carried interest, IRR-hurdle-based distribution waterfalls for LP/GP structures 5. Development topics — land/entitlement basics, ground-up feasibility analysis, construction budgeting and draws, permanent loan takeout, developer profit and developer waterfalls Curriculum Structure Requirements: • University-style curriculum: You will map out a semester-style syllabus with weekly topics tied to assigned textbook readings before we begin. • Work out of a textbook: Each session should build on assigned reading and problem sets. • Quizzes: Short quizzes at regular mile markers (roughly every 3–4 weeks) covering prior material. • Tests/exams: Longer assessments at major milestones (mid-program and capstone), including a hands-on modeling exam where I build or repair a model under time constraint. • Capstone project: A complete multifamily acquisition model built by me from scratch, including an equity waterfall tab, reviewed and graded by you. Qualifications: • Hands-on experience underwriting or acquiring multifamily assets (e.g., work at an acquisitions shop, appraisal firm, brokerage, developer, or lending institution) • Advanced, demonstrable Excel modeling skills (clean formula design, scenario toggles, waterfall logic — no copy-paste templates) • Practical familiarity with distribution waterfall math and GP/LP structures • Prior tutoring, teaching, or training experience required • Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and dual-screen setup for screen-share lessons • Ability to commit to a fixed twice-weekly schedule for at least 3–6 months Nice to Have: • Familiarity with US markets and conventions (Argus, CoStar, or similar exposure is a plus but not required — this course is Excel-native) • Experience building development / construction-draw models • Textbook-honed problem-solving: you should be comfortable assigning and grading exercises from a real estate finance text To Apply: Please send 1. A resume 2. A brief summary of your multifamily underwriting/modeling experience (deals, roles, tools) 3. A proposed curriculum outline: the textbook you'd use, a week-by-week topic list 4. A sample of your modeling work (screenshots welcome; formulas visible) 5. Your availability (EST) and confirmation you can commit to two sessions per week

jobs.description: ABOUT US The Mailroom Barber Co is a barbershop in Greenville, SC that also sells its own handmade grooming products (shampoo, conditioner, styling powder, Matte Clay) online via Shopify. We're hiring one Google Ads specialist to manage paid search for both sides of the business. WHAT YOU'LL BE WALKING INTO We already have a live Google Ads account with real spend (~$750/month) running on the barbershop side. Your first job is NOT building from scratch — it's auditing and fixing it. The current "conversions" being tracked are almost certainly not real booked appointments (cost-per-conversion is far too low, $0.60-$2 each, for a real local-service lead), because our booking tool (Squire) is a third-party widget with no API — so there's no way to see when someone actually completes a booking. We just confirmed with Squire support that no API/webhook/Zapier integration exists. We're about to add click-tracking on the "Book Appointment" button as a proxy signal, but we want your professional opinion on the best way to optimize bidding around this constraint. On the Shopify/ecommerce side (Matte Clay and our other grooming products), conversion tracking is clean and already working via Shopify's native integration — this part is more standard Shopping/Performance Max/Search management. SCOPE OF WORK - Audit and clean up the existing barbershop Google Ads account (campaigns, keywords, conversion actions, wasted spend) - Build/optimize Shopping + Search + Performance Max campaigns for the Shopify grooming product line - Recommend and help implement the best lead-tracking approach for the barbershop given the no-API booking tool - Weekly optimization: bids, negatives, budget pacing across both accounts - Short monthly report in plain English: spend, results, cost per result, what changed and why REQUIREMENTS - 2+ years hands-on Google Ads management, ideally both local lead-gen and ecommerce/Shopping experience - Comfortable with Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking troubleshooting - Can explain your reasoning in plain English — we are not Google Ads experts and want to understand your decisions, not just see a dashboard - Available for a short weekly check-in call COMPENSATION Flat monthly retainer, $500-600/month to start (combined ad spend budget is roughly $1,000-3,000/month across both accounts), reviewed after 60 days based on results. PAID TEST TASK (required before hire, $30 flat) 1. One-page written plan: how would you track barbershop booking conversions given the booking tool has no API or webhook? 2. Sample campaign structure for our "Matte Clay" product: ad groups, 15 keywords grouped by intent, 5 negative keywords, 3 responsive search ad headlines + 2 descriptions. TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE 1. A before/after result from a past account you managed — spend, conversions, and what you actually changed. 2. How would you track leads for a business whose booking tool has no API? 3. Would you run Performance Max or Search-only for the barbershop side, and why?

jobs.title: US Life Insurance Appointment Setter – Outbound Calling, Neutral American Accent – Part Time
jobs.description: ABOUT US Desmos Life is an independent life insurance agency in Utah, USA, run by two licensed agents. We help American homeowners get mortgage protection and term life insurance, often with no medical exam. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Make a high number of outbound calls to US homeowners. Most are AGED LEADS: people who asked about mortgage protection months ago and haven't been helped yet. Some are fresh leads from our Facebook ads. - Get past the first "who is this?", re-spark their interest, confirm a few basics (state, homeowner, rough age), and BOOK A PHONE APPOINTMENT with one of our licensed agents, or TRANSFER A HOT LEAD LIVE. - Log every call in our CRM. It runs in Chrome and includes the dialer, so there's nothing to install. - Set callbacks, and mark anyone who asks not to be called again. You will NOT be selling insurance. You won't quote prices or give advice. Your job is strictly appointment setting and live transfers. ENGLISH AND ACCENT: THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT Our leads are everyday Americans, many aged 40-65, and they hang up fast on callers they can't understand. We are ONLY hiring callers who sound clear, natural and easy to understand to an American ear. - Near-native, fluent spoken English with a NEUTRAL, LIGHT ACCENT. Clear pronunciation (v/b, f/p, th) and natural American rhythm and intonation, not a read-from-a-script sound. - You can handle fast talkers, Southern accents and interruptions without losing your place. - You can make small talk and handle objections naturally. - Strong accent? Please don't apply. We listen to every recording, and accent clarity is the first thing we screen for. OTHER REQUIREMENTS - At least 1 year of outbound calling to US consumers (insurance, final expense, mortgage, solar or appointment setting preferred) - Comfortable with aged leads, high call volume and hearing "no" many times a day - Stable internet (a backup connection preferred), a quiet room with no background noise, a computer with Chrome, and a noise-canceling USB headset - Fast and accurate at typing call notes - Reliable: you show up for every shift on time -Based on performance, their is opportunity to transition to full time SCHEDULE Monday-Friday, about 6:00am-11:00am Manila time, 20 hours per week. That's 5-9pm in the Eastern US and Texas, when people are home from work. From March to November, US daylight time moves the shift one hour earlier. PAY $4-$5 USD per hour, depending on experience and how you sound on the phone. HOW TO APPLY 1. Start your message with the word "DESMOS". 2. Attach ONE voice recording, 2-3 minutes long, recorded with your work headset in the room you'd work from. In it: a) Introduce yourself and describe your US calling experience, talking naturally without reading. b) Read this opener the way you'd say it on a real call: "Hi, is this John? Hey John, this is Maria with Desmos Life. A while back you asked about protecting your mortgage, and I'm just following up. Did you ever get that taken care of?" c) Answer this objection the way you would on a call: "I don't remember filling anything out. Take me off your list." 3. Tell us your internet speed (a speed test screenshot) and whether you have a backup connection. 4. List your previous calling jobs: the company, what you called about, and for how long. Shortlisted applicants will do a live 10-minute mock call with us over video, including a role-play with a skeptical homeowner, before any offer.

jobs.title: GoHighLevel & AI Operations Specialist (Claude + Meta Ads) – US Marketing Agency
jobs.description: READ THIS FIRST: Please read the whole post. How to apply is at the bottom. About us WellnessLeads is a US marketing agency that helps med spas and aesthetic clinics get new patients. We run their Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads and build their funnels in GoHighLevel. Then our in-house booking team calls every lead and books them in. We work with about 15 clinics across the US. I'm Josh Steinberg, the founder. You'll work directly with me. Website: wellnessleads.co The role You'll do our client work using Claude (an AI assistant) plus the step-by-step processes and Notion guides we've already built. Claude does most of the building. Your job is to run it, check everything it makes, fix what it gets wrong, and finish the parts it can't do. Over time you'll make more of the day-to-day decisions yourself. What you'll do each week • Build offer landing pages and quiz funnels in GoHighLevel • Set up new client campaigns in GHL: custom values, calendars, forms, workflows and funnels • Write Meta ad copy and research competitor offers in the Meta Ad Library • Build call scripts in Canva and booking-team SOPs in Notion • Fix rejected Meta ads and resubmit them • Register client phone numbers for A2P in GHL • Prepare our weekly campaign review: pull the numbers, draft what's working and what isn't, and draft each client's update • Keep our Notion guides up to date when something changes That's the job. We won't pile unrelated admin work on top of it. If the role changes, we'll talk first and adjust your pay to match. Must have • 2+ years of GoHighLevel experience at a marketing agency (funnels, forms, calendars, workflows, custom values, snapshots) • Hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience, including duplicating ads and reading delivery errors and rejections • You use Claude or ChatGPT every day for real work and can show us an example • Strong written English, because clients will read what you write • A reliable computer, stable internet and backup power Nice to have • Experience marketing med spas, healthcare or wellness businesses • Canva, Notion, Trello, Zapier, or Google Sheets and Apps Script People who do well here • Check AI's work instead of trusting it • Make a decision once they have enough information, and explain why • Bring a recommendation, not just a question • Fix the process when something breaks, not just the one task • Ask questions when something is unclear. I'd much rather you ask than guess What success looks like • After 30 days: you've run each of our main processes with my review, and your work needs only small edits. • After 90 days: you launch new client campaigns end to end and fix ad rejections on your own. • After 6 months: you run the weekly campaign review and send client updates, and I only step in for big decisions. Pay and schedule • $500–$1,300 USD per month, full time (40 hours a week), based on experience • Paid twice a month, plus 15 paid days off per year • Pay review at 90 days, then every 6 months • Fixed schedule, Monday to Friday. At least 4 hours must overlap with 9am–5pm US Eastern, which is 10pm–6am Philippine time (9pm–5am from March to early November) • Long-term role. We provide Claude and all the software accounts you need Room to grow As we add clients, this role grows into leading client delivery and training new team members. How to apply 1. Start your application message with the word EVOLVE. 2. In 3–5 sentences, tell us about a GoHighLevel build you're proud of. 3. Include a Loom video (3 minutes max) showing a GHL or AI workflow you built. Explain one decision you made in it. 4. Attach your resume. We won't review applications that skip any of these steps. What happens next 1. We reply to every shortlisted applicant within 5 business days. 2. Shortlisted applicants do a paid test task (2–3 hours, $30 USD). 3. Next comes a video interview. 4. Last is a 2-week paid trial on real work, before a long-term offer. Questions about the role are welcome. Send them with your application.

jobs.title: Looking for Fundraising Research & Outreach Assistant
jobs.description: # Fundraising Research & Outreach Assistant ### About the Project I'm looking for a resourceful and proactive research and outreach assistant to help promote a charitable fundraising campaign supporting a family in the Philippines who is struggling to provide food and essential care for their beloved cats. The family has been caring for their cats for more than five years, including rescued animals. They are currently experiencing financial difficulties, and we're looking for genuine people, organizations, and businesses that may be willing to support their situation. This is a charitable fundraising initiative, not a business investment opportunity. ### Responsibilities - Research potential individual donors, philanthropists, animal welfare advocates, and charitable organizations. - Identify business owners, executives, foundations, and companies that may offer sponsorships or donations. - Research pet food manufacturers, distributors, and businesses that may provide cat food or essential supplies. - Find relevant decision-makers and their publicly available professional contact information. - Identify potential supporters on LinkedIn and other professional platforms. - Prepare personalized outreach messages and follow-ups. - Help promote the fundraiser through relevant communities and networks. - Maintain an organized spreadsheet of prospects, contact information, outreach status, and responses. - Provide regular progress updates. ### Ideal Candidate - Experience in lead generation, prospect research, fundraising, business development, or outreach. - Comfortable researching philanthropists, business owners, executives, and organizations. - Good written English communication skills. - Able to write personalized, natural, and respectful outreach messages. - Familiar with LinkedIn, Google Search, spreadsheets, and online research. - Resourceful, organized, and detail-oriented. - Able to distinguish genuine opportunities from suspicious offers or potential scams. ### Application Requirements Please include: 1. A short introduction about yourself. 2. Relevant experience in lead generation, research, fundraising, or outreach. 3. Examples of previous research or outreach work, if available. 4. Your expected hourly rate and availability. ### Practical Assessment Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short research exercise. **Task 1: Fundraiser Promotion** Review the campaign and prepare a natural LinkedIn post that could be shared to help spread awareness. Fundraiser: ---------- **Task 2: Find Three Potential Supporters** Research three real people, organizations, or businesses that could potentially help this campaign. For each prospect, provide: - Full name or organization name. - Current position or organization description. - LinkedIn profile or official website. - Why you believe they could be relevant to this campaign. - Their publicly available professional contact channel, if available. - A short personalized introductory message you would send. We are particularly interested in people or organizations involved in philanthropy, animal welfare, pet food sponsorships, charitable giving, or community support. **Task 3: Outreach Strategy** Briefly explain how you would approach these three prospects and how you would encourage them to support or share the campaign without sounding pushy. ### Important - All prospects must be real and independently verifiable. - Do not invent contact details, positions, or organizational information. - Do not send messages or make donation requests on our behalf during the assessment. - Do not pay for access to donor lists or private contact information. - We value quality research and thoughtful outreach over the number of contacts collected. The assessment is intended to take approximately 30–45 minutes. ### Position Details - Work arrangement: Remote - Employment type: Part-time - Working hours: [Insert hours] - Compensation: [Insert hourly rate or agreed project rate] - Start date: [Insert date] If you're interested in using your research and outreach skills to help a meaningful cause, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description: **Full time | Remote, Philippines | 40 hours per week** ### About Marketix Digital Marketix Digital is a Sydney-based SEO and Search Intelligence agency working with Australian businesses, including industrial, manufacturing, equipment, B2B and eCommerce companies. Use Google Search Console, GA4, crawl data, competitor research and manual website reviews to understand what is happening. Assess technical issues, search intent, content quality, website structure, internal linking and authority. Develop clear hypotheses, identify the evidence needed to test them and distinguish confirmed findings from assumptions. **Strategy and prioritisation** Understand each client’s products, services, customers and commercial priorities. Build and maintain a practical SEO plan that prioritises work by its likely impact, urgency and effort. Explain your recommendations and adjust the plan when the evidence changes. Manage your workload across accounts, keep deadlines visible and raise dependencies or capacity issues early. **Content research, writing and optimisation** Take responsibility for content from research through to publication and review. This includes: - Keyword research, search intent analysis and keyword mapping. - Planning commercial pages, service pages, category pages and supporting informational content. - Researching unfamiliar industries and understanding what their customers need to know. - Personally writing, editing and improving content for Australian audiences. - Checking facts, sources, claims and figures. - Optimising headings, metadata, internal links and calls to action. - Publishing and checking content in WordPress or the relevant CMS. You must be able to produce clear, useful content that accurately represents the client’s business and helps customers make decisions. **Implementation and quality control** Carry out on-page and CMS changes yourself where appropriate. Identify and address issues involving indexation, canonicals, redirects, duplicate content, internal linking, site architecture and structured data. For changes requiring development support, provide clear instructions, explain the intended outcome and verify the completed work. Assess backlink profiles and authority gaps, and deliver agreed link acquisition or digital PR activity with attention to relevance and quality. Check your work after implementation and monitor whether it produces the expected result. **Client reporting and communication** Prepare clear monthly reports that explain: - What changed in performance. - What the available evidence tells us about why it changed. - What work was completed and why it mattered. - What is working, what remains unresolved and what needs attention. - What we recommend doing next. Connect reporting to enquiries, conversions and commercial priorities wherever reliable data is available. Explain the limits of the data when necessary. Be comfortable discussing your findings, answering client questions and communicating concerns early. **Processes and accountability** Keep account plans, task records and documentation current. Follow established processes, improve them where needed and document repeatable work so another team member can understand what was done. When something is underperforming, investigate it, communicate what you have found and recommend the next action. ### What we are looking for - Substantial hands-on SEO experience, including independently managing client campaigns. - Strong diagnostic skills and the ability to explain your reasoning. - Practical knowledge of technical SEO, content strategy, on-page optimisation, internal linking and authority building. - Confidence using Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog and spreadsheets. - Experience implementing changes in WordPr

jobs.title: Sales Closer, Phone and Telegram Calls (Full-Time, $1,000 Base + 20% Commission)
jobs.description: We run an online service business for social media creators, agencies and brands. We fix banned and restricted accounts, protect accounts from bans, and grow accounts. We have thousands of leads and past customers, and nobody is calling them. That's your job. THIS IS A PURE SALES JOB ON THE PHONE. No customer support and no chat replies. Our team and our AI handle that. You call, you book, you close. If you don't want sales targets, please do not apply. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1) Cold call all day. Every shift you get a fresh list of leads and past buyers. You call them on Telegram, open with their own history ("you bought X from us in May, still holding up?"), and find out what they need now. 2) Book as many calls as possible. If someone can't talk now, you book a set time and call them back. A short message to set the time is fine; selling happens on the call. 3) Get on calls and close. Run 20-minute sales calls, find the problem, send them to the right page in our app to pay, and price custom or big jobs. Deals over $5,000 you set up for the owner. 4) Log every call. Each call gets an outcome and a next date in our CRM. No lead is left without a next step. TARGETS - 80–120 call attempts a shift - 8–12 calls held a day - Every booked call happens, on time PAY - Base: $1,000 a month. - Commission: 20% of the profit on every deal you close. No cap. - Commission is paid monthly, once the customer's money has cleared plus 14 days. It is taken back on a refund or chargeback. - Example only, not a promise: if your deals make $10,000 profit in a month, you earn $2,000 commission on top of your $1,000 base. YOU MUST HAVE - Real cold-calling or phone-closing results. Tell us your numbers: dials a day, calls booked, close rate, monthly revenue. - Excellent spoken English: confident, warm, no script-reading voice. - Daily use of ChatGPT or Claude to prepare calls and work faster, and you can show us how. - Reliable night-shift availability, a quiet place to call, a good headset, stable internet and a backup connection. - The confidence to push back on us when we are wrong, and to ask for a raise when you have earned it. BIG PLUS Experience selling to creators, creator agencies or social media businesses. Knowing how Instagram bans and appeals work. BEING HONEST ABOUT THE JOB - Many people won't pick up, and some will be rude. You need a thick skin and steady energy. - Customers are often stressed: their account (and income) is gone. We never promise results or times we can't keep. - It's a night shift, and the first month is hard. HOW WE HIRE Recorded voice test (5 minutes) → 3-day paid trial calling real leads → 20-minute call with the owner → start, with a 2-week probation. TO APPLY, start your application with the word "CLOSER" and answer in your own words: 1. What have you sold by phone, at what price, and what were your numbers (dials a day, calls booked, close rate, revenue)? 2. Record a 1–2 minute voice note: call us as if we were a past customer whose account got banned last month. Send the link (Google Drive, Loom or Vocaroo). 3. Someone on the call says "how do I know you're not a scam?" What do you say? 4. Tell us about a time you told a boss they were wrong. What happened? 5. What would make you ask for a raise, and how would you ask? 6. Can you work 14:00–22:00 UTC, 6 days a week? Where are you based, and what is your internet backup?

A media buyer, a commission closer, and a video editor each need a different filter, and the people who are great at them rarely look great on paper the same way. We will sharpen your filter. We will not build it from scratch. You own this function end to end: sourcing, outreach, screening, interviewing, pipeline, reporting. You work directly with leadership. There is no HR manager above you. ## You Screen For Five Different Seats This is the part most recruiters underestimate. You are not filling one kind of role over and over. You run a bench across five distinct seats, and the filter is different for each one. **Client Success Manager.** You're testing for retention instinct and calm under pressure. jobs.title: Heir Outreach Specialist
jobs.description: We are hiring the person everyone tells things to. JABO REI is a US real estate firm. We buy houses families inherited and never settled. The paperwork tells us what happened, never why a family left its largest asset untouched for ten years. Your job: be the first voice that family hears — and come back with the why, all of it, exactly as it was said. Most callers stop at the first answer. Ours don't. An heir says: "We just haven't gotten around to it." That's Level 1 — the reason given. Level 2 is the cause: what made it hard to get around to? "My brother won't return my calls." Level 3 is the root: why won't he? He cared for their mother in that house. He believes it's his. Reaching Level 3 can't be scripted. It happens because the heir said one sentence that wasn't the whole story — and you noticed, and your next question walked through the door it opened. Listening is only half of it. The other half is what you do with what you heard: the question that maps the whole family before it slips away, the fact you pin down instead of assuming, and a next step booked at a specific time before you hang up. Our best calls sound quiet. Their notes read like case files. If you already work this way — deep and precise — you know exactly what we're describing. If you don't, no training fixes it. That's why we test for it before we hire. The work - First calls to heirs from fully researched files — family tree, debts, documents — during US hours (overnight PH). - You talk less than she does. No selling, no pitch, no commission — a separate team handles offers, by design. - Every call ends with something real: a next step at a specific time, or a family that trusts you'll call back. - Calls are recorded and graded on what you uncovered and what you booked, never on dial volume. - Hours start at 4/day, growing as your deals close: 5 after your first, 6 after your second. Don't apply if a script is your safety net, silence makes you fill it, commission is your fuel, or a problem that takes real thought makes you reach for the first easy answer. Background: outbound calling experience is required — you must already be at home on live calls with strangers. Real estate and sales experience are not: sales habits usually have to be unlearned here. Our best people come from escalations, retention, intake, care coordination — anywhere the real job was hearing people in hard moments, and getting the details right. Pay: $5/hr starting, flexible based on skill — the assessment d ---------- where you land. Remote. How hiring works (same for everyone): 1. Answer the application question below. 2. A personal packet: résumé plus a free DISC assessment. 3. Three timed tests, each taken in one sitting: an aptitude test (logic and pattern problems against the clock), a Curiosity Test of real conversation fragments — you choose the next question — and a simulated first call: two scripted heir calls where every response you pick is graded the way we grade real calls — what you uncovered, what you pinned down, how much she talked, and whether you booked the next step. Most people finish these tests. Very few max them. We hire from these results more than from résumés — we're looking for the very few. 4. A short video, then an interview and a live roleplay call. Application question (required): Tell us about a conversation where you heard the sentence everyone else missed — the one that changed what the conversation was really about. How far did you follow it, and was there anything you deliberately chose not to say? Specifics, please — vague answers are how we screen out. — JABO REI

jobs.title: Specialist VA and Personal Assistant (Full-Time, Australian Home Services Business)
jobs.description: Be the friendly, clear voice that helps people live their best life. Day shift: 6am to 2pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday. PHP 30,000 to 35,000 a month. An Australian home cleaning and gardening business on the Gold Coast needs a right hand for its owner. You answer the business phone, run the bookings and keep the owner organised. Many of the people who call are older, live with a disability (on Australia's NDIS scheme) or are war veterans. Some of them are lonely, and a kind, patient voice on the phone matters to them. What you get A day shift. You finish at 2pm and your weekends are your own. About 20 calls a day, so you have time to slow down and be kind on each one. PHP 30,000 a month during the three-month probation, then PHP 35,000 a month. 20 days paid annual leave, 10 days paid sick leave and 13th month pay. One warm, easy-going owner who trusts you to get on with it. A local Australian colleague who trains you and works with you every day. Room to grow. Once the phones and bookings run smoothly, you take on hiring, compliance and payments. How you speak matters most Our clients need slow, gentle, easy-to-follow English with a soft, neutral accent. A fast call-centre pace or a strong accent of any kind is hard for them to follow, and that includes a strong American accent. Your interview is where we hear how you speak, so take it somewhere quiet and speak the way you would to an 80-year-old client. What you'll do In your first month: Answer and make the business's calls. Manage bookings, and confirm each one the day before and again that morning. Rebook the day when a cleaner is sick, and call the client when a cleaner is late. Be the main contact for the cleaners and gardeners, and check their timesheets and clock-ins. Sort the owner's email and remind her before every appointment. From month two: hiring cleaners and gardeners, keeping police checks and insurance up to date, and preparing staff pay in Xero for the owner to approve. This is you if People tell you that you are easy to understand on the phone. You are the organised one. You would rather organise your boss than wait to be organised. You can be gentle with a lonely older client and firm with a cleaner who did not clock in, in the same morning. When something goes wrong and the owner can't be reached, you work out what to do and do it. This is not for you if You speak quickly, or people often ask you to repeat yourself. You like to be told each step before you start. You find it hard to be firm with people. You can't work 6am to 2pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday. The hours are fixed. Good to have, not required: call centre or phone customer service, bookings or rostering, a CRM, Xero or ShiftCare (we train you on both), care, NDIS or home services, recruitment. How to apply Apply on our website with the link below. You answer a few short questions, do a skills test and have a short interview. Tell us in your application that you can work 6am to 2pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday. Apply directly on our website: ----------

jobs.description: Work Schedule: U.S. business hours About the Role We are looking for a highly motivated Patient Coordinator to support prospective patients in the United States who are interested in Genicular Artery Embolization (GAE), a minimally invasive procedure used in the treatment of knee pain. These leads are captured in GoHighLevel (GHL), where Patient Coordinators will be responsible for claiming leads, making outbound calls, answering basic questions, and helping qualified patients schedule an appointment with one of our clinics. Qualifications • Excellent spoken and written English, with strong phone communication skills. • Prior experience working with U.S.-based customers or patients. • Experience in healthcare, patient scheduling, medical call centers, insurance verification, intake, or patient coordination is strongly preferred. • Working knowledge of the U.S. healthcare and health insurance system. • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and following up consistently with prospective patients. • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish trust and rapport over the phone. • Goal-oriented and comfortable working toward appointment and conversion targets. • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. • Comfortable learning and working in CRM and patient lead management systems. Experience with GoHighLevel is a plus. • Able to work independently in a remote environment during U.S. business hours. What Success Looks Like Success in this role isn't simply making calls. The goal is to help prospective patients take the next step in their care. A successful Patient Coordinator will: • Respond to new leads quickly. • Make multiple appropriate follow-up attempts when patients cannot initially be reached. • Create a professional and positive experience for prospective patients. • Clearly explain the scheduling process and next steps. • Accurately document every patient interaction. • Consistently convert qualified patient leads into scheduled clinical appointments. • Know when a patient's clinical or insurance question needs to be escalated rather than attempting to provide medical advice. You should be warm and empathetic while also being confident enough to guide the conversation toward a clear next step: scheduling a clinical appointment. Previous experience supporting U.S. healthcare organizations, medical practices, patient access centers, or healthcare call centers would be especially valuable.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager / Content Creator
jobs.description: # Social Media Manager & Content Creator | Fashion, Lifestyle & Pickleball (Part-Time) Company: SIGLA Location: Remote – Philippines Job Type: Part-Time, 10 Hours per Week Salary:$6–$8 USD/hour, depending on experience Schedule: Flexible, with some overlap with Pacific Time About SIGLA SIGLA is a Los Angeles-based women's activewear and lifestyle brand inspired by pickleball, movement, fashion, and community. We're building a brand that brings together style, sport, and everyday lifestyle, with an elevated yet playful aesthetic. We're looking for a creative, proactive, and trend-savvy Social Media Manager & Content Creator to help grow our presence on Instagram and TikTok. We're not looking for someone who simply schedules posts. We want someone who brings fresh ideas, understands what makes content engaging and shareable, and knows how to turn great visuals into content that people want to watch and follow. If you play pickleball and understand the culture, that's a BIG plus! Key Responsibilities Content Creation & Editing Create and edit engaging Instagram Reels and TikTok videos, design visually appealing carousels and Instagram Stories, and work with our existing professional photography, video footage, and product assets. Write engaging captions, strong hooks, and natural-sounding copy for a US audience. Adapt content specifically for each platform rather than simply reposting identical content. **Content Strategy & Growth** Research social media trends, trending audio, and creative opportunities. Proactively develop and pitch original content ideas that align with SIGLA's brand identity and help attract new followers. Create a weekly content calendar with proposed concepts, captions, and posting dates. Focus on organic growth, engagement, shares, and building a relevant community. Analyze content performance and recommend improvements based on what's working. **Social Media Management** Organize content, prepare posts for review, and schedule approved content using Planoly or other scheduling tools. Support community engagement, identify potential creators and collaboration opportunities, and provide brief weekly updates on completed work, performance, and upcoming content. ### What We're Looking For **Experience & Skills** We're looking for someone with experience managing Instagram and TikTok accounts for brands or businesses, strong short-form video editing skills using CapCut or similar software, and proficiency in Canva. You should have a strong eye for design, understand organic social media growth strategies, and be comfortable creating content for a US audience. Excellent written English, creativity, attention to detail, organization, and reliability are essential. Most importantly, we're looking for someone who takes initiative and can independently bring fresh ideas to the table rather than waiting for detailed instructions. **Strongly Preferred** Someone who personally plays pickleball and understands the culture, terminology, humor, and community. Experience with fashion, activewear, beauty, wellness, lifestyle, or e-commerce brands is also a plus. We'd love to see a portfolio demonstrating strong creative execution and measurable social media growth. ### How We'll Work Together You'll work directly with the founder of SIGLA. We already have professional photography, video footage, product images, and an established brand identity. Your role is to help us make the most of these assets through creative content and thoughtful social media strategy. You'll have the freedom to propose ideas and creative concepts, but all content, including visuals, captions, and posting schedules, must receive founder approval before publication. We're looking for someone who can take initiative, bring thoughtful creative ideas to the table, and help move the brand forward. ### Hours, Compensation & Trial This is a part-time position starting at approximately 10 hours per week, with compensation of $6–$8 USD per hour depending on experience and skills. Working hours are flexible, with reasonable communication and turnaround times expected. We'll begin with a paid trial period to evaluate creative fit and working style. Time tracking is required for all hours worked. There is potential for additional hours and long-term collaboration as the brand grows. ### How to Apply Please share your portfolio with examples of Instagram Reels, TikToks, carousels, or other social media content you've personally created or edited. Include links to 1–3 social media accounts you've managed, explain your responsibilities, and share any measurable results you've achieved. We'd also love to know whether you personally play pickleball, how familiar you are with the sport and its culture, and what interests you about working with a pickleball-inspired lifestyle brand. To get a sense of your creative thinking, please share two original Instagram Reel or TikTok ideas you would create for a women's pickleball-inspired activewear brand

jobs.title: Project Manager - Product Launches (Executive Partner)
jobs.description: Project Manager - Product Launches (Executive Partner) 💼 Full Time | Remote | USD $1,100 to $1,600 per month 📍 Philippines-based | 9:00am to 6:00pm PHT, weekdays Hello Nancy went from 9 products in the pipeline to 38 in two weeks. The launch schedule for all of them lives in about 55 group chats and in two people's heads. There is no system of record. Your job is to build one, then run it. If you work best inside a scope someone else has already drawn, this is not the right role. --- ✨ About Ally Ally helps founders and leaders scale themselves before they scale their companies. We match Executive Partners with fast-growing e-commerce and creative businesses, bringing structure, clarity and execution leverage. We combine human judgment with modern AI tools. We are not a VA agency. Our partners run real parts of the business, with direct access to the founder and real decisions to make. --- 🧭 The role You own product launches for Hello Nancy, working directly with the co-founder. The brand is in sexual wellness, so you should be comfortable working on intimate products every day. Two people currently hold the whole launch pipeline in their heads, and one of them is at capacity. You take it off them. The founder's own description of the job: bring order to the chaos, get everyone aligned, and make sure we know early if we are going to miss a timeline and what that costs. You will recommend the tracking tool, build it, and keep it true. Nobody will hand you a process. The product judgment stays with the team. The coordination, the dates and the follow-through are yours. --- 📋 What you'll do 1. The launch tracker, about 40% - Keep roughly twenty gated steps true for every product, so the launch date and the on-track flag actually mean something - Read the factory, designer and 3PL threads daily across WhatsApp and WeChat, and move what matters into the tracker the same day - Run the artwork rounds, keep version control, and route the founder's sign-off - Know which artwork and print file is current for any live product, and who confirmed it - Separate what is on track, what is at risk and what needs the founder. Never one flat list - Flag date conflicts before they hit a deadline 2. The chase, about 25% - Run a weekly supplier chase. Every open commitment asked, every answer logged yes or no - Chase samples, tooling, packaging development and factory dates - Chase designers for review rounds and the founders for the decisions that are only theirs 3. The handoffs, about 20% - Give the fulfilment lead launch dates and volumes far enough ahead to place an order on a 30-day production lead, so nothing lands as a surprise - Tell whoever placed a purchase order about any design change before it is made, the same day. It may move the price - Send the marketing lead the current spec every time it changes, and a clean product sample three weeks before launch. Packaging follows separately and later - Send tester and influencer samples against the list once a product is approved to proceed - Keep the current 3D render in the file library beside the diecuts and print files - Say when a new version exists, so it gets its own code. Every version gets a new one, always - Send one weekly round-up to everyone who needs it, unprompted 4. The product brief, and systems, about 15% - The brief belongs to someone else today. You draft it from day 30 and own it from day 60, with the founder seeing it before it reaches the designer - One page: spec, barcode, code and one line of art direction. Art direction is a feeling in the world of the product, not a materials spec - Remove any claim with no source behind it, and keep a record of the evidence per claim - Recommend one tracking tool with your reasons, build it, and get the team working in it rather than around it - Build the automations that remove repeat compiling, check the output by hand, and know what happens when they fail --- 🚦 What is not yours Stated up front so the line is clear from day one: - Approvals, and the final call on whether something is good enough to print - The factory relationships - Building the internal system. You run it, someone else builds and fixes it - Quotes, purchase orders, payment terms, warehousing and forecasting. Those sit with the fulfilment side - Anything after mass production. Campaigns and post-launch performance are someone else's --- 📈 What success looks like These are the real dated bars for the role, not aspirations. - Week 1 hands-on. Week 2 output every two days. Weeks 3 to 4 self-sufficient, with no call-outs. That is the ramp, and it is short on purpose. Nobody here has time to train - Day 7: every active product in the tracker shows its step, a ready-on date, and which file is current. Nobody has had to ask you where anything is - Day 14: the weekly chase is running and logged. One product has moved end to end. You flagged a date conflict before anyone else saw it - Day 30: the person who was doing launch coordination before

jobs.description: Power BI Report Writer & Developer About the Role We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Power BI Report Writer to join our team and take ownership of our business intelligence reporting. We provide residential and commercial moving services, including local moves, long-distance moves, loading, and unloading. We are seeking a reliable, confident, and sales-driven **Inbound Sales & Booking Coordinator** to answer customer calls, provide moving quotes, schedule estimates, and convert incoming leads into confirmed bookings. **This is a sales-focused position, not simply a call-answering role.** Many of our customers are ready to book when they call, so we need someone who can communicate confidently, build trust, and close sales professionally. ## Job Responsibilities - Answer incoming calls from U.S. customers promptly and professionally. - Explain our moving services, pricing, hourly rates, and policies. - Convert incoming inquiries into confirmed moving bookings. - Collect customer information, moving dates, addresses, inventory details, and special requirements. - Schedule free in-home estimates for larger moving jobs. - Check crew availability and coordinate scheduling. - Follow up with customers who received estimates but haven't booked. - Handle customer questions and price objections professionally. - Enter and maintain accurate information in our booking system. - Send booking confirmations and payment instructions through approved company systems. - Provide daily reports on calls, leads, estimates, and confirmed bookings. ## Requirements - Excellent spoken and written English with clear pronunciation. - At least 1 year of experience in inbound sales, appointment setting, or U.S. customer service preferred. - Strong communication, persuasion, and closing skills. - Experience handling U.S. customers by phone. - Ability to work independently and handle multiple customer inquiries. - Reliable high-speed internet connection, computer, headset, and quiet workspace. - Comfortable using CRM systems, scheduling software, and web applications. - Willingness to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours. **Experience in moving companies, home services, logistics, or transportation is a major advantage.** ## Work Schedule - Monday–Friday - 8:30 AM–1:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time - 25 hours per week - Fully remote, Philippines-based position ## Compensation - Starting pay: **$6 USD per hour** - Approximately $650 USD per month - Opportunity for performance-based bonuses tied to successful bookings. - Potential for increased hours and compensation based on performance. ## How to Apply Please submit the following: 1. Your résumé highlighting relevant customer service and sales experience. 2. A 60–90-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your experience handling U.S. customers. 3. A brief explanation of how you would convince a customer to book our moving service when they say our price is higher than a competitor's. 4. Your internet speed and confirmation that you can work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule. **Important:** We are looking for someone who can turn incoming calls into paying customers. Applicants with demonstrated inbound sales and closing experience will receive priority consideration. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid mock customer-call assessment.

jobs.description: I am a Realtor with Compass in Silicon Valley, California. I publish one video a week about buying and selling homes in Los Altos, Palo Alto, Mountain View and Los Altos Hills. The videos mix talking-head footage, walking neighborhood footage, charts and maps. The style is clean, clear and informative, not flashy. What you will do for each video: Cut 30 to 40 minutes of raw footage into an 8 to 12 minute video, following a written outline. Remove mistakes, pauses and retakes, keeping the best take of each section. Add burned-in captions and deliver a separate captions file. Add simple graphics: lower thirds, chart callouts using the figures in the outline, and map highlights. Clean up audio, apply basic color correction and add licensed background music. Deliver an upload-ready file to a shared Google Drive folder. Nice to have: experience making YouTube Shorts and thumbnails. These may be added later as paid extras. Requirements: A computer able to edit 4K footage smoothly. Reliable internet of at least 25 Mbps upload and download, and a backup plan for power and internet outages. Descript, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Written English good enough to follow detailed notes. First cut within 72 hours of receiving footage. One round of revisions within 48 hours. How to apply: Start your message with the word "Peninsula". Send links to three videos you edited, ideally for real estate, finance or educational YouTube channels. In two or three sentences, answer: what would you cut first to turn a 40-minute recording into a 10-minute video? Tell me your time zone and your usual turnaround for a 10-minute video.

jobs.title: Remote Analytical Data Reviewer – LC-MS Peptide Testing
jobs.description: About the role We are a peptide testing laboratory looking for a detail-oriented chemist to review LC-MS data remotely. You will review research-use-only (RUO) peptide data generated on a Shimadzu LCMS-2020 single quadrupole mass spectrometer with LabSolutions software, through secure VPN access. This is a data-review role, not a bench role. You will confirm molecular weights, verify UV and TIC peak-area purity calculations, profile synthetic impurities, and produce audit-ready review records that support Certificates of Analysis (COAs) and client reports. What you will do - Perform primary review of LC-MS data to confirm the molecular weight of target peptides (multiply charged ions, adducts and deconvolution where applicable). - Execute and verify UV and TIC peak-area integration in LabSolutions for purity calculations, following established methods and acceptance criteria. - Profile and document synthetic impurities (deletions, truncations, oxidations, adducts and related substances) by retention time and mass. - Apply method-specific acceptance criteria, such as MW match within single-quadrupole tolerance (typically ±0.5 Da), purity thresholds and impurity reporting rules. - Identify and escalate integration issues, co-elutions, baseline problems and spectral anomalies with clear documentation. - Generate accurate review records, reports and COA-supporting data packages. - Answer technical questions from customers. - Assist with method development and method changes. - Maintain strict data integrity and follow SOPs for remote review, version control and electronic records. - Handle high-throughput volume with consistent turnaround while meeting quality standards. - Take part in method training, periodic competency assessments and process improvement. Required qualifications - Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacy/Pharmaceutical Sciences or a related field. Licensed Chemists (RCh) are welcome to apply. - At least 2–3 years of hands-on experience reviewing HPLC or LC-MS data, preferably peptide or small-molecule pharmaceutical or research samples. - Proven ability to perform accurate peak integration, purity calculations and impurity evaluation from chromatographic and mass spectral data. - Experience with single-quadrupole LC-MS systems and data processing software. LabSolutions experience is a strong advantage; training is provided. - Solid understanding of peptide analysis, including multiply charged ions and common synthetic impurities. - Excellent attention to detail, consistency and documentation habits. - Reliable high-speed internet, a backup connection or power source, a quiet home workspace, and the ability to work independently. - Strong written English for clear, precise scientific documentation. Preferred qualifications - PhD in Chemistry (strongly preferred). - Direct experience with Shimadzu LabSolutions and/or the LCMS-2020 or similar single-quad systems. - Background in peptide synthesis impurity profiling or RUO/COA testing. - Experience in high-throughput or contract laboratory (CRO/QC) data review. - Familiarity with data integrity (ALCOA+) and electronic records practices. - Prior remote analytical review work. Tools and training - Secure remote access to LabSolutions via VPN. - Training and SOPs for our peptide methods, acceptance criteria and review workflow. - Standard productivity tools for reporting and communication. Pay and terms - USD 2,500 per month for full-time equivalent hours (approx. 40–50 hrs/week), depending on experience and performance. - Throughput and accuracy bonuses available after probation. - Paid weekly or bi-weekly by international transfer (Wise, bank transfer or equivalent). - 90-day probation with competency checks and dual-review sampling before you are authorized for independent primary review. - Flexible hours within defined service windows. High reliability is required. - Long-term engagement with more volume as the testing business grows. How to apply Apply through this posting and include the following: 1. Your resume or CV, highlighting LC-MS or HPLC data review experience. 2. A brief summary of any peptide or single-quadrupole work. 3. One or two paragraphs on how you approach peak integration consistency and impurity evaluation. 4. Your available weekly hours and preferred start date. 5. Your current location and time zone. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

jobs.title: Dispatcher - Customer Service with Emergency Response Background
jobs.description: Job description: Remote · $10–$12/hr · Full Time · U.S. Company hiring from the Philippines About SureFire CPR - ---------- SureFire CPR helps people get the lifesaving training and certifications they need, when they need them. We run a 24/7 CPR training operation so students can get real support, complete their certification, and actually feel confident doing it. Our mission is simple: equip people with the skills to save lives. We operate across 100+ locations and are scaling to 1,000 before 2029, which means more people who can step in when it counts, for a coworker, a patient, a stranger, a child. When a student calls for help, the person who picks up represents everything we're trying to do. Who We Are We help people save lives. That's it. 24 hours a day, every day. Three values run through everything we do, including, how we hire, how we coach, how we lead, and how we show up for students. They're not a tagline. They're non-negotiable. We Set the Pace. We move fast, get it done, and are proud of it. We take proactive, bold action and let nothing stand in our way. We’re resourceful, methodical and curious. We take others with us. We don’t wait to be told. We just go. Because the work matters. Make It Simple. Simple isn’t easy - it’s a choice we make on purpose. We take the extra time to remove anything that isn’t essential, and we step back often to make sure we're still focused on what matters most. Because complexity is the enemy of execution. Care Deeply. About the impact. About doing things right. About each other. We do more - the little bit extra that surprises people and makes them feel special. We never stop at “good enough.” Because caring deeply helps save lives. A Note from the Head of Delivery Our students are nurses, parents, coaches, teachers, first responders. A lot of them are anxious. Some are frustrated. A few are calling during genuinely hard moments. The person who answers sets the tone. We need someone who can stay calm, listen well, and give clear direction without making the student feel like a burden. Someone who follows the process, communicates with care, and stays with the problem until it's solved. You don't need CPR training experience — we'll teach you everything you need to know. But if you've worked in healthcare support, EMS, 911 dispatch, technical support, or any environment where urgency and empathy had to coexist, you'll get up to speed fast. Here's what we're looking for: You own the call. No deflecting, no passing the buck. You communicate clearly, even when the student is flustered. You follow the process and sweat the details. You can be kind and firm at the same time. You care about why this work matters, not just what the task is. If that sounds like you, keep reading. What You'll Do You are the student's point of contact when something goes wrong, something is confusing, or they just need someone to walk them through it. Your job is to resolve it on that call, whenever possible. Answer with urgency. You move first. You don't let confusion sit and turn into frustration. Treat every call like it matters. Because to that student, it does. They may need this certification for a job, a license, a deadline. Document everything. Accurate notes, correct dispositions, updated systems. The next person who touches that account needs to know what happened. Bring problems forward. If you're hearing a question without a dedicated response in our system, that's a signal. You flag it so training can fix it. What Success Looks Like Students leave the call knowing exactly what to do next Issues get resolved with you, not transferred to someone else Every interaction is documented accurately Recurring gaps in the process get surfaced and fixed Students get the same quality of support whether they call at 2pm or 2am How You'll Work This is a 24/7 operation. Shifts may include evenings, weekends, holidays, or overnight hours depending on business needs. Reliability isn't optional. Students are counting on us to pick up. You'll work closely with the rest of the Delivery Team: Training & QA — When you spot a recurring question or a confusing instruction, you bring it to them. They build the fixes; you give them the raw material. Facilities — When a location issue affects a student's experience, you document it and escalate it properly. Dispatch Team — You communicate clearly with your teammates, share context, and help maintain coverage. No student falls through the cracks because a hand off was sloppy. What You Bring Strong spoken and written English Experience in emergency response work — Emergency response, technical support, dispatch, or similar A track record of helping frustrated or anxious people without getting rattled Attention to detail and accurate documentation habits Comfortable picking up new platforms and tools quickly The ability to follow a process closely, and to ask when something isn't clear An ownership mindset — you don't wait to be told to care Helpful Backg

jobs.description: AI Software Tester — TikTok Shop & E-Commerce Tools Company: Outlandish Type: in-person, full-time About us Outlandish helps brands grow through TikTok Shop, creators, livestream shopping, and e-commerce. We’re also building AI-powered tools to make these operations easier, faster, and more automated. We’re looking for someone curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable with technology to try out our new tools, find problems, and help get them working properly. What you’ll do Test new tools and features by using them the way our team, brands, and creators would. Check that things like product listings, affiliate workflows, order management, reports, and automations work as expected. Spot errors, confusing steps, missing features, or results that don’t make sense for the business. Reproduce problems and explain clearly what happened and what should have happened. Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Codex to help investigate problems and make straightforward fixes where possible. Retest after fixes to make sure the issue is actually resolved. Work with our developers on problems that need more technical support. Keep simple records of what’s been tested, what’s still broken, and what’s ready to use. Who we’re looking for You’re comfortable learning new software and figuring out why something isn’t working. You have some hands-on experience with e-commerce, software testing, operations tools, or troubleshooting. You’ve used AI tools to solve problems, or you’re excited to learn how to use them for debugging. You pay attention to details and don’t give up when something breaks. You can explain technical issues in plain English and work independently. A big plus, but not required: Familiarity with the TikTok Shop Seller Center backend, including listings, affiliates, orders, promotions, or seller operations. Experience with Shopify, other marketplaces, or e-commerce integrations. Experience with simple automation, browser testing, spreadsheets, APIs, or basic coding. You don’t need to be a senior software engineer or have a computer science degree. We’re much more interested in someone practical, resourceful, and willing to learn. An example of the work Imagine we’ve built a tool that helps a brand manage its TikTok Shop creators. You would try the tool, check that it follows the correct steps, notice where information is missing or actions fail, and use AI to help figure out the cause. You might fix a small issue yourself or show a developer exactly what’s wrong. Then you’d test it again until the workflow works properly. How to apply Please send us: A short introduction about your experience. Any experience you have with TikTok Shop, Shopify, or other e-commerce tools. Which AI tools you’ve used and an example of a problem you’ve solved with them. Your availability. We may invite shortlisted applicants to try a short, paid practical testing task.

Issues requiring ownership's attention. We do not want long, unnecessary reports. We want accurate, actionable information that management can review in a few minutes. 5. If a client needs an update, communicate. If someone misses a commitment, determine why and establish the next step. If a problem cannot be resolved through normal coordination, escalate it. We do not want to spend our days answering questions that a capable coordinator could resolve independently. You will receive training on our systems and procedures, but we expect you to bring your own organizational skills, judgment, initiative, and professional experience. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Proven experience in project coordination, project management, service delivery, or operations coordination. EXCEPTIONAL spoken and written English, including clear pronunciation and the ability to communicate naturally and confidently with American business professionals. Strong experience working directly with US-based clients and employees. Extremely organized, detail-oriented, and dependable. Confident, assertive, and comfortable holding coworkers accountable. Ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and deadlines. Strong independent problem-solving and decision-making skills. Experience with project management, ticketing, or business management software. Ability to work US Eastern Time business hours. Reliable internet connection and professional working environment.
