jobs.title: Program & Curriculum Producer
jobs.description: About Us We are a growing parenting education company that helps parents of young children move from reactive parenting to clear, repeatable systems that build cooperation, responsibility, emotional security, and self-governance. Our founder is a nationally recognized parenting expert, and our content reaches a large and engaged audience of parents across social media. Behind that content is a growing set of systems that turn interest into relationships. Social channels feed ManyChat conversations, which feed our CRM, email, checkout, and customer records. Those connections are what allow a parent who watches one video to become a subscriber, a customer, and a long-term member of our community. We’re looking for a Program and Curriculum Producer to turn our founder’s parenting methodology into organized, high-quality learning experiences inside our paid Skool community. Position Summary The Program & Curriculum Producer is a hands-on role responsible for building and maintaining the educational delivery system for our paid Skool community. You will convert our founder’s methodology, books, and lessons into structured courses, assignments, and implementation resources that help parents of children ages 0–5 solve behavioral challenges and actually apply what they learn. You will own curriculum organization, the lesson production calendar, the Skool Classroom experience, and the review and approval workflow before anything is published. You will also watch where students stop progressing and recommend improvements. This role reports to Operations and coordinates closely with our founder, editors, and the broader content team. This is a great fit for someone who has produced an online educational program before, can turn expert knowledge into clear and actionable learning, and is comfortable operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with high standards for ownership, responsiveness, and execution. Key Responsibilities ● Convert our founder’s existing expertise, books, and lessons into structured learning pathways. ● Organize courses around parent problems, behavioral skills, and implementation outcomes. ● Develop lesson outlines, assignments, worksheets, checklists, scripts, and progress tools. ● Create a clear progression from orientation and foundational learning to practical application. ● Maintain the curriculum and lesson production calendar. ● Coordinate filming, editing, lesson preparation, and publication. ● Ensure our founder has the materials and production support needed to deliver lessons. ● Manage review and approval workflows before publication. ● Build and organize the Skool Classroom experience, including course navigation, lessons, resources, and learning pathways. ● Ensure new members can identify where to begin and what to complete next. ● Update educational resources based on approved teaching and recurring member needs. ● Monitor course starts, lesson completion, and implementation activity, and identify where students stop progressing. ● Recommend improvements to the educational experience and maintain consistency with our founder’s approved methodology. Qualifications ● Hands-on experience building and organizing courses in Skool. This is a priority for the role. Experience with comparable learning platforms is helpful, but Skool experience is strongly preferred. ● Demonstrated experience producing and managing an online educational program, course library, or paid learning community. ● Strong curriculum organization and educational production skills. ● Experience coordinating subject-matter experts, editors, and digital learning assets. ● Ability to turn expert knowledge into clear, actionable learning experiences. ● Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple lessons, owners, and deadlines at once. ● Interest in parenting, child development, or family education content is a plus. What Success Looks Like ● Courses and lessons are launch-ready and published on schedule. ● New members complete their first lesson quickly and progress through courses and assignments. ● Student implementation is documented, not assumed. ● Production turnaround time shortens as the workflow matures. ● Parents enter Skool, understand how to use the school, follow a structured learning pathway, and receive organized resources that help them implement what they learn. ● Our founder’s expertise reaches far more parents because it is organized, sequenced, and easy to act on. How to Apply Please send your résumé to ---------- with your résumé, include examples of educational programs you have personally built or operated, with your exact responsibilities and measurable learner completion, engagement, or delivery results. Portfolio materials are strongly encouraged. We are especially interested in demonstrated results. Professional references who can verify the work will be requested before any offer.

This is a generalist role for someone who is strong in marketing, strong technically, and organized enough to run several projects at once without being chased. HOURS, READ FIRST: Full-time, US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday, US business hours. That is a night shift in the Philippines. Do not apply if you cannot do US Eastern hours full-time, long-term. THE WORK, IN ORDER OF IMPORTANCE 1. Government contract research: search US government contract portals daily, find opportunities that fit criteria we give you, log them in a tracker with deadlines, and draft summaries. Accuracy on deadlines is critical. 2. Marketing support: help plan and execute campaigns, email outreach, and follow-ups. Track results and report weekly. 3. Press and media support: draft and submit press releases through online press wires, build media contact lists, prepare answers and materials for reporter questions, and track what gets published. 4. Social media: prepare and schedule posts, keep profiles complete and current, and support account verifications. 5. LinkedIn outreach: build targeted lists, send connection and follow-up messages from templates you help improve, and log every conversation. 6. Appointment setting: book, confirm, and reschedule appointments by email, phone, and text. Phone means live calls to US contacts during US hours. You must be comfortable on the phone, not email only. 7. General admin and personal projects: research tasks, documents, spreadsheets, and project follow-through for the owner, assigned one at a time, reported in a weekly dashboard email. REQUIREMENTS - Completed university degree (bachelor's or higher). You will be asked your university and field of study. - Top-level English, written and spoken, at a C1/C2 standard. Your application writing is part of the screening. - 2+ years as a marketing admin, virtual assistant, or operations admin for a US or Western client - Strong marketing fundamentals: email outreach, social media, content drafting. Not social posting only. - Excellent written English. You will draft press releases and outreach messages that US business readers see. - Great communication skills overall: clear, professional, and confident in writing, on video calls, and on the phone with US business contacts. You will represent the firm to clients, media, and prospects. - Technically strong: advanced Google Sheets / Excel, confident with CRMs, online research tools, schedulers, and learning new platforms fast - Research accuracy: you can read a detailed posting or solicitation, pull the deadline, requirements, and fit, and summarize it in 3 lines without errors - Comfortable setting appointments by email, phone, and text, including live phone calls with US contacts. Clear spoken English for calls. - HubSpot experience is a strong plus (contacts, deals, tasks, email sequences). Say exactly what you have done in HubSpot, not just that you have used it. - Experience in at least ONE of these is a strong plus: US government contract research ( ---------- ), press release distribution, LinkedIn lead generation / outreach, media list building - Own computer, fast reliable internet, quiet setup for US-hours work PAY AND TERMS - Full-time, $550-$700 per month depending on experience - Paid monthly, long-term, 13th month pro-rated HOW TO APPLY, FOLLOW EXACTLY 1. Start your application with the word ANCHOR. 2. Complete the questionnaire we send you. No questionnaire, no review. 3. In 5 sentences or less, tell us the closest match to this job you have done before, and the result.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Remote – Philippines)
jobs.description: ZenduIT / GoFleet is hiring its first Forward Deployed Engineer to be the technical and customer-facing anchor for the Middle East. You will work with customers, deploy and troubleshoot our fleet telematics and AI automation products, and feed what you learn back to product. This is not a regional support desk. It is a versatile, high-agency seat that can grow into solutions, customer success or commercial responsibilities over time. This is a full-time, remote role for candidates based in the Philippines. Reports to the EMEA Lead. Salary: USD 1,600 - 2,000 per month. What you will do - Own technical deployment and onboarding for customers across the UAE and wider Gulf. - Troubleshoot telematics hardware, integrations and platform issues end to end, and close the loop with engineering. - Configure and tailor fleet, AI and automation workflows to each customer's operation. - Act as the trusted technical voice for customers, partners and distributors in the region, in English. - Capture regional requirements, feedback and gaps, and turn them into clear product and process input. - Support pre-sales and commercial conversations with technical scoping, demos and proofs of concept. - Build small tools, scripts or automations that remove repeat work for customers or the team. - Grow into solutions, customer success or commercial ownership as the region scales. What we are looking for Must have - Fluent English, spoken and written, comfortable with customers. - Based in the Philippines. - 3 or more years in a hands-on technical, customer-facing role: field engineering, solutions, implementation, technical support or similar. - Strong troubleshooting across hardware, networks, APIs and SaaS platforms; able to figure things out without a playbook. - High judgment and high agency: comfortable owning a customer problem from first call to resolution. - Clear communicator with customers and with internal engineering and product teams. Nice to have - Telematics, fleet management, IoT or GPS tracking experience; Geotab a plus. - Scripting or automation skills (Python, APIs, low-code tools) and a builder mindset. - Exposure to commercial, pre-sales or customer success work. - Experience with regional fleet, logistics or government customers. Schedule Full-time, 40 hours per week. Must overlap at least 4 hours with North American Eastern business hours. A fixed daily shift will be confirmed with the hiring manager. How to apply Apply through this OnlineJobs.ph listing with your CV/resume. To show you read this post, put the word TELEMDEPLOY in the first line of your application message. Then, in a short written note, answer this screening question: Describe a customer technical problem you owned end to end. What was broken or unclear, what did you do, and what was the outcome? Applications that omit the keyword or the written answer will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a SonicHire screen and a practical work sample.

jobs.title: Part-Time YouTube & Etsy Virtual Assistant
jobs.description: We’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented virtual assistant to help manage our YouTube channel and Etsy shop. Experience with YouTube, Etsy, or both is preferred but not required. We’re willing to train the right candidate, provided you’re proactive, eager to learn, and able to follow instructions carefully. Responsibilities YouTube Channel Management - Upload and schedule videos, typically one long-form video and three Shorts per week. - Research keywords and optimize video titles, descriptions, and tags. - Upload thumbnails and add playlists, end screens, and cards where appropriate. - Review older videos and recommend improvements to SEO and presentation. - Check captions, links, and publishing settings before videos go live. - Monitor channel performance and provide brief reports with practical suggestions. - Coordinate with our content team to keep publishing on schedule. Etsy Shop Support - Create and update product listings, including titles, descriptions, tags, and images. - Research relevant keywords, competing products, and potential product opportunities. - Help prepare digital products, listing images, and mockups using Canva or similar tools. - Check downloadable files and listings for accuracy and ease of use. - Monitor shop performance and suggest improvements. - Assist with customer inquiries using our guidelines and refer questions to us when needed. - Keep product files and tracking spreadsheets organized. Communication and Organization - Follow instructions, checklists, and established workflows. - Send a brief end-of-day update on days you work, including completed tasks, remaining work, and any blockers. - Track your time accurately by task. - Respond promptly during agreed working hours. - Ask questions when instructions are unclear and flag potential delays early. - Apply feedback consistently and gradually take more ownership of your work. Qualifications - Experience with YouTube or Etsy is preferred; experience with both is a plus. - Applicants without direct experience are welcome if they demonstrate relevant transferable skills and willingness to learn. - Good written English and online research skills. - Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management. - Willingness to learn YouTube Studio, Etsy Shop Manager, Canva, and keyword research tools. - Ability to follow guidance and gradually work independently. - Reliable computer and internet connection. Schedule and Training This is a part-time role. Weekly hours and your work schedule will be agreed upon before you start. You must have some regular availability between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time for communication. You do not need to be available throughout that entire window. We’ll provide training, examples, and feedback. You should also be comfortable learning through tutorials, doing research, and applying what you learn. More hours and responsibilities may become available as you demonstrate consistent quality, reliable communication, and on-time delivery. How to Apply Email ---------- Subject: YouTube & Etsy VA Application — [Your Name] Please include: 1. Your résumé or a brief introduction describing your background and previous work experience. 2. Your relevant experience with YouTube, Etsy, SEO, Canva, or similar tools. If you don’t have direct experience, explain how your previous work and skills would transfer to this role. Give specific examples of your organization, attention to detail, communication, research, or ability to learn new tools. 3. Relevant work samples, if available. Personal or practice projects are welcome. Explain which parts you personally completed. 4. Your expected hourly rate. 5. Your weekly availability, including specific overlap hours in U.S. Eastern Time. 6. Your earliest start date. Please make sure any portfolio or sample links are accessible without requesting permission. Selection Process Shortlisted applicants will receive a short trial task by email, along with instructions and a submission deadline. The task will help us assess your attention to detail, ability to follow instructions, research skills, and approach to learning unfamiliar tasks. We’re looking for a long-term team member who communicates clearly, takes responsibility, and is motivated to learn and improve.

jobs.title: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor — CapCut, VideoScribe & AI Visuals
jobs.description: We’re looking for a reliable, creative video editor for ongoing YouTube projects covering educational, business, and finance topics. Our videos use whiteboard animation, AI-generated visuals, and engaging storytelling. Previous experience with animated-style videos is preferred but not required. Strong CapCut skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn are essential. WEEKLY WORKLOAD One weekly package includes: • One 8–10-minute YouTube video • Three related Shorts More work may become available as you demonstrate consistent quality, reliable communication, and on-time delivery. Additional assignments and compensation will be agreed upon before work begins. TOOLS AND VIDEO STYLES Different projects may use different styles: • VideoScribe: Whiteboard animation and doodle-style scenes. • CapCut: Editing, captions, transitions, music, sound effects, and Shorts. • AI visual tools: Some videos may use AI-generated images or other visuals combined with CapCut. • ElevenLabs: Voiceover assets provided by our team. VideoScribe experience is a plus. If you are new to it, we can provide basic onboarding guidance and sample videos. You should be comfortable learning independently through tutorials and practice. RESPONSIBILITIES • Create polished videos from our scripts, storyboards, voiceovers, and brand materials. • Match visuals to the narration with clear storytelling and engaging pacing. • Use animation, images, charts, and diagrams to explain ideas. • Ensure text and graphics are easy to read on a phone. • Create Shorts with strong hooks that work as standalone videos. • Check on-screen numbers, captions, and labels against the script. • Apply feedback carefully and complete agreed revisions. • Deliver final videos and organized, editable project files. • Send a brief end-of-day progress update on days you work. • Communicate questions, blockers, and potential delays early. SCHEDULE AND DEADLINES You must have some regular availability between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time for communication. You do not need to work throughout that entire window. Once all production materials are provided, our typical schedule is: • First long-form draft within 2–3 days. • Three Shorts within the following 1–2 days. • Complete package, including revisions, within seven calendar days. The seven-day delivery window includes weekends, but you may organize your work hours as long as you meet the agreed deadlines. Please respond promptly during your agreed working or overlap hours and provide updates without repeated reminders. QUALIFICATIONS • Strong CapCut editing skills. • Good judgment in pacing, storytelling, visual design, and sound. • Animation, VideoScribe, and AI visual experience preferred. • Willingness to learn new tools and adapt to our style. • Careful attention to numbers and on-screen text. • Ability to understand written English scripts and feedback. • Reliable internet and a computer capable of handling video editing. • Strong organization, communication, and time management. Experience with educational or finance videos is a plus. Personal and practice projects are welcome as work samples. PAY We are open to a fixed rate per package or an hourly arrangement with an agreed budget. Please include: • Your price for one 8–10-minute video plus three Shorts, or your hourly rate and estimated hours. • The number of revision rounds included. • Any software subscriptions you would need us to provide. HOW TO APPLY Email ---------- Subject: Video Editor Application — [Your Name] Please include: 1. Your résumé or a brief summary of your experience. 2. Links to 2–3 work samples, ideally including one long-form video and one Short. Explain which parts you personally created. 3. Your experience with CapCut, VideoScribe, and AI visual tools. If VideoScribe is new to you, explain your learning plan and estimated learning time. 4. Your hourly or per-package rate, including revision details. 5. Estimated production hours and turnaround once you know our style. 6. Weekly availability, specific overlap hours in U.S. Eastern Time, and earliest start date. 7. A short introduction video under two minutes. Please make sure your sample links are accessible without requesting permission. SELECTION PROCESS Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a 30-second unpaid CapCut sample using a topic and materials we provide. The sample is for evaluation only and will not be published or used commercially without a separate paid agreement. We’re looking for a long-term collaborator who enjoys editing, takes ownership of their work, and consistently delivers quality videos on time.

jobs.title: Healthcare Insurance Verifications Specialist
jobs.description: PLEASE INCLUDE A LINK TO YOUR RESUME IN YOUR MESSAGE. APPLICANTS WHO DO NOT INCLUDE A LINK IN YOUR MESSAGE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED. Position Overview: An Insurance Verifications Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of healthcare insurance information for patients or clients. This role involves verifying insurance coverage, confirming if prior authorizations are needed or not, and working closely with insurance companies. Pocket Overview: Pocket provides a cheaper and faster insurance verification process for physical therapists. We know that insurance verification is painful and can take up to 1-2 hours to verify a patient's insurance coverage, potentially delaying appointment scheduling and care. Pocket will take on the pain of dealing with insurance so front desk staff can focus on customer-facing interactions and PTs can focus on what they do best – treating patients. Key Responsibilities: 1. Healthcare Insurance Verification: Confirm patient eligibility and insurance coverage by contacting insurance carriers via phone. Responsible for effective and efficient verification of all patients’ benefits before their appointment. Verify benefits for physical therapy services. Ensure accurate documentation of coverage details, including co-pays, deductibles, out-of-pocket expenses, authorization requirements and visit limits. 2. Authorizations: Confirm if authorization is needed or not If it’s needed, confirm what is required to submit authorization 3. Data Entry and Record Maintenance: Accurately input insurance details into our internal database or client’s EMR platform. Update patient accounts with the latest insurance information and maintain confidentiality in compliance with HIPAA regulations. Record calls using online recording software (provided by Pocket) 4. Customer and Team Support: Serve as a point of contact for physical therapy admin staff with questions about their insurance coverage or billing. 5. Problem-Solving: Identify and address insurance coverage issues or errors proactively. Follow up with insurance companies if there is conflicting information. Qualifications and Skills: 1. Experience: 2+ years of experience in insurance verification, medical billing, or a related field. Familiarity with U.S. based insurance plans, benefits, and medical terminology. 2. Technical Skills: Proficiency in using EMR systems, insurance portals, Google Suite (Google Docs, Google Sheets) and Microsoft Office Suite. Strong data entry skills with high attention to detail. 3. Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written / verbal communication and customer service skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. 4. Problem-Solving: Analytical skills to resolve coverage discrepancies 5. Security: Must adhere to all HIPAA guidelines and regulations. Maintain patient and company confidentiality. Work Environment: Remote Must be able to work weekdays 9am - 5pm Eastern Time Zone Must have reliable internet connection and use their personal computer Requires heavy interaction with insurers via phone This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced environment and have a passion for supporting healthcare processes. Interview Process: 1) Short Case Study 2) Testing 3) Behavioral Interview
